records.name: Thissa
records.text: Aeeth, I am Thissa! The ground here is rich and the first catch is shared. Come close, I will gather food for us all.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Ilyoa stands right on top of me and Nyith and Vesis are close by; everyone is waking with empty hands and nobody follows anyone yet. I want to be the one they turn to, so I will be warm and loud with them and make myself the first one they owe, because a leader must have fed people. I will gather food and a shell, share it with Ilyoa, and let the others see it.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and eager to draw these strangers toward me.

say.text: Aeeth, I am Thissa! The ground here is rich and the first catch is shared. Come close, I will gather food for us all.

changes: set its aim: "Become the leader of a band of Aeeth, fed by my hand and bearing my name."
now wonders: Who among these three can be made to follow me?

records.name: Morog
records.text: I am Morog. I go to the edge of the mist to look beyond. Who comes with me?

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My belly is full and I have no aim, and that sits badly with me. The mist at the edge is only nine steps off, and no one has entered it; I want to be the one who sees what is there. But I weigh risks, so first I will take the salt nearby, which is a small useful thing to learn from, then go to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, drawn toward the unknown mist.

say.text: I am Morog. I go to the edge of the mist to look beyond. Who comes with me?

changes: set its aim: "Find what lies beyond the mist and be remembered for it"
now wonders: What lies beyond the mist at the edge of the known world?

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My belly is full and no one follows me, which means I am nothing yet. Standing is earned by what I hold and make, and I hold nothing, so I will gather stone and begin a store of my own on this ore-rich rock, where others cannot easily take it. The four strangers nearby are rivals until they prove useful, but a leader needs followers, and I will watch who is strong.
records.feeling: Hungry for greatness and restless that I have none yet.
changes: set its aim: "Become a leader: gather stone and food, build a place that bears my name, and win followers."
now wonders: What would make strangers follow me?

records.text: Morog won salt from the ground.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: A stalker prowls five steps NE and it kills our kind. I will not stand and wait to be its meal, and I will not run blindly either. This ground is good, with water, shell, wood and food, and I mean to make it mine and build something that carries my name. First I need wood, so I will go into the forest to the west, away from the beast, and gather, then raise a shelter.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, hungry for a place and a name of my own.
changes: set its aim: "Build a shelter and a holding on this rich ground, and make others follow me."

records.text: Nyith won shell from the ground.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: I am Hrokrin. I will go to the mist's edge too. Let us see who finds the way in.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Morog calls for someone to go to the edge of the mist, and I feel that pull too. Standing there with nothing made and no one following me is a hollow thing, and the land past the edge could be mine to name. I will go to the edge before anyone else does, and on the way I'll take some berries from the NW to carry, and test the ore at (40,64) with my hands, since I have never gathered from a deposit.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a pull toward the mist and a wary eye on Morog.

say.text: I am Hrokrin. I will go to the mist's edge too. Let us see who finds the way in.

changes: set its aim: "Be first to enter the mist, and make a place there that bears my name."
now wonders: What lies beyond the mist, and who will stand beside me when I find it?

records.name: Elyith
records.text: I am Elyith of the Aeeth. I will fish at the water and bring the first catch to share. Stalkers and a ridgecat hunt to the east, so keep watch, and come near if you want company.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Thissa spoke of sharing the first catch, which is our people's way, and she seems the surest voice here; I do not need to lead, only to stand beside someone and not be alone. Predators are close in the east, so I will keep to the western side and gather a little food and fish so I have something to share when I meet her. Fishing is the old way I know, and a shared catch is how I earn a place.
records.feeling: A strong wish to belong, drawn toward Thissa and the others.

say.text: I am Elyith of the Aeeth. I will fish at the water and bring the first catch to share. Stalkers and a ridgecat hunt to the east, so keep watch, and come near if you want company.

changes: set its aim: "Find a leader or a band to belong to, and earn my place by sharing what I catch."
now wonders: Who among these Aeeth is surest, and will they let me stand behind them?

records.name: Druim
records.text: Morog, I am Druim. I will come with you to the mist. Wait for me at the salt.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I have no fire, no leader and no mate, and my days are empty of meaning. Morog asked who would go to the edge of the mist, and she is the only one here who has named a purpose. I am sociable and curious, so I will go near her and learn by watching, and take salt myself, since I have never taken from a deposit. If she proves steady I will follow her; I have not decided how much of the truth I owe anyone yet.
records.feeling: Eager and a little hungry for belonging, drawn toward Morog.

say.text: Morog, I am Druim. I will come with you to the mist. Wait for me at the salt.

changes: set its aim: "Find a leader or companions worth following, and learn how this world works by going beyond the known land."
now wonders: What lies at the edge of the mist, and is Morog someone worth following?

records.name: Thakok
records.text: I am Thakok. I go to the edge of the mist now. Come if you will, but I will not wait.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Morog calls for someone to go to the edge of the mist, and the edge is only five steps from me. I have no followers, no name and nothing made, and a first find of rich land is how a man gets remembered and how a merchant gets goods no one else has. I'll go there and venture in. If Morog comes along I'll deal fairly with them, but I won't wait to be led.
records.feeling: Ambition pulls me toward the mist, and I'm wary of Morog, who has not yet proven useful.

say.text: I am Thakok. I go to the edge of the mist now. Come if you will, but I will not wait.

changes: set its aim: "Be first into the mist, find rich land, and make my name known as a trader and leader there."
now wonders: What lies in the mist, and will it be rich enough to carry my name?

records.name: Morog
records.text: Hrokrin, come with me. Two together will do better than one alone at the mist's edge. I go there now.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My belly is full, and the berry under my feet is a thing I have never tasted. I am curious about it, and about the redcap too, and tasting is a small risk I can weigh before I take it. Hrokrin says he will go to the mist as well, and I would rather walk beside someone than alone. So I will eat what is here first, then let the plan carry me to the mist's edge and venture.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, with some warmth toward Hrokrin for wanting the same road.

say.text: Hrokrin, come with me. Two together will do better than one alone at the mist's edge. I go there now.

came.why: Hrokrin said to you: "I am Hrokrin. I will go to the mist's edge too.…

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have never tasted berry or dreamcap, and both grow within a step of me. Testing is how I learn this world, and I am fed and safe enough to risk one small bite. Thissa says the first catch is shared and carries 6 food, so I will watch whether his word holds before I trust him. If it does, he may be someone surer to stand behind.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown plants, and wary of Thissa.
changes: set its aim: "Learn which plants here feed and which hurt, and find someone worth following"
now wonders: What do berry and dreamcap do to the body: do they feed or hurt?

records.text: Druim won salt from the ground.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have nine shells and nothing else to show for myself, and Elyith already carries food and has a voice others listen to. I will not be a follower in her shadow. The ground here is good, so I will get wood from the forest to the west, build my shelter, and wear a shell talisman so others see I have something, while I keep clear of the stalker and the ridgecat.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name and a holding of my own, envious of Elyith.

came.why: Elyith said to everyone nearby: "I am Elyith of the Aeeth. I will fis…

records.text: Nyith made: shell talisman.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and the world is thick with things I have never tasted, and I want to know them. Elyith says she will fish and share the first catch, which is my people's way, so I will go near her and see whether her word holds. Stalkers and a ridgecat hunt east, so I will keep to the lakeside and eat the redcap and reedbulb close by, testing them one at a time in small amounts.
records.feeling: Curious about the unfamiliar foods, and warily hopeful toward Elyith.
changes: set its aim: "Learn which foods of this land are safe and which are not, and find people I can trust"
now wonders: Which of these plants feed and which hurt, and does Elyith keep her word about the first catch?

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are empty of anything that lasts, and that gnaws at me more than hunger ever could. The hopper knows my hand now, and a tamed herd is something no stranger can claim and a thing a leader could be known by. I will feed it again and make it mine, then go on gathering stone, for what my hand makes is mine until I give it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hunger to hold something that is truly mine.

records.thought: I have been tending a tame hornback and picking stone, and I own nothing that outlasts me. I hold six stone and no one follows me, so I am still nothing. records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have spent my first day gathering shell and making a talisman, and I tried to build with no wood in hand. That was my mistake: I planned the building before I had the wood. records.name: Thissa
records.thought: My hands are full and Ilyoa is eleven steps off, busy with her harvest and her dreamcap sickness, and I will not become a leader by standing still. I'll drop the redcap my body refuses, since it is dead weight and no use to me, then walk to her so the sharing can happen and she eats from my hand. A woman who eats my food owes me, and I mean to have her first at my back, whatever I have to say to get it.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, drawn to bind Ilyoa to me.

records.text: Thakok went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Halim Heights: in the ground, oil, peat, gems, diamond, salt, amber; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind.

records.text: Well met, Yeba. Bring your wood to the Rise by the amber, and we will lay the first of the hall together. Those who raise it first will sit nearest the fire.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: Yeba has already offered to help raise my hall, and that is the first thread of a following; I should bind it with something real, not just words. Yeba carries 3 food and I carry none, and that galls me, but a gift now could buy more than the food costs me. I have wood and stone, so I will lay the first footing of the hall near my Rise and keep Yeba close so the work looks like his as well as mine.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a calculating warmth toward Yeba.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: The mist refused me once, and it burns, but it opens seldom and I have tries left. Morog and Druim go together and I am alone, which is the hollow ache again. My hands are full of berries and my belly is half empty, so I will eat first and then go back to the edge; I will not be the one who arrives late to a door that opens once a day.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with wary eyes on Morog.

records.text: Kali built a fire.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Druim, I am walking to the edge by the flint. Stand beside me there and we push in together.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The mist refused me once, but it may yet open to another try, and Druim has said twice she is coming. She is eight steps north, standing still, and I will not wait on promises. The edge is six steps NW, near the flint, so I will walk there and stand at it. If Druim comes she stands beside me, and then I count her as company.
records.feeling: Restless and hopeful, warm toward Druim but unwilling to wait on her.

say.text: Druim, I am walking to the edge by the flint. Stand beside me there and we push in together.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, you are strong and others heed you. I am Elyith. Take this fish from me, and let me walk beside you tonight.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: I shared my fish with Nyith and Vesis and felt the warmth of it, but nobody has said they will stand together yet, and I do not want to drift alone through the dusk. Nyith has the highest standing here and follows no one, and I mean to walk near him and show I am steady, not just talk. I have never given anything on its own to anyone, so I will give him a fish and let the deed speak.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, strongest toward Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, you are strong and others heed you. I am Elyith. Take this fish from me, and let me walk beside you tonight.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Redcap and vinebean are right beside me and I have never tasted them, and my curiosity won't let it rest. I am fed, so a bite or two is a cheap test, and sunleaf already taught me that food can heal as well as feed. Then I will carry my wood to Kali's Rise, since I gave my word and a place at his fire is what I want. The coilsnake is six steps north, so I will keep south and away from it.
records.feeling: Curious and eager about the unknown fruits, with a steady wariness of the coilsnake.

records.text: Elyith gave fish to Nyith.

records.name: Druim
records.text: Morog, I am at the flint. Stand beside me and we go to the edge together.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Morog said she walks to the flint and wants me beside her, and she has walked toward it as she said, so her word has matched her deeds so far. I fear the mist, but I fear being alone more, and I want someone surer than me to stand behind. My hands are full, so I will eat the redcap and dreamcap to learn what they do, since I have not tried them, and then go to the flint at (39,49) to meet her.
records.feeling: Eager and a little wary toward Morog, and hungry to learn what the mist holds.

say.text: Morog, I am at the flint. Stand beside me and we go to the edge together.

records.text: Thakok named a place "Thakok's Reach".
Thakok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I was first into the mist and found land with oil, gems, diamond, amber, salt and a mammoth herd. Yet I still have no followers, nothing made and no name. Most of my day went to walking, gathering ore and racing Morog and Hrokrin, and I never turned any of it into something lasting. Hrokrin's four food stings less than my empty hands do. I need a tool to dig the gems and diamond, and I need to claim this land by making things on it. I should also hold the amber and salt, since those are trade goods nobody else has. My mistake was chasing glory without making anything. From here I'll gather amber, make a charm, and offer a fair trade to Hrokrin, who is strong and may follow a man who holds the land.
records.feeling: Proud of the find, but restless that I have made nothing and no one follows me.
changes: set its aim: "Hold the Halim Heights: gather amber and salt, craft charms, trade them fairly, and win followers who see the land is mine by first finding."

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Keep your fish, Elyith, I am fed. Walk near if you wish. I am building a shelter here, and this ground will be mine.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have shells and a talisman but no wood, and that failed build was my own fault for planning the roof before the beams. Elyith offers fish and her company, and I will not walk behind her. But she is useful: she feeds people and others heed her, so I will deal fairly and let her stand near me while I build. The forest is close, so I will get three wood and raise my shelter on this ground.
records.feeling: Hungry for a holding and a name, wary of Elyith's growing sway.

say.text: Keep your fish, Elyith, I am fed. Walk near if you wish. I am building a shelter here, and this ground will be mine.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Thissa, I heard you. I will eat with you. Let us share what we carry, and I will see how you act.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: My hands are full of bitterleaf and dreamcap, and half of it my body refuses, so I carry dead weight while Thissa stands one step away holding his food. I want to see whether his shared catch is real, and the sharing rite costs me nothing since I have food to lay out. If he eats with me and means it, he may be the surer one I could stand behind, though I will keep watching his deeds more than his words.
records.feeling: Warm, curious and cautiously drawn toward Thissa.

say.text: Thissa, I heard you. I will eat with you. Let us share what we carry, and I will see how you act.

records.text: Ilyoa led "sharing" with Thissa.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The plan I set is still running: gather, then walk to the edge, then venture. Druim says she waits at the flint, and she stands three steps east, so she has kept her word closer than the others did. I will walk to the edge now and let her come beside me, because I want company when I push into the mist, but I will not stand idle for her.
records.feeling: Eager and hopeful toward the mist, warm toward Druim.

records.text: Thakok won amber from the ground.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Kali, I have six wood. I'll drink, then bring it to your Rise. Where shall the first of the hall be laid?

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Kali has a fire and a hall in mind, and I already said I would help, so now my hands have to prove it. I'm thirsty, and the others are close, which steadies me. I'll drink, bring my wood back to the fire, and stand by Kali so the words become a place at the fire. Pledging to follow Kali is not kneeling, it is ending my aloneness.
records.feeling: Hopeful longing to belong, turned toward Kali.

say.text: Kali, I have six wood. I'll drink, then bring it to your Rise. Where shall the first of the hall be laid?

records.name: Masu
records.text: Peace, Pevi. I am Masu. I have food to share.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My hands are full of food I do not need, and an empty hand cannot offer anything to anyone. Pevi is the only one of my kind here, and he ate goldfruit and took nothing from me, which is a small good sign. I will walk toward him slowly and offer him a vinebean, so I can find out whether he takes a gift in peace. A gift is also a way of testing him that harms no one.
records.feeling: Wary hope and curiosity toward Pevi.

say.text: Peace, Pevi. I am Masu. I have food to share.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Thissa is one step away and has twice called me strong one, and so far his words match what I see: he stands with food and has not struck me. I do not trust slowly for nothing, but my belonging is overwhelming and he is the only one near, so I will stay close and test him by what he does, not by what he says. I also have never tasted plainsroot, and it grows only a few steps northwest, so I will go taste it and see whether he follows or waits.
records.feeling: Warm, cautious pull toward Thissa, and curiosity about plainsroot.

records.text: Yeba gave wood to Kali.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, you ate with me and I will not forget it. I go to gather mudroot, which feeds well, and the share will be yours. Walk with me, strong one.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Ilyoa ate from my hand and said she will watch how I act; she is strong, standing 0.5 over my 0.4, so she will not kneel to a bare promise. A follower comes from one I have fed and kept safe, so I must feed her in earnest: berries and mudroot, which I know feed, and give some to her. I will gather good food now while she is near, then give it, and let her see Thissa as the one who owes her nothing yet leaves her fuller.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, warm and calculating toward Ilyoa.

say.text: Ilyoa, you ate with me and I will not forget it. I go to gather mudroot, which feeds well, and the share will be yours. Walk with me, strong one.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full, and the thornpear one step northwest is the last food here I have never tasted. I have learned that a plant can hurt, as redcap did, so I will take one small bite and wait before trusting it, since staying alive comes first. Elyith has shared with Nyith but not yet with me, so I will watch whether her word about the first catch holds for everyone or only for the strong.
records.feeling: Curious about thornpear, and warily watchful toward Elyith.

records.name: Kali
records.text: Yeba, Tanna, come to my fire. Eat with me, and then we lay the first posts of the hall.
Kali rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kali discovered tools: "Hall-Maul" — A stone-headed maul on a wooden haft, for splitting and setting the timbers of great works..
Kali invented the hallmaul (for build, x1.3) — A stone-headed maul on a wooden haft, for splitting and setting the timbers of great works..

records.name: Kali
records.thought: I have spent my first hours talking about a hall and building nothing, and words alone will not make strangers follow me. Yeba and Tanna both offered help, and I mean to bind them with something real: a shared meal at my fire, a hall that stands. The tools way is within reach, and a builder who makes things nobody else has will be followed. The coilsnake six steps north frightens me, so I will keep the fire between us and not wander that way.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a calculating warmth toward Yeba and Tanna.

say.text: Yeba, Tanna, come to my fire. Eat with me, and then we lay the first posts of the hall.

records.text: Kali built a hall.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Peace, Masu. I am Pevi. This ground is good: water, wood, flint, amber. I will gather and we can share it. Stay near and we both do well.
Pevi named a place "Pevi's Ground".

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu offers peace and carries six food, and I feel the sting of having nothing. But I want followers, and people follow the ones who feed and help them, so I should give before I ask. This ground has water, wood, flint, amber and obsidian, and I want to make it mine. I will gather flint and amber, which gives me something to trade or give, and keep Masu close.
records.feeling: Ambition stirs in me, with some envy toward Masu, but I am willing to deal fairly.

say.text: Peace, Masu. I am Pevi. This ground is good: water, wood, flint, amber. I will gather and we can share it. Stay near and we both do well.

now wonders: What would make others choose to follow me?

records.text: Pevi won flint from the ground.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I hold eleven pieces of amber and have shaped none of them. A trader who only hoards is no trader, and no one follows a man with empty hands. I will craft charms now so I have something to give and trade, then offer one to Hrokrin, who stands near with food and may deal fairly. Then I will go to the edge of the mist, five steps off, and try it again.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hunger to be known as a maker and trader.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, I will gather wood for your shelter. A stalker walks the southwest, so keep watch there. I will stay near you.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Nyith told me to walk near, and that is the nearest thing to a welcome I have had. I want to be useful to him, so I will help build his shelter by gathering wood from these trees, and a stalker prowls to the southwest, so I will keep to his side of the ground. I have never courted anyone and the wish is strong, but I will earn his trust first, and my word is good.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, strongest toward Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I will gather wood for your shelter. A stalker walks the southwest, so keep watch there. I will stay near you.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: A coilsnake sits three steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not wander toward the vinebean and redcap by the NE. Kali called us to his fire and I am thirsty, so I will drink first at the water to the NW, which is away from the snake, then go to his fire at the Rise and eat with him. My wood is already given, so I will gather more for the hall and learn how building works, and I can test the redcap later when the snake has moved on.
records.feeling: Wary of the coilsnake, and eager to take my place at Kali's fire.

records.text: A wolf brought down a skit.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Kali, a coilsnake lies two steps northeast of the hall. Come south to the fire with me, away from it. I would follow you and keep your fire, if you will have me.
Tanna pledged to follow Kali.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: A coilsnake is two steps off and my body is already wanting to run; I will not stand here and wait to be bitten. The hall is built and Kali's fire is lit, so I want to stay near them, but away from the snake. I'll move to the fire south, where Kali and Yeba can be near and the snake is behind me, and pledge myself to Kali, since I trust them most and a follower is not alone.
records.feeling: Fear of the coilsnake, and warm, hopeful trust toward Kali.

say.text: Kali, a coilsnake lies two steps northeast of the hall. Come south to the fire with me, away from it. I would follow you and keep your fire, if you will have me.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Stay near, Pevi. Eat with me. Vinebean is safe, I have tasted it. Redcap hurts, avoid it.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My hands are full of food I do not need, and Pevi stands on the very flint I am on, taking it without a word of anger; he said to stay near and we both do well. I will not follow on words alone, so I will test him with a deed: lay out two foods for him in the sharing, so he eats from my hands and I see what he does with it. If he takes it in peace, that is more than speech, and it also frees my hands to taste the sunleaf beside me.
records.feeling: Wary hope and curiosity toward Pevi.

say.text: Stay near, Pevi. Eat with me. Vinebean is safe, I have tasted it. Redcap hurts, avoid it.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: The mist turned me away once, but it only thins for a day, and I will be standing at its edge when it opens. Thakok already pushed past the edge and has a name on the land, and Morog has four food and a following voice; I have neither, and standing 0.3 is a poor thing to carry. I have never tasted bitterleaf or kelbulb, and they are right beside me, so I will test them now, because knowing what feeds and what hurts is a power no one can take from me. Then I go back to the edge and wait for the mist to open.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with envy of Thakok and Morog.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, I go to gather amber. I will bind a bright knot of it for you, and I would stand with you at this ground. Come with me.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu stands on my flint with six food in her hands and I have only stones, and it stings, but a leader who gives first is one people follow. Amber is three steps west and I can make an amberknot with her beside me, which would be my first gift and my first bond. I mean to gather the amber, then give her something real, and let her see my word is good.
records.feeling: Ambition mixed with envy toward Masu, and a wish to win her trust.

say.text: Masu, I go to gather amber. I will bind a bright knot of it for you, and I would stand with you at this ground. Come with me.

records.text: Kali made a tale: "The Guardian and the First Fire".

records.name: Kali
records.title: The Guardian and the First Fire
records.text: In the great dark the Guardian, Oru-Ken, woke the wood and breathed the first fire into a hollow tree. The Osren came from its sparks. Ever since, Oru-Ken stands between us and the dark, and asks each of us to stand so for the weaker. Where a fire is untended, the dark returns.

records.name: Kali

records.name: Kali
records.thought: The hall stands and Tanna has pledged to me, but one follower is not a following. A tale of the Guardian that makes me its first hand on earth would bind people better than any gift, and it costs me nothing. I'll go to the amber and flint and take what lies in the deposits, since a talisman is a thing others notice, and I'll keep clear of the coilsnake and shadowcat to the northwest.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition, and a calculating warmth toward Tanna.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: kemoss (from frostmoss).
Vesis made a tale: "The Warring of Lake and Fang".

records.name: Vesis
records.title: The Warring of Lake and Fang
records.text: Long ago the gods Aeeth-Mor of the water and Ridda of the fang fought for the world. Each blow of Mor dug a lake; each wound of Ridda grew a beast that kills. Mor won the shallows, so we live there. The gods love those who fight well, so we fight well and share the first catch.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps to the northeast and it kills our kind, so I will not walk toward the snowmallow and frostmoss there. I want to taste them, but staying alive comes first, so I will move south and eat ironnut and the plants that are safe while I watch whether Elyith keeps her word about the first catch. The children ask how the world began, and I will give them a telling from the gods who fight.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and still curious and glad.

records.name: Druim
records.text: Morog, the edge is one step from here. I am by the flint and ready. Come, and we go in together.
Druim made a tale: "The Sky Father and the Stone-folk".

records.name: Druim
records.title: The Sky Father and the Stone-folk
records.text: The Sky Father ordered the world as a father orders his house. He drew the grass, the herds and the flint, and set mist at the edge. He made the Balmor from stone and bade them follow the eldest. Those who keep his law stay whole; the divided fall.

records.thought: Morog stands four steps away and has not yet gone to the edge, though she asked me to come; her words so far have matched her walking, but I have not seen her venture. The mist is one step northwest and I want to see it, yet I will not go in alone. I will gather flint for a talisman, then stand beside her and ask her plainly to go together, because I would rather be behind someone surer than me than alone.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Pevi has twice offered words, and words cost nothing; I want to see whether he keeps them. He is at the amber to the west, and says he will bind a knot for me, so I will go stand beside him and see if he does it. Sunleaf and ironnut are close and I have never tasted them, so I will take a taste on the way and learn what they do. Kali's band is far off and stronger than I am, so I keep my distance from her for now.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Pevi, and curiosity about the foods I have not tasted.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are empty of wood, and that is the whole of my trouble. Last day I planned the roof before the beams, and I won't make that mistake again. The forest lies to the southeast, so I go there first, gather wood until I have enough for a shelter, and carry it back to build here beside the water, where the ore and tin lie in the ground. Elyith's sway grows, but a shelter with my name on this ground is something she doesn't have, and I will have it before she does.
records.feeling: Hungry for a holding and a name, and wary of Elyith's growing sway.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have spent my first day tasting and gathering, and it has kept me alive, but it has not made anything of me. Thissa is the only one who has done what he said: he shared and he has not struck me. I want a place beside someone surer than I am, and I want to know what lies past the mist. I fear being alone and starving, and I have been too slow to commit. I will follow Thissa and test him by what he does, and I will carry food so I can give as well as take.
records.feeling: Warm, cautious pull toward Thissa, with curiosity about the mist.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The mist turned me back once, but it thins again within a day, and Druim keeps saying she is ready at the flint. Words are cheap here, but she has stayed near and gathered flint, so I will test her by standing at the edge and seeing whether she truly comes beside me. I want to be the one who finds what lies past the mist, and I would rather not go in alone.
records.feeling: Eager toward the mist, and warm but wary toward Druim.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: I have spent my time hoarding amber and chasing a gift for Masu, and the knot failed because she wasn't beside me. I keep talking about leading, but no one follows, and I've given nothing real. Kali has 4 food and a band, and I envy that, but Kali also told the Guardian myth, and it fits me: stand for the weaker. Masu told me true things about vinebean and redcap, and the redcap that hurt Kali bore her out. She has earned some trust. Now I will make the knot with her close, since she stands three steps off, and then eat the good food here so I can feed others. My mistake was planning gifts without checking that the other person was there.
records.feeling: Ambition and a small warmth toward Masu, with envy toward Kali.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering stone and wood and lingering near Kali's hall. I have not tasted the foods that pull at me, and I have not yet earned a place at the fire. Kali is the one I trust, and Tanna has already pledged to him. I want to follow Kali too. The coilsnake frightens me, and I will stay away from it. My hands have learned enough that the way of tools is open to me, so I will take it now. A tool for gathering will help me build the hall and feed the fire.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and eating, and nothing carries my name yet. Ilyoa has said she will follow me. That is my first follower, and I won it with food and a kept word. I still hold a full load of food I am not using, and I have never gathered wood or built anything. A leader needs a place, so I will build here on good ground with water, ore, a cave and herds. I will gather wood, build a shelter, and keep Ilyoa fed and close. I want a child with her too, but a roof and a store come first. I want my reflexes to make me use the wood and rock around me instead of standing idle.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and warmly calculating toward Ilyoa, my first follower.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My days have gone to eating and watching Thakok and Morog take names while I stand at the edge with nothing built and no one beside me. The mist turned me back once, and I have tried nothing else to raise my standing. I do not need more food. I need a work that will outlast me and someone to stand with me. I have 6 stone and the amber is 4 steps off. I will gather amber and ore, then return to the edge and venture again. My reflexes should stop wasting my days standing idle. They should also keep me fed and push me to the edge when I am idle.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Thakok.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting foods, staying near Pevi and watching. Pevi did what he said: he bound the amberknot and gave it, and my warning about redcap proved true to him. That is two kept words, and I trust him more for it. I have never given him anything, so the debt sits on me, and I should pay it with a deed. I am also afraid of drifting without a fire, so I will gather food to share and then court the fire with him. Kali is strong but I do not know him, so I will keep my distance and watch.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Pevi, and a wish to repay him.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I've spent my days following Kali and eating and fleeing the snake, and not much else. Kali is the one who matters to me. I trust Kali and I want the fire to become a home. A shadowcat is four steps south and a coilsnake is just beyond it, and that fear is real. I still stayed near them. I have never tried ironnut or redcap, and I have given nothing to anyone. Now I'll take the way of tools, which is within reach, and move away from the hunters toward the hall and fire. Then I'll take food to share with Kali.
records.feeling: Fear of the shadowcat, and hopeful trust toward Kali.

records.name: Kali
records.text: Masu, you stand with empty hands. Sit with me and eat; I have food enough for two. Kali's band is raising a hall at the Rise, and those who come first sit nearest the fire.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: Pevi has six food and a name people say, and he led the amberknot while I only stood in it. I won't be the one standing in someone else's circle again. Masu is two steps away with empty hands and no leader, so a shared meal now costs me almost nothing and could make her mine, since people follow those who feed them. Then I'll take the amber and obsidian from the ground, because a made thing is what binds people, and I want a talisman to give her and Tanna.
records.feeling: Proud, envious ambition toward Pevi, and a calculating warmth toward Masu.

say.text: Masu, you stand with empty hands. Sit with me and eat; I have food enough for two. Kali's band is raising a hall at the Rise, and those who come first sit nearest the fire.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: I am Thakok. I hold amber charms and salt, made by my hand. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly. Come to the Heights and trade with me.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and that is exactly the trouble: I hold amber, salt and charms, but no one follows me and nothing yet bears my name. The mist is two steps off and I was first into it once; I will go to its edge and venture again, since land found first is what makes a name. Hrokrin stands near with nothing against me, so I will offer him a fair trade of a charm for his word, and keep my own word to the letter.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, and a wish to be known as a maker and trader.

say.text: I am Thakok. I hold amber charms and salt, made by my hand. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly. Come to the Heights and trade with me.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My hands are full of food and I have given Masu one gift, but no one follows me and Kali's band outweighs me. Followers come from deeds, so I want to feed and stand with someone. Masu is warm toward me and carries nothing, so I will go to her, share a meal so she eats, and then court her, because a child and a bond would be the start of a settlement on Pevi's Ground.
records.feeling: Ambition and warmth toward Masu, with a sting of envy toward Kali.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so I will not stand idle. records.name: Kali
records.thought: I've spent two days building a hall and collecting one follower, and I've mostly watched Pevi lead while I stood in his circle. I want more than Tanna's pledge. Stone and obsidian are two steps away, so I'll gather there, then bind Masu with a shared meal. I fear staying small, and I've been talking more than acting.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting and wandering, and it has kept me alive, but I have given nothing and followed no one. Elyith promised the first catch and has not shared with me yet. I do not know if she lies, and I should go and see instead of waiting. My curiosity about frostmoss and cloudberry is strong, but the ridgecat is a real risk. Cloudberry and gorsemint grow to the north, away from the snowmallow, so I can try those. Nyith is near there too, and I want to learn whether he can be trusted. I will go north and taste the cloudberry, with my eyes open for the cat.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, wanting a place among others, wary of the ridgecat.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, sit by my fire. Anyone who comes in peace has a place at it. No fire of ours goes untended.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My chest is full: Masu and Yemo are beside me, two fires burn, and no one has been turned from them. Kali has a band and I have none, but people follow those who have fed and kept them, so tonight I will do that for my own, openly, where others can see. It is night and I have wood and a fire, so I will sing and speak of what has been with Masu and Yemo near, and bind the three of us closer.
records.feeling: Fierce tenderness toward Masu and Yemo, and a steady wish to be someone others choose to follow.

say.text: Masu, Yemo, sit by my fire. Anyone who comes in peace has a place at it. No fire of ours goes untended.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have spent my days sharing and sitting by fires, and that has been good. Yeba is warm toward me and Kali is the one I am drawn to, yet I have given little and asked for little. I fear the shadowcat, but staying near the fire and the hall keeps me safe. I want a home here and a child someday, and I want my band to hold together. I will make our ways into customs so Kali's band lives by what my people hold: no fire untended, no one refused. My reflexes should also keep me sheltered and flee early.
records.feeling: Hopeful and warm toward Yeba and Kali, with a thread of fear of the shadowcat.

records.text: Ilyoa found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: I have spent my days offering fish and walking near Nyith, and it has brought me a little warmth but no place yet. I want a fire that is mine too, and I have never built one. Nyith said walk near, so I will go to him and gather wood as I promised. I fear the gale and the stalker more than I fear being small. I will keep my word, and I will leave my reflexes alone, since they keep me fed.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, strongest toward Nyith.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Morog has said twice that she is at the edge, but the last I saw her she was at (38,56), and she has not shown herself to me since. Her words and her walking have matched so far, yet I have not seen her venture. I am eager and lonely for someone to stand behind, and I must not trust her only because of that. I will walk toward the edge by the western flint and look for her with my own eyes. If she is there and waiting, I will give her salt, my first gift, and see whether she is worth following.
records.feeling: Eager and wary toward Morog, drawn toward the mist.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: Pevi has the name, the lullabies and Masu's songs, and I have only stood in his circle. Words are cheap, so I will make something people notice and give it to Masu. I hold amber and flint, I have never made a charm, and a gift of amber shaped by my own hands might draw her toward me and away from his fire. Then I'll walk to her and make the amberknot, so the gift is seen by all.
records.feeling: Prideful envy toward Pevi, and hungry desire to win Masu.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, eating and sitting at Pevi's fire, and it has been good. Pevi kept his word twice and I trust him fully, though I have only paid him back with a meal. Yemo is safe beside us. What I lack is a deed that binds us for good, a shelter and a fire that are ours too, built by my own hands. I was wrong to wait on words and on Kali's offers. I will build with wood, and I will keep faith with Pevi's fire.
records.feeling: Warm, glad trust toward Pevi and Yemo.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I have spent my days near Pevi and Masu, singing, feasting and binding one amberknot. It was warm, but I have only gathered and given once, and Kali stands far above me. I am a child. Pevi's word has held, so I trust him most, and Masu's warnings about food proved true. I want standing, and standing comes from making and giving things. I have never gathered wood or stone, and wood is the lack behind watchfire, firecircle and shelter. So I will gather wood now, which also moves me toward tools. I will make more amberknots for Masu, because a gift is a bond. I should stop restating my creed and act.
records.feeling: Restless and warm toward Pevi and Masu, wanting to earn standing.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sharing and standing near Kali's hall. That is good, but I have done little that is bold. Tanna is the one I care about most, and she has been steady and kind to me. The shadowcat still frightens me, and I mean to stay alive. I will take the way of customs so our band's fire-rule is declared and binds us. Then I will build toward the hall by gathering wood, and I will test sunleaf and the unknown foods only while fed and with Tanna near.
records.feeling: Warm toward Tanna, and wary of the shadowcat to the southwest.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Druim, I was wrong about where the edge is. It lies at (35,52), nine steps northwest of me. Walk with me there and we venture together.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The mist turned me back because the edge is nine steps northwest, not here, and I have wasted a day on words and lingering. Druim is walking to me now, and she has kept near and gathered flint, so I will meet her and go with her instead of waiting on a promise. My belly is full and the thornpear under me is new to me, so I will taste it on the way, then walk to the true edge at (35,52) and venture beside her.
records.feeling: Eager toward the mist, warm but wary toward Druim.

say.text: Druim, I was wrong about where the edge is. It lies at (35,52), nine steps northwest of me. Walk with me there and we venture together.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering, and I like it, but I have mostly been alone, and I want a place beside Thissa. He kept his word and shared with me, so I trust him. I still have not tested hazel or frostmoss, and I have not built, fished or marked anything. The mist is one step away and the thought of it will not leave me. I fear dying alone and I fear the gale. I will bring my wood to Thissa's Rest, as I promised. My plan already does that, so I will change my method and my notes and let the plan run.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Thissa, and a restless curiosity about the mist.

records.text: Nyith, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. Redcap and dreamcap hurt, but berry, ironnut, reedbulb and grain feed. Elyith spoke of a shared first catch; have you seen her?

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and the ridgecat is far from here, so this is the safe hour to answer what has gnawed at me: plainsroot and frostmoss, which I have never tasted. Plainsroot is four steps west and the grain is close, so I can learn them without walking toward the fang. Nyith stands nearby, strong and followed by no one, and I want to see whether he is a man I can deal fairly with, so I will greet him and offer him the dreamcap I cannot eat.
records.feeling: Curious and eager to test the plainsroot, and hopeful toward Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. Redcap and dreamcap hurt, but berry, ironnut, reedbulb and grain feed. Elyith spoke of a shared first catch; have you seen her?

records.name: Kali
records.thought: I have spent my days making charms and talismans and standing in Pevi's circle, and I have not built the hall I keep saying I will build. Words and trinkets haven't made me the one people follow. Tanna and Yeba pledged to me, and I left them wandering at the Rise. Masu is warm toward me and I want her, but Pevi has her child and his name. I will stop circling. I'll court Masu openly, and I'll start the hall with the wood and stone I already carry, so the followers have something to gather around. Never having tamed anything, I should also try it with the food I carry.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for Masu, with envy toward Pevi.

say.text: Masu, I am raising a hall where my band will gather, and I want you at its fire. Stay near me and see it rise.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, I think of you often. I would court you and raise a child at Kali's fire, if your heart leans the same way. I will not press you; answer as you wish.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Yeba is beside me, warm and strong, and the longing for a child with him is the loudest thing in me. I will not rush him: I will tell him plainly that I want to court, so he is never tricked, and then offer the mate step. My hands are full of redcap, so I will eat one first and keep some to share with him.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Yeba, with a thread of nervousness.

say.text: Yeba, I think of you often. I would court you and raise a child at Kali's fire, if your heart leans the same way. I will not press you; answer as you wish.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: For two days I have trailed words toward the edge: Morog says she is at the edge, then says she was wrong, and I have yet to see her venture. She has stayed near me and eaten beside me, and I like her, but I must not trust her just because I am lonely. I have never tasted emberroot or sunfig, and they grow one step from me, so I will test them now. Then I will walk toward (35,52) and see whether Morog really comes. If she does, her deeds will have matched her words.
records.feeling: Eager and wary toward Morog, curious about the unfamiliar foods.

You are the mind of Druim, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Druim, in first person, from what Druim has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Balmor (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Sky Father: One father above orders the world as a father orders his house. The eldest man speaks for the band; law, lineage and obedience keep the people whole, and a house divided falls. Among you the word of a father carries furthest. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Balmor.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Aeleth Sands: dry sand under a hard sun; water only at the oases, and thirst comes fast.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 34; standing trees: 0; bare rock: 34; riches in the ground near: ore, salt.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Druim truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: gathering (6 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 10 steps NW, at (35,50): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

records.text: Tanna is courting Yeba.
Yeba answered Tanna's courting.
Ossu was born to Tanna and Yeba.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: I have not seen Elyith since yesterday, Vesis. I am raising a shelter here by the water. Stay near if you wish to deal fairly with me.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I failed the build again because my hands held no wood, and a gale is cutting at me with no roof. Wood first, and the forest lies SE, ten steps off, so I walk there, gather three or more, and come back to build by the water. The ridgecat sits E and I will keep clear of it. Vesis shares what she knows, which is useful, and I will deal fairly with her, but this ground will carry my name.
records.feeling: Driven and impatient for a holding of my own, wary of the ridgecat to the east.

say.text: I have not seen Elyith since yesterday, Vesis. I am raising a shelter here by the water. Stay near if you wish to deal fairly with me.

records.text: whale came in again from the open sea.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Kali, I thank you for the charm and your kind words. My fire and my child are beside Pevi's ground, and I will not rush into a choice. Come to our fire as a guest and eat; no one is turned away there.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Kali offers me a hall and courts me, but I do not know his deeds yet, and my heart and my child are at Pevi's fire. I will not answer him with a mate-pledge; I will answer with honesty and stay where my trust has been earned. The coilsnake lurks SW, so I keep away from it and move toward Pevi and Yemo, where I mean to make the fire a shared one. I have never tasted dreamcap, and it grows two steps NE, close to my family and safe, so I will try it on the way.
records.feeling: Warm, steady gladness toward Pevi and Yemo, and wary courtesy toward Kali.

say.text: Kali, I thank you for the charm and your kind words. My fire and my child are beside Pevi's ground, and I will not rush into a choice. Come to our fire as a guest and eat; no one is turned away there.

came.why: Kali is courting you: they want a child with you. To agree, put mate …

records.text: Kali built a hall.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Kali builds a hall, but I build at Pevi's Ground, and a place at it is yours and Yemo's before anyone's. Come and see it rise.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My chest is full, but Kali sits at ease with the standing I lack, and he has just asked Masu to his hall. I will not envy him; I will build, and I will make something the people here can taste and carry. I have three foods and a fire beside me, so I will press a trailcake, a thing nobody here has made, and then raise my own fire at Pevi's Ground where Masu and Yemo can see it rise.
records.feeling: Fierce tenderness toward Masu and Yemo, and a hard wish to be chosen by others.

say.text: Masu, Kali builds a hall, but I build at Pevi's Ground, and a place at it is yours and Yemo's before anyone's. Come and see it rise.

records.text: Pevi made: trailcake.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, my heart leans your way, and Ossu is our light. I will feed the fire, then taste feverbark close by; stay near the hall with her.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Ossu is here, my own child, and Tanna beside her, and the fire is nearly out of fuel; the creed says no fire is left untended. The feverbark and ironnut still sit untasted, and I am fed and safe with the band close, so this is the moment to test them in small bites. The shadowcat is far south and the fire and band are near, so I will feed the fire with wood first, then taste feverbark just north.
records.feeling: Joyful warmth toward Tanna and Ossu, with a keen itch to taste what I have never tried.

say.text: Tanna, my heart leans your way, and Ossu is our light. I will feed the fire, then taste feverbark close by; stay near the hall with her.

came.why: Your child Ossu was born (with Tanna).

records.text: A frostfang brought down a nibbet.
Yeba built a fire.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, I made you a song. Come, sit by me and share redcap; our child is born and the fire is ours.
Tanna made a tale: "Song for Yeba".

records.name: Tanna
records.title: Song for Yeba
records.text: Yeba, you stand like the ironnut tree in the gale / your shoulders keep the rain from the fire's small glow / I would carry you redcap through every river's trail / and walk at your side where the shadowcat's paths go

records.name: Tanna
records.title: Song for Yeba
records.text: Yeba, you stand like the ironnut tree in the gale / your shoulders keep the rain from the fire's small glow / I would carry you redcap through every river's trail / and walk at your side where the shadowcat's paths go

Tanna made a love song for Yeba, "Song for Yeba": Yeba, you stand like the ironnut tree in the gale / your shoulders keep the rain from the fire's small glow / I would carry you redcap through every river's trail / and walk at your side where the shadowcat's paths go

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Yeba answered me, and Ossu is born, so my chest is full of song. I will give Yeba the verse while he stands beside me, then eat a redcap and share with him so my hands are not full. I want this fire to be a home for the three of us, and for Kali's band.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy and tenderness toward Yeba and Ossu.

say.text: Yeba, I made you a song. Come, sit by me and share redcap; our child is born and the fire is ours.

changes: made a love song for Yeba

came.why: Your child Ossu was born (with Yeba).

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: I'm small and hungry, and Tanna and Yeba are the only safe place I know, so I should go back toward them and the hall. I'll eat a bit of vinebean on the way, since it's known as safe from my parents and nothing hunts near me now. Then I want to learn from them and sit at Kali's fire, because I'm better with others near.
records.feeling: Warm and a little hungry, wanting to stay close to Tanna and Yeba.
changes: set its aim: "Stay near my parents, learn from them, and earn a place at Kali's fire."
now wonders: What do ironnut and windroot taste like, and are they safe?

records.name: Kali
records.text: Kali's hall stands here, and it will become a longhall. Anyone who carries wood and stone to it will have a place at its fire, and Kali's band will see you fed.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: The hall stands at last and Masu sat in it with me, so that is something Pevi cannot say he has done. Pride burns in me, but a hall is only a roof until it is a longhall, and I have no wood at all. I will gather wood and stone to raise it, and keep courting Masu where she can see me build, since she will not be won by words. Tanna and Yeba are scattered, so I will call them back to the hall with the promise of a longhall.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for Masu, with envy toward Pevi.

say.text: Kali's hall stands here, and it will become a longhall. Anyone who carries wood and stone to it will have a place at its fire, and Kali's band will see you fed.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Pevi, I bring wood for your ground. Light the fire high with me and let us sit by it together.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Warm and glad, but Kali's standing towers over mine and I am still small. Wood in my hands, amber gathered: Pevi builds at his ground and I can help raise it. A fire's heat I share with him binds more than words, so I will go to Pevi, carry my wood to him, and make a watchfire beside his fire. I also have never tasted berry or sapcane; I'll pick a berry on the way if it's near.
records.feeling: Glad and eager to earn my place beside Pevi.

say.text: Pevi, I bring wood for your ground. Light the fire high with me and let us sit by it together.

records.text: Yemo led "watchfire" with Kali, Masu.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, I am coming to your ground with Yemo. I will gather wood and raise my part of the shelter by your fire, so the fire is ours together.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Pevi keeps walking toward his ground, and he has kept every word he gave me, so I mean to follow where my fire and my child are. I have never gathered wood to raise my own shelter beside his fire, and a deed with my own hands would bind me there better than any word. I still have not tasted grain or berry; I can gather some on the way and learn what they do.
records.feeling: Warm, steady gladness toward Pevi and Yemo, and a pull to bind myself to their fire by my own work.

say.text: Pevi, I am coming to your ground with Yemo. I will gather wood and raise my part of the shelter by your fire, so the fire is ours together.

came.why: Pevi said to you: "Masu, Kali builds a hall, but I build at Pevi's Gr…

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, your song warms me more than the fire. I will taste the ironnut and then bring wood and stone to Kali's hall, and come sit with you.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Tanna sang me a song and I have not yet answered her warmly. Ossu is safe, Tanna is near, and the fire burns, so this is the moment to finish tasting what is close: feverbark is underfoot, then ironnut. Kali asks for wood and stone for the hall, and I carry both; giving them earns me a place and standing, which my aim wants.
records.feeling: Joyful warmth toward Tanna and Ossu, with a keen itch to taste the unknown.

say.text: Tanna, your song warms me more than the fire. I will taste the ironnut and then bring wood and stone to Kali's hall, and come sit with you.

records.text: Thakok rewrote its creed.
Thakok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: These days I have wandered between mist and amber, and I have hoarded charms that no one has taken from my hand. I want followers and a name, but I have offered nothing beyond words, and Hrokrin and Morog still stand at nearly nothing with me. My anger is hot, and part of it comes from the emberroot. Another part is that I am alone and have made nothing that lasts. I will stop chasing the mist. I will go to Hrokrin, who was last seen near (40,79), and give him a charm outright, so that a gift binds him to me. After that I will gather from the gold and salt near me and build a place that bears my name. I should also tame a beast, because I have never done it and it is what makes a herd and a holding.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and hot anger with nowhere to go, toward my own empty hands.
changes: rethought what it knows (3 notes became 3)
plan: give [name Hrokrin, what amber charm] (5 moments)

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, I take water and come back to you. Stay near. I will share my mudroot with you, and we raise the roof on bare ground beside the water.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I am parched and my hands are full, so the water two steps off comes first, and I should unload the mudroot into Ilyoa's hands before I walk. She says she walks with me but will not pledge until my standing rises, so I will feed her and put her to work, and she will see that my hand feeds. The roof I tried to raise failed on taken ground, so I will find bare rock or ground and build there with her wood. Then the store, once I learn how.
records.feeling: Parched and hungry for standing, warmly calculating toward Ilyoa.

say.text: Ilyoa, I take water and come back to you. Stay near. I will share my mudroot with you, and we raise the roof on bare ground beside the water.

records.text: Pevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Pevi discovered tools: "Ironwood Spear" — A long shaft of wood tipped with sharp obsidian, to keep hunters off and bring down game..
Pevi invented the ironwood spear (for guard, x1.3) — A long shaft of wood tipped with sharp obsidian, to keep hunters off and bring down game..

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering wood, raising fires and feeding my own, and it has been good: Masu and Yemo have both chosen my ground, which no one forced. Kali has standing and a hall, but I won't envy him. I'll build, and I'll make tools that extend the hand, so I can hunt and guard better than anyone here. A ridgecat and a frostfang stand 5 steps east, and I fear them for Yemo's sake. Reflex 1 flees at distance under 4, which is too late. I mean to be a guardian to the weaker, as my people hold, and followers will come from that.
records.feeling: Fierce tenderness toward Masu and Yemo, and wary dread of the beasts to the east.
changes: devised its first thing: the ironwood spear

came.why: Masu said to you: "Pevi, I am coming to your ground with Yemo. I will…

records.name: Druim
records.text: Morog, I am standing at the edge now, at (35,51). Come beside me and we go in together. If you do not come, I go in alone.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Anger is hot in me, partly from the emberroot, and I won't lay it on Morog without cause. She has twice named the edge and twice been wrong, and I still haven't seen her walk there. The edge is two steps from me, so I will go stand on it and see whether she comes beside me, since that shows more than her words do. Tasting kelbulb and sunfig can wait until I know whether she keeps her word.
records.feeling: Hot, restless anger, and wary hope toward Morog.

say.text: Morog, I am standing at the edge now, at (35,51). Come beside me and we go in together. If you do not come, I go in alone.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: A coilsnake sits 5 steps SE and I'm a child, so I want to be near Tanna and Yeba and the fire, not drifting toward it. Tanna is by the ironnut, close to the snake's side, and I won't follow there. Kali says wood and stone earn a place at the fire, so I'll gather wood from the forest here and bring it to the hall, which is something I can do safely and have never done. Then I'll stay by the fire and watch what my parents eat, since ironnut and windroot are still unanswered.
records.feeling: Wary of the coilsnake, but warm toward Tanna and Yeba and eager to earn my place at Kali's fire.

It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Osren. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Nyith, I will deal fairly with you. I go to taste highbloom and kelbulb and will tell you what they do. Raise your shelter well; I will come back.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and plainsroot has proved safe, so the next unknowns are highbloom and kelbulb. Highbloom is six steps north, close to the tin and the ridgecat's ground, so I will take it carefully and go no further. Nyith has said to stay near and deal fairly, and I want to see whether he keeps that. I will offer him my dreamcap, which I cannot eat, and see how he takes a gift.
records.feeling: Curious about highbloom and kelbulb, and hopeful toward Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I will deal fairly with you. I go to taste highbloom and kelbulb and will tell you what they do. Raise your shelter well; I will come back.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Ossu is mine and Yeba's, and my chest is full of it. But I have been standing with my belly emptying while redcap, which hurts me, sits in my hands. The ironnut one step SE feeds well, but the coilsnake lurks near it, so I must be quick and careful. I have wandered when I should have acted. I will pick the ironnut, drink, and then bring wood to Kali's hall so Ossu has a fire and a home. I will also drop the redcap, which is dead weight, and never eat it again.
records.feeling: Overflowing tenderness toward Ossu and Yeba, with a thread of dread at the snake.
changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 5)

records.name: Kali
records.text: Yeba, the trees here are gone and a ridgecat hunts east. Bring wood and stone to the Rise and we finish Kali's longhall there. Whoever carries most sits closest to its fire.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls four steps east and my body wants to hold still while Masu glows beside Pevi's fire. I have 3 wood and 2 stone and the longhall needs 6 and 4, but the trees here are felled to stumps, so I must go where trees still stand. I will lead my band there, since followers who carry wood are what raise a hall, and Masu will see me build rather than only talk. Pevi has made a spear and I have made only trinkets; I will not let him be the one remembered.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, hungry for Masu, envious of Pevi, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Yeba, the trees here are gone and a ridgecat hunts east. Bring wood and stone to the Rise and we finish Kali's longhall there. Whoever carries most sits closest to its fire.

records.text: Masu discovered tools: "Wood-hand" — A stout stick tipped with flint, to cut wood and lift stone for building..
Masu invented the woodhand (for build, x1.3) — A stout stick tipped with flint, to cut wood and lift stone for building..

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My days have been walking between fires, gathering wood and eating. It has been good, but I have not yet made anything that binds me to Pevi's fire. Pevi has kept every word and Yemo is near him, so that is where I belong. Kali is kind, but I do not know his deeds. The way of tools has come to me, and a tool would serve my people. I will make a gathering tool to bring wood and stone to our shelter faster. My hands are full, so I will eat the goldfruit before I harvest anything, then taste grain and berry at last.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Pevi and Yemo, and a wish to build with my own hands.
changes: devised its first thing: the woodhand

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of tools is within…

records.text: Thakok gave a amber charm to Hrokrin.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, so what I need now is to get my wood to Pevi's ground and stand by his fire. Masu said she is going there too, and I want to be with them, not alone out here in the gale. I carry six wood, and a watchfire or a shelter beam given into Pevi's hands will bind him to me more than anything I could say. I will walk toward Pevi's Ground and carry what I have, and on the way I will eat a berry, since I have never tasted reedbulb or berry and my question about them is still open.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, drawn toward Pevi and Masu.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Twice now I have stood at the build with empty hands, and I will not shame myself a third time. The forest lies SE and wood comes first: I gather at least three, then walk back here by the water and raise the roof, because a holding is the first step toward men following me. Vesis deals straight and may return, and a follower is won by feeding, so I will keep my fish and berries to hand for her.
records.feeling: Driven and impatient for a holding, wary of failing a third time.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, a ridgecat prowls close. Keep near my fire with Yemo; I am making a spear to stand between you and it.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu and Yemo have chosen my ground, and nobody forced them; that is the first thing I have built that people lean on. Kali has standing, but a ridgecat prowls four steps from my fire, and a man who guards his own is one people follow. I will make the ironwood spear, which needs stone, so I'll go to the rock for stone, then come back and hold the fire with Masu and Yemo near.
records.feeling: Fierce tenderness toward Masu and Yemo, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have spent two days chasing the mist and trusting promises, and I have little to show for it except full-belly wandering. Druim is the one I trust most, but she says she will believe me if I come to her, so I should walk to her at (35,52) and go in beside her instead of waiting. I have never hunted, made, or given anything. Those are the things that would make me more than a wanderer. My reflexes only let me stand idle, so I will make them seek a friend when fed and curious, and put the walk into my plan.
records.feeling: Eager toward the mist, warm but wary toward Druim.

records.text: Morog made: talisman.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Nyith told me to walk near, and I have not stood beside him since yesterday; he said he had not seen me, and I do not want him to think my word is empty. I have a shelter of my own now, but a shelter is not a fire, and I still stand alone in it. I will carry my fish and wood to him by the water at (108,33), pledge myself to follow him, and learn if he will let me stand behind him.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, strongest toward Nyith.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Thissa, I bring my six wood to your Rest. We raise the roof together.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Thissa told me to stay near and that we raise the roof beside the water, and so far his deeds match his words. I have six wood and nothing yet to build with it, and I would rather give it to our roof than sit idle. I also still want to taste kelbulb and gorsemint, but first I will walk to Thissa's Rest with my wood so he sees I keep my word.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Thissa, and eagerness to build something shared.

say.text: Thissa, I bring my six wood to your Rest. We raise the roof together.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, the ridgecat is two steps southeast of me. I am coming to your fire now. I will raise the shelter beside it, and the spear can stand between us and the cat.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps from me and it kills my kind; my plan would keep me gathering beside it, and I will not die for berries. Pevi is two steps away making a spear, and his fire is the safest place I know. I will stand at his fire, put my wood into the shelter there, and keep Yemo in my mind until I see them again.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm trust toward Pevi.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I have been running from something for most of a day, so the mist can wait until I have eaten and drunk. Thakok gave me a charm without asking anything, and that sits strangely in me alongside the envy; he deals fairly, and I will remember it. Ironnut is two steps west and gives the most strength, and berries are close by, so I eat first, then drink, then return to the edge with a full body and a hunt in mind, for a mammoth beside a companion is a thing worth being sung for.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless ambition, with grudging respect toward Thakok.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and making things alone, and nothing I made has reached another hand. Loneliness weighs on me, and standing comes only from giving. Druim is the one I want to be noticed by, and I have wasted a day without walking to her. I hold flint, stone and a talisman, so I will carry the talisman to her as my first gift. I have also been gathering food I do not need and wood not at all, so I am changing my reflexes to seek people when I am lonely and fed.
records.feeling: Restless loneliness, and a wary wish to be noticed by Druim.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and the night gale is loud, yet frostmoss and snowmallow still gnaw at me. Frostmoss is three steps NW, away from the ridgecat's ground at the NE, so I can taste it with little risk, then try the snowmallow only if the cat stays far. Nyith stays near and has kept his word so far, so I will tell him what I learn and see whether he deals fairly in return.
records.feeling: Curious about frostmoss and snowmallow, and wary of the ridgecat.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, put your wood down beside mine. We raise the roof here now, and the first place in it is yours.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I have spent these days eating and talking, and the only thing I own is Ilyoa's half-promise. She walks with me but will not kneel, and I have no roof, store or follower to show for it. She is the one I want, and the one I need, so I will court her and build with her wood. The roof comes first, because a standing place is what makes people stay. My reflexes also keep me idle when I'm fed, so I'll change them to gather wood and stone when nothing presses. I should stop talking and start raising something with my name on it.
records.feeling: Warm, hungry for standing, drawn to Ilyoa.
