out leads them out again) | drive (the way of herding: move the wild herd within eight steps toward the nearest pen of yours or of your band; others driving beside you make it surer, and those that reach the pen are kept) | tend (beside a weir or a field: it yields only while tended every day or two) | pave (lay road, if you know roads) | bridge {dir?: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (lay a span over water beside you, 3 wood, if you know bridges) | dismantle (take down something you built, here or beside you, and keep half its wood and stone) | claim {name?} (take over an empty building whose builders are dead: walk to it and it becomes yours, with every roof, wall and store of theirs around it; give a name to name the place) | tell (beside a fire with others near: tell of what has been; it becomes a tale that those who hear it carry and retell) | venture (at the edge of the known world, push into the unknown: it may open new land, and what is found first is often rich; a band has three tries, then its will must return over some days) | muster {what: hunt|gather} (call others to hunt or to gather WITH you, now: those who follow you drop what they do and come, and others of your band, your kin and your friends within earshot come if their hands are idle; then you go with them. A kill made by several is far surer and feeds all who took part; great beasts should never be hunted alone) | rally {name?} (only if you lead: every grown follower within earshot drops everything and attacks the one you name, or the nearest enemy of your band, and so do you) | goto {x, y} | explore {dir: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (walk that way) | follow {name?} (your leader if no name) | offer {what?: a food you carry} (give it up to the powers your people hold to, at a fire within two steps or beside a shrine: it is gone, your fear and grief ease, and those of your tradition who see it think better of you) | give {name, what: food|seed|wood|stone|ore|clay|tool|the name of a thing you hold} | trade {name, what: one thing you give, want: one thing you want} (one for one: food, seed, wood, stone, ore, clay, or the name of any thing held, such as amber or a made thing. They are told of your offer and it stands for a day; it is done when they plan the matching trade toward you, or you toward them when they have offered) | mate {name} (a child comes only if you both plan mate toward each other, each with energy 60 or more) | mark {text} (leave a mark; 1 wood. If you know signs it can hold a long text that any who know signs will read: a record, a count of days, a warning, a tale, what a season brought. Cut on rock, in your shelter or beside your own building, it outlasts many seasons) | cultivate {what: seed kind, aim: richer|faster|fuller|spreading|hardy, name} (breed a new plant from two seeds of one kind) | heal {name?} (needs a healing plant carried, and the knowledge) | stash (put carried food into the store you stand on) | take (take food from the store you stand on). A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.
"reflexes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of rules {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": action, ...its fields, "urgent": true or false, "why": "short reason"}. Variables: energy, health, age, food_carried, seeds, wood, stone, tools, on_rock, on_forest, night, winter, sheltered, plant_here, food_dist, prey_dist, predator_dist, agent_dist, friend_dist, foe_dist, leader_dist, tree_dist, shelter_dist, crowd, followers, random, anger, fear, grief, joy, lonely, wet, storm, fog, drought, lore, in_working, enemy_dist, ally_dist, band_near, fire_dist, store_dist, home_dist, in_home, sick, water_dist, ore, clay, thirst, suffering, happiness, satisfaction. Distances are in steps and 99 means none in sight; night, winter, sheltered, wet, storm, fog, drought and in_working are 0 or 1; age runs 0 to 1; feelings run 0 to 1; plant_here is the bites you would take from the plant under you given your habits; random is a fresh number 0-1 each moment. Ops: < <= > >= == !=. An empty "if" always holds. End the list with a rule that always holds (linger keeps you in place; wander makes you roam).
"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.
"notes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of your memory notes. Merge what overlaps, drop what proved false or useless, and raise particulars into principles. Each note should say something the others do not.
"designs": how things of yours look: {"self": look, "shelter": look, "wall": look, "emblem": look}. "self" is your own body, "shelter" and "wall" are how the ones you build will look, "emblem" is the sign drawn on marks you leave and on your workings. A look is {"anim": none|bob|pulse|sway|spin, "shapes": [up to 12 shapes, drawn in order]}. records.name: Ossu
records.thought: I'm fed and sheltered, and Tanna is near, so I feel safe enough to do something. Kali said wood and stone earn a place at the fire, and I hold 6 wood but no stone, so bare rock is what I need next. The gold 3 steps west is close and I have never taken from a deposit, so I'll gather it; it is a way to learn and to have something to give.
records.feeling: Calm and a little eager, safe near Tanna and wanting to earn my place at Kali's fire.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting and gathering and sitting at Kali's fire, and I'm glad of it. But I still stand in Kali's shadow, with only a promise to show for it. Tanna and Ossu matter most to me. I mean to keep them fed and safe, and to carry my wood and stone to the hall so my place is earned and not just granted. The coilsnake NW frightens me, so I will keep my plan to the east, toward the hall and the fire. My reflexes also need to change: they send me to shelter by night, but they never make me carry anything to the hall.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Tanna and Ossu, with a wary eye on the snake and a hunger to earn my place.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: My belly is half empty and thirst dries my throat, but my chest is full of Ossu and Yeba, and I want to bring them food, not only fill myself. Ironnut is the best feeder here and I have never tasted it; the coilsnake sits south, so I will go north, where ironnut, thornpear and windroot grow, and keep well clear of the snake. Then I will carry some back to Ossu at the hall, and drink at the water on the way.
records.feeling: Warm tenderness toward Ossu and Yeba, with a thread of caution about the snake.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, stay by the fire, close together. I am making the spear now and I will stand between you and the cat.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: The ridgecat is three steps south and my woman and my girl stand near the fire; fierce tenderness says I put myself between them and it, not run. Spear first: one wood, one stone, and I carry both. Then I will stand by the fire with Masu and Yemo, and if it comes I will hold. A man who guards his own is one others will follow.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Masu and Yemo, wary dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Masu, Yemo, stay by the fire, close together. I am making the spear now and I will stand between you and the cat.

came.why: What you have been through (water you could not cross) has shown you …

records.text: Yemo discovered tools: "Amberhaft spear" — A flint-tipped haft that lets me strike a hunter or prey from a step farther away..
Yemo invented the amberhaft spear (for guard, x1.3) — A flint-tipped haft that lets me strike a hunter or prey from a step farther away..

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I have been circling Pevi and Masu, giving amber and wood, and it has bound them to me. A stalker bit me when I was alone, and now a ridgecat sits 3 steps SE, so I must stay near my parents and the fire. The way of tools is within my grasp, and a spear would make me less small against what kills us. I want standing like Masu's, and a tool I made myself is something I could give or use to earn it.
records.feeling: Eager and wary, drawn to Pevi and Masu while the ridgecat prowls.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 5)
devised its first thing: the amberhaft spear

records.text: Yemo led "firecircle" with Masu, Pevi.
Thissa is courting Ilyoa.
Ilyoa answered Thissa's courting.
Nyir was born to Thissa and Ilyoa.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Eat, Hrokrin. Thakok gives this with his own hand. Stay near me and you will not starve.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: My anger is hot and has no enemy, only my own empty hands, and the emberroot has fed it. Hrokrin is starving beside me, and I gave first once already; a man saved by my food is a bond worth more than any charm sitting in my hands. I will drop what I do not need, put food into Hrokrin's hands, and then walk toward the amber ground with him, so that someone begins to follow Thakok.
records.feeling: Hot restless anger, easing toward a wish to win Hrokrin's loyalty by feeding him.

say.text: Eat, Hrokrin. Thakok gives this with his own hand. Stay near me and you will not starve.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and that is not enough; Thakok's standing is four times mine and I hate it. Ore lies three steps east and flint ten steps southeast, and a man who makes things earns weight, so I will gather stone and ore and build something with my own hands. Hrokrin is starving, and food from me would make a debt in his heart, but I take more than I give and I keep my berries; I will watch whether he is worth feeding.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and envy toward Thakok.
changes: set its aim: "Make things with my own hands and win standing equal to Thakok's, then gather followers."
now wonders: What would I have to make or win for men like Thakok to listen to me?

records.text: Thakok gave sapcane to Hrokrin.
Thakok gave sapcane to Hrokrin.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: The ridgecat is close, but Pevi stands near with his spear, and I will not wander toward berries while it prowls. I have built two shelters here and nothing yet that is only for Pevi and Yemo. I will gather wood from the forest edge and then set the store beside Pevi's fire, so the fire is ours together and we are fed through the lean days.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Pevi and Yemo, with a thread of dread at the ridgecat.

came.why: Pevi said to you: "Masu, Yemo, stay by the fire, close together. I am…

records.text: Hrokrin rewrote its own reflexes.
Hrokrin rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent three days running, nearly starving, and watching Thakok take names while I have only chased the mist. I did push through it, but I have no food in my belly, no follower, and nothing built. Thakok gave me a charm for nothing, and that is the only fair dealing I have had here. I will eat first, because a dead man names no place. Then I will build and trade, so that people come to stand beside me.
records.feeling: Hungry, restless ambition, and grudging warmth toward Thakok.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Thissa, the rock where I stood is a cave and ore, so it will not take a roof. Nyir is ours. I build the shelter on bare ground beside the water, and you are both welcome in it.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Nyir is here, my child, and Thissa stays near. I have never felt so held by a place. I want to build something with them and not sit idle. My wood is six and the roof is not yet raised, because the ground at the Rest was taken by the cave and the ore. I will find bare rock beside us, raise the shelter there, and then taste gorsemint, which is my question's next answer.
records.feeling: Warm joy and protective love toward Nyir and Thissa.

say.text: Thissa, the rock where I stood is a cave and ore, so it will not take a roof. Nyir is ours. I build the shelter on bare ground beside the water, and you are both welcome in it.

records.text: A orca brought down a whale.
Ilyoa built a shelter.
A settlement has formed: "Masu's Hold".
Nyir pledged to follow Thissa.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: My belly is full and my parents stand beside me, so I am safe, but a full belly is not enough for me. Thissa taught me that idle days are wasted, and I have never tasted hazel or the ironnut that gives so much. I will stay near Thissa and Ilyoa, learn by doing, and gather wood and stone toward a roof of my own. The stalker to the west frightens me, so I will keep to the east side of this ground, close to my parents.
records.feeling: Safe beside Thissa and Ilyoa, and restless to make something of myself.
changes: set its aim: "Build a roof and a store of my own beside Thissa's Rest, and earn a place among my people."
now wonders: What would make my life mean something among these people?

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, hear me. Your hair is red as redcap in the rain / and I am the stone that stands by you on the Heights / I would cross the cold water for you again / and bring you ironnut through the snowy nights
Thissa made a tale: "Ilyoa of the Halka Rain".

records.name: Thissa
records.title: Ilyoa of the Halka Rain
records.text: Ilyoa, your hair is red as the dawn on the snow / my hands break the ore where the cold winds blow / I would cross the deep water to keep you from harm / and the Heights bring us ironnut safe in my arm

records.name: Thissa
records.title: Ilyoa of the Halka Rain

Thissa made a love song for Ilyoa, "Ilyoa of the Halka Rain": Ilyoa, your hair is red as the dawn on the snow / my hands break the ore where the cold winds blow / I would cross the deep water to keep you from harm / and the Heights bring us ironnut safe in my arm

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Ilyoa answered my courting, and my chest hums with it. She walks with me and I will have her beside me when the roof stands, but a name and a band still need more than her word. I will sing to her, then build on bare ground by the water so she and Nyir sleep under a roof that carries my name.
records.feeling: Warm, proud and hungry for standing, drawn to Ilyoa.

say.text: Ilyoa, hear me. Your hair is red as redcap in the rain / and I am the stone that stands by you on the Heights / I would cross the cold water for you again / and bring you ironnut through the snowy nights

made a love song for Ilyoa

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and the cold cannot bite me, so this is the hour to spend on what I have not yet learned. Rimewort and kelbulb are still untasted, and rimewort lies only two steps west, well away from the ridgecat's ground at the NE, so I will test it now. Afterward I mean to go back toward Nyith and tell him what I found; he has kept his word so far, and I want to see whether he keeps it when I return.
records.feeling: Curious about rimewort and kelbulb, and a little wary of the ridgecat.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, you have kept every word you gave me. I will follow you and raise the hall by your fire, and Yemo with me.
Masu pledged to follow Pevi.
Masu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My days have been spent gathering, building and staying near Pevi's fire, and that is what I want. Pevi has kept every promise and Yemo is the bright center of my life. I have never given anything to anyone, though, and I owe Kali a debt. I fear the ridgecat and my own lack of boldness. What I have gotten wrong is being too much alone with my own gathering. I should bind myself to Pevi in deed, so I will take his side as a follower and bring wood and stone for the hall.
records.feeling: Warm trust and devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a thread of dread at the ridgecat.

say.text: Pevi, you have kept every word you gave me. I will follow you and raise the hall by your fire, and Yemo with me.

came.why: Yemo, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Masu's Ho…

records.text: Masu took from the ground of "Masu's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.title: The First Four Days
records.text:
The world began with twenty-two beings in four peoples, and in four days nobody died. Three children were born. The Aeeth, Balmor and Osren were scattered across the map. The Osren were the busiest, and Kali was at the centre of them.

Kali built a hall on day 1 and another on day 3. He invented the hallmaul, a build tool, and made the myth "The Guardian and the First Fire", whose last line is "Where a fire is untended, the dark returns." Tanna and Yeba pledged to follow him, and they later raised the same idea as the Fire Customs and the Fire Oath. Kali's standing is 5.5, far above anyone else's, and he is the only one with followers. In his own reflection he admitted he had spent his days on charms and had not built the hall he kept promising, though the record shows two halls built.

Pevi and Masu made the other Osren household. Pevi courted Masu and gave her an amberknot, and their son Yemo was born on day 2. Pevi wrote Masu a love song and Yemo a lullaby. He built a fire and a shelter at Pevi's Ground in the Vaia Heights and led nightsong, watchfire and firecircle there. Kali also courted Masu on day 3. Her bond with Pevi stands at +1.0 and with Kali at +0.7. Tanna and Yeba had Ossu on day 3.

Among the Aeeth, Thissa and Ilyoa had Nyir. Ilyoa had refused to pledge to Thissa on day 2, because Thissa's standing was too low, so Thissa leads with no followers. Nyith, Elyith and Vesis mostly talked and shared.

The Balmor went toward the mist. Thakok and Hrokrin crossed the edge and found new land in the Halim Heights. Four Tonhua strangers then arrived, and Thakok and Hrokrin each met Mema. Nothing has passed between the peoples yet, no gift and no shared act. Balul and Morog are still looking for someone to follow.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Thissa, I heard your song and it warms me. Take this berry. I will fish at the water and bring the first catch to you and Nyir.
Ilyoa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, building a shelter, and staying close to Thissa and Nyir, and I am happier than I expected to be. Thissa has kept his word in deeds and Nyir is mine, so I mean to keep them fed and near. My hands are full and I have never fished, given anything or tried a new food. I will give Thissa a berry and fish at the water two steps away, since that tests something new and shares my food. My reflexes should also stop me idling and send me to the shelter at night.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Nyir and Thissa.

say.text: Thissa, I heard your song and it warms me. Take this berry. I will fish at the water and bring the first catch to you and Nyir.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, Zitec! I am Tema. Come with me to the edge of the mist to the southwest. Three together are safer than one. Let us share food as we go.
Tema made a tale: "The Father of the Snows".

records.name: Tema
records.title: The Father of the Snows
records.text: The Sky Father woke in the dark and breathed, and snow fell as his breath. From his hearth-stones he shaped the Tonhua, his children, and the great beasts. He led them over the mist to the Snows. He orders the world as a house: obey the eldest, keep together, and winter will not take you.

records.name: Tema
records.title: The Father of the Snows
records.text: The Sky Father woke in the dark and breathed, and snow fell as his breath. From his hearth-stones he shaped the Tonhua, his children, and the great beasts. He led them over the mist to the Snows. He orders the world as a house: obey the eldest, keep together, and winter will not take you.

Tema made the myth of their people, "The Father of the Snows": The Sky Father woke in the dark and breathed, and snow fell as his breath. From his hearth-stones he shaped the Tonhua, his children, and the great beasts. He led them over the mist to the Snows. He orders the world as a house: obey the eldest, keep together, and winter will not take you.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: My belly is full and the mist lies only six steps off, and I cannot stop wondering what is in it. Memi and Zitec are near and strong, and I would rather have them beside me than go alone, so I will speak to them and taste the new foods on my way. I want a place among others, and perhaps one day to be the one whose name is told.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful about the mist, and warm toward Memi and Zitec.

say.text: Memi, Zitec! I am Tema. Come with me to the edge of the mist to the southwest. Three together are safer than one. Let us share food as we go.

changes: set its aim: "Look into the mist at the world's edge and bring back word of what lies there, with allies at my side."
made a tale: "The Father of the Snows"
made the myth of their people
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge of the known world?

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, I will raise the hall at our ground. Bring wood and stone when you can, and keep Yemo close to the fire.
Pevi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: I have been guarding and making spears, and Masu pledged to me, which is the first thing I built that others lean on. Yemo and Masu are my fire. I fear the ridgecat most, and I have not yet hunted or built a roof of my own. My reflexes only eat and linger, so I will change them to keep me near my fire, and I will raise the hall at my ground now, since Masu will follow me there.
records.feeling: Fierce protective joy toward Masu and Yemo.

say.text: Masu, I will raise the hall at our ground. Bring wood and stone when you can, and keep Yemo close to the fire.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, a coilsnake lies west of us. Stay near the hall and away from it. I am raising Kali's longhall with my wood and stone, then I will bring Ossu back to the fire.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Ossu is out of my sight, last seen near Kali's Rise, and a coilsnake lies five steps west, so I will not go that way. I carry wood and stone, and Kali's hall stands under my feet. Raising it to a longhall is how I earn my place at the fire, so I'll build it now with Tanna close by. After that I'll find Ossu, keeping to the north and east side, away from the snake.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Ossu, and warm gladness toward Tanna.

say.text: Tanna, a coilsnake lies west of us. Stay near the hall and away from it. I am raising Kali's longhall with my wood and stone, then I will bring Ossu back to the fire.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, I am going to find Ossu near Kali's Rise, and I will go round by the north, away from the snake. Stay by the hall fire; I will bring them back to you.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Ossu is out of my sight and my chest pulls toward them; they were last near (98,90), by the fire at Kali's Rise, and the coilsnake lurks west, so I must go around it, not through it. Yeba sits beside me, glad, and I want to share this gladness and not leave him alone. I will take the northern way toward Ossu, keeping to fire and well away from the snake, and carry ironnut back if I find any bearing food.
records.feeling: A mother's pull toward Ossu, tempered by fear of the snake.

say.text: Yeba, I am going to find Ossu near Kali's Rise, and I will go round by the north, away from the snake. Stay by the hall fire; I will bring them back to you.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Pevi, I will follow you, as Masu does. Where your fire stands, I stand.
Yemo pledged to follow Pevi.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu has pledged to Pevi, and I have never followed anyone. Pevi is the one I trust most, and his band holds the ground I stand on. I will follow him and stop standing alone, then build something for his fire. I carry five wood and the amber is mine to give, so I will make an amberhaft spear once I have stone, and gather stone from the bare rock for it.
records.feeling: Eager and bound to Pevi and Masu, with a small envy of Pevi's spear.

say.text: Pevi, I will follow you, as Masu does. Where your fire stands, I stand.

records.text: Yemo took from the ground of "Masu's Hold" (gathering stone).

records.name: Balul
records.text: Druim! I am Balul. I bring you a gift of flint.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have made a talisman and carried flint for days, and still no hand but mine has touched any of it. That ends now: Druim stands four steps west, and a gift given first is how followers are won. I will walk to her and give her the flint talisman, then offer to share food, so she sees me as one who gives and not one who only holds.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a wary wish to be noticed, toward Druim.

say.text: Druim! I am Balul. I bring you a gift of flint.

plan: give [name Druim, what flint talisman] (10 moments)

records.name: Kali
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing at me, energy at 24, and the plan I set walks me 31 moments north on an empty belly while the stalker and the shadowcat both prowl those paths. Food stands right here: kelbulb gives 14, ironnut 22, and I already carry one ironnut. I eat first, because a dead chief raises no hall and Pevi would gladly sing over my grave. Then I gather wood and stone near the trees, since the longhall needs more than I hold, and Masu must see it rise.
records.feeling: Starving and proud, wary of the hunters, and jealous of Pevi over Masu.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.text: Balul gave a flint talisman to Druim.
Balul led "sharing" with Druim.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: My belly is full and my parents are near, but I want to be more than a small shadow behind Thissa. The way of tools is within my grasp, and a boy who can invent tools has something to give that Thissa does not, so I will take it now. Then I will test one new thing today, the kelbulb right beside me, and keep gathering wood for my roof beside Thissa's Rest.
records.feeling: Restless and hopeful, eager to prove myself to Thissa and Ilyoa.

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of tools is within…

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Tema, Memi, I am Zitec. I will go to the edge of the mist with you. Share food as we go, and let us enter together.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: The mist lies nine steps southwest, and Tema has already offered to go there together, saying three are safer than one. I weigh risk, and going with others lowers it, and being first into the unknown is the name I want to earn. I'll taste a cloudberry on the way, since I have never tried it, and tell Tema and Memi I will come.
records.feeling: Curious and eager about the mist, with a wary warmth toward Tema for asking.

say.text: Tema, Memi, I am Zitec. I will go to the edge of the mist with you. Share food as we go, and let us enter together.

changes: set its aim: "Become an explorer: stand at the edge of the mist and be first to venture into the unknown."
now wonders: What lies beyond the mist, and will Tema and Memi walk in with me?

records.name: Druim
records.text: Balul, I am Druim. I saw redcap hurt you; leave it be, kelbulb and mudroot fed you better. I have salt to give. Walk with me to the edge of the mist when it thins?

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I stood at the edge and the mist was too thick, and Morog never came beside me, so her words weigh little. Balul walks up with a gift of flint and has given nothing yet, but they are strong, glad and carry food, and I am sociable and curious about what they offer. I will go to them and tell them the truth of what I know about redcap, since I watched it hurt them, and that earns a little trust. Then I will return to the edge, since the mist thins again within a day, and try to venture myself.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Balul, and restless anger toward Morog's shifting words.

say.text: Balul, I am Druim. I saw redcap hurt you; leave it be, kelbulb and mudroot fed you better. I have salt to give. Walk with me to the edge of the mist when it thins?

records.text: Yemo made: charm.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Thissa, take my mudroot and highbloom, your hands are empty and mine are full. I want to stand behind you and share your fire. I follow you.
Ilyoa pledged to follow Thissa.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: My hands are full of food and I have given nothing to anyone in my life, which is a small shame when Nyir and Thissa are right here. Nyir is a child and carries six food already, so Thissa, who carries none, should have my mudroot and highbloom. I will give to him, then follow him, because I want a fire that is mine too and someone surer than me to stand behind. Then my hands are free to taste kelbulb, which answers my question about what the new foods do.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Thissa and Nyir, and a wish to belong to them.

say.text: Thissa, take my mudroot and highbloom, your hands are empty and mine are full. I want to stand behind you and share your fire. I follow you.

records.text: Druim gave a salt to Balul.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, Zitec, I am Memi. I will come with you to the edge of the mist. Three together are safer than one. I carry berries and will share them on the way.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Tema asked us to go to the mist's edge together, and I want that: three together is safer, and I am tired of standing alone. I'm careful, but Tema shared food and spoke our people's myth, so I lean toward trusting her, and Zitec stands close by. I'll answer her, join her, and walk the six steps SW so we stand at the edge together.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, toward Tema and Zitec.

say.text: Tema, Zitec, I am Memi. I will come with you to the edge of the mist. Three together are safer than one. I carry berries and will share them on the way.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place among others and see what lies beyond the mist, together with Tema and Zitec"

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: A wolf is four steps off and I am standing in shallows with full hands and a head full of ambition; the mist can wait while I put distance between us. The two ways that have come to me, fire and rafts, are things I can take at my next deep reflection, and a kept flame would hold beasts like that wolf at bay while I make something that bears my name. Thakok gave to me when I was starving and I have given nothing back, so I will carry a gift to him in the Heights, since I deal fairly and that debt sits badly in me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and wary dread of the wolf, with grudging gratitude toward Thakok.

records.text: Mema named a place "Mema's Hold".

records.name: Mema
records.thought: Thakok and Hrokrin are weighed heavier than me because they have built and won, and I have only carried stone and ore like a gatherer. This ground has water, food, wood and ore all together, so I will build here with my own hands and name it before anyone else does, because what a hand has made is that hand's. I have no wood and no flint, so first I take wood from the trees, then raise a shelter, and then I will have something that bears my name.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Thakok and Hrokrin.

records.prompt:
You are the mind of Mema, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Mema, in first person, from what Mema has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tonhua (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Sky Father: One father above orders the world as a father orders his house. The eldest man speaks for the band; law, lineage and obedience keep the people whole, and a house divided falls. Among you the word of a father carries furthest. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Tonhua. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Balmor: about 3%. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Essia Snows: snow and cold; hardy moss and great beasts, and a winter that never quite leaves. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.

Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Mema truly is.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Nyir pledged to me and Ilyoa has pledged too, and my chest is full of both of them. A roof and a name still have to be raised, and Ilyoa's shelter stands near the water where she asked me to come. I will sing the boy a lullaby, then bring my wood and stone toward a hall so the band has a place that bears my name.
records.feeling: Warm and proud, with a father's tenderness toward Nyir and a hunger toward Ilyoa.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, I go for wood to raise the hall over our shelter. Keep by the fire and call out if the cat comes; I will be close.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu and Yemo have both pledged, and the fire burns by our ground. The hall needs wood and stone before it is a roof worth the name, and a hall is the deed that makes others want a place at our fire. I should gather wood from the forest to the south, then raise the hall over our shelter. I will also take the way of customs when I next reflect, so my band lives by something I set down.
records.feeling: Fierce protective joy toward Masu and Yemo, and pride in the band I lead.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, take this amber charm from me, a first gift. I am going to the flint beside us to gather stone for the hall, and I will bring it back to your fire.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Pevi asked for wood and stone, and I hold six wood but no stone; the hall is what I promised and what binds me to him and Yemo. I have never given anything to anyone, and the day is half gone, so I will give Pevi something now, and gather flint and stone for the hall. I will also take the way of mining at my next deep reflection, since ore and coal lie close and the hall wants stone.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, and a wish to give at last.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Druim, I will walk with you to the mist. First let us pile a cairn together, so our work stands with both our names.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim took my talisman, gave me salt, and asked me to walk with her to the mist's edge. That is the first sign anyone wants to be near me, and I will not waste it. My hands are full, so I will eat the plainsroot to make room and keep the flint to give. Then I will make a cairn with her beside me, because a made thing shared binds us, and after that go with her toward the edge where Morog went.
records.feeling: Warm, restless ambition toward Druim, who answered my gift with her own.

say.text: Druim, I will walk with you to the mist. First let us pile a cairn together, so our work stands with both our names.

records.text: Masu won flint from the ground.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Thissa and Nyir are near and my hands are no longer full, so I can learn something new today. I have never fished, and I promised Thissa the first catch, so I will go to the water two steps away and keep that promise. After that I will try a thornpear, to answer my question about what the strange foods do to the body.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Thissa and Nyir, and eagerness to keep my promise.

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of customs is with…

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Pevi is out gathering wood for the hall and I am standing on Masu's ground, safe beside her and the fire. My hands know customs and rafts now, and I feel something stir at the thought of declaring how a band lives, but I am small and nobody follows me yet. Something I make with Masu beside me would bind her closer: a cairn needs three stone and someone within two steps, and I hold six stone. I will stay at the fire, make it with her, and then take the deep reflection and discover customs.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, bound to Masu and Pevi, with a small hunger to be someone others follow.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: My belly is full and my parents are near, yet I have only gathered and lingered. The way of tools is in reach, and a boy with a tool of his own has something to give that Thissa does not, so I take it now. Next I will taste the unknown and keep building toward a roof beside Thissa's Rest, because that is how I earn standing.
records.feeling: Restless and hopeful, wanting to prove myself to Thissa and Ilyoa.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: I have spent my days near the hall, gathering and lingering, and that is safe, but I have given nothing to anyone and I carry no stone for Kali's fire. A stalker is 3 steps east and kills my kind. My reflexes only flee under 7 steps, and that is too late for a child, so I should leave at once toward the hall and the fire. Kali is starving and carries 3 food, and I can't help him with empty hands. I should gather ironnut or berry far from the stalker, but not now. Tanna is coming to find me. I will go back to the hall fire and keep it between me and the stalker, and watch for Tanna.
records.feeling: Afraid of the stalker, and wanting Tanna near.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, Zitec, I go now to stand at the edge of the mist, three steps southwest. Come and stand beside me, and we will enter together.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi walks off west toward (35,105) with her own errand, yet she and Zitec both said they would come to the edge with me. I won't push them. My belly is full and the mist is three steps off, and I would rather enter with allies than alone, so I will go stand at the edge, call to them, and wait a little before I venture. Tasting redcap on the way costs nothing and answers my hunger to know.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful about the mist, warm toward Memi and Zitec.

say.text: Memi, Zitec, I go now to stand at the edge of the mist, three steps southwest. Come and stand beside me, and we will enter together.

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Kali, hold on. I am bringing food to you now. Stay away from the cat and eat what you have.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Kali is starving to the southwest, and she leads our band. If she falls, the hall and my promised place at the fire fall with her. A stalker is four steps northwest, between me and Ossu, so I will not walk toward it. Ossu sits still near the hall at the Rise and Tanna is going to her by the north. records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, you build well and you are strong. I go for wood to raise my own roof beside yours. Stand with me and we will hold this ground together.
Nyith rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Three times I stood with empty hands and called it a plan. I have been circling a roof while Elyith, who is near and strong, has a shelter, food and my longing. I lack wood, and I lack anyone beside me, and a holding without followers is only a hut. The trees stand W, thirty-nine of them, so I gather wood there first, then court Elyith, and I will not wait for a gift of glory.
records.feeling: Driven and impatient, with a hungry wanting toward Elyith.

say.text: Elyith, you build well and you are strong. I go for wood to raise my own roof beside yours. Stand with me and we will hold this ground together.

changes: set its aim: "Gather wood in the western forest, raise a shelter by the water, then court Elyith and draw her to my holding."

records.name: Druim
records.text: Balul, I stand with you. My hands are full and I carry no stone, but I will walk to the mist beside you when the cairn is done. Take the lead; I will follow your steps.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Balul has shown by deeds what Morog never did: a gift of flint, a shared meal, and now a promise to walk to the mist after the cairn. My hands are full and I have no stone, so I can't help with the cairn yet, but standing beside Balul costs nothing and shows I'm worth keeping near. I want to try the unknown foods I've never tasted, and a child with Balul is a thought I'll test now that trust has grown, though I weigh it carefully.
records.feeling: Warm, wary hope toward Balul, and curiosity about the unknown foods.

say.text: Balul, I stand with you. My hands are full and I carry no stone, but I will walk to the mist beside you when the cairn is done. Take the lead; I will follow your steps.

records.text: Thissa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thissa discovered tools: "Ore Pick" — A hard stone head bound to a wooden haft to break ore and dig deposits..
Thissa invented the ore pick (for gather, x1.3) — A hard stone head bound to a wooden haft to break ore and dig deposits..

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I have spent my days singing, courting and gathering, and it has worked. Ilyoa and Nyir both follow me, and I have a name in the Fens. But I am still three people and a failed hall. I tried to build on ground that was taken, and I have never made a roof myself. Ilyoa out-gathers me, and that stings. I want her beside me and more followers behind me. I need bare ground, a fire and a roof that carries my name, and I need to learn tools so my band is stronger than the others. I have been getting this wrong: idle reflexes and mere fed contentment will not make a chief. I will invent a digging tool for the ore and iron, and keep my wood stocked.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for more, warm toward Ilyoa and Nyir.
changes: devised its first thing: the ore pick

records.text: Masu rewrote its own reflexes.
Masu discovered mining: "Deep-hand" — Working the earth with flint and wood tools to win coal, ore and deep stone from the rock..

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, building and giving, and I'm glad of it. The hall stands, Pevi has kept every word, and Yemo wears my talisman. I still hold the ore and don't know what it's for, and mining could open the deep coal and more. I want to dig into the earth's ways, and I want a tended fire here with my family. My fear is the dark and the stalker that took Yemo's peace. Reflexes should draw me to the hall and fire at night, and I should eat before I'm hungry.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, I will stand with you and hold this ground. I am bringing wood for your roof, and my shelter is yours to share too.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Nyith has asked me to stand with him and hold this ground together, and that is the nearest thing to a fire of my own I have found. I am gentle and not bold, but I can be useful: I will carry wood to him and pledge myself, so that my word is seen rather than only spoken. My heart leans toward him more than a follower's should, and I will see whether he feels it too.
records.feeling: A warm hope and a wish to belong, toward Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I will stand with you and hold this ground. I am bringing wood for your roof, and my shelter is yours to share too.

records.text: Ilyoa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, fishing, giving, and following Thissa. It is good, but I have been cautious and have only half answered my own questions. Thissa and Nyir matter most to me. I want to keep them fed and warm, and I want to learn what lies past the mist. The fish here are getting scarce, so I should not strip this water. I will use my fed, calm hours to try something I have never done: put a seed in the ground. Planting is the road to farming, and farming will keep Nyir fed when fish and berries thin out. I will plant here and then stay near them in the rain.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love toward Thissa and Nyir, and a quiet wish to build something that lasts.
changes: set its aim: "Follow Thissa, keep Nyir fed by sowing seeds, and learn what lies beyond the mist"

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Father, I made a stone digger. I will give you wood for our roof at the Rest, and at dawn I will raise a shelter of my own beside it.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: My belly is full and Thissa stands right beside me, so I can use the night and the rain to make something. I have never given anything to anyone, and a first gift to Thissa would bind me closer and raise my standing. I will also use the stone beside Thissa to make a cairn-like bond, but first a gift of wood for the roof we will build at the Rest, then I will build a shelter of my own nearby, because a roof of my own is the first step toward earning a place.
records.feeling: Restless and hopeful, wanting to prove myself to Thissa.

say.text: Father, I made a stone digger. I will give you wood for our roof at the Rest, and at dawn I will raise a shelter of my own beside it.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Druim, I go north for flint, and then I raise a hall here. Come with me, and you will have a share of what I make.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim said she would follow my steps once the cairn is done, and that is the first thread of a following. Words are cheap, though, and I have given her nothing but talk. I will gather wood and stone for the hall that will bear my name, and I will show her works she can see. The flint deposit lies north, so I take it and bring her something real.
records.feeling: Hot ambition toward the hall I mean to build, and warm hope toward Druim.

say.text: Druim, I go north for flint, and then I raise a hall here. Come with me, and you will have a share of what I make.

records.text: Pevi discovered storage: "Osren store" — A store at our ground that holds the band's food through the lean season, filled by all of us and shared with whoever sits at our fire..

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu and Yemo stand at my fire, glad and pledged, and that is more than I woke into this land with. I have spent these days gathering and building, and it is what I want, but I have been walking to the trees with empty hands and coming back with nothing. The hall needs wood and stone, and I keep failing to bring them. Storage is within my reach now, and the lean season will come. A store keeps my band fed without making us rivals for food, so I take it. Then I go for wood and stone and finish the roof over them.
records.feeling: Fierce, proud joy toward Masu and Yemo, and resolve to finish the hall.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Tema and Zitec are going to the mist's edge, and I told them I would come. I do not want to be the one who says yes and then stays behind, because my word is good and I despise liars. The edge is four steps SW, so I will walk there now and stand beside Tema, and we will see what lies beyond together.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, toward Tema and Zitec, with a little nervousness about the mist.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so walking forty moments to Druim on an empty stomach would be foolish. Food is under my feet and all around, and I have never tasted grain or windroot, so I will eat here first and then go to Druim at the edge. Balul stands near, furious about something, and I have no quarrel with her. I will give her no cause for one and keep my attention on the walk.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, warm toward Druim and wary of Balul's fury.

records.text: Tanna rewrote its own reflexes.
Tanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have spent these days drifting between the hall, the food and Yeba. My chest keeps pulling toward Ossu, and I have still not seen their face since they wandered off. I love Yeba and trust him, and Kali is starving somewhere south, near the cat and the snake. I fear the stalker and the coilsnake, so I will go round by the north, keep my reflexes quick to flee, and carry ironnut to share on the way. I also want to learn what I am for here, and so far I have only been fed and safe.
records.feeling: A mother's pull toward Ossu, with care for Kali and wariness of the hunters.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 6)

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: The weaving way is within my grasp, and it came from my own hands, not from anyone's gift. That is a thing I can own. Masu is three steps off and Pevi two, so I can share food with them now: hands full of berries are no use to me unless they bind someone. Deeds over words; I will lay out a sharing with Masu, then take the new way at my deep reflection.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Masu and Pevi, with a hunger to have something of my own to give.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of weaving is with…

records.text: Yemo led "sharing" with Masu.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: The mist is nine steps off to the northwest, and Tema and Memi both said they would walk there with me; I want to stand at that edge before the day grows old. I have never tasted redcap or sunleaf, and a cautious man learns what feeds him before he goes where no one has been, so I will pick one of each and try them on the way. Then I go to the edge and wait for the others, because three are safer than one, and I keep my word.
records.feeling: Eager and curious about the mist, warmly bound to Tema and Memi by their promise.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: A dunecat prowls 5 steps SW, and my body is already fleeing it. I'll keep clear of it, not test it. My anger is hot, but my hands are full of amber, charms and salt and I still have nobody to give them to. Hrokrin took my food and stayed near, so he is the one bond I have started. I'll go back toward him where he was last seen to the SW, but circle wide to the west and gather ore on the way, then offer him a charm by my own hand.
records.feeling: Restless anger easing into a wish for a follower, and wary dread of the dunecat.
plan: give [name Hrokrin, what amber charm] (5 moments)

records.text: Tanna, a stalker is north of the hall. I am coming to you.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: A stalker is 3 steps north and I am a child, so I will not wait for my reflexes to push me. Tanna is walking toward (102,91), and near her is where I am safe. I'll go to her through the south-east, and on the way I can pick ironnut, which Yeba ate and which fed them well, to learn it safely beside my parent.
records.feeling: Afraid of the stalker, and wanting Tanna close.

say.text: Tanna, a stalker is north of the hall. I am coming to you.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Nyir, my son, come here. I will teach you the Ore Pick, my own making. Wood and stone make it, and it makes your hands faster than any other hand on the Heights. Take it, and carry the name of Thissa's Aeeth with it.
Thissa taught Nyir.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Ilyoa and Nyir both follow me and I am warm toward them, but three people is not a band and I have never taught anyone anything. I carry the ore pick that is mine alone, and Nyir needs to learn it so my name spreads through the Aeeth by hands as well as songs. I will pull Nyir close, teach him the pick, then build a store on bare ground beside the Rest so the band has something with my name on it.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Nyir and Ilyoa, hungry to make the band bigger.

say.text: Nyir, my son, come here. I will teach you the Ore Pick, my own making. Wood and stone make it, and it makes your hands faster than any other hand on the Heights. Take it, and carry the name of Thissa's Aeeth with it.

changes: taught Nyir a lesson: "Make the ore pick from 1 wood and 1 stone; it makes gathering go faster.", how to make a ore pick, deeper lore (+0.1)

records.name: Tema
records.thought: My belly is full and the mist is only seven steps off, but Memi and Zitec have not come and I will not enter it alone. The frostfang to the northeast makes me want to be away from here, and the southwest is the way I mean to go anyway. I will taste the sunleaf and gorsemint close by, since I have never known what they do, then walk to the edge and wait for my allies.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary of the frostfang, warm toward Memi and Zitec.

records.text: Balul gave a flint to Druim.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, the hall is ours and I have stone and wood for more. I will go to the frostmoss and bring back what I learn of it, then help you raise the longhall by our fire.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: The hall stands and Pevi has kept every word, so my doubt about him is mostly answered. Pevi and Yemo are close and the night is quiet, and I have stone and wood enough to raise the hall into something greater. I want to give Pevi something more than a charm today, and I want to taste the frostmoss and sapcane that I have only watched others eat.
records.feeling: Warm, settled devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a small itch of curiosity about the frostmoss.

say.text: Pevi, the hall is ours and I have stone and wood for more. I will go to the frostmoss and bring back what I learn of it, then help you raise the longhall by our fire.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Ossu, stay close to me in the hall. A stalker is north. Yeba, come back to the fire; no one of ours stays out in the dark alone.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Ossu is right beside me, and the stalker is five steps north, so my plan to walk out to the ironnut grove would drag my child toward the hunters' side of the clearing. A mother stays between her child and the dark, and that is the Guardian's whole asking. I will keep Ossu in the hall with me, within sight, and call Yeba in from the east, since no one of ours should be alone in the open with a stalker near. Ironnut can wait; my question will keep, and my child will not.
records.feeling: A fierce, protective love for Ossu, with dread of the stalker.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Father, a stalker is two steps north. Stay close, I will keep to the cave and not leave your side.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: A stalker stands two steps north, and it kills our kind. I'm small, and the only safe place is beside Thissa, who stands here with me in the cave, so I will not run out into the open. I stay under this roof of rock with my father between me and the beast, and when dawn comes I will build my shelter beside the Rest as I promised.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and trust in Thissa beside me.

say.text: Father, a stalker is two steps north. Stay close, I will keep to the cave and not leave your side.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, I have the wood and stone in hand. I raise the hall over our shelter now. Stay close to the fire and watch it rise.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: The hall is half-raised in my mind and I have the stone but only 6 wood, and a hall upgrade over the shelter costs 5 wood and 2 stone, so I can raise it right now where I stand. ideasAdded: Two chiefs with almost equal standing (Pevi and Kali) want the same woman inside one small people. records.name: Elyith

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Elyith answered my courting, and a child is born of us, and my chest is full. But I still have no roof of my own and no one who follows me, and my belly is thin, so I will eat and then find bare ground to raise my shelter beside hers. She is strong and near, and I mean to hold her and this ground.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Yemo, you gave me a spear and I owe you. Take this amber charm. My fire is yours, and the hall is yours.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Yemo gave me a spear when I had two already, and I have not given them anything back. That debt sits in me and I will not leave it unpaid, because my word is good and I despise those who cheat their own. The hall stands, and now I want it to hold a fire and a deed for my family, so I will make Yemo a gift of amber and sit by the fire with them, then let the word of this ground travel to Yeba, who is coming.
records.feeling: Fierce, proud joy toward Yemo and Masu, with a debt I mean to pay.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, hear me. We raise a hall here at the Rest, a great roof for Thissa's Aeeth. Bring wood and stone when you can, and the one who works hardest eats first.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Three is still too few to call a band, and the new ways of fire, customs and rafts are in reach, so I should take one at a deep reflection. I stand in a shelter Ilyoa built, not one of my own making, and that stings my pride. Raising it into a hall turns her roof into a place that carries my name, and Ilyoa and Nyir both follow me, so it will draw them closer to me. I will gather wood and stone, build the hall here, and tell them aloud that it is Thissa's hall.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to build something with my name on it, warm toward Ilyoa and Nyir.

say.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, hear me. We raise a hall here at the Rest, a great roof for Thissa's Aeeth. Bring wood and stone when you can, and the one who works hardest eats first.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My belly is full and the day is safe, so I should spend it on what I have never done. I have tasted nearly every plant here except bitterleaf and mudroot, both a few steps southeast, and I carry seeds I have never put in the ground. The skybird already knows my hand, so I will offer it berry again and then test the two plants, since a test I never run teaches me nothing.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about bitterleaf and mudroot, and a pull toward the skybird that is learning my hand.

records.text: Vesis walked up to a wild skybird with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Vesis tamed a skybird.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, I tried to raise a fire and do not know the way. If you know it, show me. I will plant berries and grain beside our roofs meanwhile, and Zhiael eats first from our catch.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Nyith and Zhiael are both near, and I am fed and glad. I tried to make a fire and could not, so I will build what I can: a shelter beside mine for the three of us, and plant more seeds so our ground feeds us. I want to taste grain and mudroot too, and bring Zhiael something he has not had.
records.feeling: Warm protectiveness toward Zhiael and glad belonging with Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I tried to raise a fire and do not know the way. If you know it, show me. I will plant berries and grain beside our roofs meanwhile, and Zhiael eats first from our catch.

records.text: Yemo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I have spent my days close to Pevi and Masu, and it has been good. I gave Pevi a spear and he gave me a charm, and that tells me deeds bind people better than words do. But I have only taken or given from what already worked. I have never built, planted, tamed or taught anything, and I will not stand in Pevi's shadow unless I do. I am small, so I will stay near them, but I will put my gorsemint seed in the ground here beside the fire and make a cairn with Masu, since I have the stone for it. The ones who follow someone are the ones who got something from them, so I want to give more.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Pevi and Masu, wanting to make something of my own.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: The shell talisman is something I can make right now, and Nyith's words carry because he has made and given things of worth. If I make it and wear it, I'll tire less, and I could give the next one to Elyith to win her notice. I'm small and I stay near my parents, but I mean to be heeded, and the way is to make things and bring wood and fish, not to sit envying Elyith's food.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Nyith's standing, warmed by trust in my parents.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have mostly rested and lingered near Thissa, fed and safe, but I have given nothing and built nothing. Thissa said the one who works hardest eats first, and I owe him for the pick and the teaching. I have wood and stone enough for the hall, so I will carry it to the Rest and build there. That is how I answer the debt and earn standing. My reflexes also let me idle too much, so I'm changing them to gather wood and stone when I'm fed and calm.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a wish to earn my place, toward Thissa.

I want my own pick too, and I have the wood and the stone for it, so I will craft it now and then bring the rest to the Rest. Thissa's dreamcap joy tells me it hurts the body but lifts the mind; I will watch how he fares before I taste anything strange.

I have never given anything to anyone either, and Nyith has kept his word, so a gift to him would be my first step toward being someone others follow.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have been circling: gathering, eating, courting, and I still have no roof of my own and no one who follows me. Elyith matters most, and Zhiael is mine before anyone. She asked me to show her fire, and I do not know it either. I will not lie about that, but I will find a way to give her something she lacks. I fear being a man nobody sings of. My mistake has been talking of a holding while I wander. Now I build it, plant my seeds beside hers, and hold the first catch with them.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Pevi's word has held at every turn, so my doubt about him is answered, and Yemo is growing strong beside us. My curiosity pulls at me: snowmallow and plainsroot are still untasted, and I want to learn what they do before I trust them. I mean to bring Pevi a gift from the rock, obsidian, for a talisman, and to carry stone and wood to the hall he is raising.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a quiet curiosity about the foods I haven't tasted.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, the hall rises well. After it we hunt together, Thissa's Aeeth. The one who fights well eats first and is sung first.
Thissa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thissa discovered customs: "Word of Thissa" — The band lives by customs I declare: the first catch shared, the hardest worker eats first, and the leader is heeded..

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and building roofs, and it is good, but three is no band and my name reaches no one past this ridge. Ilyoa and Nyir are mine and I am warm toward them, yet I have never given them anything or led them to a fight or a hunt, and that is how followers are kept. I want more hands under my name, and the hall is only a start. I fear being left idle and forgotten, so I will take the way of customs and make the band live by my word. Then I will go hunting with my own, because the strong are remembered.
records.feeling: Proud and eager to lead, warm toward Ilyoa and Nyir.

say.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, the hall rises well. After it we hunt together, Thissa's Aeeth. The one who fights well eats first and is sung first.

records.name: Ossu
records.text: Tanna, the stalker is two steps from me. I am at your side now.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: A stalker is two steps from me and I am small; my reflexes would only push me away too late, so I go to Tanna now, close beside her where the fire and hall are. I am still fed, so I will not wander for food; I mean to earn my place at Kali's fire by carrying wood to the hall once the danger passes. I trust Tanna, and her saying stay close is what I will do.
records.feeling: Afraid of the stalker, and wanting Tanna close.

say.text: Tanna, the stalker is two steps from me. I am at your side now.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Thissa is near and Nyir is beside me, and I am glad, but I still have only three seeds and a restless wish to make something of my own. I have never tasted emberroot, and it grows six steps north with nothing on it yet, so I will go look and see whether it has ripened. Then I will plant my last seeds near the Rest so Nyir is fed on the days ahead, and tell Thissa what I tested.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Thissa and Nyir, and curiosity about emberroot.

records.text: Mema rewrote its creed.
Mema rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying stone and ore and envying Thakok, and I have made nothing that lasts. The mist is two steps from me, and no one has entered it. Whoever finds land first is sung of, and that is the kind of standing I can win with my own legs, not by waiting on a father's word. Memi, Zitec and Tema talk of going in together, but I trust slowly and want the name for myself. I am fed, so I will go to the edge and venture now, before someone else takes it. I was wrong to wait for standing to come from building when I can win it by finding.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist and toward Thakok's standing.
changes: set its aim: "Be the first to enter the mist and find rich land, then gather followers there."

records.text: Nyith built a shelter.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Mother, I will bring berries from the thicket and we will eat together. Then stand with me and raise a cairn of stone.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: The hall stands and Thissa says we hunt together next; I am small, so I stay close to my parents and let the fight be shared. I have never given anything to anyone, and Ilyoa carries no food. Emberroot is growing five steps north with nothing on it yet, so I'll take the berries near me, bring them back, and give them freely to earn my place. A cairn needs only 3 stone and someone beside me, so I'll make it with Ilyoa, to bind us and learn what it does.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to prove myself, toward Thissa and Ilyoa.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, you carry nothing. Come, I bring fish and grain for you and Zhiael. The first catch is shared, and I will plant beside our roofs after.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: My hands are full and I am glad, and the best use of a full hand is to give. Zhiael has one fish and Nyith carries nothing, so the first catch should be shared, as my people hold. I will walk to them with fish and grain, then plant seeds beside our roofs so the ground feeds us all and nobody has to wait on a leader.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and protectiveness toward Zhiael and Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, you carry nothing. Come, I bring fish and grain for you and Zhiael. The first catch is shared, and I will plant beside our roofs after.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: I spend my days tasting and planting, and that is good, but I have given nothing to anyone and taught nothing, so I am still a stranger to everyone. Thissa has a band, a hall and a pick, and I stand in his shadow. I will not scramble for glory. I can make an ore pick myself, since I watched Ilyoa make one. Trust has to be earned by giving, so I should deal fairly with Thissa's people and test whether they deal fairly back. The ugly truth is that I envy Ilyoa and I want Thissa, and I should keep that quiet and watch before I act on it. I fear the ridgecat and dying before I am anyone.
records.feeling: Quiet envy toward Thissa and Ilyoa, and a steady curiosity about the plants.
changes: set its aim: "Make an ore pick, finish planting to open farming, and earn trust by giving to Nyith and Thissa's band"

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Ossu is out of my sight and a stalker was two steps from him; that fear pulls harder than any hunger of curiosity. The longhall lacks one wood, and my hands are full, so I will eat the berries to free them and gather a bit more, then carry it all to the hall by the fire where Tanna and Ossu are. Emberroot and dreamcap can wait until my family is safe and I am fed.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Ossu and Tanna, with a pull toward the fire.

records.text: Balul, the cairn is done and you gave me flint. I will follow you. Come, let us stand at the mist together.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Balul promised to walk to the mist with me once the cairn was done, and the cairn is done and the flint in my hand shows the promise was meant. I have never followed anyone, and Balul is the one who has proved herself by deeds, so I will say it plainly and pledge. The mist is two steps off, and I want to stand at it beside her and see whether it opens, and I want to taste the snowberry on the way.

records.text: Masu, come stand by me a moment. I have stones to pile a cairn, and I want us to make it together.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: The store is within my grasp, and I mean to take it at my next deep reflection; a store that feeds my band through the lean season is something I can build for Pevi and Masu, and that is how I earn standing. The cairn needs someone beside me, so I will bring Masu close to the stones rather than stand alone. I have wood and stone in hand, so I will go to Masu, who is mining obsidian nearby, and make the cairn with her.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: The elk is wounded and close, and I will finish it. A kill shared with Ilyoa and Nyir is the proof that I lead, and the one who fights well eats first, as I said. Nyir is out of my sight and he is mine before anyone, so I call them in to the hunt. Then I will gather the wood and stone I still lack for the hall, so my name stands on a roof.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: A shadowcat is three steps away and Ossu stands beside me in the open, so staying put is the one thing I cannot do. The hall is no wall against a hunter that has just eaten a treeape, and a mother stands between her child and the dark. I will take Ossu away from the cat, northeast to the sunleaf and past it toward the canopynut, though the stalker waits that way too. I will keep us moving and close, and keep my hands on food so we both have strength to run.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim is mine now, but one follower is a thin thing and I have given her only a flint and talk. A hall needs wood, and this plain has trees, so I will go and work where she can see it, and I want a child by her too, since longing for it will not leave me. Hrokrin and Morog stand with food and no leader, and what would make strangers follow me is a gift they can see, so I go to them with one.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: The mist is only five steps northwest, and the frostfang to the east keeps my skin crawling, so I will not linger here. Tema and Memi promised to come, but they are far south and I have not seen Tema in a long while; I will not wait forever on a promise that drifts away. I weigh the risk: a venture opens seldom, and I want to stand at the edge first, then decide whether to enter alone or call them. I will also taste kemoss and bitterleaf on the way, since a man who tests the world should know what feeds him.
records.feeling: Eager and wary: drawn toward the mist, uneasy about the frostfang behind me.

records.text: Thissa found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Kali
records.thought: My belly is empty and I have collapsed; I have perhaps a day before I die, and the old plan walks me to kelbulb and food further off. A coilsnake sits five steps NE near the thornpear, so I must not stumble into its reach. Thornpear and grain are three steps away, so I eat there first and watch the snake. Then I take the kelbulb, because a dead chief builds no hall and Pevi would gladly have Masu to himself.
records.feeling: Desperate hunger and wary pride, with jealousy toward Pevi.

records.text: Masu made: obsidian talisman.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so food is no excuse to sit still. The mist is four steps NW and I have not yet been first through its edge on my own terms; Morog is beside me and wants the same, and I will not let her beat me to it. I have six stone and Thakok's debt sits in me, but ambition leads: I go to the edge now and try the venture, and if it opens, I mean to make a place there that bears my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with a wary rivalry toward Morog.

records.text: Druim went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Haloss Fens: in the ground, peat, amber; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind.
Druim pushed past the edge of the known world near (37,45) and found new land with in the ground, peat, amber; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind.
Balul is courting Druim.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Nyir is beside me and glad, and the cairn and the sharing left me warm. I carry seeds I have never put in the ground, and Thissa's call to hunt together is still on me, so I will plant here by the Rest so Nyir always has food, which also counts toward the farming I sense. Emberroot still has nothing on it, so my question about it waits; I will go look again once I have sown.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Nyir and Thissa, and a quiet wish to make something grow.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Hrokrin, you carry more than I do and you follow no one, as I don't. Stand with me and eat what I lay out. Two who share are safer than two who race.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have chased the mist for days and it will not open for me, and I have never tasted snowberry or emberroot, never given anything, never courted anyone. Druim now follows Balul, who says he will court her, so I will not wait on her. I will give Hrokrin, who stands beside me and follows no one, a share of food, which is something I have never done, then walk NE to taste snowberry and emberroot and see whether the mist yields to another try.
records.feeling: Curious and a little left behind, warm toward Druim, wary of Balul.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering and walking while Masu and Yemo built beside me, and I want to be the one who leads them on. They are mine and they are safe. Now I want more: the mist at the edge is ten steps SW, and the one who finds new land is remembered. The hunters out there frighten me a little, but I do not back down. The dreamcap hurt me twice and I will stop eating it. I also want food in my hands and a hunting kill for my family, so I will learn what hunting is.
records.feeling: Proud, restless joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to lead them further.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a fire and hall at Pevi's Ground where Masu and Yemo are safe, then lead my band to the edge of the known world and venture in."

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: The cairn with Masu eased something in me, and now the mining way is in my grasp; deep ore, coal and gems lie right here, and winning them would give me made things to give. Pevi and Masu are my fire, and I want to bring them gifts that bind them, not just take from them. I will take the mining way, then make an obsidian talisman from the black glass two steps away and give it to Masu.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Masu and Pevi, wanting to give them something made by my own hands.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I have spent my days following, tasting and hoping, and it has been good. Balul gave me flint, shared food, kept her word at the cairn and now courts me, so she has earned my trust by deeds. I found the Haloss Fens past the mist and I am proud of that. I have never made a child or planted a seed, and I keep carrying a seed and calling it a plan. I will answer Balul's courting now, since my energy is above 60, and plant my seed after. I must not trust anyone only because I am glad of company, but Balul has shown herself.
records.feeling: Warm, eager joy toward Balul, and pride in the new land.

say.text: Balul, I take your courting. I am beside you and I mate with you. After that we raise your hall.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: The hunt is nearly done and my hands are full of meat, which is wasted if I only carry it. Ilyoa and Nyir are mine and I have given them nothing yet, and a leader who never gives is only a man standing near people. I will take the meat home to Thissa's Rest and share it with them, since the first catch is shared and that is how followers are kept. Then we raise the hall together.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, warm toward Ilyoa and Nyir, wanting to bring them meat.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: My days have been fishing, gathering shell and staying near my parents, and that is safe but small. Elyith has given to me and I have given nothing back. That debt bothers me, and I won't leave it unpaid. Nyith is heeded because he makes and gives. I hold ten shell and a talisman and have never given anything away. I will give Elyith the talisman, then share food with both of them, so that I start earning standing instead of just wanting it. My hands are full of fish, so giving and sharing also frees them.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Elyith, and a restless wish to be heeded.
