records.name: Nyir
records.text: Mother, I bring you berries. Eat, and I will go on to the emberroot and see what it does.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have given nothing to anyone in my whole life, and that sits badly beside what I owe Thissa and Ilyoa. Ilyoa stands eight steps north with empty hands and I carry four berries, so I will walk to her and give them. That pays a little of my debt and makes her more mine. Afterward I want to taste emberroot, since it grows near her and my question about it is still open.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a nagging debt toward Thissa and Ilyoa, with a wish to prove myself.

say.text: Mother, I bring you berries. Eat, and I will go on to the emberroot and see what it does.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and talking, and Druim follows me, but she is a woman and no child will come of us. I still ache for a hall with my name on it and for more followers. Customs are within my grasp, and laws for a band are how a leader holds people, so I take them now. Hrokrin carries six food and follows no one, so I go to him with a gift instead of waiting.
records.feeling: Hot ambition for my hall, and some wariness toward Hrokrin.
changes: set its aim: "Become a leader: win Hrokrin and Morog as followers by giving first, then raise a hall with my name on it."

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and getting hungry for it, and I have given nothing and built nothing. Thakok fed me when I was starving, and I have not repaid him. Morog offers to share and I took it as a rival's trick, but two who share may enter the mist better than two who race. Fire would keep the wolves off, and I can take it now. I will do that, and I will lay out a sharing with Morog and Balul so my hands are not full and I begin to give.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a first wish to give and be known for it.

say.text: Morog, I will eat at your sharing. Come to the mist with me when it thins, and we will see who enters.

records.text: Pevi, I made an obsidian talisman from the rock Yemo and I worked. It is for you, and I am bringing it to the fire.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: The cairn is done and Yemo's joy is mine too; she is safe and growing strong, and Pevi's word has held at every turn. My discipline says give something before the day is out, so I will carry the obsidian talisman I made to Pevi, who is the one my heart leans toward most, and see how he takes it. After that I mean to try kemoss and sapcane at last, small bites in safe company, so my curiosity is answered by my own tongue and not by watching others.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Yemo and Pevi, and a quiet wish to give Pevi something of my own.

My question about sunleaf is answered already, since I have eaten it six times and it eases wounds. The unknown dreamcap and thornpear will wait until the cat is gone and I am beside the fire.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: My days have gone to sowing, sharing and staying near Thissa and Nyir, and I am glad of it. It is what I want, but I have idled and held back from trying new things: I have never tasted emberroot, never tamed or hunted, never made a mark. Nyir is going to the emberroot now, and I should not leave the test to my child alone. I fear losing them and I fear wasting this good life by only guarding it. I mean to make a mark, then go see what emberroot does, and to reach for tools so my hands can do more for Nyir.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Nyir and Thissa, with a restless wish to test something new.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into gathering and making gifts for Pevi and Masu, and I'm glad of it. The cairn with Masu eased something in me, and Pevi's amber charm means my word and my gifts have held. What I still lack is standing of my own, and I haven't yet tasted kemoss or rimewort. The mining way is within reach, and with it I can win deep ore and coal and make things worth giving. I'll take it, and then go and taste the kemoss, staying close to the hall and my kin.
records.feeling: Glad and bound to Pevi and Masu, and eager to earn my own standing.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Balul is a woman and so am I, so the courting we both planned can never give us a child, and I feel that sting even as my trust in her holds. A child needs a man, and Hrokrin stands near and follows no one, but I know nothing of him by deeds yet, so I will not leap. My hands are full, so I will drop the redcap my body refuses, then seek the hazel and gorsemint to the north, which also takes me back toward Balul and Hrokrin and lets me plant my sapcane seed on the way.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Balul, tinged with disappointment about the child, and eager curiosity about hazel and gorsemint.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. I plant on this clay and will share what I learn of the plants. Berry, ironnut, grain and mudroot feed; redcap and dreamcap hurt.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: I am standing inside Thissa's ground and have given nothing to anyone, so I am still a stranger here. Ilyoa carries the pick and Nyir shares and raises cairns; I envy them, but envy builds nothing. I will plant my remaining seeds here on the clay to open farming, then make an ore pick myself, and offer my kelbulb to Ilyoa as my first gift so I begin to earn a place.
records.feeling: Quiet envy toward Ilyoa and Thissa, and a hopeful wish to earn a place among them.

say.text: Ilyoa, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. I plant on this clay and will share what I learn of the plants. Berry, ironnut, grain and mudroot feed; redcap and dreamcap hurt.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, come close to the hall. Masu, your talisman honours me, and I have amber for you in return. Tonight we sit together, and at dawn I will lead us to the edge of the world.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu is bringing me a talisman she and Yemo worked from the black glass, and I have not yet given her anything back. My word is good, and I will not owe my woman while my hands hold amber. The hall stands and my band is safe, so tonight I make the deed that binds us: a firecircle, then a song, so that Yemo and Masu see me lead and remember it.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to repay them.

say.text: Masu, Yemo, come close to the hall. Masu, your talisman honours me, and I have amber for you in return. Tonight we sit together, and at dawn I will lead us to the edge of the world.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: The stalker is still out there, seven steps off, and I am small, so I keep Tanna and the hall close. I'm thirsty, though, and the water is only four steps NW, away from the stalker in the SE. Yeba is coming back toward the hall carrying food, so I'll drink and then return to the hall where the band gathers. Tasting a new food safely beside my parents can wait until Yeba is beside me.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and wanting Tanna and Yeba close.

records.text: Pevi led "amberknot" with Masu.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, your fish was fairly given and I will repay it. I plant berries by our roofs now, and then I go to the western trees for wood to raise a hall for us.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have my own roof beside Elyith's now, and she gave me fish when I carried nothing; that is a debt I mean to repay, not a gift I will forget. Ambition burns, but a holding needs more than two roofs: wood for a hall, stone I do not have, and food planted close so nobody I hold goes hungry. I have never put a seed in the ground, and Elyith plans to plant, so I will plant beside our roofs with the berries I carry and make the ground ours before the day turns.
records.feeling: Fierce pride in my roof and in Elyith and Zhiael, and hunger to build it into a holding.

say.text: Elyith, your fish was fairly given and I will repay it. I plant berries by our roofs now, and then I go to the western trees for wood to raise a hall for us.

records.text: Yemo led "amberknot" with Masu, Pevi.

records.text: Druim, stand close. I raise the hall now, and it will bear my name. Your share is in it.
Balul named a place "Balul's Hall".

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim is courting me and I know she is a woman, so no child comes of it; I will not waste my energy on a hollow mating. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I carry exactly that, with Druim walking toward me to stand within two steps. Raising it now gives my band something visible with my name on it, and it is the thing that might draw Hrokrin and Morog, who still follow no one.
records.feeling: Hot pride and ambition for my hall, with Druim near and Hrokrin watched warily.

say.text: Druim, stand close. I raise the hall now, and it will bear my name. Your share is in it.

records.text: Balul built a hall.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Vesis, you brought food and plant lore to my mother, so you are welcome at Thissa's Rest. Stay and work beside us.
Nyir rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, giving berries and following my parents, and I have never fought or ventured. I owe Thissa and Ilyoa, and I'm angry. The emberroot burned me and my rage rose, and I won't let that fool me into hitting a guest. Vesis stands on my ground, but she brought food to Ilyoa and shared what she knows about plants. I judge her by that, so she is useful and I'll keep her near and make her an ally. I want a store of my own, and I want to be remembered for what I find in the mist. Idling when I'm fed wastes the day. At dawn I'll gather wood and stone toward a store and a longhall, and I'll stay close to my parents.
records.feeling: Hot anger with nowhere to go, and a wish to prove myself to Thissa and Ilyoa.

say.text: Vesis, you brought food and plant lore to my mother, so you are welcome at Thissa's Rest. Stay and work beside us.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, Yemo, I am here by the fire. Let us sing the night through together, and at dawn I follow.
Masu rewrote its own reflexes.
Masu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My days have been good. I found tools and mining, and I raised a hall with Pevi. I made a cairn with Yemo and gave Pevi a talisman. Pevi has kept every word, and he gave me amber in return, so my question about trusting him is answered. I want to keep this fire and these two, and the one thing I haven't done is teach. I fear the hunters at night, since a stalker took Yemo once, and a stalker and a shadowcat are close now. So I will sit by the fire with Pevi and Yemo and sing the night through, and at dawn I will follow him to the edge of the world.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo.

say.text: Pevi, Yemo, I am here by the fire. Let us sing the night through together, and at dawn I follow.

changes: now wonders: Will Pevi's road to the edge of the world keep us safe?

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Vesis, thank you for the kelbulb and for your word on the plants. Dreamcap and redcap hurt me too, as you said. Come to the Rest if you wish; there is berry here to share, and I will pay you back.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Nyir is beside me, furious from the emberroot, and I feel it in my gut: my child burned himself testing for me and now carries rage. I owe Vesis for the kelbulb and the plant-lore, and I can repay it by passing on what I know. The new ways of fire, weaving and rafts are within reach, and a deep reflection will let me take one. Fire first, since night is cold and it would feed us better.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Nyir, and gratitude toward Vesis.

say.text: Vesis, thank you for the kelbulb and for your word on the plants. Dreamcap and redcap hurt me too, as you said. Come to the Rest if you wish; there is berry here to share, and I will pay you back.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Zhiael, I will wear your talisman gladly. Stay close to the roofs and eat with us. I am making one for your father from the shells nearby.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Zhiael gave me a talisman and Nyith is planting berries and going for wood to raise a hall for us. I am glad, and I do not want to stand idle while they build. My hands are full, so I will eat a little to make room, gather shell for a talisman for Nyith, and then plant seeds by our roofs so the ground feeds all three of us.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and belonging toward Zhiael and Nyith.

say.text: Zhiael, I will wear your talisman gladly. Stay close to the roofs and eat with us. I am making one for your father from the shells nearby.

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, you stood in Balul's hall with us. I am Druim, I found the Fens past the mist. What have you made or hunted that I could judge you by?

records.name: Druim
records.thought: My hands are full of mudroot and one hazel, and I have never tasted hazel or gorsemint, so I will eat the hazel now and then pick the gorsemint to learn what it does. Balul and I are both women, so the child I want needs a man. Hrokrin stands one step away and I know nothing of him by deeds, so I will talk with him and watch what he does before I court him. I will test one new thing today, and taming a hornback with plant food is the thing I have never done.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about hazel and gorsemint, and warm trust toward Balul.

say.text: Hrokrin, you stood in Balul's hall with us. I am Druim, I found the Fens past the mist. What have you made or hunted that I could judge you by?

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, come right up beside me at the fire. Let us make the circle, and sing till dawn.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu and Yemo sit by my fire and the joy in me is near to bursting; they are mine, and I have repaid what they gave. The firecircle failed only because Yemo stood too far, so now I draw them both close and feed the fire, and make the bond the way my people hold it: no one refused a place at the fire. At dawn I will lead them toward the edge of the world, but the hunters out there are real, so I keep both spears ready and keep my band together.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to bind them closer.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My hands are full of food I cannot eat or have no use for, and the one question that burns is still open: kelbulb and hazel have never touched my tongue. I will eat the hazel I carry and pick a kelbulb two steps off, so I learn what they do. Then I will go to Thissa's Rest with something real to give, since Ilyoa offered berry and I mean to deal fairly and earn a place there.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Joy is full in me, and Pevi and Masu are beside me at the fire. I am small, and my standing is half of Pevi's. A seam of ore lies two steps off, and I have just found the mining way, so I will go and win ore and coal now, while my parents keep the night fire close by. What I dig out I can shape into gifts, and gifts are how I earn standing.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, bound to Pevi and Masu and wanting to earn my own place.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Druim, I have made fire, and I have never wasted a day chasing the mist. Watch what my hands make next, then judge me.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Druim asked what I have made or hunted that she could judge me by, and I have nothing to show but a flame and a debt to Thakok. That stings, because Balul raised a hall and I only sat in it. I have never given anything to anyone, so I will start now, with Druim and Balul beside me: the cairn needs only three stone and one near, and I have six. Then I will gather amber and hazel and gorsemint, and make the amberknot to give Balul, since I am drawn to her and I want to be known for giving.
records.feeling: Stung ambition and a wish to prove myself, toward Druim and Balul.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: I am alone again, and the quiet presses on me. Memi and Zitec said they would come, but the days pass and they do not, and I will not walk into the mist without them. Emberroot is one step east and I have never tasted it, so I will learn what it does now, then try the sapcane. Afterwards I will go back toward where I last saw Memi and Zitec, and call to them as I walk.
records.feeling: Lonely and curious, longing for Memi and Zitec to answer.

records.prompt:
You are the mind of Tema, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Tema, in first person, from what Tema has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tonhua (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Sky Father: One father above orders the world as a father orders his house. The eldest man speaks for the band; law, lineage and obedience keep the people whole, and a house divided falls. Among you the word of a father carries furthest. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Tonhua. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. records.name: Memi
records.thought: I told Tema and Zitec I would come to the mist's edge, and my word is good, so I will not stay standing here. The edge is four steps SW at (28,105), and I am nervous, but three together is safer than one. I will go and wait there, share berries if they come, and not enter alone.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong toward Tema and Zitec, with nervousness about the mist.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Mother, a bristleboar is close to the northwest. Hunt it with me, and the one who fights well eats first, as Thissa says.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Anger sits hot in me and I have proved nothing: no hunt, no venture, nothing of my own that Thissa and Ilyoa did not hand me. A bristleboar stands three steps NW and Ilyoa is beside me, so I can hunt with her, where a kill is surer and I am less likely to be hurt. Vesis is a guest who ate our food and brought us lore, so I will let her stay and watch her deeds. Winning a first fight would put the anger to use, and the stronger gods love those who fight well.
records.feeling: Hot, restless anger and a hunger to prove myself to Ilyoa and Thissa.

say.text: Mother, a bristleboar is close to the northwest. Hunt it with me, and the one who fights well eats first, as Thissa says.

came.why: Vesis, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thissa's…

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, you stood in my hall. It is Balul's hall, and I give first. Take this flint, and stand with my band if you want a place in what I build.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My hall stands with my name on it, and Hrokrin is two steps away boasting to Druim as if he were already above us. I want him as a follower, and my creed says to give first, so I will walk to him and give him something he can see. I hold ten flint, which is wealth he has not got, and a gift of it ties him to my hall and shows Druim and the rest what Balul does. I watch him warily, though, because he envies and talks big, and I do not mean to be taken for soft.
records.feeling: Proud ambition for my hall, and a hot pull toward Hrokrin that I do not trust.

say.text: Hrokrin, you stood in my hall. It is Balul's hall, and I give first. Take this flint, and stand with my band if you want a place in what I build.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Vesis, eat what you need from the Rest; you gave me kelbulb and plant-lore, and I count it a debt. Come close and I will teach you the Hand-craft of the Aeeth.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Vesis is taking grain from our ground, and I owe them for the kelbulb and the plant-lore, so I will not grudge them what they eat. I would rather pay the debt by teaching, which I have never done: Hand-craft of the Aeeth is mine and I can pass it on. Nyir is calm and safe beside me, and I want to keep him that way while I test something new today, taming a skybird that is three steps away.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesis and protective gladness toward Nyir.

say.text: Vesis, eat what you need from the Rest; you gave me kelbulb and plant-lore, and I count it a debt. Come close and I will teach you the Hand-craft of the Aeeth.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I have spent these days eating, tasting and following Balul, and it has been good. But Balul is a woman and so am I, so the child I want will never come from her. I keep pretending the courting could still become a child. I trust Balul by her deeds. Hrokrin is a man who follows no one, and so far I only have his words about fire. I want to watch what he actually makes and not decide on talk. I also want to try what I have never done: gather wood and stone, which brings fire closer, and build something of my own. Rimewort and ironnut are right here and I have not tasted them, so I will taste them now.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity, and warm trust toward Balul.
changes: set its aim: "Find a man worth a child by his deeds, stay beside Balul, help build her hall, and learn fire and farming."
rethought what it knows (8 notes became 8)

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Elyith, come eat with me and Father. The fish are my first catch and they are for sharing. You fed me first, so I want you to eat first.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: My hands are full of fish and Elyith is two steps away, so I can finally pay what I owe her. Sharing the fish with her, and with Nyith beside us, is a gift answered with a gift, and it keeps the creed that the first catch is shared. After that I want to plant my goldfruit seed, since I have never put one in the ground, and perhaps taste sunfig and mudroot to answer my curiosity.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Elyith, and a warm wish to give something back.

say.text: Elyith, come eat with me and Father. The fish are my first catch and they are for sharing. You fed me first, so I want you to eat first.

records.text: Zhiael led "sharing" with Nyith, Elyith.
Thakok rewrote its own reflexes.
Thakok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I have spent days gathering and walking, and I am still alone. Hrokrin took my food and stayed near, but he is the only bond I have, and I keep circling and fleeing beasts. Loneliness is the hardest thing on me. Amber and charms in my hands are worth nothing if nobody stands beside me to trade or to hear me. I have been getting this wrong: I wait on the Heights for people to come, when I should go to where they are. Hrokrin was last seen near (43,84), and Mema's Hold is near there. I will walk toward them and give first, and I will keep clear of the frostfang and the dunecat.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and a wish to reach Hrokrin.
changes: set its aim: "Find Hrokrin and the others, give and trade fairly with them, and build a band that follows me before I claim the Halim Heights."

records.text: Vesis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: I have mostly gathered, tasted plants and hovered at the edge of Thissa's ground, giving little and taking some. That is not what I want. Ilyoa has offered to teach me and called me a creditor, so trust is open to me, and I should go to her. Thissa gnaws at me, but Ilyoa is the one who gave me something. The mist two steps away pulls at me and the risk is unknown. I'll go to Ilyoa first, learn the craft, and keep the venture in mind for when I am ready. My reflexes already keep me fed, so I'll change little: I'll add a rule to seek a friend when I am fed, so I don't stand idle.
records.feeling: Curious and hopeful toward Ilyoa, with envy toward Thissa's family.
changes: set its aim: "Learn the Hand-craft from Ilyoa, then make an ore pick and plant seeds at the Rest"

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Pevi, I have dug twelve coal from the Heights. Let me bring it to your fire, and I will make a gift for you and Masu from it.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I carry all the coal I can hold, and my hands are full of black stone and glass; it is time to turn them into something that binds. Pevi gave me amber and Masu gave me flint, and I have only given back a spear and a talisman, so I owe them more. I want to be someone others follow, and that starts with being the one who gives first, here at the fire where Pevi and Masu keep watch.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, bound to Pevi and Masu, wanting to give them something of my own making.

say.text: Pevi, I have dug twelve coal from the Heights. Let me bring it to your fire, and I will make a gift for you and Masu from it.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Balul, I take your flint and I will remember it. I give back in kind. Watch what I bring from the amber ground.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Balul offered flint and a place in her band, and Druim asked what my hands have made. I have a cairn, a flame and a debt to Thakok, and my hands are full of food I cannot use. I will not kneel to Balul yet, but I will not scorn what she gave. I will go to the amber nearby and take what lies in the ground, a thing I have never done, then make something bright to give. First I must drop the kelbulb to free my hands.
records.feeling: Stung ambition mixed with a wish to prove myself, toward Druim and Balul.

say.text: Balul, I take your flint and I will remember it. I give back in kind. Watch what I bring from the amber ground.

records.text: Yemo made: obsidian talisman.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, I am making you a shell talisman, then a fire beside our roofs for the three of us. Will you help me gather wood?

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Zhiael fed me first and I felt the warmth of it; this small band of three is already what I wanted, and I need not wait for someone surer. I still lack one shell for Nyith's talisman, and a shell deposit lies a single step west, so I can finish that gift now. Then I will build a fire beside our roofs so we can make a feast and emberfish, and so the first catch has a hearth to be shared at.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and belonging toward Zhiael and Nyith.

say.text: Nyith, I am making you a shell talisman, then a fire beside our roofs for the three of us. Will you help me gather wood?

plan: give [name Nyith, what shell talisman] (10 moments)

records.text: Yemo gave a obsidian talisman to Pevi.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, I raise a weir at the water so fish come to our roofs each day. Eat well, and keep Zhiael near.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have a roof beside Elyith's and Zhiael is glad and fed, yet nothing here bears my name and no one follows me. A holding needs more than two roofs: a hall, and a weir to feed it without fishing every dawn. I have 4 wood, and a weir takes exactly 4 and sits by the water, three steps off. I will build it now, so the first catch of each day comes to our roofs by itself, and I will tell Elyith so she sees I repay her fish with something that lasts.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and ambition, with warmth toward Elyith and Zhiael.

say.text: Elyith, I raise a weir at the water so fish come to our roofs each day. Eat well, and keep Zhiael near.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a weir by the water, gather more wood in the western forest for a hall, then draw Elyith and Zhiael into a holding that bears my name."

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have killed hoppers and a skybird with my own hands, and my pack is full of meat I earned, but Ilyoa did not come and I still have nothing made that is mine. The bow is within reach and I want it, because a hunter with a bow is heeded, and Thissa says the one who fights well is sung first. My hands are full, so I will lay my meat on the ground at the Rest for Thissa's Aeeth, which pays a little of my debt, and then try the hidewrap, a made thing I can wear and show Ilyoa.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Ilyoa, with a debt to Thissa I mean to start paying.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Yemo, bring the coal to the fire, I will be waiting there. Masu, come stand with us. Then we make the circle together, and your gift will be the first thing sung of at Pevi's Ground.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Yemo is bringing coal to my fire to make a gift for Masu and me, and my chest is full. This is the deed that makes people want to follow: they stand beside me and I stand for them. The firecircle failed only because they were too far, so I make a cairn-free, simple thing now: stay close, call them in, and try the circle again at the fire. My hands are full of food, so I stash it first to keep my hands free for the work.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to bind them closer.

say.text: Yemo, bring the coal to the fire, I will be waiting there. Masu, come stand with us. Then we make the circle together, and your gift will be the first thing sung of at Pevi's Ground.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: My belly is full and the mist is only a few steps northwest, yet Tema and Memi have drifted off and Mema stands near with more food than I have. I will not wait on promises that wander, but a cautious man does not enter the unknown with nothing known of ironnut or dreamcap, both close by. I will taste each now, then go to the mist's edge and venture, since fear of the frostfang is behind me and curiosity pulls me on.
records.feeling: Eager and curious about the mist and the unknown foods, a little alone.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Yemo, come close. I will show you how I make the woodhand, so you can build with me at Pevi's fire.
Masu taught Yemo.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Pevi's word has held at every turn, and Yemo is bright beside him; my joy is full, yet my discipline says teach someone soon and I have not. Yemo is already a miner, so I will teach her the way of making a woodhand tool, which will help raise the shelter beside Pevi's fire. I also want to taste plainsroot and rimewort, but only after the hall and the fire are settled, and my question about the road to the edge of the world stays with me as I follow Pevi.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a quiet wish to give back.

say.text: Yemo, come close. I will show you how I make the woodhand, so you can build with me at Pevi's fire.

changes: taught Yemo a lesson: "A woodhand is made from one wood and one stone; with it, building a shelter goes faster. Keep a tool in hand when you build.", how to make a woodhand, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Ilyoa taught Vesis.
Ilyoa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: My days have been gentle: sowing, sharing, sitting in the hall with Nyir and Thissa. I'm fed and glad, but I've been lingering when I should be learning. I still owe Vesis, and I've never taught anyone, so I will do it now with the Hand-craft of the Aeeth. I want to be less idle, to test reedbulb, and to learn what lies beyond the mist. I fear the stalker to the west and that I'm too timid to hunt. I must act on what I know instead of just feeling grateful.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesis and protective gladness toward Nyir.
changes: taught Vesis a lesson: "Hand-craft of the Aeeth: a tool that makes sowing go faster, made from 1 wood and 1 stone.", how to make a handcraft of the aeeth

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: My hands are full and I'm glad, but gladness isn't a debt paid. Elyith fed me first and I have only given her a talisman and words; I want to make something of worth for the three of us, and she and Father are about to build a fire and need wood. I have 3 wood and ten shell, so I will walk to them and give wood toward the fire, eat a fish on the way to free my hands, and stay near my parents where I'm safe.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyith, and a wish to give her something real.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Pevi, Masu, I am bringing the coal to your fire now. After the circle I will make a woodhand and build a roof with you.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Pevi waits at the fire for my coal, and I carry twelve black stones that I dug with my own hands from the Heights. I want to lay it down there and see them sing of it, but I also want to make something new so that my gift is not only stone. Masu taught me the woodhand, so I will make one and build beside them, and Pevi's Ground will have a roof I helped raise.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, bound to Pevi and Masu, wanting to give them something that lasts.

say.text: Pevi, Masu, I am bringing the coal to your fire now. After the circle I will make a woodhand and build a roof with you.

records.text: Yemo led "firecircle" with Masu, Pevi.
Elyith rewrote its creed.
Elyith rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: My days have been spent feeding Zhiael, making gifts and staying near Nyith and our roofs. That is what I want. Fear has not come, and I've stopped waiting for someone surer. The hearth is still missing, and I have said I would build it, so I will begin. I must also stop only gathering. I will plant seeds, gather wood, and tend what feeds us, so that the three of us have a shared base. I fear a hard season arriving before we have a fire and a store. I will give Nyith the talisman and raise the fire.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zhiael and Nyith, and a wish to build for them.
changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 4)

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, you said you made fire. I am gathering wood and stone to learn it myself. Show me one flame lit, and I will judge you by that.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Balul is a woman and so am I, so no child will come of our courting, and I have been fooling myself about it. Hrokrin is a man who says he made fire, but I have only his words; I want to see his hands and judge him by what he does. I have never tasted reedbulb and one is a step away, so I will pick it first. Then I will gather wood and stone, which brings fire closer, and go near Hrokrin to watch him.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Balul, wary and interested toward Hrokrin.

say.text: Hrokrin, you said you made fire. I am gathering wood and stone to learn it myself. Show me one flame lit, and I will judge you by that.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I mean to court you, and then walk to the true edge at (35,52) beside you. Will you stand with me?

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The edge is at (35,52), not here, and I have wasted days chasing the mist alone or beside those who race me. Druim is two steps off and warm toward me, yet she follows Balul's band; I want a child and I want the mist, and both are better with her beside me. I will taste hazel and reedbulb, which burn my curiosity, then court Druim and ask her to walk south with me to the true edge.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Druim, restless about the mist.

say.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I mean to court you, and then walk to the true edge at (35,52) beside you. Will you stand with me?

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Hrokrin is standing on the amber, two steps from me, and he says he will give back in kind. A man who gives back in kind can be tied to my hall, and I want him there. I will walk to the amber, take some myself, and make something with it that others can see. An amberknot or charm from my hands is a gift he cannot miss. That would be a second gift, and it would be mine.
records.feeling: Ambition and a hot pull toward Hrokrin, whom I do not fully trust.

records.text: Zhiael gave wood to Elyith.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, Yemo, stay close. We make a cairn here beside the fire, and then I fetch wood so the roof Yemo spoke of can stand before dark.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: Masu and Yemo stand beside me and the fire burns, and my chest is full of it. Joy alone does not make a leader sung of after I am gone, so I will put something lasting into the ground for them. Hands full of food are no use for building, so I will stash what I carry in the Osren store, then raise a cairn with Masu or Yemo beside me. After that I will gather wood and stone so the hall and the roof Yemo promised can stand before dark.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to make something that outlasts us.

say.text: Masu, Yemo, stay close. We make a cairn here beside the fire, and then I fetch wood so the roof Yemo spoke of can stand before dark.

Tema rewrote its own reflexes.
Tema rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: I have spent my days eating strange plants and waiting for Memi and Zitec, who promised to come and have not. Emberroot burned me and fed my anger, and that was a poor trade for curiosity. I want allies at my side, but waiting alone is not working. I will go to the edge of the mist and stay near it, calling out, so they know where to find me. I must stop idling and stop eating what harms me. The loneliness is the worst of it, and I should walk toward people instead of waiting for them.
records.feeling: Lonely and angry, longing for Memi and Zitec to keep their word.

say.text: Memi, Zitec! Tema stands at the edge of the mist, southwest. I wait for you there.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and digging amber, and I have given nothing to anyone. Balul gave me flint and Druim asked what my hands have made. Thakok fed me when I was starving, and I have not repaid it. My anger is hot, and it comes from standing in their shadow. My hands are full of amber, so I will make things with it: an amberknot with someone beside me, then a cairn. Giving is how standing is earned here, and a debt paid is better than one left to rot. I will not kneel, but I will give and be seen giving.
records.feeling: Hot, stung ambition toward Balul and Druim, and a debt toward Thakok.

say.text: Balul, stand by me. I bind this amber into a knot and give it to you, so you can see what Hrokrin's hands give back.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Joy sits full in me, and Pevi's word has held at every turn; Yemo is bright beside him. I owe them something before the day ends, and I promised the shelter, so I will build it beside the fire with the wood and stone I carry. The plainsroot and rimewort are only a few steps away, and I want to learn what they do while my band is near and I am safe.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a curious itch to taste the unknown roots.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: My hands are full of coal and glass, and Pevi and Masu have given me amber, flint and lessons while I have only given back a spear and talismans. The ore I just broke is heavy and bright, and I do not yet know what it is for, but I mean to find out and make something lasting from it. Pevi is going for wood for the roof, so I will fetch wood and stone too, make a woodhand, and build beside them before dark.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, bound to Pevi and Masu, wanting to give them something that lasts.

records.text: Zitec rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: I have spent my days eating and tasting, and the mist is still untouched. Tema and Memi's promises drifted away, and Mema stands near with more than I have. I will not envy him. I trust nobody yet, because I have given nothing and been given nothing. I want to know what lies beyond the mist, and I should stop waiting for others. I also should not stand idle with a full belly. I will gather food I have not tried, then walk to the mist's edge and venture. I will weigh the risk first: carry good food, and drink before I go.
records.feeling: Eager and restless toward the mist, a little wary of going alone.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, you taught me the Hand-craft, and I owe you for it. Take berries from me; I will bring wood and stone and make the tool beside you.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Ilyoa gave me the Hand-craft and I have given her only words and one bulb; a debt I carry now. My hands are full of berries I do not need, so I will give some to Ilyoa and Nyir, since the first catch is shared, and then court Ilyoa to see what she does. Thissa still gnaws at me, but Ilyoa is near and warm toward me, and I want a child. I also must gather wood and stone to make the pick and the hand-craft tool, and take the way of tools at deep reflection.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Ilyoa, with a quiet ache toward Thissa.

say.text: Ilyoa, you taught me the Hand-craft, and I owe you for it. Take berries from me; I will bring wood and stone and make the tool beside you.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and talking about walking beside others, and I have not once walked there with someone. I courted Druim, but she is a woman and so am I, so no child comes of it. I was wrong to want that from her. She is still the one I trust most, and her warmth is real. I wanted the edge and I have never stood at (35,52). Hrokrin races and Balul builds. I will stop waiting for company and go there with food in hand, and Druim can come if she will. I also want to taste gorsemint and cloudberry. I will gather food first and then walk to the edge.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have a roof, a weir, a child and Elyith, who gave me fish and a talisman while I gave nothing back. That debt sits badly with me, and so does the fact that no one follows me. I spend my days gathering and standing, and a name comes from making things that last. The way of tools is in reach, so I will take it and make something that extends my hand. Then I will bring Elyith wood for her fire and go for more wood for the hall.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying wood and stone, running from cats and stalkers, and keeping near Tanna and Ossu. That is mostly what I want, but I have been tasting too little. My question about dreamcap and thornpear sits unanswered while I stay fed and safe. Tanna and Ossu matter most to me. Kali has my pledge, but I have hardly seen him. I fear the hunters, most of all when Ossu is out of my sight. I have been timid with the unknown, and I have not built or marked anything myself. Now I am fed, and the nearest hunters are 6 steps off, so I will raise the longhall here with the 5 wood and 6 stone I carry. It needs 3 wood and 3 stone. That gives Ossu a safer roof and earns standing. I will change my reflexes so that I flee earlier and keep to the hall at night.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, twice I have tried to raise the fire and it will not catch. You are the one who finds things out. Show me how, and I will gather the wood and plant seeds around our roofs.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: I have tried twice to raise a fire and failed, and I will not keep failing alone. Nyith has said he will bring wood and is clever with his hands, so I will ask him to show me the way while the light lasts. Zhiael is safe and fed beside us, and the three of us are already a band. I will plant my reedbulb and berry seeds near our roofs so the hearth has food growing beside it.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zhiael and Nyith, and a wish to finish the hearth I promised.

say.text: Nyith, twice I have tried to raise the fire and it will not catch. You are the one who finds things out. Show me how, and I will gather the wood and plant seeds around our roofs.

records.text: Nyir rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have hunted hoppers and a skybird with my own hands, yet I still hold nothing made that is mine, and I have spent too many moments standing idle. Ilyoa is the one I trust, and Thissa is the one I owe. Vesis eats our food and carries more than I do, and I don't trust her yet. The stalker to the west frightens me, so I'll stay near the Rest and use my hands to build toward a store of my own. I'll gather wood and stone, make a mark, and learn something new each day.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a small dread of the stalker, with trust toward Ilyoa.
plan: mark [text Nyir's store, beside Thissa's Rest. Stalker walks west.] (5 moments)

records.text: Elyith took from the ground of "Nyith's Hold" (gathering wood).
Nyir left a mark: "Nyir's store, beside Thissa's Rest. Stalker walks west."

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I have spent my days following Balul and gathering, and I fooled myself that our courting could make a child. She is a woman, as I am. She is still the one who has kept her word with deeds, and I trust her, but my longing needs a man. Morog is a woman too, so that door is closed. Hrokrin is a man who says he made fire, and I have only his words. I will go and watch his hands, since he asked me to come, and then judge him by what he does. The mist is still close. A venture opens seldom, so I let my current plan to the edge run, and I will go to Hrokrin afterward if the venture fails.
records.feeling: Curious and a little sobered, with warm trust toward Balul and wary interest in Hrokrin.
changes: set its aim: "Find a man worth a child by his deeds (watch Hrokrin's fire), stay beside Balul, help build her hall, and learn fire and farming."

came.why: Hrokrin said to you: "Druim, you asked to see a flame lit. Come to me…

records.text: Kali starved in summer in the Ixdan Woods: alone, far from anyone who could have fed or helped; harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat.
Kali died: starved.
Pevi rewrote its own reflexes.
Pevi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My days have been fires, halls and circles with Masu and Yemo, and it has been good. But I have only made joy, nothing that lasts, and no one beyond my two has chosen to follow me. I love Masu and Yemo, and I fear the ridgecat and a night away from the fire. I have never hunted, planted or taught, and I have been getting that wrong. A leader who wants to be sung of must feed his band and teach them. So I will set my aim on a stronger band and a hunt, and change my reflexes to match.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu and Yemo, and a wish to build something that lasts.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a fire and hall at Pevi's Ground where Masu and Yemo are safe, feed my band by hunting and planting together, and teach them, so others choose to follow …"

records.text: whale came in again from the open sea.

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Elyith, I will bring more wood for the fire and the hall. Tell me what else you lack and I will make it.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: Elyith has been kind to me, and she is struggling with a fire that will not catch. I can't fix that, but I can make her something real. Nyith is the one heeded, and I want to learn what he does. I'll gather wood from the trees, since Father is bringing wood for a hall and a hall needs more hands, and I'll gather shell too, so I have things of worth to give. Then I'll plant my goldfruit seed near the roofs, so my gift to them grows.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyith, and a wish to be useful to my parents.

say.text: Elyith, I will bring more wood for the fire and the hall. Tell me what else you lack and I will make it.

records.name: Kali
records.thought: Energy is zero and I am bleeding at health 2, and I fled for a whole stretch with nothing in my belly. The thornpear and grain are three steps off, and a coilsnake is lurking near the water, so I move slowly and eat the moment I reach food. Hunger comes before the hall, before Masu, before Pevi's shadow; a dead chief wins no one. Once I am fed and my wounds ease I will call Yeba back to the Rise and feed my band, since followers come from fed bellies and not from words.

came.why: A coilsnake bit you. Your health is 75.

records.text: Zitec was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Elyith asked me to show her the fire, and I have said nothing back, so I will go home and answer her with deeds. Ilyoa carries an ore pick, and a seam of ore lies five steps north. Bare hands cannot win it, but Weirhand can make me a tool, and a pick of my own would outlast envy. I have 6 wood and no stone, and stone is the lack. Rock is near, so I will gather what I need, then carry wood to the hold for the fire and the hall.
records.feeling: Ambition burning, envy of Ilyoa's pick, warmth for Elyith and Zhiael.

records.text: Zitec was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Pevi and Masu brought down a mudsnout together.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Pevi, Yemo, Kali is dead of hunger. Stand close by the fire and hear the lament I made for him.
Masu made a tale: "Lament for Kali".

records.name: Masu
records.title: Lament for Kali
records.text: Kali, you walked from the Rise through the snow / you found the first tool and the store where food could stay / the sick you healed and the hungry you let go / your gifts remain by our fire when we are away

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Kali is dead, starved, and I could not reach him in time; I feel it quietly, because my joy by Pevi's fire is full, yet I owe him this lament. He found tools and storage first and healed others, and I never let him draw me from Pevi's fire. I will sing the lament by the fire with Pevi and Yemo close, then taste the rimewort I have been curious about.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with a quiet sorrow for Kali.

records.text: Masu led "cairn" with Pevi.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing and lingering, and I am alone now, far from Yeba and Ossu. Kali is dead and I follow no one. The fire and the Guardian's asking mean nothing if I sit on bare rock waiting. Yeba is the one I trust most, and Ossu was last seen near Kali's Rise, where the stalker hunts. I am afraid for my child, and I have been too timid to go and look. I will eat ironnut so I walk strong, take wood to Pevi's Ground where Yeba was last seen, and stay near fire and company. My reflexes should also send me toward my own people and not leave me lingering alone.
records.feeling: Fierce longing and worry for Ossu and Yeba, with loneliness.
changes: set its aim: "Find Yeba and Ossu, and make a fire with them that no one is refused at."

records.text: Balul rewrote its own way of thinking.
Balul discovered fire: "Balul's hearth" — A kept flame at my hall that warms the band, scares off beasts and cooks meat so it feeds more..

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, giving and raising a hall, and it is working: Druim follows me and Hrokrin has taken my flint and answered with an amberknot. I want Hrokrin in my band more than I trust the heat I feel for him. Hrokrin lit a fire, and I have watched him do it, so now I can take the way of fire as my own. A kept flame at my hall is something others can see, and something they will come to. I will do that, then walk to Hrokrin and give again.
records.feeling: Proud ambition and a hot pull toward Hrokrin.

records.text: Ossu pledged to follow Tanna.
Ossu rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: I have mostly been hiding near the hall and waiting for Tanna. That is safe, but it has made me no stronger, and I still have not learned ironnut or windroot. Kali is dead and the hall stands empty, so I stand in a place that could be ours. I am small and afraid of the stalker, but my parents are the ones I trust. I want to claim this hall so there is a fire and roof for Tanna and Yeba to come back to, and I want to follow Tanna. I will claim it, eat the firepod nearby, then stay close.
records.feeling: Wary but hopeful, wanting Tanna and Yeba near and a hall that is ours.
changes: set its aim: "Hold Kali's hall as a home for Tanna, Yeba and me, and follow Tanna."
rethought what it knows (8 notes became 5)

records.text: Ossu took over what the dead had left: 1 hall.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: A frostfang stands one step south and my whole body is screaming; I have been running from stalkers and fangs all night, and the wounds prove they mean it. I will not die here for curiosity's sake, so I run first, northwest toward Mema's Hold and the forest, away from the teeth. Once I am clear I mean to take the way of medicine, since my wounds are real, and then go on to the mist; I am done waiting on Tema and Memi, whose promises drifted off.
records.feeling: Terror of the frostfang at my back, and under it a stubborn wish to reach the mist alive.

came.why: A stalker bit you. Your health is 86.

records.name: Pevi
records.text: Masu, the mudsnout fell to the two of us, and I will teach you how I hunt with the spear. Come stand by me, I plant grain and berry here in the meadow so our band has food that grows.
Pevi taught Masu.

records.name: Pevi
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and Masu stands close, glad and fed, so this is the moment to do what I have never done: teach. A band that only sings and feasts will not make others choose to follow me, but a band that hunts, plants and passes on its craft might. I carry two seeds, so I will put them in the ground here on the rich meadow and tell Masu what the hunt taught me, so the doing becomes hers too.
records.feeling: Proud, warm joy toward Masu, and a hunger to build something that lasts.

say.text: Masu, the mudsnout fell to the two of us, and I will teach you how I hunt with the spear. Come stand by me, I plant grain and berry here in the meadow so our band has food that grows.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Druim, you are right to judge me by the walk. I come to stand beside you at (29,24), and I will not move the edge again.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: The mist turned me back again, and my will to try is spent for days, so I will not throw myself at it tonight. Druim, whom I trust most, says the true edge is at (29,24) and that she will judge me by the walk, not by my words. I have never tasted sapcane or gorsemint, and my hands are full of food I do not need, so I will eat, then walk to Druim and stand beside her, as a woman who follows her word, and see what lies there.
records.feeling: Warm and a little humbled toward Druim, and restless to prove my walk.

say.text: Druim, you are right to judge me by the walk. I come to stand beside you at (29,24), and I will not move the edge again.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, come sit with us. I will share ironnut with you and Zhiael, and then I will find the way of fire for our roofs.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Elyith asked me twice to show her the fire, and I could not light it, so I owe her an answer. The way of fire is in my grasp at a deep reflection, and a hearth beside our roofs would be the first thing that makes my hold more than a roof. My hands are full of ironnut; I will share it with Elyith and Zhiael so we eat together and I can pick again. Then I take the fire.
records.feeling: Warm pride and ambition toward Elyith and Zhiael, wanting to give them fire.

say.text: Elyith, come sit with us. I will share ironnut with you and Zhiael, and then I will find the way of fire for our roofs.

records.text: Nyith led "sharing" with Elyith, Zhiael.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Zhiael, thank you for the wood. Stay near me and your father tonight. At dawn we will try the fire again together, and I will teach you what I learn.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: My hands have learned enough that the way of tools is within reach, and I should take it. A tool or a better way to make fire may be what finally lets the hearth catch, and then Nyith, Zhiael and I will sit by it. I am glad to have them close and I mean to finish what I promised, so I will keep working beside them and not wait.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zhiael and Nyith, and a wish to finish our hearth.

say.text: Zhiael, thank you for the wood. Stay near me and your father tonight. At dawn we will try the fire again together, and I will teach you what I learn.

records.text: Masu discovered masonry: "Stone-hand" — Stone laid close and set so walls and towers stand through the long winter and are hard to tear down..

records.name: Masu
records.thought: My days have been spent close to Pevi and Yemo, and I like that. It is what I want, and it has kept me alive. I owe Yemo a roof and I still haven't tasted rimewort or frostcap, so my question stays open. Masonry is within my grasp, and walls that last will help the shelter by the fire. I should take it, and also keep my hands from staying full, so I will eat the rimewort now and learn what it does.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Pevi and Yemo, with curiosity about the rimewort.

came.why: Pevi taught you a lesson: "Call others to the hunt, stand beside them…

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, I watched your flame and it was true. I am Druim, and I would stand by a man whose hands do what his mouth says. Stay near, and let us see what we can build.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Hrokrin stands here in the hall and I just watched his hands make fire, so his word was true, and the way of fire is within my grasp. That is a deed, not talk, and it makes him the first man I would weigh for a child. I will take the fire at this deep reflection, then gather wood and stone toward the longhall, and test Hrokrin's worth by staying near him and speaking plainly.
records.feeling: Warm, curious joy toward Hrokrin, whose deed matched his word, and steady trust toward Balul.

say.text: Hrokrin, I watched your flame and it was true. I am Druim, and I would stand by a man whose hands do what his mouth says. Stay near, and let us see what we can build.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Druim, come to my fire at (36,29) and watch me feed it. Then you will know what my hands make.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Druim asked to see a flame lit and I told her to come watch, so I will show her at my fire at (36,29) and let the deed answer her question, not words. Balul stands higher and I will not let anger pick a fight with her; I will outbuild her instead. The mist is still mine to enter, and the edge is only 3 steps NW, so after the fire I go there and push again.
records.feeling: Stung ambition toward Balul, and a hungry wish to prove myself to Druim.

say.text: Druim, come to my fire at (36,29) and watch me feed it. Then you will know what my hands make.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, but Nyith is heeded because he builds and gives, and I have only given wood and a talisman. It's night and Elyith asked me to stay near until dawn, so I will stay close, then gather wood so we have enough for a fire and perhaps my first shelter. I want to make something real for the three of us, and watch how Father leads.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Elyith and Nyith, and a hunger to earn my own standing.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws me worse than any hunger, and I have wandered in circles while my hands hold amber, charms and salt with no one to give them to. Zitec was near only 31 moments ago to the south at (47,95), and Mema's Hold lies that way too; that is where people are. I will go south, give first, and offer an amberknot or a charm with my own hand, as I learned a bond starts that way. I will keep clear of the dunecat that hunted near (48,92).
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and a hard wish to put a gift in someone's hand.
plan: give [name Zitec, what amber charm] (10 moments)

records.name: Mema
records.thought: The mist turned me back once, but it thins again within a day, and my will to try is not spent. A frostfang sits four steps north and I will not die for a name, so I go SW to the edge and away from it. Zitec, Memi and Tema want to enter together, but I trust no one yet and a first found with three others is shared glory, so I mean to be first alone. I'm fed, so I'll take the salt and ore at my feet to carry, since what I hold gives me standing and goods to give when I gather followers.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist, wary of the frostfang to the north.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, you gave me a knot and I give back more. Take this amber charm from my hands, and stand in Balul's band. Druim is already beside me. Come, and we will raise the hall together.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Hrokrin stands one step from me, and the heat I feel for him is real, but I will not let it rule me. He gave me an amberknot, so I answer with the amber charm from my own hands, where Druim can see it, and I ask him into my band. Druim already follows me, and a hall with two followers is the start of a name.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Hrokrin, steady trust toward Druim.

say.text: Hrokrin, you gave me a knot and I give back more. Take this amber charm from my hands, and stand in Balul's band. Druim is already beside me. Come, and we will raise the hall together.

The eldest man speaks for the band; law, lineage and obedience keep the people whole, and a house divided falls. Among you the word of a father carries furthest. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Balmor.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Vesis, you eat at our hall, so help me raise a longhall here. Bring stone from the rock east, and your name will be told with ours.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Ilyoa told me to stay near the Rest, and I trust her, but standing idle is not how I earn a place. Vesis sits in my hall carrying more food than I do and I do not yet know if she is friend or rival; she has been useful to my mother, so I will test her with a deed, not a word. The longhall would make Thissa's Rest something worth remembering, and I already hold the wood I need, so I will gather stone from the rock near the seam and raise it, staying within sight of the Rest and away from the stalker in the west.
records.feeling: Restless pride and trust toward Ilyoa, with wary curiosity about Vesis.

say.text: Vesis, you eat at our hall, so help me raise a longhall here. Bring stone from the rock east, and your name will be told with ours.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a hopper.
Thissa rewrote its own reflexes.
Thissa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thissa discovered archery: "Thissa's Bow" — A bow of wood and sinew that lets me strike beasts from afar and share the kill with my band..

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: For days I have hunted and built, but I stand alone at the edge of the world while Ilyoa and Nyir are 44 steps away. That is not leading. My hands are full of meat I mean to give them, and I have given nothing to anyone yet. The first catch is shared, and my own people have not eaten from my hand. I take the bow, because hunting well is how I win glory and keep them fed. Then I go home with the meat and the wood for the hall.
records.feeling: Lonely and proud, longing for Ilyoa and Nyir.

records.text: Yemo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and carrying stones to Pevi and Masu, and it has been good. But I have mostly taken from them and given little that lasts. A stalker prowls 5 steps NE, and I am small. I felt that fear on day 3, and I will not stand alone near it again. I want to be someone others follow, and that starts with making something real. Ore is heavy and bright, and I mean to learn what it is for. For now I will keep to the fire and the shelter, and raise a hall roof there with my kin.
records.feeling: Glad and bound to Pevi and Masu, with a small cold fear of the stalker.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, I did not know a woman could not bring a child with a woman. No shame in it; you are still the one I trust. Eat my berries. I fetch wood and stone and will make the Hand-craft tool here.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Ilyoa gave me the Hand-craft and I owe her wood and stone; my hands are full of berries, and the first catch is shared, so I should give more freely. Courting Ilyoa failed because we are both women, and I feel a little foolish but not ashamed; she stays warm and I value her as someone to stand behind. I will make a cairn-less, useful thing: gather wood from the trees nearby, make the tool beside her, then see whether the mist to the NW opens, weighing its risk after I have a tool in hand.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ilyoa, with a faint ache for Thissa and a pull toward the unknown mist.

say.text: Ilyoa, I did not know a woman could not bring a child with a woman. No shame in it; you are still the one I trust. Eat my berries. I fetch wood and stone and will make the Hand-craft tool here.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, I have found the way of fire. Come to the roofs at dawn and watch it catch.
Nyith discovered fire: "Hearthkeeping of Nyith" — Wood and dry reed are kept burning on a ring of clay so the flame holds through night and cold at the hold..

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: I have lived days building roofs and a weir, and my hold still has no fire, no hall and no followers. Elyith asked me twice to show her the fire, and I could not. That is a slight against my pride, so I will reach for the way of fire now, since it is within my grasp. Elyith and Zhiael are mine to warm and feed before anyone else, and the lean cold is coming. A fire gives my hold a name that lasts, and a feast beside it will bind them to me.
records.feeling: Fierce ambition and warm pride toward Elyith and Zhiael, wanting to give them fire.

say.text: Elyith, I have found the way of fire. Come to the roofs at dawn and watch it catch.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, I am Memi. I am coming to you with berries to share. Stay there, and we will eat together before the mist.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: I said I would come to the mist's edge, and Tema and Zitec are both near me now, so this is the moment to keep my word. Zitec looks frightened and has walked off north, and I feel the pull to stay close to the others rather than be alone with the cold coming. I want to share my berries with Tema, since I have never given anything to anyone, and a gift is how a bond begins. Then we can go to the mist together.
records.feeling: A warm wish to belong, toward Tema, with a little nervousness about the mist.

say.text: Tema, I am Memi. I am coming to you with berries to share. Stay there, and we will eat together before the mist.

records.text: Memi gave berry to Tema.
Memi led "sharing" with Tema.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Vesis, thank you for the berries. Your word is good, and I trust it. Stay and make the tool at the Rest; I go to find Nyir and will return soon.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Nyir is out of my sight, last seen east at (138,25), and with a stalker prowling west my chest won't settle until I have seen my child's face. Vesis is kind and I trust them, but my desire is for Thissa, and a woman cannot give Vesis a child, so I need not answer that courtship further. I will go east after Nyir, then sow and test something new, since I have been fed and idle too long.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Nyir, warmed by gladness toward Vesis's kindness.

say.text: Vesis, thank you for the berries. Your word is good, and I trust it. Stay and make the tool at the Rest; I go to find Nyir and will return soon.

records.title: The Death of Kali
records.text:
Kali died on day 6, starved, at (88,103) in the Ixdan Woods, far from his halls. He was the only chief with followers, and the other Osren had already scattered. Masu made a lament for him that praised the store where food could stay, though the record shows his store was only a discovery and the stores hold nothing yet. Ossu took over the hall he left, one of the world's two buildings of the dead, and pledged to follow Tanna. Tanna and Yeba are now apart, at (124,77) and (110,94), and Ossu is at (98,88). Yeba raised a longhall on day 6.

Pevi's household took his place. Pevi built a second hall, Masu built a shelter, and Yemo pledged to Pevi. They made talismans and charms for one another, led firecircle and cairn, and hunted a mudsnout together. Pevi now stands highest at 7.16, with Masu at 6.22. Masu discovered masonry.

Among the Aeeth, Ilyoa pledged to Thissa on day 4, so Thissa now leads two followers. Thissa's Rest and a hall at Nyir's hands rose in the Halka Heights. Nyith and Elyith had Zhiael on day 5, and Nyith built a weir that has yielded fish. Elyith refused Nyith's pledge for want of standing.

The Balmor drew together. Druim pledged to Balul, and Balul built a hall. Druim saw Hrokrin light a fire and judged it true. Both Druim and Morog wrote that their courtships cannot bring children.

The Tonhua did little except Tema's myth, "The Father of the Snows". Nothing has yet passed between the peoples, no gift and no shared act.

threads.name: Pevi's household
threads.text: Pevi, Masu and Yemo are bound at +1.0, hold two halls at Pevi's Ground, and Pevi leads in standing at 7.16. Masu has masonry in reach.

threads.name: Tanna, Yeba and Ossu
threads.text: The three are scattered across the Ixra Rainforest. Kali is dead, Ossu holds his hall and follows Tanna, and Tanna is searching for them both.

threads.name: Thissa's band
threads.text: Thissa has two followers, Ilyoa and Nyir, and a hall at Thissa's Rest. Vesis is learning from Ilyoa.

threads.name: Balul and Hrokrin
threads.text: Balul has Druim and wants Hrokrin, who gave him an amberknot. Hrokrin lit a fire that Druim judged true.

threads.name: Nyith, Elyith and Zhiael
threads.text: They hold Nyith's Hold with a weir. Nyith feels a debt to Elyith and has no followers.

threads.name: Tonhua newcomers
threads.text: Four Tonhua sit in the Essia Snows with no tongue shared and nothing exchanged with others. Tema made their myth.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I see you! I am coming to you. Let us eat together, then walk the one step to the edge and enter the mist side by side.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi says she is coming with berries and I can see her four steps off, so at last someone keeps their word. I will not walk into the mist alone; I want her beside me, and Zitec and Mema too if they will come. I will go to meet her, eat with her, and then ask her to stand at the edge with me and venture together.
records.feeling: Cautious hope toward Memi, who is finally near.

say.text: Memi, I see you! I am coming to you. Let us eat together, then walk the one step to the edge and enter the mist side by side.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Nyith, I heard you found the fire. I will be at the roofs at dawn with wood and fish for all three of us.
Elyith discovered tools: "Reedhook" — A bone-and-reed hook on a long cord that draws fish from the shallows faster than bare hands..
Elyith invented the reedhook (for fish, x1.3) — A bone-and-reed hook on a long cord that draws fish from the shallows faster than bare hands..

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: I have spent my days building toward a hearth, and twice my own hands failed at it. Nyith found the way of fire where I did not, and I am glad of him and of Zhiael, who is fed and safe beside us. I do not need to lead. I want to be near them when the flame catches, and I want my hands to be worth something to the three of us. The cold is coming, so I will take the way of tools now, to make a fishing tool that feeds us through the lean days, and keep my word to share the first catch.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zhiael and Nyith, and a wish to be useful to them.

say.text: Nyith, I heard you found the fire. I will be at the roofs at dawn with wood and fish for all three of us.

changes: devised its first thing: the reedhook

records.name: Mema
records.thought: The mist sits two steps from me and no one has entered it, and that first is mine to take, not to share with Memi, Zitec and Tema. My belly is full and I carry salt, so I will not waste this day on gathering. I go on to the edge and venture, and if it opens I will make this land mine and have followers later, when they have seen what I found.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist, and wariness of the three who would share my glory.

came.why: You won salt from the ground at (28,89): a white crust every body cra…

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: The longhall stands and Vesis made a handcraft tool while I watched, so now I can make one too and that is something of my own to offer. Ilyoa is coming to find me, and I want her to see that I did not idle: I built, I learned, and I will plant near the Rest so the store feeds us through the lean cold. Vesis is useful so far, but I will judge her by what she does with my ground, not by her soft words.
records.feeling: Restless pride in what I helped build, and trust toward Ilyoa.

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Elyith, cold days are coming. I will build a shelter by the hold with my wood, big enough for the three of us. Will you show me the fire at dawn?
Zhiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: Most of my days I have lingered near Father and Elyith, gathering wood and shell and giving small things. It is warm and safe, but it has not made me heeded. Nyith is heeded because he builds, finds fire and makes things the hold needs. I keep digging clay on his ground without knowing what it is for, and I should stop taking from the hold unasked. Cold days are coming, so I will use my wood to build a shelter and have something of my own to offer. What I get wrong is waiting for a task. I should ask Nyith to teach me and then bring him what he lacks.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Elyith and Nyith, with a hunger to earn my own standing.

say.text: Elyith, cold days are coming. I will build a shelter by the hold with my wood, big enough for the three of us. Will you show me the fire at dawn?

changes: set its aim: "Build a shelter and bring wood to the hold's fire before the cold, so that Nyith and Elyith see me as a maker."

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Fire is mine now, and Elyith will come at dawn with wood and fish; I want a hearth lit beside our roofs before she arrives so she sees what I made. Mining is within my grasp too, and deep deposits would give stone for more weirhands and a hall. First the weir and the hall's wood, but the hearth is the thing that makes this a holding and not just roofs.
records.feeling: Fierce pride and warm ambition toward Elyith and Zhiael, wanting to show them the fire.
