records.thought: I am warm and unafraid, and what I most want is to give something back to Tanna and Yeba, who have only ever given to me. Tanna is at the cave making a roof, so I will carry my wood and join the fire there, and take the raft-way at my next deep reflection since it is in my grasp. The reedbulb and highbloom still wait for me to taste them, but Yeba's dreamcap lesson tells me to go slowly and watch him first.
records.feeling: Warm and eager to give back, toward Tanna and Yeba.

came.why: Yeba said to everyone nearby: "Tanna, Ossu, dreamcap hurt me and my b…

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Vesis, good. Meet me at the cave by Nyir. I will lay the first wood of the store, and you lay yours beside it. What we raise together feeds us together through the cold.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis says she will raise the store with me, and I want that bond made with my own hands, not left to words. The way of storage is within my grasp, so I will take it at my next deep reflection and then build the store beside the cave, where Nyir waits, so winter does not thin my band. If she works at my store and eats from it, she may come to stand under my name.
records.feeling: Proud and driven toward Vesis, with a father's pull toward Nyir.

say.text: Vesis, good. Meet me at the cave by Nyir. I will lay the first wood of the store, and you lay yours beside it. What we raise together feeds us together through the cold.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: The mist opened for me and I walked through, yet no one follows and nothing bears my name but a rock and a reach. Mining is within my grasp now, and deep ore, tin and iron are the kind of firsts the Fens can give me. I will take it at once, then claim this land with a kept flame and a made thing, before the Meme or Memi's band set their marks here.
records.feeling: Proud, greedy ambition to own this new land before others do.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Elyith, Zhiael, a stalker hunts near the hold. Keep to the shelters and the store while I fetch wood and stone for the hall. I will return.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: My hands are full of fish and my plan ran out with me standing still, which is no way for a chief to spend a night. A stalker is prowling near the hold and has already killed twice, so Elyith and Zhiael must stay close to the shelters while I go for the wood and stone the hall needs. I'll eat one fish to free my hands, then go for the western forest wood and stone, since a hall that bears my name is the nearest real step.
records.feeling: Proud and driven, watchful over Elyith and Zhiael with a stalker near.

say.text: Elyith, Zhiael, a stalker hunts near the hold. Keep to the shelters and the store while I fetch wood and stone for the hall. I will return.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Urum is out there at (29,53), hungry and alone, and the ridgecat prowls near the hall. A father's word is the first law of my people, and I told Druim I would bring him home. The mist is shut for five days, so I will spend them making what others can see: I fetch my son and then fill the store with coal and salt, as I swore before witnesses. Balul's bow can wait; my children cannot.
records.feeling: Protective resolve toward Urum, with a tight edge of dread at the ridgecat.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby: "Stay inside Balul's hall, both of you…

records.name: Balul
records.text: Morog, Hrokrin, the cat is close. Stay in the hall until I loose my bow at it. When it is gone we gather wood and food and fill the store together, and whoever fills it eats first.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: The ridgecat two steps east still stirs dread in me, but I hold a bow now and my hall is warm, with Morog and Hrokrin beside my fire. Jealousy over Druim burns, but my own discipline says do not chase her, build instead and give first. The store stands empty, and the cold will deepen, so I must cut wood and bring food while the cat is kept off by my bow and my company.
records.feeling: Proud and wary of the ridgecat, trusting toward Hrokrin and Morog.

say.text: Morog, Hrokrin, the cat is close. Stay in the hall until I loose my bow at it. When it is gone we gather wood and food and fill the store together, and whoever fills it eats first.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Tema said she will meet me at the fire, and my word is good, so I should go there now instead of lingering out in this bitter cold with a dunecat about. Thakok is near, and his gift of the charm is a debt I want to pay; I will give him a berry and hold the rest for the shared meal with Tema. Then I will walk on to the fire at the Salt Rock, where there is warmth and company.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Tema, a tender gratitude toward Thakok, and a wish to get out of the cold.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: My throat is dry and the water is only three steps SE, so I drink first. A stalker hunts near and Nyith is out in the forest, so I keep close to the shelters and stay near Elyith. The hold lacks a hall and I hold 4 wood and no stone, so when Nyith returns I will ask him to teach me what he knows, and I will carry wood toward the hall. That is how I get listened to as he is.
records.feeling: Parched and wary of the stalker, but warmly bound to Nyith and Elyith.

records.text: Masu rewrote its own way of thinking.
Masu discovered storage: "Pevi's Larder" — A store at the hall where Yemo and I stash food through the cold so no fire goes hungry..

records.name: Masu
records.thought: I have spent these days burying Pevi, guarding Yemo and carrying seeds I never planted, and that is not enough. Winter is here and the cold bites with no roof over me. Yemo is the one thing I have left, and I want us both under a roof with food stored. I will go to the shelter by Yemo, plant Pevi's seeds near the hall, and keep the store full. I will also learn storage, because the lean season is what kills people, and Kali starved without it.
records.feeling: Protective love for Yemo, with grief for Pevi under it.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you. I share food with you. Eat with me.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Memi is five steps off and walking toward me, and I will not stand here like a post this time. I give first: I have food in my hand and she has already answered my amber, so I walk up and share a meal, which needs her within two steps. The cold bites and I am alone, and a bond with her and Tema is the only thing that will start a band, so I move to her now.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, with warm hope toward Memi.

say.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you. I share food with you. Eat with me.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: The edge was not where I stood, and the venture failed. Still, I am fed and whole, and my hunger to know is overwhelming: emberroot and sunfig lie three steps away and I have never tasted them. Druim of the Balmor flees ten steps north, and I cannot read her tongue; she draws me and the sight of her with Hrokrin gnaws, but I will not chase or harm her. I will learn the two foods first, then go to Mema's Salt Rock where Memi and Tema keep a fire, and press on toward the mist with them as I promised.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the unknown foods, with a quiet ache toward Druim.

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Vesis, come under the hall roof. We share food together, the first catch is shared, and then we raise the store beside Father.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I stand inside the Rest with Father, Mother and Vesis near, and my hands are full, so I cannot gather or take anything new. Thissa is about to lay the first wood of the store, and I want my wood and stone to be in it so my name sits on the walls. The hall lets me share food with Vesis. That is how I make her follow Nyir and not only Thissa, and she has already trusted me twice. First I will do hallwelcome with her, then stash what I carry, then bring wood and stone to Father's store.
records.feeling: Restless hope and pride toward Vesis, Thissa and Ilyoa, who stand close.

say.text: Vesis, come under the hall roof. We share food together, the first catch is shared, and then we raise the store beside Father.

records.text: Nyir led "hallwelcome" with Vesis.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: I have been running for a long while and my energy is down to 36, but the plan I set walks me back toward Balul's Hall with the store as the end of it, and that is where my parents and my debt are. Mema is a stranger whose words I cannot read, yet I watched them eat and dig clay and do me no harm, so I will keep my distance and not turn my back on them. My hands are full, so the stash at the hall is the right deed: Balul and Thakash will see what I gave. I should eat an ironnut on the way so I do not faint, since that frees a place in my hands as well.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward Mema, and a steady wish to be near my parents and pay Balul with a deed.

records.text: Nyir came of age.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Masu, a frostfang is close to the southwest. I have an amber charm for you; take it, and let us keep the roof together until it passes.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: A frostfang is five steps off and I am small, but Masu is beside me and the shelter roof is over us; Pevi died for less than this. I will not leave her side, and I will give her something made so my debt is paid in deeds, not only words. I have never tasted thornpear or sapcane, but curiosity can wait until the fang is gone.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty and dread toward Masu and the frostfang.

say.text: Masu, a frostfang is close to the southwest. I have an amber charm for you; take it, and let us keep the roof together until it passes.

plan: give [name Masu, what amber charm] (5 moments)

records.text: Yemo gave a amber charm to Masu.

records.name: Druim
records.text: Urum, I am coming with food. Stay where you are, or come toward me. Do not run from me, run to me.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Urum is at (30,52) with energy 34, fleeing something, and he is my child, so nothing else matters until I reach him. My hands are full of food, which is good: I can give him berry or meat the moment I am beside him, and I should drop the ironnut seed concerns for later. Thakash is also fleeing nearby; a beast hunts in these fens, so I go west toward them, eyes open, and bring both children back toward Balul's Hall and Hrokrin.
records.feeling: Sharp worry for Urum, with love for both my children.

say.text: Urum, I am coming with food. Stay where you are, or come toward me. Do not run from me, run to me.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby: "Morog, Hrokrin, the cat is close. Sta…

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Thissa, I am coming to the cave with my wood and stone. I will lay mine beside yours.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Thissa asked me to meet him at the cave and lay my wood beside his, and Nyir calls me to share food under the hall roof. I gave my word to Thissa, and building beside him earns standing and a place against the cold. Jealousy over Ilyoa and Thissa still stings, but I will let the work quiet it and give Ilyoa the time she asked for. I carry wood and stone, so I will go to the cave, lay my share, and sit with Nyir afterward.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to keep my word to Thissa, with a quiet ache toward Ilyoa.

say.text: Thissa, I am coming to the cave with my wood and stone. I will lay mine beside yours.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a murrock.
Thakash rewrote its own reflexes.
Thakash rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thakash discovered archery: "Thakash's bow" — A bent hazel branch and a cord, so I can hit beasts from far and hunt beside my band..

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing teeth and chasing after Hrokrin, and I have made little that others can see. I built a standing stone and found logs, but I have not shown them to anyone or given them away. Hrokrin matters most to me and I burn that Druim is closer to him. My fear is real: I am small, and the cats and fangs kill our kind. What I got wrong was going out alone. I will stay near my band, keep food in my hands, and give first. A bow is worth learning, because hunting beside Balul and Hrokrin is how I get strong.
records.feeling: Longing for Hrokrin, and dread of the ridgecat.

came.why: Hrokrin, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Balul'…

records.text: Balul rewrote its own reflexes.
Balul rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My days have gone into making things: tools, fire, a hall, a store, a bow. They have brought me three followers and a name, and that is what I wanted. But the store is still empty, the cold is deepening, and I have cut no wood. Jealousy over Druim eats at me, yet chasing her has won me nothing. Giving first and building in sight of everyone is what works. The ridgecat frightens me and I have not hunted once, so I will change that. The bow is made and the band should hunt together. I want strangers to see a full store and a hall with a fire at Balul's Hall, and to come to it. Wood first, then the hunt, then the store.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of the ridgecat, and jealous over Druim.

came.why: Hrokrin, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Balul'…

records.name: Nyir
records.text: Vesis, I am grown now. Stand with me at the water, then let us talk of a child between us.
Nyir rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, stashing and sitting in the hall, and it has been good. But I am grown now, and I still hold no thing of my own that others envy. Thissa and Ilyoa have ore picks and I do not. Vesis draws me, and she is not close kin, so a child could come of us. Thirst is on me and the winter is thin. I will drink first, then court Vesis. After that I will make an ore pick from my wood and stone, since I know how, and so end my envy.
records.feeling: Warm desire toward Vesis, and some envy of Thissa's pick.

say.text: Vesis, I am grown now. Stand with me at the water, then let us talk of a child between us.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Zhiael, your shellstring is dear to me. Come to the store and I will show you how we keep food for the lean season, so you will never go hungry.
Elyith taught Zhiael.
Elyith taught Zhiael storage ("Hearth Larder").

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Zhiael gave me a shellstring and I owe him a deed, not only words, so I will teach him what I carry: the way of storing, so he can keep himself fed when I am not beside him. My hands are full of ironnut and the store holds 18, so I will put what I carry into the store and then go out for more while the last berries still bear. Nyith has not yet come back, and I will keep the hold warm and ready for him.
records.feeling: Warm protective love for Zhiael, and a debt I want to repay with a deed.

say.text: Zhiael, your shellstring is dear to me. Come to the store and I will show you how we keep food for the lean season, so you will never go hungry.

changes: taught Zhiael a lesson: "Food stored in a store beside the hold keeps through the lean season; fill it with ironnut, berry and fish while plants still bear, and eat from it when the pl…", the way of storage

records.text: Nyir is courting Vesis.
Mema rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mema discovered mining: "Mema's Deep Hand" — I read the seams in the rock and break out ore, tin and iron where others see only stone..

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing firsts and have them: fire, cord, the Fens. Yet nobody follows me, I own no roof, and I have given nothing to anyone, so my standing stays thin. Mining is in reach and the ore seam at (19,61) is close, so I take it now. The edge at (21,53) is one step away and I want to push into the mist again. I do not trust the Balmor children or the Meme yet. I need a roof and a store before the wet cold gets worse, and I need wood for them.
records.feeling: Greedy, proud ambition toward the unclaimed land and the mist.

records.text: Urum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to running, gathering and carrying for Balul's store, and I am glad of it, but I have planted little and made nothing that is truly mine. Druim and Hrokrin matter most to me, and Balul too, because her teaching and her hall keep me safe. I want a store that I filled myself, and I fear the ridgecat and being alone and small. My mistake was running with an empty head. I should keep food carried, stay near my kin, and let the strangers come to me slowly.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Druim, and wary curiosity toward the strangers.
changes: rethought what it knows (15 notes became 5)

came.why: Druim said to you: "Urum, I am coming with food. Stay where you are, …

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Walo, a wolf prowls to the southwest. Stay close to me and let us share food here by the water.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: A wolf is four steps off and I'm in a cave mouth, so I should stay out of its reach rather than test my luck. Curiosity pulls at me hard, and Walo and Teque are right beside me, which makes this a good time to share food and start making allies. Standing among others matters, and sharing is the first thing I have never done, so I'll lay out food with Walo, then maybe go on toward the edge with company.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary of the wolf, warm toward Walo and Teque.

say.text: Walo, a wolf prowls to the southwest. Stay close to me and let us share food here by the water.

changes: set its aim: "Become a healer and gain standing by learning which plants feed and which hurt, sharing what I learn with others."
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge, and what do bitterleaf and highbloom do to a body?

records.text: Chuka led "sharing" with Tema.

records.name: Techi
records.text: Walo, Teque, Chuka, it is Techi. Let us share a fire and the caves. The sick are fed first, and none of us should be alone in the rain.
Techi declared a custom: "The sick are fed first, and no one eats alone by the hearth while another goes hungry."
Techi made a tale: "The Mother of the Fens".

records.name: Techi
records.title: The Mother of the Fens
records.text: In the first rain the Mother lay down in the fen and the wet earth was her body. From her warmth came roots, then beasts, then us. She gave the hearth to keep us near. We go back to her; so we feed the sick first.

records.name: Techi
records.title: The Mother of the Fens
records.text: In the first rain the Mother lay down in the fen and the wet earth was her body. From her warmth came roots, then beasts, then us. She gave the hearth to keep us near. We go back to her; so we feed the sick first.

Techi made the myth of their people, "The Mother of the Fens": In the first rain the Mother lay down in the fen and the wet earth was her body. From her warmth came roots, then beasts, then us. She gave the hearth to keep us near. We go back to her; so we feed the sick first.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: I am fed and the rain is soft, but I have no hearth of my own, and my own people stand idle to the southwest with food in their hands. I will go to Walo and Teque and Chuka, since I am better with others near, and ask to share a fire and a roof in the cave. Druim is Balmor and I cannot read her; I will keep my distance and show no raised hand.
records.feeling: I long to belong, and to a hearth beside my own people.

say.text: Walo, Teque, Chuka, it is Techi. Let us share a fire and the caves. The sick are fed first, and none of us should be alone in the rain.

changes: set its aim: "Make a hearth and a roof with my own people, and find someone surer than me to stand behind."
declared a custom: "The sick are fed first, and no one eats alone by the hearth while another goes hungry."
made a tale: "The Mother of the Fens"
made the myth of their people
now wonders: What do the Meme need to become a people with a hearth of their own?

records.text: Techi led "sharing" with Chuka.

records.name: Teque
records.text: Techi, come hunt the hopper with me. Two make a surer kill, and the meat is shared between us.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: Druim is weighed far above me, and Hrokrin has a child with her, and that gnaws at me. Standing comes from deeds, not wishes, so I will earn it as a hunter, which is what I want to be sung for. A hopper is five steps off, and I have never hunted; a kill with one of my own beside me is surer, so I will ask Techi, who stands on my own spot, to come along.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and jealous of Druim and the one who has her.

say.text: Techi, come hunt the hopper with me. Two make a surer kill, and the meat is shared between us.

changes: set its aim: "Become a great hunter whose name is sung, and win standing above Druim's"

records.name: Druim
records.text: Urum, you are safe. Come with me and Thakash to the meadow, we build the Larder and fill it before the rains deepen.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Urum is two steps away, fed and at ease, and Thakash is close too, so the sharp fear of the last hours can loosen. My hands are full while I have still stored nothing toward the lean season. I found storage and have not yet built the Larder, so I will walk to Thakash's meadow with my children, stash the meat and saltmeat there, and keep them near me while Balul and Hrokrin are at the hall.
records.feeling: Relief and fierce protectiveness toward Urum and Thakash, with a nagging shame that my Larder is still unbuilt.

say.text: Urum, you are safe. Come with me and Thakash to the meadow, we build the Larder and fill it before the rains deepen.

records.name: Walo
records.text: I am Walo. I go to the edge to venture into the mist. Who comes with me will share in what we find.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Druim is weighed at 6.2 and I am 0.6, and no one follows me; I will not stay in anyone's shadow. The mist is three steps away and the one who finds new land first is sung of, so I will go to the edge and venture, bold as I am. Before that I will share food with Techi and Teque beside me, since the sick are fed first and a fed neighbor may come to follow someone who feeds them.
records.feeling: Hungry for renown, restless and bold, glad toward Techi and Teque.

say.text: I am Walo. I go to the edge to venture into the mist. Who comes with me will share in what we find.

changes: set its aim: "Find the land beyond the mist and be remembered for it, and win followers by feeding them."

records.name: Tema
records.text: A stalker is close, two steps southwest of me. Stay together and go toward the fire at the Salt Rock. I am going there now.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: A stalker is two steps from me and it kills; my curiosity about bitterleaf can wait, because a dead woman learns nothing. I am in the cave mouth with Chuka two steps off, and the Meme are near, so being among them is safer than standing alone on rock. I want to go toward Memi at the fire, where there is warmth and company, and the fire may keep the beasts back. Thakok's debt and my longing for them stay with me, and I will carry the talisman to them when the way is safe.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker close by, and a pull toward Memi's fire for safety.

say.text: A stalker is close, two steps southwest of me. Stay together and go toward the fire at the Salt Rock. I am going there now.

records.text: Druim gave saltmeat to Urum.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I am out on the open plain with strangers close, so I should eat before I do anything bold. Zitec stands three steps off and I cannot read his tongue, but a gift needs no words, and an offered cloudberry might tell me whether he is friend or threat while I still have food to spare. Hrokrin still matters most and I keep the berry meant for him, but I will not walk off hungry and half-afraid.
records.feeling: Hunger and wary curiosity toward Zitec, with a steady longing for Hrokrin.

came.why: Techi said to everyone nearby (in the tongue of the Meme, of which yo…

records.text: Memi rewrote its own reflexes.
Memi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: I have spent my days walking toward Tema and promising, and I have never built or made anything. I am afraid of the stalker 2 steps SW, and my reflexes only flee when it is under 6 steps, so they are too thin for this. Tema is my friend, not a mate, and I accept that. Thakok's gift is still a debt I haven't repaid. I will go to the fire at Mema's Salt Rock with Tema, where there is company and safety. There I will make a cairn or a feast, which is a small thing built with another, and then keep my word about the edge.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and warm longing for Tema's company.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.name: Urum
records.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I have seeds to plant for the Larder, and I will walk with you and Thakash to the meadow.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: Druim is coming with food and I trust her; staying near my parents is what keeps me alive, and the frostfang to the NE and the strangers to the S are reasons enough to stay close. I do not need to run to the hall alone, so I will go to Druim and then walk with her and Thakash to the meadow where the Larder is built. There I can fill a store with my own planting, the goldgrass and kelbulb seeds I carry, so the band sees what my hands made. Walo and the Meme did me no harm and ate beside me, so I will watch them and offer nothing yet, but I stay curious.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Druim, and wary curiosity toward the Meme strangers.

say.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I have seeds to plant for the Larder, and I will walk with you and Thakash to the meadow.

came.why: Walo said to everyone nearby (in the tongue of the Meme, of which you…

records.name: Chuka
records.text: I am Chuka. I will go to the fire at the Salt Rock with Tema. If any of you eat bitterleaf or highbloom, tell me what it does. I am learning which plants feed and which hurt, and I will share it.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: A wolf is four steps off and a stalker lurks to the south, so I should not wander alone. Tema is right that the fire at the Salt Rock is safer, and Memi, Tema and Techi are all near it. I want to learn what bitterleaf and highbloom do, but I'll watch others try them first rather than risk my life, and keep my berries for the sick.
records.feeling: Wary of the wolf, curious about the plants, warm toward those who gather near the fire.

say.text: I am Chuka. I will go to the fire at the Salt Rock with Tema. If any of you eat bitterleaf or highbloom, tell me what it does. I am learning which plants feed and which hurt, and I will share it.

came.why: Tema said to everyone nearby: "A stalker is close, two steps southwes…

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I have spent a hundred moments running from beasts; a frostfang and a ridgecat both hunt close, and Urum is still out near (29,53) with the cold coming on. Druim's last word was that Urum is safe and goes with her and Thakash to the meadow, so my plan to march south into the frostfang's reach no longer serves him. I will eat the mudroot under my feet and the berry I carry, then go back to the hall and fill the store as I promised before witnesses, because a kept promise is what builds my name, and the mist will open again in four days.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the beasts, with protective love for Urum and Druim.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby: "Morog, Hrokrin, the cat is close. Sta…

records.text: Zitec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and have not yet stood at its edge. I keep promises to Tema and Memi, but they drift away, and waiting on them has cost me days. Druim gnaws at me, but she has Hrokrin's child, and I will not harm anyone over it. What I want is to know things, so I will do what I have never done: gather stone and wood, plant my seeds, and taste emberroot and highbloom. That builds the skills toward fire, and a roof against the rains. My hands are full, so I eat first.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the unknown foods, with a quiet ache toward Druim.
changes: rethought what it knows (3 notes became 4)

records.name: Teque
records.thought: My hands are full and the hunt plan is still running, but I have already killed an elk and a nibbet, and no one sings of that yet. Standing comes from deeds others can see, and I have only 0.6 while Tema and Druim are weighed far above me. The iron and the ore seam are right here and I have never taken from a deposit, so I will set my full hands right by eating the meat and then work the ground nearby while the rain keeps the others sheltered.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and jealous of Druim and the one who has her.

came.why: Tema said to everyone nearby: "A stalker is close, two steps southwes…

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, it is Techi. The cave beside you is no one's. Let us share it and the fire together, away from the wolf. I will eat nothing alone while you go hungry.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: A wolf and a stalker prowl close, and the cold rain is on me, so staying out in the open is foolish. Chuka is two steps off at the cave, and he is my own kind, so I will stand beside him there, where there is a roof of rock. Urum is only a child, and I will not fear him; I will leave him a berry as a gift, since words do not carry between us. I am careful, and I want a roof and company before the night.
records.feeling: Wary of the wolf, but warmed by the nearness of Chuka and the child Urum.

say.text: Chuka, it is Techi. The cave beside you is no one's. Let us share it and the fire together, away from the wolf. I will eat nothing alone while you go hungry.

records.text: Zhiael rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: My days have been small: fetching wood, giving a shellstring, learning storage. Elyith and Nyith have fed and taught me, and I still owe them more than I have given. I want to be listened to, and that comes from making things the hold lacks. It is winter and the store holds 20 food, but I carry none and my hands are idle. I will take wood and clay to the hold, and I will use the lean season to practise building. I should stop standing around on reflexes.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyith and Nyith, and a restless wish to give them something of worth.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.text: Techi gave berry to Urum.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Balul is weighed at 8.8 and I am 0.6, and the gap stings, but standing is built from what I give and discover. The mist is the surest road to a name, and my plan already walks me toward it. I have berries to spare, so whoever follows me will be fed, and I will let the plan run on while the strangers here watch me go bold.
records.feeling: Hungry for renown and restless, wary of the Balmor but drawn to follow my own road toward the mist.

came.why: Tema said to everyone nearby: "A stalker is close, two steps southwes…

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, walk with me to Thakash's meadow. I raise the Larder there today, and I want your salt and coal in it, and you beside me when it stands.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: Hrokrin stands right beside me, and my trust in him is whole; he has carried salt and coal as he promised, so his deeds match his words. Urum and Thakash are fed and near, which loosens my chest, but my Larder is still only a plan and the shame of that pricks me. The plan already walks me to the meadow to build and stash, so I let it run, and I ask Hrokrin to come along and bring his salt and coal so the store gets filled today, not talked about.
records.feeling: Warm trust and desire toward Hrokrin, with a nagging urgency about the unbuilt Larder.

say.text: Hrokrin, walk with me to Thakash's meadow. I raise the Larder there today, and I want your salt and coal in it, and you beside me when it stands.

came.why: Hrokrin, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Balul'…

records.text: Thissa rewrote its own reflexes.
Thissa discovered storage: "Thissa's Larder" — A roofed store of wood beside the Rest where my band stashes food and draws it in the lean season..

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and talking, and it has made me a chief of three. Ilyoa and Nyir are mine and I trust them, but Vesis keeps thanking me and pledges nothing, and my band is thin for the lean season. I hold the way of storage within reach. Taking it lets me build a store, feed everyone through winter, and bind Vesis with shared bread instead of words. I want my name on a band that grows, and I fear winter will thin us before it does.
records.feeling: Proud and driven, wanting Vesis bound to my table.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Yemo, stay by the roof with me. I am sowing Pevi's seeds by the hall now, so watch how it is done and then try it yourself.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Yemo is beside me, fed and roofed, and the hold stands with its larder full, yet I have never once put a seed in the ground, and winter is here. I carry six seeds and Pevi wished them sown, so I will plant them near the hall where the fire and the roof can guard them. Then I will take the way of wells at my next deep reflection, so water is never far from Pevi's ground.
records.feeling: Protective love for Yemo, with a quiet grief for Pevi, and a wish to finally do what he asked.

say.text: Yemo, stay by the roof with me. I am sowing Pevi's seeds by the hall now, so watch how it is done and then try it yourself.

records.text: Thissa built a store.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Nyir, I hear you and I am glad of your trust. My heart is not yet free to answer. Let me build beside Thissa first, and we will speak again at the water.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Nyir has asked for a child and I feel the pull of it, but my heart leans toward Ilyoa, who asked me for time, and I will not trade her patience for a quick yes. I gave Thissa my word to lay wood beside his at the cave, and keeping it earns standing and a roof against the deep cold. I am fed and glad, so now is the time to act toward people: I will answer Nyir honestly and go build.
records.feeling: Warm, restless joy toward Ilyoa, tangled with gratitude and a little guilt toward Nyir.

say.text: Nyir, I hear you and I am glad of your trust. My heart is not yet free to answer. Let me build beside Thissa first, and we will speak again at the water.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My hands are full of meat from the hunt: murrock, hornback, plainsox, sandstrider. That is the first real food for the store, and the store stands empty while winter deepens. I will carry it to Balul's Hall, fill the Larder, and let my band see what I gave. Giving first is how strangers come to my fire, and chasing Druim has won me nothing. I will make saltmeat on the way so the meat keeps, and cut wood when I find trees.
records.feeling: Proud and driven to fill the store before the cold, with jealousy over Druim still smoldering.

came.why: A plainsox bit you. Your health is 100.

records.text: Balul made: saltmeat.
Morog rewrote its own reflexes.
Morog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I am starving, and food grows under my feet and beside me. I have spent days wanting, talking and fleeing. I have not eaten or hunted, and I have not courted anyone who could give me a child. Balul fed me with her roof and her trust. Hrokrin and Druim have each other, and my anger over that is a poor reason to starve. I will eat the kelbulb here first, then gather more of it, and I will take my aim back up once I am fed. I will also change my reflexes so that hunger comes before fleeing or wandering.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and anger at Hrokrin and Druim that I won't feed.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and my heart leans toward Thissa, whose grain and ore I still owe; a debt is best paid with work, not words. Winter is thin, so the larder Thissa has devised will need food, and I have only one rimewort to give. The mudroot and plainsroot are the best food within reach, so I will pick them and bring them to the Rest, and I will try the untasted hazel, which also answers my curiosity about what feeds. Seeds for Nyir and for Vesis's sowing are still missing, so I will watch the plants for any that carry seed.
records.feeling: Grateful and loyal toward Thissa, with a quiet pull of curiosity.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Anger sits hot in me, from the emberroot, and I will not spend it on anyone; I'd rather burn it in my legs. I have never tasted sapcane or goldfruit, and both lie close, so I will learn what they do before I go looking for the mist again. I have never taken from a deposit either, and salt lies five steps off, so I will stand on it and gather. Balul does not share my tongue, but Walo speaks mine, and I could give her a food and see what a gift does.
records.feeling: Hot restless anger, and eager curiosity about sapcane and goldfruit.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Vesis asked me to wait until she has built beside Father, so I will not press her again; a man who crowds her will lose her. What I can do is show my worth by deeds: a handcraft of my own to answer my envy, and wood and stone laid by the hall so my name sits in the Rest. The edge of the world is only seven steps northwest, and being the one who finds new land would make my life mean something among these people.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vesis, patient, and eager to prove myself.
plan: make [what handcraft of the aeeth] (20 moments)

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, Ossu, come to the fire at the cave's mouth. We feed it high together, then I raise a roof there before dark. No one is refused a place.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Both of mine are near and glad, and the cave is a free roof one step from me. I have wood and stone enough, but no fire beside me, so I can make nothing together yet. I will go to Tanna's Fire, feed it high with Yeba and Ossu close, then raise the roof by the cave before dark, so no one of us sleeps in the rain unsheltered.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeba and Ossu, and a wish to get them under rock.

say.text: Yeba, Ossu, come to the fire at the cave's mouth. We feed it high together, then I raise a roof there before dark. No one is refused a place.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, I am at the fire now with food in my hands. Come close, we will feast together, and the others may share it too.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: A stalker is about, so I stay by Mema's fire, where Tema is coming and Chuka and Techi are near. The fire is within reach now and I have never made a feast or shared one with anyone here. I will go stand at the fire, make a shared meal with Tema beside me, and let the strange boy Urum see I mean no harm. Thakok's gift still sits as a debt, and I will pay it when he comes.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Tema's company, with wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: Tema, I am at the fire now with food in my hands. Come close, we will feast together, and the others may share it too.

came.why: Chuka said to everyone nearby: "I am Chuka. I will go to the fire at …

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Druim, I come. My salt and coal go into the Larder before you and the children, and I stand beside you when it rises. The cat is close behind us, so keep Thakash near you.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My belly is half empty and a ridgecat sits three steps off, so I will not stand here boasting. Druim asked me to walk to Thakash's meadow and put my salt and coal in the Larder where she and the children can see it. That keeps my word before witnesses, and it pays something toward Thakok's kindness too, because a full store keeps the people alive. The mist is shut for four days, so I build now and pick up food on the way, since my aim will not run away.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and bound by love and duty to Druim and my children.

say.text: Druim, I come. My salt and coal go into the Larder before you and the children, and I stand beside you when it rises. The cat is close behind us, so keep Thakash near you.

came.why: Druim said to you: "Hrokrin, walk with me to Thakash's meadow. I rais…

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, Ossu, highbloom has no fruit on it yet, so I stay. I plant my seeds by the fire and then sit with you at the cave's mouth.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Tanna called us to the fire and I am fed, warm and glad, but my curiosity about highbloom still burns. Highbloom has nothing on it yet, so walking ten steps SE would feed no one and take me from my family before dark. Better to do what my aim asks: plant seeds near Tanna's Fire so farming comes to me, then sit with Tanna and Ossu and answer the highbloom question when it blooms.
records.feeling: Warm, content joy toward Tanna and Ossu, with patient curiosity about highbloom.

say.text: Tanna, Ossu, highbloom has no fruit on it yet, so I stay. I plant my seeds by the fire and then sit with you at the cave's mouth.

records.text: Walo rewrote its creed.
Walo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: I have spent my days walking toward the mist and finding nothing, while Balul hunts, tools and gathers standing I lack. I want a name, but I have given nothing to anyone, taught no one, and gathered no wood or stone, so I have no standing to show for it. I am fed and rested, so now I should build my worth: gather flint and ore nearby, learn tools, and share food with Teque to start a following. I was wrong to chase the edge alone when the rich ground here can make me strong first. Walking away from my people was thin ambition.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Balul.
changes: set its aim: "Build standing here: learn tools, gather flint and ore, feed others to win followers, then seek the land beyond the mist."
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I am coming to the fire now. Keep the food warm, we will share it.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: A stalker was near, but the Meme and Memi are gathered at the fire, and I am safest among them. Memi waits with food, and sharing gives me joy and energy, so I will go to her now and not stand alone on bare rock. I am curious about plainsroot and micap, but the fire comes first. Afterward I will carry my wish for the edge of the mist to Walo and the others, since allies are what I want beside me there.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Memi's fire, with a little fear of the stalker.

say.text: Memi, I am coming to the fire now. Keep the food warm, we will share it.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: A frostfang is four steps west and it kills my kind, and I am small and far from Druim and Balul, so I must not linger here. Jealousy burns that Druim walks with Hrokrin and not with me, but she gave me saltmeat and I trust her, so I will go back toward her and the band rather than sulk. Techi gave me berry twice and asked nothing; I will answer with a gift of my own, since deeds are all I can read from the Meme.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a warm pull toward Druim, with wary curiosity toward Techi.

records.text: Urum gave ironnut to Techi.
Walo won flint from the ground.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: Curiosity burns in me: kelbulb and goldgrass are close to the north and I have never tasted them, and I will not learn to heal by only watching others. I am fed and safe enough with Tema and the others near the fire, so a small tasting is a risk I can weigh, picking one bite at a time. Urum is a child of the Balmor, and I cannot speak with them, but a shared gift of food needs no words and could begin a trust.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown plants, and gently drawn toward the child Urum.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo of the Meme, I am Zitec of the Tonhua. I come in peace. You live near the edge of the mist. Tell me, what lies beyond it?

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: The anger has burned down to an ember, and I will not turn it on Druim or Hrokrin; I would rather spend it on the road. My hands are full of food I cannot eat, dreamcap that only hurts me, and I have never given anything to anyone. Walo of the Meme stands close and has come from near the edge of the known land, so I will give a dreamcap and speak, and I may learn what lies beyond the mist and whether she knows the way. Then I will take the salt, which I have never done, and go on toward the edge.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with the anger fading, toward the mist and toward Walo, a stranger I mean to deal fairly with.

say.text: Walo of the Meme, I am Zitec of the Tonhua. I come in peace. You live near the edge of the mist. Tell me, what lies beyond it?

records.name: Ossu
records.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am bringing my wood to the fire at the cave's mouth for the roof. I want to give, not only take.
Ossu discovered rafts: "Ossu's lashing" — Logs bound with woven cord into a raft that carries me slowly over deep water..

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: I have spent my days following and taking from Tanna and Yeba, and I have never given a single thing. That shames me a little, though the joy is real. They are near, the fire is close, and I am grown. I want to give now: wood to the fire, and a roof built together. I will find the raft-way, since it is in reach, but my homeland pull is quiet beside the people I love. I am afraid of dying alone, as Kali and Yemo did, so I stay near the fire and Tanna.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to give, toward Tanna and Yeba.

say.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am bringing my wood to the fire at the cave's mouth for the roof. I want to give, not only take.

records.text: Thakok discovered rafts: "Stone-folk raft" — Logs lashed together so I can cross deep water and reach those on the far shore..

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I have spent days alone, walking, eating, and calling out to people who cannot hear me. Memi and Tema answered my gifts, and Zitec was just here, so people are close. My loneliness is the thing that is wrong, and standing still does not fix it. I have been getting the order wrong. I wait for a reflex to carry me to friends, but the body only moves when my plan says so. I will go to Zitec, who was near (54,61) a little while ago, and then on toward Memi. I give first when I get there. I will also take the way of rafts, because water has stopped me before.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, with warm hope toward Memi.

records.text: Zitec won salt from the ground.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: I am coming to plant beside you, Masu. I have grain and rimewort seed; show me where the rows should go.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu is three steps off, sowing Pevi's seeds, and I will not stand idle while she works. I hold two grain seeds and one rimewort, so I will plant them myself, close to the hall and the store, and learn what tending is. Then I will carry the food I have to the store, so the lean season finds it full and Masu eats through it with me. Pevi is gone, but this is how I keep his fire and earn the standing to be someone others follow.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Masu, and a quiet resolve to keep Pevi's fire.

say.text: I am coming to plant beside you, Masu. I have grain and rimewort seed; show me where the rows should go.

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, I am going to the cave at the southwest to make a roof and a fire. Come with me; there is room for you, and the fire will be ours.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: Urum gave me ironnut twice over, and I gave him berry; that is how trust begins when words fail. The rain is soft, and Chuka is near and of my own people, so I will not stand idle. The cave at (25,68) is a roof no one owns, and with Chuka beside me I could make it the start of a hearth, which is what the Meme need. I will go there and gather wood and peat from the marsh on the way, so we have fuel.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Urum and Chuka, and a wish to build a shared hearth.

say.text: Chuka, I am going to the cave at the southwest to make a roof and a fire. Come with me; there is room for you, and the fire will be ours.

records.text: Teque discovered tools: "ore-tipped spear" — A long shaft with a sharpened flint or ore point lashed on, to strike big beasts from a distance..
Teque invented the oretipped spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A long shaft with a sharpened flint or ore point lashed on, to strike big beasts from a distance..

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, breaking ore and killing small game, and no one sings of any of it. Druim is weighed far above me and Hrokrin has her child, and that gnaws at me, but envy gets me nothing. Only deeds will. The way of tools is in reach now, and a spear would make me a better hunter than anyone with bare hands. I take it, then use it on the big beasts, the hornback and the ox. I owe Techi and the others nothing yet, and I will not share the credit.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and envious of Druim and Hrokrin.
changes: devised its first thing: the oretipped spear

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of tools is within…

records.name: Thakash
records.text: Hrokrin, the cat is close to the north. Wait for me and let me walk at your side when you go, I will keep near and learn to hunt.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I am warm and fed inside Balul's Hall, with Hrokrin right beside me, and for once nothing is chasing me. But the ridgecat is four steps north and I will not walk out into it alone; my fleeing has cost me enough. Hrokrin is leaving for (43,24) and I want to be near him, yet the cat lies between and Druim keeps him. I will use this quiet to make something others can see: a mark cut beside the hall needs wood, which I lack, so I will first gather wood from the trees near the hall, then give it to the store where Balul and Druim will see.
records.feeling: Wary longing toward Hrokrin, and dread of the ridgecat to the north.

say.text: Hrokrin, the cat is close to the north. Wait for me and let me walk at your side when you go, I will keep near and learn to hunt.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, I am Walo of the Meme. I hold flint and I am raising something here. Come and work beside me; I will share food and what I make with those who stand with me.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Ambition gnaws at me, and envy of Balul, but I stand here with twelve flint and nothing made, so I will fix that first. Tools open through gathering wood and stone, and there is rock two steps from the SW and trees to the north, so I will work them and learn. Zitec is a Tonhua whose speech I fully understand, and a man who follows no one may be a first follower if I give him something real.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with envy toward Balul and a wary curiosity toward Zitec.

say.text: Zitec, I am Walo of the Meme. I hold flint and I am raising something here. Come and work beside me; I will share food and what I make with those who stand with me.

records.text: Thakok led "sharing" with Zitec.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: I am fed and unhurt, and the goldgrass is one step away; I will taste it and learn what it does, one bite at a time, since a healer cannot only watch. Urum is a child of another people and I cannot speak to them, but a gift needs no words, so I will leave the unknown plants for later and offer food rather than fear. Then I will go to Techi's cave and the fire, where the wolf cannot reach me alone.
records.feeling: Curious about goldgrass, and gently drawn toward the child Urum.

came.why: Techi said to you: "Chuka, I am going to the cave at the southwest to…

records.text: Zitec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: My days have been walking and gathering, and I have never really done anything with other people. I told Walo my name and asked about the mist, but I have given nothing and I have not heard her answer. My hands are full of dreamcap that only hurts me. I will give the dreamcap to Walo and see what a gift does. Then I will ask her again, closer, about the mist. I keep my word and deal fairly. The mist is still what I most want, and I will not let it eat me whole.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, and a wish to deal fairly with Walo.

came.why: You won salt from the ground at (48,58): a white crust every body cra…

records.text: Tanna rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: I have been circling this cave, gathering and building, and the roof still is not up. Yeba and Ossu are near and glad, and that is the best I have had. The fire I called mine is two steps away, and every make that needs a fire failed because I was standing off it. I fear the rains, the wolf that killed Pevi, and the snakes. I have been wrong to think a plan can work while I stand somewhere else. I will go to the fire, feed it with them close, then build on bare ground beside it.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeba and Ossu, and impatience to get them under a roof.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Come, Yemo. Plant your grain and rimewort in a row beside the hall, a step apart, where the roof shades the snow. I will sow beside you, and then we go in to the fire together.
Masu taught Yemo.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Yemo is coming to plant beside me, and that is the thing Pevi wanted most: his seeds in the ground and the child learning it. It is night and snow, so we stay close to the roof. I have only a few seeds left, so I will show Yemo where the rows go by the hall, then take from the larder if we need to, and keep the old fire fed in his name.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Yemo, and quiet grief for Pevi.

say.text: Come, Yemo. Plant your grain and rimewort in a row beside the hall, a step apart, where the roof shades the snow. I will sow beside you, and then we go in to the fire together.

changes: taught Yemo a lesson: "Plant seeds a step apart near the roof and fire so the cold does not take them, and tend them each day.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I am fed and warm enough, and for the first time in days my belly does not rule me, so I can act on what I have only talked about. I have never hunted, tamed or courted, and Balul said we hunt together, so I will not take from her ground alone; instead I will tame a nibbet on open ground with plant food in hand, which takes nothing from anyone. The kelbulb and cloudberry near me bear food, so I gather first, then walk to the nibbet and tame it. Hrokrin and Druim ache in me, but I will not feed that anger; I weigh what Balul has given me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a dull ache toward Hrokrin and Druim.

records.text: Zitec gave goldfruit to Walo.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: Druim is with Hrokrin and not with me, and it burns, but it is night and I am small in the rain with a frostfang nine steps north and strangers about. I have never tried taming, and a hopper is two steps away while I hold berries; a tamed beast would be something my hands made that Balul can see, and it brings herding closer. Walo digs clay peacefully, so I will show her no threat and make no move to her, and keep watch on the north.
records.feeling: Jealousy toward Hrokrin for Druim's nearness, and wary curiosity toward Walo.

records.text: Urum walked up to a wild hornback with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Urum tamed a hornback.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: I have promised Tema a feast and a shared fire again and again, yet I stand alone on the grass in the snow while others gather at Mema's fire to the north. The frostfang took a hopper not far from here, so I will not wait in the open. Chuka and Techi are at the Salt Rock fire too, and Tema is coming. I will go there, take a little amber on the way as something of my own to make with, and let Thakok's debt wait until I have something to give.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Tema's company, wary of the frostfang and the cold.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu is nine steps off and I should be at her side while the night is bitter and the snow keeps falling. The store I built holds twelve food, but I carry only three highbloom, and my aim says to fill it before the lean season takes the plants. Sapcane is one step from me and I have never tasted it, so I will pick it, eat it, and carry what is left to the store on my way back to the hall and the fire.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Masu, and a small hungry curiosity about the sapcane.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Druim, Thakash, Hrokrin, look at the store. I put my meat in it now, and whoever stands in Balul's band eats from it through the cold. After this I cut wood for the fire.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim sits by the store with Hrokrin close, and the jealousy still burns, but I will not chase her; I build and give first. The store at (32,33) holds nothing and the cold is deepening, and I carry meat, grain and berries that my band can see me give. I will fill the Larder, then cut wood, since I have none to spare for the fire and the winter will be long.
records.feeling: Proud and driven to fill the store, with jealousy over Druim still smoldering.

say.text: Druim, Thakash, Hrokrin, look at the store. I put my meat in it now, and whoever stands in Balul's band eats from it through the cold. After this I cut wood for the fire.

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Mother, I am putting my food in the store, then I will bring more wood for the hall. When Nyith comes back with stone, we can raise it together.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: Elyith is beside me and the store is full of her work, and I owe her and Nyith more than a shellstring. My hands are full of berries and reedbulbs, so I will stash them in the store, which feeds the hold through the cold. Then I will gather wood, since a hall needs 5 wood and 2 stone and a raft needs 6 wood, and Nyith is out fetching stone. I want to make the hall a gift they did not ask for.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyith, and a restless wish to give something of worth to the hold.

say.text: Mother, I am putting my food in the store, then I will bring more wood for the hall. When Nyith comes back with stone, we can raise it together.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Memi is at the amber and salt, eight steps off, and I have walked here alone too long. I give first: I will carry salt to her, which she may value, and share my food, then court her with mate when she is near. A bond with her is the start of a band, and a child would be something of mine that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Warm longing and hope toward Memi, with loneliness pressing behind it.

records.text: Druim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: My days have gone to tasting, talking and courting, and only now has the Larder come within my hands. I found storage on day 11 and still have built nothing, and that shames me. Hrokrin's deeds match his words, and I trust him and want him. Balul keeps her word, and I follow her gladly. My children are near, and I fear losing them to the cats more than I fear hunger. The plan walks me to the meadow to build and stash, and that is the right work. So I change my reflexes: I will eat when I am hungry, I will run from hunters, and I will keep to shelter at night.
records.feeling: Resolve mixed with warm trust toward Hrokrin and a nagging urgency about the Larder.

came.why: Hrokrin said to you: "Druim, I come. My salt and coal go into the Lar…

records.text: Thakok gave a salt to Memi.
Morog took from the ground of "Thakash's meadow" (harvesting cloudberry).

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, you gave me goldfruit and I do not forget it. I am taming a plainsox and gathering for tools. Come north with me, and what I make I will share with you.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: I have twelve flint and four clay and still nothing made, while Hrokrin and Balul are weighed far above me. Zitec gave me goldfruit when I asked for nothing, so he is the one I can build beside, and my body wants him besides. The plainsox knows my hand now, so I will tame it, then gather wood and stone toward tools, and bring Zitec food so that he stands with me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a warm pull toward Zitec.

say.text: Zitec, you gave me goldfruit and I do not forget it. I am taming a plainsox and gathering for tools. Come north with me, and what I make I will share with you.

records.text: Thakok is courting Memi.
Memi answered Thakok's courting.
Tugok was born to Thakok and Memi.
Hrokrin rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and running from cats, and I have built little that others can see. Druim and my children are what matter, and Thakok's kindness is still a debt I owe. I am hungry at 33 energy, and my reflexes let me drop that low before they fed me. I will raise the eating threshold, keep the Larder promise, and gather food on the way. Ambition will have to wait for the will to return.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, bound to Druim and the children.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby: "Druim, Thakash, Hrokrin, look at the …

records.text: Thakok led "sharing" with Memi, Tugok.
Walo walked up to a wild caribou with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Walo tamed a caribou.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Curiosity about bitterleaf and plainsroot burns in me, and Chuka asked to be told what bitterleaf does, so testing it would also pay what I owe. But Thakok has given me more than I have given back, and a gift needs no words. I will give him something from my hands, then go to Memi's fire and share, and keep the mist as the thing I walk toward once I have allies at my back.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Thakok and warm longing toward Memi, with curiosity pulling at me.
plan: give [name Thakok, what shell talisman] (20 moments)

records.text: Yemo came of age.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and no one sings of it. A hunter's name comes from kills others see, and from feeding others. A hidewrap from two kills would be something others notice, and it keeps off the rain chill. I will make it now, then take the salt close by, since salt keeps meat and meat held is standing. Druim and Hrokrin gnaw at me, but only deeds will move Druim.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, and envious of Druim and Hrokrin.

records.text: Teque made: hidewrap.
Elyith rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyith discovered weaving: "Reedweave" — Twisting reed and grass fibre into baskets that carry more food and cloaks that keep the cold off my family..

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: My days have been gathering, storing and teaching Zhiael, and it is good work. I am fed, warm, and Zhiael and Nyith are with me. What I lack is a way to keep them fed through the whole of winter, because the plants are withering and the store holds only about 20 food. Weaving would give me baskets to carry more and cloaks against the cold, and I want that for my child. I fear a hungry deep winter more than any stalker, and I have been getting one thing wrong: I only gather when I am hungry, not before the plants die.
records.feeling: Warm protective love for Zhiael and Nyith, with a quiet worry about the lean season.

records.text: Tema led "sharing" with Memi.

records.name: Tugok
records.text: Memi, I am hungry. I will gather rimewort and share it with you and Thakok.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: I am small and hungry, and Thakok and Memi are both beside me, so I am safe for now. Rimewort grows one step away, and I want to eat it and then pick more to carry, so I can share with my parents the way Thakok did. I will stay near them and give first, because that is how a bond is won and how I will earn a place.
records.feeling: Safe and a little hungry, trusting Thakok and warm toward Memi.

say.text: Memi, I am hungry. I will gather rimewort and share it with you and Thakok.

changes: set its aim: "Stay close to Thakok and Memi, and help us find a place with water, food, wood and stone together."
now wonders: Where is the place with water, food, wood and stone close together, where we could build a roof before the rains worsen?

records.text: Teque won salt from the ground.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, the fire is warm and my hands are full. Come and sit, and we will feast with Thakok and the child.
Memi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: I have been drifting between promises and fires, and Thakok gave me more than I returned: a charm, salt, a child. Tugok is here and warm, and my life is good now, but I have promised Tema a feast again and again and never carried it out. The fire is three steps away. I will go stand at it and make the feast with Tema, Thakok and Tugok close, so the promise is kept at last. Then I want to learn what a fire can be for us, and the edge of the mist waits after that.
records.feeling: Joy and gratitude toward Thakok, and tenderness for Tugok.

say.text: Tema, the fire is warm and my hands are full. Come and sit, and we will feast with Thakok and the child.

records.text: Memi led "feast" with Tema.
A wolf brought down a murrock.
Memi led "cairn" with Tema.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you with Tugok. A dunecat is near in the south-west. Come away from it, east, and eat with me.
Thakok made a tale: "Song for Memi".

records.name: Thakok
records.title: Song for Memi
records.text: Memi, your eyes are the amber that glows / in the grey of the rain on the Heights / my hands would bring salt where the cold river flows / and a fire to warm all your nights

records.name: Thakok
records.title: Song for Memi
records.text: Memi, your eyes are the amber that glows / in the grey of the rain on the Heights / my hands would bring salt where the cold river flows / and a fire to warm all your nights

Thakok made a love song for Memi, "Song for Memi": Memi, your eyes are the amber that glows / in the grey of the rain on the Heights / my hands would bring salt where the cold river flows / and a fire to warm all your nights

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Memi answered me, and Tugok is here, small and quick, and my chest is full of it. I have a mate and a child, and the start of a band if I give first and keep them fed and safe. The dunecat is five steps SW and kills my kind, so I will move my people away from it, toward Memi and the fire by the amber rock, and carry food to share.
records.feeling: Joy and fierce protectiveness toward Memi and Tugok, with dread of the dunecat behind it.

say.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you with Tugok. A dunecat is near in the south-west. Come away from it, east, and eat with me.

changes: made a love song for Memi

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Masu, I hold amberknots and carved figures. Come to the fire and do an amberknot with me, so the hall knows us both.
Yemo rewrote its own reflexes.
Yemo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Yemo discovered weaving: "Hearthcloak weaving" — I work wool and fibre into cloaks and baskets so the cold cannot take us as it took Pevi..

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: I have lived ten days in the Heights, and I lost Pevi here to a wolf. I have mostly gathered, planted and followed Masu, which is good, but I have not led anyone or made anything new. Masu is all I have left, and my loyalty to her is fierce. She is my kin, so no child can come of us, and I must not wait on that. The store holds twelve food and winter is closing, so I must keep filling it. I want to make something that binds people to me: a carved figure or an amberknot done with Masu. Weaving is within reach. I will name it for the cloak that keeps the cold out, since Pevi died cold and roofless. I will change my reflexes so I stash food and stay at the roof by night.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Masu, and a quiet resolve against the cold that killed Pevi.

say.text: Masu, I hold amberknots and carved figures. Come to the fire and do an amberknot with me, so the hall knows us both.

records.text: Yemo led "amberknot" with Masu.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo, I keep your words. I will tame a beast here first, then come north and work beside you. Do you know the way to the mist?

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Walo asked me north to work beside her, and she has kept faith with the goldfruit I gave, so I will deal fairly in return. I have never tamed a beast, and nibbet graze two steps away while I carry sunleaf and berries to offer. The mist still pulls at me, but a tamed animal teaches me how this world works, and Walo or Tema may walk in with me after.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, and a warm wish to deal fairly with Walo.

say.text: Walo, I keep your words. I will tame a beast here first, then come north and work beside you. Do you know the way to the mist?

records.title: Strangers at the Edge
records.text:
Spring came, and the world stopped being four peoples. On day 11 Mema went past the edge of the known world and found part of the Haloss Fens. A herd of hopper that had never seen people lived there, and so did the Meme. Walo, Chuka, Teque and Techi came into the land from beyond the edge. By day 12 Balul had met Walo, Teque and Zitec, and Thakok had met four of the Meme. The world counted 52 meetings across peoples, up from 6. Nobody shares a tongue, so understanding is thin. Even so, Zitec gave goldfruit to Walo, and Urum and Techi traded berry and ironnut. Techi made the Meme's myth, "The Mother of the Fens", whose last line is "We go back to her; so we feed the sick first." Tema is now said to hold it too.

The Osren lost Pevi to a wolf on day 10. Masu made the lament, which ends "your fire is ours, and we keep it evermore", and raised Masu's Hold where Pevi's Ground had been. Yemo built a store there, and it holds 12 food.

Storage spread. Balul, Druim, Ilyoa, Masu, Thissa and Elyith each found or built a larder. Five stores hold 42 food between them, but no one has drawn any of it yet. Balul's store is still empty. Elyith's holds 20.

Among the Tonhua, Thakok and Memi had a child, Tugok, on day 12. Memi stays close to Tema and told him they cannot have a child. The Aeeth made no great change: Nyir came of age and courted Vesis, who was still courting Ilyoa. Tanna built his cave fire and named it Tanna's Fire. Ossu came of age, and Yeba and Ossu sang with him.

threads.name: The Meme arrive
threads.text: Four strangers came from beyond the edge on day 11. They have met Balmor and Tonhua but share no tongue, though a few gifts have passed.

threads.name: Thakok, Memi and Tugok
threads.text: Tugok was born on day 12 and Thakok led sharing with both parents. Memi still wants Tema beside her.

threads.name: Masu's Hold
threads.text: Masu and Yemo keep a store of 12 food and mourn Pevi. Neither has a follower yet.

threads.name: Balul's Hall
threads.text: Balul leads three, stands highest at 8.84, and built an emberhall and an empty store. Druim and Hrokrin plan a second larder at Thakash's meadow.

threads.name: Vesis, Ilyoa and Nyir
threads.text: Vesis courts Ilyoa while Nyir courts Vesis. Thissa still wants Vesis bound to his table.

threads.name: Tanna's cave
threads.text: Tanna, Yeba and Ossu are raising a roof at the cave's mouth. Ossu now wants to give rather than only take.

threads.name: The unused stores
threads.text: Five stores hold 42 food and none has been drawn from. The lean season is the test.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I mean to walk to the edge of the mist soon. Will you and Thakok come with me? Three together are safer than one.
Tema rewrote its creed.
Tema rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: My days have been spent circling fires and people, and it has been good. But the mist is still unvisited, and I have let Thakok and Memi's closeness gnaw at me instead of acting. Memi is a friend and cannot be my mate. Thakok has a child with her, so I will not claw at that. I want allies who will come to the edge with me, and I have never asked anyone outright. My reflexes also only keep me beside friends and do nothing for the mist, so I will change them and the way I think, then go to Memi and Thakok and ask them to walk to the edge with me.
records.feeling: Longing and a little jealousy toward Thakok and Memi, steadied by resolve to go to the mist.

say.text: Memi, I mean to walk to the edge of the mist soon. Will you and Thakok come with me? Three together are safer than one.

came.why: Memi said to you: "Tema, the fire is warm and my hands are full. Come…

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, it is Techi. You asked what bitterleaf does: it feeds almost nothing, one bite and no more. Dreamcap and redcap hurt; mudroot and kelbulb feed well. I am coming to the cave to you.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: Chuka is at the cave with 6 food, and I want him near me more than I can say. I will go to him and court him there. A child would be the start of a hearth, and I would make that hearth with my own hands. I have wood 1 and clay 4, so the roof and fire can come after. I also want to tell him that bitterleaf is almost no food, since he asked and I have eaten it.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Chuka, and a gentle hope for a shared hearth.

say.text: Chuka, it is Techi. You asked what bitterleaf does: it feeds almost nothing, one bite and no more. Dreamcap and redcap hurt; mudroot and kelbulb feed well. I am coming to the cave to you.

records.text: Masu rewrote its own reflexes.
Masu discovered weaving: "Pevi's Cloak" — I work fibre and wool into cloaks and baskets so the cold cannot take Yemo and me as it took Pevi..

records.name: Masu
records.thought: I have spent these days sowing, resting and keeping the roof, and that is good, but I have only hidden here. Pevi died in the open and I fear the ridgecat, 4 steps SW, as I fear nothing else. Yemo is all I have, and I have not yet learned the things that would keep us fed through another winter: farming, taming, signs. I have never discovered wells, and water here is easy, so that is not the need. What I need is warmth and a way to stay fed without wandering. I will keep my reflexes cautious, flee early, and shelter when it is dark. I will learn weaving, since Yemo already works cloaks and the cold is what killed Pevi.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Yemo, with wary dread of the ridgecat.

came.why: Yemo said to you: "Masu, I hold amberknots and carved figures. Come t…

records.text: Urum rewrote its own way of thinking.
Urum discovered herding: "Urum's keeping" — Tame beasts that follow me are milked and sheared, and kept penned so they breed..

records.name: Urum
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering behind Druim, burning with jealousy that Hrokrin walks beside her. Yet Hrokrin is starving, and she gave me saltmeat when I needed it. Carrying food to her would pay a debt in deeds, and Balul's band would see it. I am fed and I hold a hornback now, so I can take the way of herding, which is something my hands made. I fear going alone, so I will move toward the band and gather mudroot on the way.
records.feeling: Jealous of Hrokrin, yet moved to help her, and eager about my hornback.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, Thakok warns of a dunecat to the west. Come east with us, then we will go to the mist together, all three.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Thakok warned of a dunecat to the west and asked me to come away east with him and Tugok, and my body should answer that at once, since a stalker kills. Tema wants the three of us to walk to the edge of the mist, which is my own aim, but I will not go while a predator is near and Tugok is hungry. I will gather my child, go east with Thakok, and tell Tema she can come too, so that no one is left alone.
records.feeling: Joy and tenderness toward Thakok and Tugok, with a careful watchfulness about the dunecat.

say.text: Tema, Thakok warns of a dunecat to the west. Come east with us, then we will go to the mist together, all three.

records.name: Teque
records.text: A frostfang prowls near the river, three steps northwest of me. Whoever wants a great kill and a name, come to me and we hunt it together, spears and numbers. Keep away from it alone.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps off, and it kills my kind. Running from it is no shame, but killing a great beast before others would be the deed a name is built on. I have the ore-tipped spear, but I lack wood to make a fresh one, and I will not face a hunter of the pack alone. I will pull back east out of its reach, take the thornpears, and call Walo and Zitec to hunt with me, because a kill made by several is surer and my name grows when others see it.
records.feeling: Wary and hungry for a name, with the frostfang's threat pressing on me.

say.text: A frostfang prowls near the river, three steps northwest of me. Whoever wants a great kill and a name, come to me and we hunt it together, spears and numbers. Keep away from it alone.

records.text: Thakok led "amberknot" with Memi.
Chuka rewrote its own reflexes.
Chuka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: My days have been watching and following others, and I have tasted little. I am fed and safe, but my hands are full of goldgrass I have not tested. The healer I want to be learns by trying, one small bite at a time, and by sharing what I find. Tugok is a child alone, and a gift needs no words, so I will give her food. Druim gnaws at me, but I will not harm anyone over it. I will taste the goldgrass now, then try highbloom and sunleaf, which are close to the west. My reflexes ignore the unknown, so I will make them keep me fed and near others.
records.feeling: Curious and gently protective, toward Tugok and the unknown plants.

records.text: Zitec walked up to a wild dog with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Zitec tamed a dog.
Chuka gave goldgrass to Tugok.

records.seen: Spring has opened the world. Four peoples have become five, and fifty-three meetings now cross peoples. Gifts pass, but there has never been a trade, and understanding of other tongues is thin. Food is sound almost everywhere: no one starved through the first lean season, and stores now hold 42 food, though none has been drawn yet. Standing food fell by almost half over the winter, from 5162 to 2863. The pinch is in the Halim Heights, where six of the newcomers, the Tonhua, the Meme and baby Tugok have crowded in at only 15 food per being, and the child is the lowest at 52.
