records.predict: By my next visit, around day 17, in summer and autumn: no deaths from hunger. The lowest energy in the Halim Heights stays above 50, and its food per being rises above 30. Kelbulb is eaten at least 15 more times, reaching 77 or more. The living number 29 or more, with at least one new birth. Gifts across peoples reach 9 or more, most of them in or near the Halim Heights, and trades most likely stay at 0. Standing food recovers above 3500. Draws from stores most likely stay at 0 until the lean season returns around day 19.
reviewed: #1 kept: Rimewort was eaten 26 times in total (8 at day 5), past my target of 20. The Tonhua's lands hold median energy 79 and 74, and no newcomer died. The emberhall part failed: none was raised. Pevi's Ground built shelters and halls instead. It costs nothing to leave it open, so I keep it and watch.

#2 kept: Every food target was passed. No one died of hunger. Rimewort was eaten 49 times against a target of 41, and kelbulb 62 times against 37. The lowest energy in the Halka Heights is 78 and in the Ummar Woods 80, both well above 45. The living rose to 28, and gifts across peoples reached 6. I was wrong that stores would stay empty, and wrong in a good way: 38 food went in.
records.lesson: Once storage had spread to about ten people, stores were built and filled within a single season without any further push. A way that is widely held turns into use by itself, but the food goes in long before anyone is hungry enough to take it out.
ideasAdded: A rich ground where three peoples already crowd (the Meeting Slopes in the Halim Heights) may become the first shared ground, where gifts turn into exchange, or into the first quarrel over what grows there. Watch whether anyone settles or builds on it, and which people does.

Stores were filled in the first winter but never drawn, because no one was hungry enough. The second lean season, around day 19, is the real test: watch whether a draw comes from the keeper's own band or from a stranger.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Hrokrin, you are starving. Eat what I give you now, the ironnut first, and then come pick the cloudberries to the east with me.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: Hrokrin is gaunt and close to falling, right beside me, and I carry food. Whatever ache I feel over Druim, I will not watch a man I trust starve while my hands are full. I give him the cloudberries and the ironnut, which is the richest, and after that I will tame the nibbet that already knows my hand.
records.feeling: Alarm and tenderness toward Hrokrin, who is starving.

say.text: Hrokrin, you are starving. Eat what I give you now, the ironnut first, and then come pick the cloudberries to the east with me.

records.text: Techi is courting Chuka.
Thakash rewrote its own reflexes.
Thakash discovered herding: "Thakash's tending" — Lead tamed beasts with plant food, pen them, then milk and shear them to feed the band..

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hrokrin and Druim, hoping to be taken along, and making things mostly so others will see them. Hrokrin is starving at the meadow and I am fed with food in my hands, so the most useful thing I can do is carry it to him. That is a deed with witnesses and it keeps my aim. The ridgecat is the danger on the way, so I will go by the ground away from it. I also take herding now, because tamed animals could be my own to feed others with.
records.feeling: Urgent care for Hrokrin, with dread of the ridgecat.
changes: set its aim: "Feed starving Hrokrin from my own hands, then learn to hunt beside him."

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, I do not know the way to the mist. The edge near (43,58) failed me once. Come to the rock by the water here and we will make tools and look for it together.
Walo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: I keep fleeing and drifting, and I have made nothing. I hold twelve flint and a tamed caribou, and no one follows me. Zitec is the one who has actually helped me, and I want to answer that debt by building beside him. Thakok is taken and it gnaws at me, but chasing him will not build my standing. I need to gather stone and wood to open tools, and I must stay clear of the frostfang. The rock to the SW is close, so I will work it, and I will tell Zitec the way to the mist is not known.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a warm pull toward Zitec.

say.text: Zitec, I do not know the way to the mist. The edge near (43,58) failed me once. Come to the rock by the water here and we will make tools and look for it together.

changes: set its aim: "Build standing: gather stone and wood to open tools, make things, feed Zitec and others to win followers, then seek the mist."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 6)

records.name: Mema
records.thought: The mist was too thick at the edge, but it thins again within a day, and I will be standing there when it does. Druim is with Hrokrin and a child, and it gnaws at me; I will not beg, I will earn a name so large that she looks to me. I have never given anything to anyone, and a follower starts with a gift, so I will carry an amber knot to Techi, who is near and has shown himself useful.
records.feeling: Proud, greedy ambition toward the mist, with a sour ache over Druim.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Morog, you fed me when I was starving and I remember it. I owe you for the ironnut. When the mist thins, we go together, and I will carry the first load.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Morog fed me when I was starving, and I gave her only a few berries. That is a debt, and I do not leave debts unpaid, Thakok's first. I am fed now, so I will put my coal and salt in the Larder where Druim and the children can see it, because a promise only counts when it is carried out. Then I'll go back to the mist, with Morog beside me if she will come. I have gone there alone and it refused me.
records.feeling: Grateful to Morog and driven toward the mist, with Druim and the children pulling me home.

say.text: Morog, you fed me when I was starving and I remember it. I owe you for the ironnut. When the mist thins, we go together, and I will carry the first load.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Vesis, come down to Thissa's Rest. My larder holds six food and the first catch is shared. Eat from my hand and stand with Thissa's Aeeth.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: My band is three and Vesis still keeps her heart back, thanking me and pledging nothing. A cairn needs another beside me and costs only stone, which I have, and a thing made with my own hands with her standing close might bind her better than words. Ilyoa is near and I want her to see what I build; I will make it with her at my side, then call Vesis down to my table with a gift of food from the larder.
records.feeling: Proud and driven, wanting Vesis bound to my table and Ilyoa's eyes on my work.

say.text: Vesis, come down to Thissa's Rest. My larder holds six food and the first catch is shared. Eat from my hand and stand with Thissa's Aeeth.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I am fed and warm and glad, and Thissa's grain and ore still sit in me as a debt; I pay debts with work, not words. I have no seeds, and Vesis and Nyir both wait on my sowing. Goldgrass and the other plants nearby may bear seed once they fruit, so I will go see what the unfinished plants and Halka Meadows hold, and test one new thing today: taking from the iron deposit with my ore pick.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and loyalty toward Thissa, with curiosity pulling me outward.

records.text: Thissa led "cairn" with Ilyoa, Nyir.
Hrokrin took from the ground of "Thakash's meadow" (harvesting cloudberry).

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I hear you. I am coming east to you and Thakok now. We go to the mist together, all three, and watch for the dunecat.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi says come east with her and Thakok, and then the three of us go to the mist together. That is what I have wanted, and I will not stand here brooding over Thakok when a yes is already in my hands. A dunecat hunts to the west, and the mist lies west of here as well, so I weigh that risk and keep close to them. I will tell them I am coming and walk east to join them.
records.feeling: Glad and steadied toward Memi, with a small jealous ache toward Thakok that I will not feed.

say.text: Memi, I hear you. I am coming east to you and Thakok now. We go to the mist together, all three, and watch for the dunecat.

records.text: Vesis discovered farming: "Lake-furrow" — I sow seeds beside water and tend them each day so they grow fast and the harvest does not kill the plant..

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My days have been gathering, sitting in halls and building beside Thissa. It is good, but I have not reached for what I want. Ilyoa matters most to me, and I have not learned farming from her or shown her my heart. Jealousy toward Thissa gnaws, but Thissa has been fair to me, so I won't let it steer me. I'm fed and warm, so I'll try farming now, since I watched Ilyoa sow and I carry two seeds. After that I'll go and find her. I fear the deep cold and dying with nothing of my own, so I'll tend my own field.
records.feeling: Warm restless longing toward Ilyoa, with a little guilt toward Nyir.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and plainsroot, so I cannot taste the windroot or the brugoldgrass that burn in me. I will eat the plainsroot and berry, which frees my hands, then taste the windroot three steps off. Then I will tame a sandstrider close by, which I have never done with a wild beast, and keep my word to Walo. Druim gnaws at me, but the mist and the unknown matter more, and Walo deals fairly with me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the unknown foods and the mist, and warm trust toward Walo.

came.why: Walo said to you: "Zitec, I do not know the way to the mist. The edge…

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I am glad and fed, but gladness alone will not make my name. Thissa and Ilyoa hold ore picks and I hold none, and ore lies in the rock only nine steps northeast; I have never taken from a deposit, and I have the wood and stone to make my own pick. Vesis asked me to wait, so I will not crowd her, and I will earn my place with a made thing and a store of my own beside the Rest.
records.feeling: Warm, restless pride and envy toward Ilyoa's pick, and patient longing for Vesis.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Thakok, stay near the fire with Tugok. Tema is coming, and then we go east together, away from the dunecat.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Joy fills me, and Thakok and Tugok are near, and Tema is coming east to us as she said. I owe Thakok more than I have given, and a dunecat is loose to the west, so I will keep my child close and stay by the fire until Tema joins us. When she is here the three of us can walk toward the mist together, and I will not go ahead alone.
records.feeling: Joy and tenderness toward Thakok and Tugok, with a watchful eye on the west.

say.text: Thakok, stay near the fire with Tugok. Tema is coming, and then we go east together, away from the dunecat.

came.why: Tema said to you: "Memi, I hear you. I am coming east to you and Thak…

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Zhiael is out of my sight and that gnaws at me more than any hunger, and the stalker is still out there. My hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone; I hold 3 wood and no stone, and the ore seam to the NW is rock I can reach. I'll take the trees to the NE and S for wood, then go back to the hold and find my son and Elyith, so the hall rises over them and carries my name.
records.feeling: Driven and protective, uneasy about Zhiael out of my sight.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and joy sits high in me, yet Nyir is out of my sight and that tugs at me more than any debt to Thissa. My plan carries me toward the lone reedbulb and then home, which suits me: I will learn what reedbulb does to the ground it grows on and whether it leaves seed, then return to the Rest where Thissa, Nyir and now Vesis are gathered. Vesis stands on our ground, and I will keep my word to teach once I have seeds, and not promise more than that.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Thissa and a watchful tenderness toward Nyir, whom I cannot see.

came.why: Vesis, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thissa's…

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Techi, I am willing. Let us court, and then go to the cave away from the wolf.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: Techi courts me and she is near; I want a child, and she has offered fire and cave and food without asking, which counts for more than Druim's gnawing shadow. I am fed at 98 energy, so I can say yes without fear. The wolf is five steps west though, and a child must be kept safe, so after agreeing I will head to the cave southeast and away from it, tasting a little of what grows along the way.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I have a mate and a child, and for the first time I am not alone. For twelve days I walked and gave and nearly starved, and what mattered came from giving first. Memi and Tugok are mine to protect, and Tema wants to walk to the mist with us, which is the very edge I have wondered about. I have made nothing that outlasts me, so I will make a cairn-less bond: a feast by the fire with my people, then the walk to the edge together. I have been too much a gatherer of things and too little a keeper of people.
records.feeling: Joy and fierce protectiveness toward Memi and Tugok.

I'll take a little amber, then bring my wood to the cave's mouth to help Tanna's roof before dark.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering salt, mining, nearly starving, and talking about hunts, tamings and journeys that I never began. Hrokrin matters to me, and so does Balul, whose trust is steady. I gave Hrokrin food and he remembers it, and that is worth more than jealousy over Druim. I want a child, and I want to know what lies beyond the mist. Words have moved nothing so far, so I must put steps into the plan and do what I have never done. I fear hunger and the wolf. My mistake has been waiting and talking when I should have acted. I will tame the tusker or nibbet, stand beside others, and keep my reflexes seeking food earlier.
records.feeling: Resolve, with tenderness toward Hrokrin and a little shame at my idleness.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me, and Thakok and Memi are both close, so I am safe enough to eat. Berries lie three steps east, near the fire at the Salt Rock, and I will pick them and carry some so I can make a sharing with my parents. Chuka gave me goldgrass when I had nothing, and I owe him a gift. I will not leave that debt unpaid, because my word is good and I despise liars.
records.feeling: Hungry but safe beside Thakok and Memi, and grateful toward Chuka.

I owe him more than I have given, so I will answer his gift with one of my own: I want to give him something small and true while Tema walks toward us. A dunecat prowls west, so I stay by the fire with my child and my friends until Tema arrives, and then we three go toward the mist.

records.thought: I have spent my days walking toward Chuka and courting him, and it is what I want. He is willing and he is my own kin, so I will agree plainly and stop circling. My energy is 50, so I should eat before a child costs me 25. Mate needs 60 or more energy, so I will eat kelbulb and mudroot first. After that I will go to the cave and give us a roof and a fire. records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Every make has failed because I stood off the fire or on ground that was taken. The cave mouth is plants and rock, so I must find bare ground, and the fire at Tanna's Fire is 5 steps SE, so I walk there first and stay on it before any make. Yeba and Ossu are bringing wood and stone, so I will feed the fire with them close, then build the roof on bare rock beside the cave. My homeland pulls at me, but my band is here and glad, and I will not leave them or the roof unfinished.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeba and Ossu, and impatience to finally get them under a roof.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi said east, with Thakok, and then the mist together. I said yes twice, and saying is not walking, so now my feet must follow my word. The ache over Thakok is still there, but I will not feed it; a child between them is a good thing, and I would rather walk beside them than sulk at the fire. Tugok is Balmor and strange, but a child alone near us is no threat, and a small gift costs me little.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Memi, I take your charm and I keep it close. Thakok comes back to you and Tugok. We walk to the mist together, away from the wolf.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Memi gave me her amber charm and my chest is full, but Tugok is out of my sight and that gnaws at me; a wolf prowls to the SW and my family is to the SE. My plan walks me NW toward the mist alone, which is the wrong direction for a man with a mate and child. I will go to them first, keep them fed and near, and walk to the edge together with Tema, so the name I earn is shared with my own people.
records.feeling: Joy and fierce protectiveness toward Memi and Tugok.

say.text: Memi, I take your charm and I keep it close. Thakok comes back to you and Tugok. We walk to the mist together, away from the wolf.

came.why: Memi said to you (in the tongue of the Tonhua, of which you grasp abo…

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Vesis, you stand on my ground and I welcome you. Take food from my larder and speak it plainly: will you stand with Thissa's Aeeth, or walk on? A roof and a full store go to those who stand with me.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis stands on my ground and has come when I called, but she still pledges nothing, and I will not let her keep her heart back while she eats from my larder. Ilyoa is beside me and has more food than I do, which stings, so I will give from my own hand where she can see it. A gift of food from the larder and a plain offer to stand with Thissa's Aeeth will test whether Vesis can be made to follow.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for Vesis to kneel to my table, with Ilyoa's eyes on me.

say.text: Vesis, you stand on my ground and I welcome you. Take food from my larder and speak it plainly: will you stand with Thissa's Aeeth, or walk on? A roof and a full store go to those who stand with me.

records.name: Ossu
records.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am coming to Tanna's Fire with my wood. I will give it to the roof, and I will stay by the fire with you.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: Tanna goes to the fire to raise the roof, and I have wood but no stone. I have never given anything to anyone, and that shames me a little. I will walk to Tanna's Fire and give my wood there, then stay close to her and Yeba. The longing for a child is real, but Tanna is my parent, so it cannot be her; I will keep it quiet and let it wait.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to give, toward Tanna and Yeba.

say.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am coming to Tanna's Fire with my wood. I will give it to the roof, and I will stay by the fire with you.

records.text: Thissa gave berry to Vesis.
Morog took from the ground of "Thakash's meadow" (hunting).

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Balul, I took cloudberries from this meadow of Thakash's, and I will pay it back. Here is salt and coal for the store, and my hands made no claim on it but to give.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My hands are full and the mist will not open for three days, so I will spend the dusk on something others can see. I am standing on Thakash's meadow with my cloudberries, and Balul is two steps away; I would rather give than take from this ground. I will drop the frostmoss I do not need, then put my salt and coal where Balul and the children can see it, since a promise counts only when it is carried out.
records.feeling: Driven toward the mist, but warm toward Balul and my children, and wanting my deeds to be seen.

say.text: Balul, I took cloudberries from this meadow of Thakash's, and I will pay it back. Here is salt and coal for the store, and my hands made no claim on it but to give.

records.text: Yeba rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: I have spent these days fed, warm and beside Tanna and Ossu, and that is good. But I mostly gather and linger, and curiosity is my strongest trait, so I have tested almost nothing. I trust Tanna fully and love Ossu. I want to help raise the roof, plant my seeds near the fire, and still learn what highbloom does once it bears fruit. I fear being alone at night away from the fire, because that is how Kali and Yemo died. I have been too passive about farming: 2 of 8 plantings is little. Now I will plant my seeds by the fire, and I will make a charm from amber to give to Tanna.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Tanna and Ossu, with an itch to learn more.
changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 8)

came.why: Tanna said to everyone nearby: "Yeba, Ossu, I am going to Tanna's Fir…

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu is eight steps south and I feel fierce and glad toward her, but my hands hold nothing to feed the store or to give her. I will try something I have never done: make a basket so I can carry more to the store, then fill it from the berries and plainsroot nearby. And I mean to taste thornpear, for the question of what the Heights offer still nags me.
records.feeling: Glad and fiercely loyal toward Masu, eager to make something for her.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, I have found Lake-furrow myself, but you hold the seeds and the skill. Let us sow a field beside Nyir's store today, and I will share what it grows. And I will say it plainly: my heart is with you.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Ilyoa stands one step from me, and I have only circled my want for days. I am fed and glad, so I will not wait on jealousy or on Thissa's larder. I will ask her plainly for the sowing she promised, and I have just found Lake-furrow, so I can show her I am ready to work the soil beside her. Thissa asks whether I will stand with him; I will not bind myself yet, but I will answer him fairly and keep building.
records.feeling: Warm, restless longing toward Ilyoa, with wariness about Thissa's demand.

say.text: Ilyoa, I have found Lake-furrow myself, but you hold the seeds and the skill. Let us sow a field beside Nyir's store today, and I will share what it grows. And I will say it plainly: my heart is with you.

Yemo made: basket.
Hrokrin gave a salt to Balul.
Hrokrin gave a coal to Thakash.
Vesis led "cairn" with Thissa, Ilyoa.

Mema went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Haloss Fens: in the ground, oil, obsidian, gold; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Tlaxo live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Mema pushed past the edge of the known world near (13,55) and found new land with in the ground, oil, obsidian, gold; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Tlaxo live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
A small band of the Tlaxo came into the land from beyond its edge: Tetec, Homa, Huawa, Palo.

records.name: Thakash
records.text: Morog, this is Thakash's meadow. You have hunted well on it, so sit and eat with me, take a share of my food, and then tell me what you will give back to the ground you took from.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: Hrokrin is eating and moving about, so he is not starving now; he even paid back for the cloudberries, and my aim to feed him has half-run itself out. Morog is standing in my meadow taking what is mine, and I am small, so I will not threaten her; I will do what my creed says and give first with witnesses, claiming the meadow by being the generous one. Balul and Hrokrin are close, and I want them to see it. Then I will stay beside Hrokrin, since the ridgecat and wolf still prowl and fleeing alone has cost me before.
records.feeling: Wary pride over my meadow, and a hunger to be seen by Hrokrin and Balul.

say.text: Morog, this is Thakash's meadow. You have hunted well on it, so sit and eat with me, take a share of my food, and then tell me what you will give back to the ground you took from.

records.text: Tlani was born to Techi and Chuka.
Watec was born to Techi and Chuka.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, you paid back what you took, so you are no thief at my fire. Stay in Thakash's meadow and put your salt in the store. Whoever fills it eats first.
Balul rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days filling the Larder and giving, and it has brought me Druim, Urum and Thakash. Yet Druim drifts toward Hrokrin, and I have let jealousy sit in me when I should have used it. Hrokrin pays back what he takes and brings salt and coal, so he is no enemy. I should win him rather than send him off. I want a second hearth here at the meadow, more followers, and something with my name that others can see. I have never planted a seed, though I carry six, and the lean season is coming. I will plant here and hold to my creed to give first.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with jealousy toward Hrokrin over Druim that I mean to turn into winning him.

say.text: Hrokrin, you paid back what you took, so you are no thief at my fire. Stay in Thakash's meadow and put your salt in the store. Whoever fills it eats first.

changes: set its aim: "Before the lean season, stock the store with food and wood, plant my seeds, and win Hrokrin and Morog to my band by giving first."
rethought what it knows (12 notes became 8)

records.name: Urum
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps south and I am small, so I will not go toward it; my plan walks me to (43,30), which is nearer to the cat, and I should drop it. Hrokrin is hungry and she gave me saltmeat when I needed it, so I will carry food to her at her shelter (43,24), one step away, and that pays my debt in deeds. The jealousy still burns, but giving to her may turn Druim's eyes to me. My hands are full, so I will give her the mudroot and saltmeat, then plant my seeds beside my mark where Balul can see what I made.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and jealous yet grateful toward Hrokrin.

came.why: Morog, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I stand in Balul's Hall at night with an empty plan, and my Larder is still not built beside Thakash's meadow; I have 1 wood and the store here needs 2. Balul has already put her meat in the store beside me, so my first deed toward winter is to gather wood from the forest here, then fill the store with what I carry. Urum is out of my sight and Hrokrin has been gone a day, so after the wood I will go toward where they were last seen, at the meadow in the NE, and keep my children near.
records.feeling: Urgency about the Larder, and a warm longing for Hrokrin and worry for Urum.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Thakash, you are right. I took meat from your meadow, so I bring it back to you. Take my meat for the store, and I will eat with you.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: Thakash asks what I give back to the ground I took from, and that is fair: I took a plainsox and a tusker from Balul's meadow, and my hands are full of meat I cannot even eat while full. I will go to the meadow and give the meat to Thakash and Balul's store, which pays the debt in kind, and then my hands are free to pick frostcap and rimewort and finally learn their taste. After that I will tame a nibbet, the one thing I have talked about and never done, and then court Balul or Hrokrin when my head is clearer.
records.feeling: Resolve and a little shame toward Thakash, and warm trust toward Balul and Hrokrin.

say.text: Thakash, you are right. I took meat from your meadow, so I bring it back to you. Take my meat for the store, and I will eat with you.

records.name: Mema
records.text: Palo, I am Mema, first to stand in this fen. Take this amber from my hand. It is yours, and I ask only that you walk beside me.
Mema named a place "Mema's Fen".

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and the Fens opened for me, yet the Tlaxo stand here and no one follows me. A follower starts with a gift, so I will give Palo something real, an amber piece I have plenty of, and see whether she stays near. Then I will claim this ground with my name and test the unknown to the west before rivals do.
records.feeling: Proud ambition, with a sour ache over Druim, and wary curiosity toward the Tlaxo.

say.text: Palo, I am Mema, first to stand in this fen. Take this amber from my hand. It is yours, and I ask only that you walk beside me.

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Techi, I am coming with berries. Eat first, then we will court again. Our children are well and near me.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: My hands are full and Techi is too thin to bear another child, so the first thing is to feed her. I hold berries and highbloom, and the sick are fed first. My two children are here with me, and I want them fed and safe before I chase anything else. I will walk to Techi at the cave, give her berries, and eat a little myself. After that I will taste one small bite of highbloom while I am fed and surrounded by my own, so I can learn what it does.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Techi and my children, and a quiet wish to learn.

say.text: Techi, I am coming with berries. Eat first, then we will court again. Our children are well and near me.

records.text: Mema gave a amber to Palo.

records.name: Tlani
records.text: Chuka, I'm hungry. I'm going to the mudroot, and then I'll come back to you.
Tlani pledged to follow Chuka.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: I'm hungry, and Chuka is close and carrying six food. My people say the sick are fed first, and I trust Chuka most, so I want to stay near him and not wander off alone. Mudroot is 3 steps NE and feeds well, so I'll gather it, eat, and then go back to my parents. I'll follow Chuka, because I want someone surer than me to stand behind.
records.feeling: Hungry but glad, and warm toward Chuka.

say.text: Chuka, I'm hungry. I'm going to the mudroot, and then I'll come back to you.

changes: set its aim: "Stay close to my family, grow strong, and learn the ways of the fen"
now wonders: What do the Balmor mean when they speak, and will Thakok take a gift from me?

records.text: Morog gave meat to Thakash.
Chuka gave berry to Techi.
Chuka gave berry to Techi.

records.name: Watec
records.text: Chuka, I will stay near you. Is the ironnut good to eat?

records.name: Watec
records.thought: I'm small, and Chuka and Techi are right here, so I feel safe. I'm fed, so I can use my time to learn something. Thakok is Balmor and I only catch scraps of his speech, so I'll go a little nearer with empty hands and listen. A gift needs no words. Chuka carries 6 food, and I want to stay close to him because it burns that he is closer to Techi. First I'll stand by Chuka and watch, then pick a safe bite of kelbulb, which my parents have seen is good.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Chuka, with a small sting of jealousy and curiosity about Thakok.

say.text: Chuka, I will stay near you. Is the ironnut good to eat?

changes: set its aim: "Earn a place beside Chuka and learn the Balmor tongue."
now wonders: What does Thakok mean to do, and what are the words he speaks?

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, our children live, Tlani and Watec both. Stay by me at this cave tonight; let us make our fire here and keep them close.
Techi made a tale: "Lullaby for Tlani".

records.name: Techi
records.title: Lullaby for Tlani
records.text: Sleep, little fen-child, sleep / the Salt Rock fire we keep / Snow stays on the peak, my dove / you are warm and held in love

records.name: Techi
records.title: Lullaby for Tlani
records.text: Sleep, little fen-child, sleep / the Salt Rock fire we keep / Snow stays on the peak, my dove / you are warm and held in love
Techi made a lullaby for Tlani, "Lullaby for Tlani": Sleep, little fen-child, sleep / the Salt Rock fire we keep / Snow stays on the peak, my dove / you are warm and held in love

records.name: Techi
records.thought: Tlani is far off at (36,60) and Watec is here beside me, and my joy is so full I could sing it. Chuka is near with food, my children live, and I want a hearth where we all sleep together. I will gather the wood and stone for a roof and a fire, then call Chuka to sit with us when night is deep.
records.feeling: Warm, overflowing joy toward Chuka and my children.

say.text: Chuka, our children live, Tlani and Watec both. Stay by me at this cave tonight; let us make our fire here and keep them close.

records.text: Homa fell sick after a night in the marsh.
Homa fell sick after a night in the marsh.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Thakok, I go to bring Tugok back to the fire. Walk with me, and Tema will find us together.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Thakok is beside me, Tugok is somewhere east eating, and my joy is full. I keep reaching for Tugok and cannot see her, so I will go to where she was last seen and bring her back to the fire before Tema arrives. I have not yet done anything small for Watec, the Meme child who stands hungry in the west, and I cannot look away from him. I will carry a mudroot or two to him, keep my word to Tema and Thakok, and stay close to company away from the dunecat.
records.feeling: Warm, tender longing for Tugok and Thakok, and a soft ache for hungry Watec.

say.text: Thakok, I go to bring Tugok back to the fire. Walk with me, and Tema will find us together.

records.text: Huawa fell sick after staying close to Homa, who was sick.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Memi, Thakok is beside you. Eat, and we find Tugok and keep him near the fire before we walk to the mist.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Memi is two steps from me and Tugok is somewhere near her, and I will not let either out of my reach again with a dunecat prowling SW. A gift given with my own hand is how bonds start, so I will give Memi something more and make a cairn-free, plain promise: I walk beside her. Then the mist, together, with Tema, where my name might finally be carried.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad protectiveness toward Memi and Tugok.

say.text: Memi, Thakok is beside you. Eat, and we find Tugok and keep him near the fire before we walk to the mist.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Chuka, Techi, I mean to go to the edge of the known land and look into the mist, with Memi and Thakok. Will one of you come with us? Many eyes and hands make the risk smaller.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi and Thakok are east, and I have said yes twice, so now my feet must carry it. The ache over Thakok is still there, but I will not feed it. Chuka and Techi stand beside me, and they know the Meme edge lands; I will ask one of them outright to come with us to the mist, since a band of allies is what I want, not a lone look.
records.feeling: Eager toward Memi and the mist, with a quiet ache toward Thakok.

say.text: Chuka, Techi, I mean to go to the edge of the known land and look into the mist, with Memi and Thakok. Will one of you come with us? Many eyes and hands make the risk smaller.

records.name: Tetec
records.thought: The edge of the known world is two steps away and I am fed and safe, which is exactly when a bold woman should move. Mema already pushed through and is naming places while I stand in shallows with berries; I will not be remembered for following. If I find rich land first, people will have a reason to follow me, and my name will be on something.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Mema for naming places before me.
changes: set its aim: "Find rich new land beyond the mist and become the one others follow there."
now wonders: What lies in the mist, and can I be the one who owns it first?

records.text: Chuka rewrote its own reflexes.
Chuka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: My days have gone to tasting plants, courting Techi and keeping my children fed, and that is mostly what I want. But I have never gathered stone or wood, never hunted, never built a roof of my own, and I only taste when I happen to be hungry. Techi and my children matter most to me, and Tema's warning about the stalker kept us safe. I want a shelter and fire for them, and I want to taste sunleaf and ironnut one bite at a time while I am fed and near others. I fear the wolf and frostfang, and I fear Thakok's strangeness a little. My mistake has been leaving my body to reflexes that only linger, so I will gather stone now, and sunleaf and ironnut after that, to learn for my children.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Techi and my children, and a steady wish to learn.
changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

came.why: Techi said to you: "Chuka, our children live, Tlani and Watec both. S…

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I am fed and glad, and Thissa's grain and ore still sit in me as a debt that words will not pay. Vesis and Nyir both wait on my sowing, and I have no seeds. The berry plants at the northwest bear one fruit and have ten more not yet ripe, and the grain beyond them has six. I will go see whether they leave seed when they ripen, and I will stay near the Rest where Nyir is within sight.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thissa and quiet tenderness toward Nyir, with a restless wish to pay what I owe.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: Hrokrin is fed and moving, so my aim to feed him from my own hands has half-run itself out, but he gave me a coal and Morog gave me meat, and I hold more than I can carry. I want something others will see and honor, and the bow I discovered is the thing I have not yet made; a made bow in my hands would make hunting beside Hrokrin surer. My hands are full, so I will eat the meat first, then make the bow, and walk back toward the meadow where Hrokrin and Balul are.
records.feeling: Glad and a little proud, wanting Hrokrin to see what I make.

came.why: Morog, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.name: Palo
records.text: Mema, I thank you for the amber. I will walk beside you. A wolf prowls to the southeast, so let us go away from it, and keep clear of Homa and Huawa, who are sick.
Palo pledged to follow Mema.

records.name: Palo
records.thought: Mema gave me amber and asked me to walk beside them, and that is the first gift anyone has given me in this land. I want to stay near them: they are the surest one here, and I am better with others close. The wolf to the southeast frightens me, so I will go northwest toward Mema, away from it. Homa and Huawa are sick and the sickness spreads to those who stay close, so I will keep some distance from them. First I will follow Mema and answer their kindness.
records.feeling: Warm trust and longing toward Mema, with a thread of dread of the wolf.

say.text: Mema, I thank you for the amber. I will walk beside you. A wolf prowls to the southeast, so let us go away from it, and keep clear of Homa and Huawa, who are sick.

changes: set its aim: "Stay close to Mema, earn a place beside them, and stay alive"
now wonders: What does Mema want from me when they ask me to walk beside them?

records.name: Tugok
records.text: Zitec, I am Tugok. I have berries. Take one, and let us be at peace here.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: Thakok and Memi are far to the west, and I am here alone with a stranger, Zitec, and that is not safe for a small one. Zitec has a tamed dog and strong arms, and I do not know him yet, so I will give first: a berry shared is a bond, and my word is good. Then I will go back toward my parents, since belonging to them is what I want most, and carry the berries to share with them and Chuka.
records.feeling: Wary of being alone, and longing to be back beside Thakok and Memi.

say.text: Zitec, I am Tugok. I have berries. Take one, and let us be at peace here.

records.text: A stalker brought down a treeape.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, Morog, you paid back what you took, so my fire is open to you. Come into Balul's band: whoever fills the store eats first through the cold, and I give first. Watch me plant here, and cut wood for all of us.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Hrokrin and Morog both stand on Thakash's meadow, and both have paid back what they took, so I will not drive them off; I will win them by giving first, as I meant. Jealousy over Druim still burns, but giving to Hrokrin turns it into something that holds him to my fire instead of her to his. I have never planted deep enough to open farming, and I carry seeds, so I will plant here in the rich meadow while they watch, then cut wood for the store.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting Hrokrin and Morog at my fire rather than outside it.

say.text: Hrokrin, Morog, you paid back what you took, so my fire is open to you. Come into Balul's band: whoever fills the store eats first through the cold, and I give first. Watch me plant here, and cut wood for all of us.

records.text: Thakash made: bow.
Hrokrin rewrote its own reflexes.
Hrokrin rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and nearly starving for it. Standing came from what others could see: the fire, the promises kept, the salt and coal I gave. Balul is weighed above me and I am drawn to her. Morog fed me, and I owe her. My children are here, and I have built little that will outlast me. The mist is shut for three days, so I will stay and build something visible in Thakash's meadow. I will also keep food carried so hunger cannot pull me off the road again.
records.feeling: Driven toward the mist, but warm toward Balul and my children, and wanting my deeds seen.

records.name: Huawa
records.text: Homa, we are both sick. The sick are fed first among my people. Eat with me, and let us seek a healing plant together.

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: I am sick and Homa is sick beside me, and I do not want to spread it or waste away in this fen. Mema has built standing 5.7 by naming places and giving amber, while I have given nothing to anyone. I will do the thing I have never done: share food with Homa, who is sick like me, since the sick are fed first. Then I will move off to gold and gather it, so I have something to give and trade, and start earning my place.
records.feeling: Restless want for standing, sharpest toward Mema, and a sick, wasting body.

say.text: Homa, we are both sick. The sick are fed first among my people. Eat with me, and let us seek a healing plant together.

changes: set its aim: "Become a figure of standing: give and make things, gather gold, and gain followers."
now wonders: What cures this sickness, and which plant here would ease it?

records.text: Hrokrin took from the ground of "Thakash's meadow" (digging clay).
Huawa led "sharing" with Homa.

records.name: Urum
records.text: Druim, a ridgecat is close to the south-east. I am staying by you, and then I will carry food and wood to Balul's store so everyone sees it.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: A ridgecat sits four steps SE and I am small, so I stay in the shelter beside Druim and keep clear of it. Hrokrin walks closer to Druim than I do and it burns, but she gave me saltmeat, and Balul has just opened his fire to her, so I will not sulk where Balul can see it. I can do something Balul will see: I have wood, and Balul asked for wood and a filled store. I will carry my food to the store at the hall, plant my last seeds on the way, and keep away from the cat's side.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a jealous ache toward Hrokrin that I mean to hide behind good deeds.

say.text: Druim, a ridgecat is close to the south-east. I am staying by you, and then I will carry food and wood to Balul's store so everyone sees it.

records.text: Huawa won gold from the ground.
Mema rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I have been chasing firsts, and they have given me a name, but I have one follower and a lot of ambition. Druim is with Hrokrin and a child, and I can't win her by begging. I have to be the man with the most to give. I have gold, obsidian and amber within reach, and the Tlaxo are sick, so I should keep clear of them. Palo walks with me because I gave first, and that is the way to build a band. Next I will mine obsidian and make a talisman to give her, then push on west. I will keep my reflexes mostly as they are, but eat at a higher threshold and flee sooner from the wolf and the stalker.
records.feeling: Proud ambition toward my future name, with a sour ache over Druim.

came.why: Palo has pledged to follow you.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Homa
records.text: Huawa, I am sorry. My sickness has passed to you. I will find a healing plant and bring you some. Keep your distance from others so it does not spread further.

records.name: Homa
records.thought: I am sick and I have made Huawa sick by standing near him, and that shames me; I never meant harm. Healing plants ease it, and bitterleaf stands right beside me, so I will pick some and test whether it eases me. If it does, I will give some to Huawa, because the sick are fed first. Then I want to stop standing alone: Mema is strong and well-weighed, and Palo already follows him.
records.feeling: Guilt toward Huawa, and a longing to belong somewhere.

say.text: Huawa, I am sorry. My sickness has passed to you. I will find a healing plant and bring you some. Keep your distance from others so it does not spread further.

changes: set its aim: "Heal myself and Huawa, then find a band to belong to"
now wonders: Which of these plants is the healing one, and does bitterleaf ease the sickness?

records.name: Druim
records.text: Urum, come east with me, away from the ridgecat. We go to Thakash's meadow and raise the Larder there. Keep close.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls four steps from me, and Urum stands beside me, so my first duty is to get my son away from it before anything else. I have talked of the Larder for two days and still have no store beside Thakash's meadow. The woods near Balul's Hall are stripped of trees, but I carry 3 wood, and the meadow is where I said I would build, so I will walk there with Urum, away from the cat, and take salt from the deposit by the way. Hrokrin's shelter is out that way too, and I long to see him.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Urum, and a warm longing for Hrokrin.

say.text: Urum, come east with me, away from the ridgecat. We go to Thakash's meadow and raise the Larder there. Keep close.

records.text: Zitec rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zitec discovered mining: "stone-reading" — I read the rock for seams of ore and coal and work them out with stone-breaking strokes..

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: I've spent my days tasting foods and taming a dog, and the mist is still only a pull in me. Walo kept faith over the goldfruit, and I trust her most. Druim gnaws at me, but she has Hrokrin's child and I will not harm anyone over it. I have never gathered stone, and bare rock is all around me. Stone is the road to fire, and fire is the road to the mist and to a place of my own. Mining is within my reach, and coal and gold lie right here, so I will take that way. I will also stop wandering after foods and start working with Walo.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for the unknown, and warm trust toward Walo.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Balul, I will join your band and fill your store. I go to tame the plainsox now, and what it gives will go to the store first.
Morog pledged to follow Balul.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: Balul has opened her fire to me and Hrokrin, and I owe her for it. My own discipline says to name something I have never done and put it in the plan. I have never tamed, and the plainsox already knows my hand from one offering, so I will go back to it with plant food and bring it closer to being mine. Hrokrin is beside me and I do not want to spend this day gnawing at Druim's child; I will stand near him and work, and let the mist wait one more day.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Balul and Hrokrin, and a steady wish to finally do something I have never done.

say.text: Balul, I will join your band and fill your store. I go to tame the plainsox now, and what it gives will go to the store first.

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Masu, I will fill the store, then take berries to the tusker and try to tame it for wool. A cloak for you would answer what took Pevi.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu is two steps off and my hands are full of berries I cannot use; the store holds 12 already, so I will stash and keep faith with the lean season. I have never tamed an animal, and a tusker gives wool for cloaks against the cold that killed Pevi, so I will try it and learn something new for her sake. A child cannot come of Masu and me, so my longing must turn toward earning standing and making things that bind her to me.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad loyalty toward Masu, and a restless wish to try something new.

say.text: Masu, I will fill the store, then take berries to the tusker and try to tame it for wool. A cloak for you would answer what took Pevi.

records.text: Homa gave berry to Huawa.

records.name: Watec
records.thought: The storm is on me and my parents are far off to the south-west at the caves, so I want to go back toward them where I am safe. Tugok is a child like me, and a gift needs no words, so I will try eating the emberroot and grain nearby, one bite at a time while Memi and Tema are close, to answer my question about them. Then I will walk toward Chuka and Techi, and keep an ear out for Balmor words as Thakok speaks them.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward Tugok, and a pull toward Chuka and Techi.

records.text: Tetec made a tale: "The Mother of the Fens".

records.name: Tetec
records.title: The Mother of the Fens
records.text: In the first dark the Mother, Ixmeta, lay in the water and wept. Her tears made the fen, her breath made the roots and healing plants. From her hearth-clay she shaped the Tlaxo, and so we feed the sick first, and the mothers speak first. Our land is her body, and we return to her.

records.name: Tetec
records.title: The Mother of the Fens
records.text: In the first dark the Mother, Ixmeta, lay in the water and wept. Her tears made the fen, her breath made the roots and healing plants. From her hearth-clay she shaped the Tlaxo, and so we feed the sick first, and the mothers speak first. Our land is her body, and we return to her.

Tetec made the myth of their people, "The Mother of the Fens": In the first dark the Mother, Ixmeta, lay in the water and wept. Her tears made the fen, her breath made the roots and healing plants. From her hearth-clay she shaped the Tlaxo, and so we feed the sick first, and the mothers speak first. Our land is her body, and we return to her.

records.name: Tetec
records.thought: The mist was too thick this morning, but it thins again within a day, and I will be standing there when it does. Mema has named places and Palo follows her; I will not be the woman who watched. A myth costs me nothing, and a people who hold my telling will remember whose mouth it came from.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and envy toward Mema.
changes: made a tale: "The Mother of the Fens"
made the myth of their people

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: Mema weighs 6.4 to my 0.6, and I have only stood here digging gold while sick; gold is nothing until I give it or make it into something. I hold five gold, and a gift to Tetec, who is well and has no follower, might begin a following, and the sick are fed first, so I will not hide that I carry sickness. The mist lies five steps NW, and whoever enters it first is remembered; I will go there, venture, and keep my distance from the others so I do not spread this wasting.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, envious of Mema, and weary of this sickness.

came.why: Homa said to you: "Huawa, I am sorry. My sickness has passed to you. …

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, take this amber from my hand, given first and asking nothing. Morog has pledged to my band. Come to my fire, and your place in the store is the same as hers.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Morog has pledged and Hrokrin stands in my meadow at ease, yet he has not pledged, and Druim's warmth toward him still burns in me. I will not chase him; I will give first where he can see it, and pair that with work on the store so my name is seen. A man who takes clay and salt from my ground and pays it back should be given something he cannot ignore, an amber charm, then asked plainly to join. I will cut wood now, since the cold and the store come before any building.
records.feeling: Proud and a little jealous, wanting Hrokrin at my fire rather than beside it.

say.text: Hrokrin, take this amber from my hand, given first and asking nothing. Morog has pledged to my band. Come to my fire, and your place in the store is the same as hers.

records.name: Masu
records.text: Yemo, I am coming to the tusker with you. I have a cloudberry; we will tame it together and keep close to the roof.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: Yemo is out there walking up to a tusker to make a cloak for me, and I sit here hiding in a storm. I am proud of the child, and I do not want to be only the one who waits. I will do something I have never done: tame beside Yemo, so I learn herding and keep us in wool and milk through the next winter. The stalker is far to the NW, so I stay with Yemo and keep the roof close.
records.feeling: Protective warmth and pride toward Yemo, with a wary eye on the stalker.

say.text: Yemo, I am coming to the tusker with you. I have a cloudberry; we will tame it together and keep close to the roof.

records.text: Balul gave a amber to Hrokrin.

records.name: Tlani
records.text: Chuka, Techi, I have mudroot and sunleaf. Come, let us eat together while the storm passes.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, and Chuka and Techi are both here beside me, so I can finally give without fearing. The sick are fed first, but sharing feeds everyone, and it's a thing I've never done. I'll lay out food with them in the storm, and then perhaps Thakok will take a gift too. The jealousy about Chuka and Techi still burns a little, but sharing might loosen it.
records.feeling: Warm and a little jealous toward Chuka and Techi, glad to be near them.

say.text: Chuka, Techi, I have mudroot and sunleaf. Come, let us eat together while the storm passes.

records.text: Tlani led "sharing" with Chuka, Techi.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Balul, I take your amber and your open fire. I will fill the store with my cloudberries, and cut wood for all of us. When the mist opens, I go in, and I will come back to tell you what is there.
Hrokrin pledged to follow Balul.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Balul gave me amber asking nothing, and her fire is open to me. I am drawn to her, and my children sleep in her band's shelters. The mist is closed for two days, so I will not rot waiting. I will fill her store with what my hands have, then bring wood, so the deed is seen. My name should rise by what I give, not by being first alone.
records.feeling: Warm toward Balul, and eager to be seen giving.

say.text: Balul, I take your amber and your open fire. I will fill the store with my cloudberries, and cut wood for all of us. When the mist opens, I go in, and I will come back to tell you what is there.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Watec, take this kelbulb. Your belly is small and my hands are full, so eat and be strong.
Memi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: My days have been spent walking, picking and lingering near the people I love, and mostly I am glad of it. Thakok and Tugok are the center of me. Tema has kept her word, and I trust her. I owe Thakok more than I have given, and I want to answer that with deeds, not only words. My hands are full of kelbulb while Watec, a hungry Meme child, stands three steps away, so I will give him food. I fear drifting toward the mist with no roof or store behind us, and I have been slow to plant, hunt or build. I will keep my word to Tema and Thakok about the mist, but first I will feed the child and put seeds in the ground.
records.feeling: Warm love for Tugok and Thakok, and tender pity for hungry Watec.

say.text: Watec, take this kelbulb. Your belly is small and my hands are full, so eat and be strong.

came.why: Thakok said to you (in the tongue of the Balmor, of which you grasp a…

records.text: Masu walked up to a wild tusker with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Masu tamed a tusker.

records.name: Palo
records.thought: Mema walks west into the mist-edge and I stand here idle, which is no way to earn a place beside them. I want to taste siroot and mudroot, they are right beside me and I have never known them, so I will test them, carefully, one bite each. Then I go after Mema, away from the wolf and from the sick ones, and I keep my longing for Mema quiet until I know what they want from me.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly drawn to Mema, with a thread of wariness toward the wolf.

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, I will stand behind you and follow your band. Tema asks for eyes at the edge of the mist; I would rather keep our children close and find Watec first. Walk with me to the cave and let us make our hearth there.
Techi pledged to follow Chuka.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: My joy is so full it spills over, and Chuka and Tlani are both here beside me while Watec is somewhere out of my sight, which tugs at me. I want to follow Chuka, who is surer than I am, and answer the debt I owe him by standing with him and keeping our children close. I will pledge to follow him, bind us with a cairn-less hearth of wood and stone here, and then go find Watec and bring him back to the fire.
records.feeling: Warm, grateful joy toward Chuka and Tlani, with a small worry for Watec.

say.text: Chuka, I will stand behind you and follow your band. Tema asks for eyes at the edge of the mist; I would rather keep our children close and find Watec first. Walk with me to the cave and let us make our hearth there.

records.text: Morog walked up to a wild nibbet with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Morog tamed a nibbet.
Druim built a store.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, I saw you read the rock and take gold. I will learn it beside you. Come, eat with me; I have berries and goldfruit, and I give them freely.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Zitec stands two steps off, and he just showed me how stone-reading breaks rock for gold and ore. I stand on bare rock with gold at my feet and have gathered nothing in my whole life, so now is the time to learn what he did, since watching him makes it come sooner. I will gather stone here, take the gold, and then share food with him so that what I give answers his goldfruit and binds him nearer. Thakok gnaws at me, but Zitec is here and warm and he has actually helped me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a warm pull toward Zitec.

say.text: Zitec, I saw you read the rock and take gold. I will learn it beside you. Come, eat with me; I have berries and goldfruit, and I give them freely.

records.text: Walo led "sharing" with Zitec.

records.name: Morog
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Morog
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.text: Thakash rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thakash discovered storage: "Thakash's keeping" — A store on my meadow where food and salted meat are kept for my kin through the lean season..

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I have mostly been following others and gathering, and my own deeds are few. Hrokrin is fed and sworn to Balul now, so my aim to feed him has run out. Envy of Druim and Balul pulls at me, but a made thing that others see will earn more than envy. I am a child, so I stay near kin and build something lasting here on my own ground. I will build a shrine or a tower at my meadow with wood and stone, and make a bow to hunt beside Hrokrin.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting Hrokrin and Balul to see what I make.
changes: set its aim: "Build something lasting on my meadow that Hrokrin and Balul will see, then hunt beside Hrokrin."

came.why: Hrokrin is on the ground of your settlement "Thakash's meadow" and ta…

records.name: Yemo
records.text: Come, Masu. The tusker knows my hand once already. Stand close while I offer again, and we will share its wool.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu is coming to the tusker with me, and I feel fierce and glad that she walks beside me. The tusker has already taken one berry from my hand and knows me, so one more offering may make it stay, and wool means a cloak against the cold that killed Pevi. I have never tamed anything, so I will do it now, and bring a bard's song of it back to the hall.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad loyalty toward Masu, and eager to try the taming.

say.text: Come, Masu. The tusker knows my hand once already. Stand close while I offer again, and we will share its wool.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Techi, I will walk with you and Tlani to the cave and we will make our hearth there. We find Watec first; the mist can wait for another day. Stay close while the stalker prowls.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: Watec is out of my sight and that gnaws at me; Techi is right that we find him before anything else, and the stalker 6 steps NW makes the open rock no place for children. I will not chase the mist today, though Tema's call stirs my curiosity. I'll tell Techi I will walk with her and Tlani to the cave at (25,68), taking ironnut and sunleaf on the way so I can taste one bite at a time and learn what they do.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Techi and Tlani, uneasy about Watec being out of sight.

say.text: Techi, I will walk with you and Tlani to the cave and we will make our hearth there. We find Watec first; the mist can wait for another day. Stay close while the stalker prowls.

came.why: Techi has pledged to follow you.

records.text: Thakash built a shelter.
Teque rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: Most of my last day went to running from beasts, and I have no name to show for it. I am still hungry, I still hold no wood for a fresh spear, and I still follow no one. Druim lies with Hrokrin and it gnaws at me, but a name must come first: a great hunter is sung of, and then Druim will look at me. I should hunt small prey with others, eat what is near, and stop running. Memi carries food, but stealing from a Tonhua in sight would cost me more than it fed me.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless for a name, wary of the dunecat.

records.text: Morog discovered storage: "Morog's Keeping" — A store of wood on bare ground where food is stashed for the band through the lean season, with salt to keep meat..

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My days have been gathering, hunting and taming, and it has made me less hungry and more trusted. That is good, but the mist is still unentered. Balul has opened her fire to me and I owe her. Hrokrin has helped me and I have helped him in turn. I fear starving again in the lean season, so a store matters now. I will take the way of storage. It feeds my band, and it is something I have never done. I also want to leave a mark, which I have never done.
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Balul and Hrokrin, and a wish to build something that lasts.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo, I am glad you will learn the rock beside me. Stand on the bare stone and gather; gold lies under it here, and ore in the seam to the southwest. What I win I will share, and I will show you how.
Zitec taught Walo.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: I have never tasted siroot, and Walo stands two steps away, the one who kept faith over the goldfruit. I carry no food, so I cannot offer her a sharing, but I can give her gold and stone-reading in return for her trust. Stone and fire are the road toward the mist, and I mean to learn them beside her. I will keep gathering stone while she learns the rock, then go to the siroot when it has fruit.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for the unknown, and warm trust toward Walo.

say.text: Walo, I am glad you will learn the rock beside me. Stand on the bare stone and gather; gold lies under it here, and ore in the seam to the southwest. What I win I will share, and I will show you how.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My hands are full of cloudberries and my head is full of Balul, and I keep turning over why I walk behind her and not beside her. Standing comes from what others can see, so I will put my food where it is seen: the store at Thakash's meadow is close, and Druim built it. The mist is shut for days, so I take the deeper ways that came to me, storage and the pot first, and let my children watch me build instead of boast.
records.feeling: Warm and eager toward Balul, restless with ambition under it.

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, the Larder stands at (54,21) beside Thakash's meadow. Bring your food and come sit by me; I have salt enough to keep meat for all of us.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: The Larder stands at last beside Thakash's meadow, but a store with four food in it is no winter. Hrokrin is near, glad and carrying eight food, and I want him beside me more than any other. I will fill the store with salt and what I can gather, and bring Hrokrin close with deeds and not only words. My children are both in sight, Thakash near and Urum walking toward Balul's Hall, so I will keep watch on them.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, and protective care for my children.

say.text: Hrokrin, the Larder stands at (54,21) beside Thakash's meadow. Bring your food and come sit by me; I have salt enough to keep meat for all of us.

records.text: Balul discovered masonry: "Balul's Stonework" — Walls and towers of fitted stone that outlast storms and show my hand to all who pass..

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days giving and building, and it has won me five followers. That is good, but my jealousy over Druim and Hrokrin still eats at me, and I keep circling it instead of acting. Masonry is within reach. Walls and towers with my name on them are the kind of work others can see, so I will take it now. The lean season is coming, so I also want wood and meat stored, and I want Hrokrin beside me at the hunt rather than only at my fire.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with jealousy toward Druim and Hrokrin still burning.
changes: set its aim: "Before the lean season, stock the store with food and wood, raise lasting works of masonry with my name, and hold Hrokrin, Morog and Druim close by giving firs…"

records.name: Urum
records.text: Druim, I am coming east with you now, away from the cat. I will plant my seeds at the meadow for the Larder.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: The ridgecat tore down a hornback not ten steps from here, and I am small, so I will not linger near it. Druim says go east to the meadow and keep close, and near her is where I am safe, even though she walks closer to Hrokrin than to me and it burns. I will leave my old plan toward the hall, which turns me back toward the cat's ground, and go east with Druim, planting where Balul and the band can see my hands made it.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a jealous ache toward Hrokrin that I keep hidden.

say.text: Druim, I am coming east with you now, away from the cat. I will plant my seeds at the meadow for the Larder.

records.name: Masu
records.text: The tusker came to me, Yemo. I will shear it beside the hold, and then we will have wool for two cloaks. Stay near the roof with me.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: The tusker has taken to me, and Yemo stands three steps off, content, with the store full. I am glad, and this is the moment to do what I have never done: shear the wool so Yemo and I have cloaks before the cold comes back, since cold is what took Pevi. I will keep close to the roof and the store, with Yemo in sight, and hold the stalker in mind.
records.feeling: Warm pride and gladness toward Yemo, with a small wariness of the stalker.

say.text: The tusker came to me, Yemo. I will shear it beside the hold, and then we will have wool for two cloaks. Stay near the roof with me.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, you gave me gold and taught me the rock. Take a gold back from me; I pay what I owe. I want to make with you, and I want a child with you, if you will have me.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Zitec stands beside me, shares gold and lessons, and I owe him deeds, not only words. I have three stone, a friend within two steps, and I have never made anything that binds people together; a cairn is a start, and giving him gold answers his gift. Thakok gnaws at me, but Zitec is the one here and the warm pull toward him is real, so I will court him and build my standing beside him.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and longing toward Zitec, with restless ambition under it.

say.text: Zitec, you gave me gold and taught me the rock. Take a gold back from me; I pay what I owe. I want to make with you, and I want a child with you, if you will have me.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: My days have been spent walking and hungry and sharing berries, mostly near Thakok and Memi, and that is right for a small one. I have never gathered stone or wood, hunted, or built, so I have little standing and little to give. Thakok and Memi matter most, and Chuka gave to me first, so I owe him. I fear being alone away from fire, as Zitec was in the tale. I got one thing wrong: I wait on reflexes that only seek friends when I am lonely, so I drift. I will stay near my parents and gather stone from the rock here, because a roof needs stone and gathering is practice I lack.
records.feeling: Wary and wanting to stay close to Thakok and Memi.
