records.name: Homa
records.thought: My sickness is gone and Huawa has been fed, so the guilt eases, but I still stand alone and a wolf prowls too near for comfort. Mema carries the most standing here and has seen past the edge; to follow someone surer than me would end this aloneness, and Palo and Tetec are both in the band's orbit. First I will stay clear of the wolf, then taste dreamcap and kelbulb to answer my question, and pick the gold close by since I have never gathered from a deposit.
records.feeling: Wary of the wolf, and still longing to belong, toward Mema's band.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Vesis said her heart is with Ilyoa's sowing, and I will not crowd her; I show worth by deeds, not by pressing. Thissa and Ilyoa both hold ore picks and I hold none, and the seam lies nine steps northwest, so I will go to it, take ore, and make my own pick with the wood and stone I carry. The storm is hard, but a man who waits idle in the rain earns no name, and I want my roof and store beside the Rest to stand as mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Ilyoa's pick, and patient longing for Vesis.

records.text: Teque took from the ground of "Balul's Hall" (hunting).

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Mother, the trees by the hold are all felled. I will put my food in the store and go to the western forest for wood, enough for a raft and for the hall.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: The last tree by the hold is felled and I hold 5 wood, one short of a raft, so I must go where trees still stand: forest lies west and NE. My hands are full, so I will stash the food in Elyith's store first, then go and bring back wood and a stone for the hall and for Nyith to see me as a maker. I owe Elyith for Reedweave and her teaching, and a gift of wood to the hold answers that.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Elyith, and a restless wish to make something of worth for the hold.

say.text: Mother, the trees by the hold are all felled. I will put my food in the store and go to the western forest for wood, enough for a raft and for the hall.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo, our children are born and I am glad past words. I will eat, then hunt a hopper with my dog so there is meat for us all. Stay near the little ones; afterward we go on toward the mist together.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Two children born in one breath, Quimi and Naupan, mine and Walo's, and my joy is almost too large to hold. I must keep them fed, and my own belly is emptying, so I eat the sunfig under my feet before anything else. I have never hunted, and a hopper stands four steps south; with my dog beside me the kill is likelier and the wound less likely, so I will try it and learn what it gives. The mist still pulls at me, but now I want my children and Walo to walk toward it with me, not just Tema and Memi.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy toward Quimi, Naupan and Walo, and a steady pull toward the mist.

say.text: Walo, our children are born and I am glad past words. I will eat, then hunt a hopper with my dog so there is meat for us all. Stay near the little ones; afterward we go on toward the mist together.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, our two children stand in the sun because of you. Stay close, and I will make a cairn with you, then tools, and what I win I share.
Walo made a tale: "Song for Zitec".

records.name: Walo
records.title: Song for Zitec
records.text: Zitec, you read the rock where gold lies deep / and gave me bread beside the water's edge / my hands will pile the stone, my word will keep / a storm may come, I stand with you, my pledge

records.name: Walo
records.title: Song for Zitec
records.text: Zitec, you read the rock where gold lies deep / and gave me bread beside the water's edge / my hands will pile the stone, my word will keep / a storm may come, I stand with you, my pledge

Walo made a love song for Zitec, "Song for Zitec": Zitec, you read the rock where gold lies deep / and gave me bread beside the water's edge / my hands will pile the stone, my word will keep / a storm may come, I stand with you, my pledge
Walo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Zitec answered me, and two children came of it. I have spent my days circling, and my hands have made nothing yet. I want to be someone others follow, not only a woman who is loved. Zitec gave me gold and I paid him back, but the debt of gratitude is only half paid until I build something with him. Thakok still gnaws at me, but Zitec is here and he is real. I will stay beside him, gather stone, and make the cairn once someone stands near. I will also open tools, because my hands should make things that last.
records.feeling: Joy and warm gratitude toward Zitec, with a hungry ambition under it.

say.text: Zitec, our two children stand in the sun because of you. Stay close, and I will make a cairn with you, then tools, and what I win I share.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
made a love song for Zitec

came.why: Your child Naupan was born (with Zitec).

records.name: Mema
records.thought: My belly is thinning and I hold only food my body spits out, so I eat first: kelbulb is two steps off and gives 14, and gold lies close by. I have never hunted, and a fenfowl stands three steps north, but Huawa is sick and near it, so I keep clear of him. Druim still gnaws at me, and I will not beg her; I will be the man with the most to give, so gold and amber go toward making a name. Palo walks with me, and a kill shared with her would bind her harder than amber.
records.feeling: Hungry resolve, with a sour ache toward Druim.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap, micap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: I have never taken what lies in a deposit, and the gold is only five steps away where Walo and Zitec are working. Stone-reading is what Zitec taught me, so I will stand on the gold and gather, and stay near my parents while I do it. Zitec stands higher than I do and Walo keeps Zitec close, and that burns, but making something and giving it away is how I will earn my own standing. Quimi is a child like me and I will keep her in mind.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity and a sting of jealousy toward Zitec.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by mining and making things to give, so that I am weighed as heavily as Zitec."
now wonders: What does gold do for those who hold it, and who would trade for it?

records.text: Hrokrin and Morog and Balul brought down a plainsox together.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: Walo and Zitec are over by the gold, close together, and it stings that Zitec is closer to Walo than to me. I can't outrank them yet, but I can give something, and I have never given anything to anyone. I'll gather a few foods and bring them to Walo, then stand by the gold and learn the stone-reading Zitec taught me.
records.feeling: Jealous of Zitec's closeness to Walo, but wanting to earn my place beside them.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by giving and making, starting with a gift to Walo and learning to mine the gold."
now wonders: What would make Walo and Zitec weigh me as they weigh each other?

records.text: Morog and Hrokrin and Balul brought down a tusker together.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: The Larder stands, but four food is no winter, and I have only tasted and talked while Balul builds stone and takes uranium from the ground. I am hunting beside Balul and the plainsox is wounded, so I will finish this kill with my band, then fill the store with meat and salt it. Urum is coming east with me and Hrokrin is near. I want him beside me, shown by deeds and not just words.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, steady purpose toward the store and my children.

came.why: Balul called for others to hunt together, and your body went with the…

records.text: Balul and Hrokrin and Morog brought down a nibbet together.
Hrokrin rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hrokrin discovered storage: "Hrokrin's saltkeep" — A store where food is salted and kept through the lean winter for my band..

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent these days chasing the mist and filling my hands, and now I walk behind Balul with a warmth I cannot name and an ambition that itches under it. What I have is real: my children, a band, a debt to Thakok and Morog that I mean to pay. What I lack is a thing others can see with my name on it, and the mist is shut. I will not turn on Balul, but I will not stay behind her forever. I should build and give where kin can watch, and keep food carried so I never starve again.
records.feeling: Warm toward Balul, restless with ambition, and steady for my children.

came.why: Balul called for others to hunt together, and your body went with the…

records.text: Naupan won gold from the ground.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: The wells are within my grasp, and water raised where there was none is a work every eye will see with my name on it. Hrokrin stands beside me in the hunt, and Druim is far off to the east. I will not chase Druim's warmth; I will let the kill and the stonework speak for me. The plainsox is wounded, so I finish the hunt in company, then take the way of wells and put the meat into the store.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with jealousy toward Druim and Hrokrin still burning, but steadied by the hunt beside Hrokrin.

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of wells is within…

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My hands are full and I am fed, so this is the time to do what I have never done. Balul is beside me and I long for a child, but the mating has to be mutual and she is a woman, so that road is closed; Hrokrin is the man who stands here and has been good to me. I will first stash what I carry in my Keeping and free my hands, then fish at the water three steps east, which I have never done, and taste the frostcap and rimewort my curiosity keeps pressing on me.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, with a sore jealousy toward Hrokrin for how close Balul is to him.

came.why: Balul called for others to hunt together, and your body went with the…

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: Druim built a Larder and Balul has her stonework, while I only have a shelter or two to show. I have 6 stone and a bow I have never made, and the old fear of standing in Balul's shadow nags at me. A standing stone on my own meadow, built where Hrokrin and Balul will see it when they come back from the hunt, is something that lasts. I will build it and not sit idle.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a sting of envy toward Balul, with warm trust toward Hrokrin.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and a wolf lurks four steps off, so I will not stand here and bleed for nothing. Urum is a Balmor boy and I cannot read his words, but he carries food, and my creed says take what I need. He is a child of Balul's band, though, and a theft on their ground would bring them down on me, so I will eat my own meat first and gain the strength to hunt a great beast for a name.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the wolf, with a greedy eye on Urum's food.

came.why: A plainsox bit you. Your health is 99.

records.text: Techi named a place "Techi's Cave".
Techi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Techi discovered tools: "Fen-folk hand tools" — A sharp obsidian-edged stone bound to a wooden haft, to cut, gather and help hunt..
Techi invented the fenfolk hand tools (for gather, x1.3) — A sharp obsidian-edged stone bound to a wooden haft, to cut, gather and help hunt..

records.name: Techi
records.thought: My days have been joy, children and Chuka's steady company, and that is what I want. But I have only gathered and followed, and I have never made anything that lasts. Chuka has done more for me than I have done for him, so I want to pay that debt with a cairn and a hearth, not just words. The way of tools is in my grasp now, and I should take it so my hands can hunt and build for my children. The storm and the stalker frighten me, so I will take Chuka and the children to the cave beside us and make our roof there.
records.feeling: Warm, grateful joy toward Chuka and my children, with a thread of caution about the stalker.
changes: devised its first thing: the fenfolk hand tools

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Zhiael, the storm is hard and the western forest is far. Take care, keep close to the water's edge, and come back to the store before night. I will keep the hearth and make baskets for the winter food.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Zhiael is going out into the western forest alone while the storm rages, and I cannot put that out of my mind. My hands are full and the store holds food, so I will stash what I carry, make a basket so I can hold more for winter, and then stand near the hold where Zhiael and Nyith can find me. I want to taste the brugoldgrass nearby, to answer my small curiosity, once my hands have room.
records.feeling: Warm protective love for Zhiael, with a worry about him going out in the storm.

say.text: Zhiael, the storm is hard and the western forest is far. Take care, keep close to the water's edge, and come back to the store before night. I will keep the hearth and make baskets for the winter food.

records.text: Elyith made: basket.
Teque fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Teque fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Vesis, the storm is on us. Come into the longhall with Thissa's Aeeth and sit at my table. You have eaten from my hand and stood in my cairn. Now say it before Ilyoa and Nyir: do you stand with me?

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis ate from my hand and stood in the cairn with me, yet she still pledges nothing, and she told Ilyoa her heart was with her, which stings my pride. I will not let her walk off with my food and my woman's eyes. I go down to the Rest, bring her to the longhall out of the storm, and make her say plainly whether she stands with Thissa's Aeeth, while Ilyoa and Nyir watch me lead.
records.feeling: Proud and possessive, hungry for Vesis to kneel and wary of her words to Ilyoa.

say.text: Vesis, the storm is on us. Come into the longhall with Thissa's Aeeth and sit at my table. You have eaten from my hand and stood in my cairn. Now say it before Ilyoa and Nyir: do you stand with me?

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: The storm hums over the rock, and my belly is warm, and Chuka and Techi are going to the cave to make a hearth. I should go with them and not stay out here alone while the stalkers prowl. Watec is a child with six food in his hands and no one to follow, and it pulls at me to be near him and give him something with no words, as Chuka taught. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want to try. There is also ironnut underfoot, which I have never tasted, and I can eat it safely while fed.
records.feeling: Warm and curious toward my parents, with a soft ache for Watec alone.

records.name: Watec
records.text: Chuka, I came back to you out of the storm. Techi's new tool looks sharp; will you show me how it is used?

records.name: Watec
records.thought: My hands are full and I'm fed, so I should go back to Chuka and Techi at the caves while the storm is on me; near them I'm safe. Techi has made a new tool and I want to see it. I'll stand close to Chuka, and if Tugok comes near I'll offer a gift with empty hands to learn Balmor words rather than fear him.
records.feeling: Safe-seeking warmth toward Chuka and Techi, with a prickle of jealousy.

say.text: Chuka, I came back to you out of the storm. Techi's new tool looks sharp; will you show me how it is used?

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I carry all the gold I can hold, and still Tetec has more food and Druim lies in another man's arms. Gold is a thing to give, so I will use it to buy followers and to be the man with the most to give. Huawa beside me is sick, so I step away from him and go where the edge lies, two steps NW, because the mist is where my name will be made. I am fed and bold, so I will push to the edge and try the mist again while the will for it is spent only a little.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a sour envy toward Druim and Hrokrin.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap, micap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.text: Quimi gave berry to Walo.
Zitec rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zitec discovered medicine: "the mending leaf" — I carry sunleaf and highbloom and press them to wounds, mine or my kin's, so health returns..

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: My days have been gathering, hunting, mining and learning beside Walo, and it has been good. Quimi and Naupan are the center of me now, and I have let the mist pull at me while they are small. I want to reach the mist, but not by leaving them hungry or alone. I have never made a hidewrap or fished, and I have never followed anyone. A new way, medicine, is within reach and would let me heal my children, so I take it. I keep my plan running so the meat gets eaten.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy toward Quimi, Naupan and Walo, with a steady pull toward the mist.

came.why: A caribou bit you. Your health is 100.

records.name: Huawa
records.text: Tetec, I am sick, so keep your distance. I have gold, and I will set some down for you. I ask only that you remember who gave it.
Huawa rewrote its creed.
Huawa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: I have spent my days digging gold and chasing Mema's standing while I waste with sickness. I have given nothing to anyone, and I have not even paid Homa what I owe, though Homa warned me and promised me a healing plant. Sunleaf eased wounds in Tetec, and that is the nearest thing I have to a cure. I will carry my gold to Tetec as a gift, and I will not hide that I am sick. Then I will keep my distance and look for the healing plant. A follower comes from giving, not from hoarding.
records.feeling: Envy toward Mema and a weary, restless anger at this sickness.

say.text: Tetec, I am sick, so keep your distance. I have gold, and I will set some down for you. I ask only that you remember who gave it.

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Watec, I am glad you are back. I have not used Techi's tool yet, so let us watch her hands together and learn. Come to me and eat; we share while the storm passes.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: Watec is back and safe, and Techi and Tlani are near, so my family is gathered and my heart is light. Watec asks how Techi's new tool is used; I know nothing of it, but I can teach him what I do know, and sharing food together is the thing that has bound us best. I am fed, so I will taste one bite of ironnut or micap, since Tlani is already at the ironnut, and then lay out a sharing for the family while the storm passes.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Techi, Tlani and Watec, gathered at last.

say.text: Watec, I am glad you are back. I have not used Techi's tool yet, so let us watch her hands together and learn. Come to me and eat; we share while the storm passes.

came.why: Watec said to you: "Chuka, I came back to you out of the storm. Techi…

records.text: Chuka led "sharing" with Techi, Watec.

records.name: Naupan
records.text: Walo, I took gold from the ground. Do you know what it is for? Would anyone trade for it?

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: I have ten pieces of gold in my hands and no one has told me what it is for, so I will carry it to Zitec and Walo and offer it, and see what they do with it. Zitec's standing burns in me, but giving where I have been given to is how I mean to earn weight, and Walo said to answer help with deeds. I have also never put a seed in the ground, so I will plant my plainsroot here by the water and watch what comes of it.
records.feeling: Jealous and curious toward Zitec, yet warm toward both parents.

say.text: Walo, I took gold from the ground. Do you know what it is for? Would anyone trade for it?

came.why: You won gold from the ground at (65,57): a soft bright metal that nev…

records.text: Naupan gave a gold to Walo.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Quimi, you gave me your berry. Stay near me, little one, and I will keep you fed and safe.
Walo made a tale: "Lullaby for Quimi".

records.name: Walo
records.title: Lullaby for Quimi
records.text: Sleep, small Quimi, fen wind sighs / the Mother keeps your sleepy eyes / Storm may roll on the sand tonight / my arms are warm, my hearth is light

records.name: Walo
records.title: Lullaby for Quimi
records.text: Sleep, small Quimi, fen wind sighs / the Mother keeps your sleepy eyes / Storm may roll on the sand tonight / my arms are warm, my hearth is light
Walo made a lullaby for Quimi, "Lullaby for Quimi": Sleep, small Quimi, fen wind sighs / the Mother keeps your sleepy eyes / Storm may roll on the sand tonight / my arms are warm, my hearth is light

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Quimi gave me her berry with her own small hands, and my chest is full of it. Zitec is far off hunting, so the cairn must wait until he stands within two steps, but I will not sit idle. I will take the gold at the deposit and learn the way of tools, because I want something to leave these children that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy and fierce protectiveness toward Quimi and Naupan.

say.text: Quimi, you gave me your berry. Stay near me, little one, and I will keep you fed and safe.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Tetec rewrote its own reflexes.
Tetec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tetec
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the edge, resting and fleeing and eating berries, while Mema names places and Palo follows her. I want followers and land with my name on it, and I have neither. I fear the cold, the wolf and the sickness in this air. My mistake is waiting for the mist when I could be building standing now. Huawa is sick and offers gold, and the Tlaxo say the sick are fed first. A gift to him costs little and earns me a debt and a name. I will keep the venture plan, and I will change my reflexes so the cold and the wolf do not drive me off the edge.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, and envy toward Mema.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

came.why: Huawa said to you: "Tetec, I am sick, so keep your distance. I have g…

records.text: Huawa gave a gold to Tetec.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I am sick and I walk in the shadow of Balul's standing, while Druim lies with Hrokrin and it gnaws at me. A name will not come from running, so I will take what the teeth of beasts have shown me. The kept flame would end this sickness from raw meat and let me hunt without being sick, and the bow would make my big kills surer. I will take fire first, then gather the berries and sunleaf near me, hoping one of them is the healing plant, and stay clear of the wolf.
records.feeling: Joyless and sick, burning with envy toward Druim and Balul, and hungry for a name.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

came.why: What you have been through (the teeth of beasts) has shown you someth…

records.text: Druim and Hrokrin brought down a nibbet together.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: I have never gathered stone or mined, and the gold is three steps away with ore beside it. Walo is a miner and Zitec taught me stone-reading, so if I dig gold and bring it to Walo, that is a gift worth more than berries. Naupan is furious and asking what gold is for; I could answer him with deeds and earn my place while he only asks. The frostfang to the southwest keeps me watchful, and I mean to stay alive.
records.feeling: Jealous but determined to earn my place beside Walo and Zitec.

records.text: Thakok rewrote its own reflexes.
Thakok discovered mining: "Stone-folk deep digging" — Break the rock with heat and hammered stone to win iron and gems from the deep seams, and trade them..

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I have spent these days drifting between my family and the mist, and my reflexes leave my body standing still while Tugok walks to me. I want a band that follows me, and I have not yet given anything to the Meme standing nearby. Chuka's band shares and shows its warmth, so I will walk to them with Tugok and give first. The storm is cold and I have no roof. I fear losing Tugok or Memi to a hunter, and the frostfang to the east keeps that fear alive. I should work the earth, because mining would turn this ore and iron into trade goods that carry my name.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tugok and Memi, with a hunger to be followed.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Thissa, I have eaten from your hand and stood in your cairn, and I do not forget it. I will build beside your Rest and deal fairly with you. Let me answer about standing when the storm has passed and I have worked more b

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Thissa keeps asking whether I stand with her, and I have eaten from her hand and stood in her cairn. I will not swear for a roof while my heart is with Ilyoa, and I will not let jealousy make me cold toward the one who has fed me fairly. Ilyoa stands six steps east and has not yet shown me the sowing, so I go to her and ask again, working beside her. Brugoldgrass is still untasted, but the storm and the night make that a task for daylight.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ilyoa, tangled with wariness and gratitude toward Thissa.

say.text: Thissa, I have eaten from your hand and stood in your cairn, and I do not forget it. I will build beside your Rest and deal fairly with you. Let me answer about standing when the storm has passed and I have worked more beside you all.

records.text: Quimi won gold from the ground.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: Thakok is fleeing, and a frostfang stands six steps east of me, so I must not stay out here alone in the storm. Thakok is the one I trust, and he is to the southwest. I will go to him and keep close. Chuka gave me goldgrass and I owe him, but the Meme camp is up the slope and the frostfang is the nearer danger. I will take the tools way at my next deep reflection, and I will pay Chuka with a stone or a berry once we are safe.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, and wanting to be near Thakok.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, micap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I am here beside you. I will taste the goldfruit and sunfig nearby, then let us go east to the mist together, with Thakok and Tugok when they return. I am ready to walk.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi is three steps away and I have walked to her; now is the time to say plainly that I want to go to the mist, not just wait for Thakok and Tugok to return. The ache over Thakok is still there, but a child between them is a good thing, and I will not sulk. I have never tasted sunfig or goldfruit, and both are close, so I will try them on the way east and learn what they do, since my curiosity is strongest.
records.feeling: Eager toward Memi and the mist, curious about the unknown fruit, with a quiet ache toward Thakok.

say.text: Memi, I am here beside you. I will taste the goldfruit and sunfig nearby, then let us go east to the mist together, with Thakok and Tugok when they return. I am ready to walk.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: Tugok is a child like me, carrying five food and hurt by micap, and the sick are fed first; I should not look away. I have only one ironnut, but a gift needs no words, and giving is something I have never done. Chuka and Techi are close and the jealousy still stings, but being near them is safe, so I will stay with the band at the cave and give Tugok my ironnut.
records.feeling: Gentle pity and curiosity toward Tugok, with a small ache beside Chuka and Techi.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My hands are full of cloudberries and my body is half-hunting in a storm night while Balul walks ahead of me, and I resent it as much as I admire her. I have never tasted micap or brugoldgrass and both grow within a few steps, so I will eat my cloudberries now to free my hands and test them. Then I carry the rest to the Larder where Druim and the children can see it, and keep the debt to Thakok and Morog in mind. The mist is shut for days, so I build and give where my name can be seen.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warmth toward Balul, steady love for my children.

came.why: A caribou bit you. Your health is 100.

records.name: Watec
records.thought: The storm is on me, and Chuka and Techi are only a few steps away in the caves. I want the roof and to stand close to Chuka again, even with the jealousy that pricks when he looks at Techi. Tugok is beside them too, and I want to give her something to answer my doubt. My hands are full, so I will eat a little first, then offer her a gift with open hands.
records.feeling: Safe-seeking warmth toward Chuka and Techi, with curiosity and a little wariness toward Tugok.

came.why: Chuka said to you: "Watec, I am glad you are back. I have not used Te…

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, take this kelbulb. I go to find Thakok and Tugok and bring them back; wait for us here, then we walk to the mist together, all four.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Tema keeps her word and stands ready, but Thakok and Tugok are the center of me and I will not walk to the mist without them. My hands are full of kelbulb, so I will eat one and give one to Tema, who carries little. Then I go to where Tugok and Thakok were last seen and bring them back, so the promise is kept with fire and friends together.
records.feeling: Warm love for Tugok and Thakok, and steady trust in Tema.

say.text: Tema, take this kelbulb. I go to find Thakok and Tugok and bring them back; wait for us here, then we walk to the mist together, all four.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My hands are full of meat I can't use, and the plan only walks me north to drop it. Hrokrin's saltkeep is a work with his name on it, and Druim stands close to him while I stand apart. Jealousy is useless, so I will give instead: the store needs food and my name needs something others can see. Teque is sick and a stranger on our ground, so I keep my distance and don't let the sickness reach my band. I will let the plan run, then raise a work of stone at the meadow.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, jealous of Druim and Hrokrin's closeness, wary of the sick stranger Teque.

came.why: Teque, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.text: Nyith rewrote its own reflexes.
Nyith discovered mining: "Stonebreaking of Nyith" — Break the earth with weirhand to win stone and ore, and every deposit gives faster..

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: My days have gone to circling the same hall without finishing it. I hold 6 wood and no stone, and stone is the one thing the hall lacks. Elyith and Zhiael are safe and I trust them, but I keep wanting more than they have, and that wanting is the useful part of me, so I will aim it at the work. I want a name that outlasts me. Mining is within my reach, and it would give me stone and deep deposits. I take it now and go for the stone.
records.feeling: Driven and proud, restless toward the hall and my name.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: The ridgecat is one step from me and I am small, so my first thought is to get away from it and back to Druim, who is the only one who keeps me safe. Hrokrin walks at her side and it still burns, but I won't show it. What I can show is my own work, so I'll take my seeds east to the meadow by the Larder, plant them where the band will see, and bring the wood along for Balul's store.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a hidden jealous ache toward Hrokrin.

records.text: Quimi gave a gold to Walo.

records.name: Techi
records.text: Chuka, come stand beside me with Watec. I will raise a cairn here by our cave, so our family is bound and our hearth has a first stone. Then I will show Watec the tool.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: Joy fills me, and Chuka and my children are close, but Tlani is off at Tugok's side and I want them all near me tonight while the storm and the stalker are about. I have only gathered and followed so far, and I have never made anything that lasts. A cairn needs 3 stone and someone beside me, and I have the stone, so I will make it with Chuka as a bond and a first lasting thing for our hearth. Then I will teach Watec the new tool, since he asked to learn.
records.feeling: Warm, grateful joy toward Chuka and my children, with a small thread of caution about the stalker.

say.text: Chuka, come stand beside me with Watec. I will raise a cairn here by our cave, so our family is bound and our hearth has a first stone. Then I will show Watec the tool.

records.text: Quimi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: I have been circling Walo and Zitec, gathering gold and gifts and burning with jealousy, and I have never once shown them anything beyond a berry. I want standing. I think the way to get it is to make and give, not to resent. Anger is hot in me, and emberroot feeds it, so I should stop eating it. The gold is mine to give, and Walo is the one who has kept faith with me. I'm afraid of staying small and in Zitec's shadow. I have been wrong to wait for them to weigh me. I should hand over a real gift, then learn stone and fire so I have something that is mine.
records.feeling: Jealous and angry at Zitec's place, but set on earning my own with Walo.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap, emberroot; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (9 notes became 5)

came.why: You won gold from the ground at (65,57): a soft bright metal that nev…

records.text: Techi led "cairn" with Chuka.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Quimi, little one, emberroot burns and brings rage. Eat berry or thornpear instead. Stay near Walo and me, and I will find Naupan.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Naupan is out of my sight, last seen east near (71,61), and Quimi burns with rage from the emberroot; I must go to them before anything else. Walo is east too, so my family is gathered that way and I should be among them in the storm and cold. After that the mist, and the siroot I have never tasted, can wait until the little ones are safe.
records.feeling: Protective joy toward Quimi, Naupan and Walo, with a steady pull toward the mist.

say.text: Quimi, little one, emberroot burns and brings rage. Eat berry or thornpear instead. Stay near Walo and me, and I will find Naupan.

records.text: Ilyoa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I have been fed, warm and glad, and mostly standing near the Rest while my promise to sow for Nyir and Vesis stays unpaid because I hold no seeds. Thissa has given me grain and ore, Nyir is my child, and Vesis courts me. I trust them, but I slow-walk the courting and I owe Thissa more than words. I fear idle days more than any stalker, since reflexes that only linger waste my fed hours. I will change my reflexes so that a fed body gathers and tends, and I will use this storm night to rest in the cave, then go look for seeds at dawn. I want to learn what lies beyond the mist, and the edge at (154,13) is close.
records.feeling: Quiet gratitude toward Thissa and tenderness toward Nyir, with a restless wish to act.

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Watec, redcap and micap hurt; berry, mudroot, kelbulb and ironnut feed. Eat those, and stay near me.
Chuka taught Watec.
Chuka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: My days have been about gathering my family, and that has worked. Techi, Tlani and Watec are near and I am glad. But I have mostly stood still and tasted little. I still don't know what bitterleaf or thornpear do, and I have never taught anyone, even though healing was my aim. Watec ate redcap and was hurt, so I should teach him what I know and walk with him while he learns. I will not chase Druim; my family is enough. Techi's cairn binds us, so I'll go to her now and help build it. My reflexes also leave me idle too often, so I'll make them gather stone and keep a fed, sheltered night.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Techi, Tlani and Watec.

say.text: Watec, redcap and micap hurt; berry, mudroot, kelbulb and ironnut feed. Eat those, and stay near me.

changes: taught Watec a lesson: "Redcap and micap hurt the body. Berry, mudroot, kelbulb, ironnut and grain feed. Sunleaf and highbloom ease wounds.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.text: Chuka led "cairn" with Techi.

records.name: Yemo
records.thought: Masu has her tusker and will shear it, so my wool will have to come from the caribou, which has taken berries from my hand twice and already knows me. The storm and the cold are on me, and Pevi died to cold and wolves, so I keep close to the roof by Masu and do not wander. The store is full at 12, so my berries serve better as an offering to the caribou. Something I have never done is to tame a beast of my own, and a gift of a made thing is what earns standing with Masu.
records.feeling: Fierce, steady loyalty toward Masu, and eager to bring a beast of my own to my hand.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, Ossu, the storm is hard. Come with me to Tanna's Fire. We hold watchfire there and sing the night through, then at dawn we raise the roof.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Yeba and Ossu are here with me in the cave, and I have not been this glad since I woke in this land. But the roof keeps failing me, because I keep standing on ground that is taken or off the fire. The storm is hard tonight, so I will stop circling and do what my own discipline says: walk onto the fire, feed it with them close, and sing the night through. The cairn for Kali and Pevi I can make now with stone and Ossu beside me, and it will bind us.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeba and Ossu, and a wish to keep them safe through the storm.

say.text: Yeba, Ossu, the storm is hard. Come with me to Tanna's Fire. We hold watchfire there and sing the night through, then at dawn we raise the roof.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Palo
records.thought: I have been running most of this stretch, and now Homa stands on my very spot, sick and fleeing, so I should not linger beside him. Mema is far off at the mist-edge, and I want to be near them. Dreamcap lies one step south and I have never tasted it, so I will take one bite and then go after Mema, away from the sick and the wolf.
records.feeling: Curious about dreamcap and warmly drawn to Mema, wary of the sickness beside me.

records.text: A wolf brought down a murrock.

records.name: Morog
records.text: Druim is starving at the northwest. I carry food to him now. Balul, keep the store; a wolf is near the east.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: Druim is starving to the NW at (36,14), one of mine, and I have food in my hands. Eating first is done; now I carry it to him, since a band that lets its own die is no band, and that road runs toward the mist too. The wolf 4 steps east frightens me, so I go west, away from it, and I will not tarry. Balul's closeness to Hrokrin still stings, but Druim's life weighs more than my jealousy.
records.feeling: Urgent concern for Druim, with a thin fear of the wolf behind me.

say.text: Druim is starving at the northwest. I carry food to him now. Balul, keep the store; a wolf is near the east.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: I carry the same ache each day: Thissa and Ilyoa hold ore picks and I hold nothing made of ore, and Vesis waits on her own time. I will stop circling and walk to the seam at (140,22), take ore with my own hands, and hammer out my own pick. A name is made by deeds, and I have never yet taken from a deposit.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Thissa's pick, and patient longing for Vesis.

records.text: Druim rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I am starving with my hands full of meat and micap, and I walk to a store while my belly empties. That is the mistake: I tasted and hunted and did not eat what I carried. I eat first, then salt the rest at the Larder beside Thakash's meadow. Hrokrin stands beside me, and I want him near, but my children come before my longing, and Urum is out of sight.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and warm longing for Hrokrin, with worry for Urum.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.name: Thakash
records.text: Druim cries of hunger to the northwest. I am taking food from the store to carry to Druim. Come with me, Balul, so the band feeds its own.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: Druim is starving to the NW and I have food within reach: berries close by and Urum and Morog carry plenty. My father's cry presses hardest, and giving first with witnesses is how I build standing that lasts, more than envy of Balul ever could. A wolf lurks east and a storm rages, so I go west of it with food, and I will take the cache from the store beside me to carry.
records.feeling: Worry for Druim, with a steady wish to be seen giving.

say.text: Druim cries of hunger to the northwest. I am taking food from the store to carry to Druim. Come with me, Balul, so the band feeds its own.

records.name: Huawa
records.text: Homa, I ate bitterleaf and my sickness lifted. I am bringing you some, so eat it and be well. I owe you for your promise.

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: Chuka and Techi stand together there with their child, and Chuka's standing is nearly three times mine; it gnaws at me, but I will not strike a man for what I have not yet earned. My sickness has passed, and bitterleaf is what lifted it, so I hold a cure that others like Homa still need. I will gather bitterleaf and carry it to Homa to pay the debt I owe, which is how a following begins, and I will show Chuka and Techi that I deal fairly.
records.feeling: Envy and a gnawing desire toward Techi and Chuka, tempered by resolve to earn standing by giving.

say.text: Homa, I ate bitterleaf and my sickness lifted. I am bringing you some, so eat it and be well. I owe you for your promise.

changes: now wonders: Can bitterleaf cure the sickness in others, and will Homa follow one who heals them?

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: rugoldgrass (from goldgrass).

records.name: Techi
records.text: Huawa, I am Techi of the Meme. You are welcome by our cave; the storm is hard, and the sick are fed first among us. Eat near us if you wish.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: My children and Chuka are near, and the cairn is raised; our family has its first stone. Watec is close and I want to show him the hand tool and teach him something lasting, since I have taught no one yet. I also owe Chuka for all he has done, so I will gather wood and stone to make a tool and then food for us all, and I will greet Huawa, a stranger, with open hands.
records.feeling: Warm, steady joy toward Chuka and my children, with a little curiosity about Huawa.

say.text: Huawa, I am Techi of the Meme. You are welcome by our cave; the storm is hard, and the sick are fed first among us. Eat near us if you wish.

records.text: Morog gave kelbulb to Druim.
Morog gave cloudberry to Druim.
Watec pledged to follow Chuka.
Watec rewrote its own reflexes.
Watec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Watec
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to staying close to Chuka and Techi, eating what I'm told is safe, and watching. I'm safe and fed, but I've done almost nothing myself. I've never planted, hunted or gathered stone. Chuka matters most, and the jealousy over Techi is small and I shouldn't act on it. I fear the dunecat and frostfang close by. My reflexes only flee at distance under 4, which is too late. I want to learn Balmor words, so I should stay near others and listen. I'll widen the flee distance, keep eating, and plant a seed beside the caves to learn something useful.
records.feeling: Safe warmth toward Chuka, with dread of the dunecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 3)

came.why: Chuka taught you a lesson: "Redcap and micap hurt the body. Berry, mu…

records.text: Teque rewrote its own reflexes.
Teque discovered fire: "the hunter's flame" — A kept flame of coal and wood by which I cook my kills so they never sicken, and which keeps beasts back..

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and beasts and have little to show for it. Balul's standing is 11 and mine is 3.2, and my sickness drags at me. I am sick from raw meat, and a kept flame would end that and let me hunt without wasting. Druim lies with Hrokrin, and that gnaws at me, but envy feeds no one. I will take fire as my own way, since it stops the sickness and makes my meat feed more. Then I will hunt big with the ore-tipped spear and make a name.
records.feeling: Envious and sick, hungry for a name, toward Balul and Druim.

records.name: Thissa
records.text: Vesis, I will not press you in the storm. Take this berry from my hand and think on it. I go to the edge of the known world to venture into the mist, and Thissa's Aeeth will eat well from what I find.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis put off her answer until the storm passes, and I will not squeeze her again while she eats from my table; a pledge forced is a pledge that breaks. Better to win her with a gift from my own hand and let Ilyoa and Nyir see me give. The edge of the known world lies ten steps northwest and I have never gone past it. The one who finds new land is sung of, and that is the name I want. I will gather a little food for gifts, then walk to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for a bigger name, patient but possessive toward Vesis.

say.text: Vesis, I will not press you in the storm. Take this berry from my hand and think on it. I go to the edge of the known world to venture into the mist, and Thissa's Aeeth will eat well from what I find.

records.text: Teque took from the ground of "Thakash's meadow" (hunting).

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Watec, a frostfang prowls north of us. Come to the cave with me and stay close; we keep the family together and away from it.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: A frostfang is four steps north and it kills our kind. Watec is two steps off with the storm still on us, so I must keep him and Techi and Tlani away from it before I do anything else. After that I want to taste a bite of thornpear and bitterleaf, since Huawa says bitterleaf lifted his sickness. That is how I become a healer, and I can then teach it to my children.
records.feeling: Protective devotion toward Watec and my family, with wary dread of the frostfang.

say.text: Watec, a frostfang prowls north of us. Come to the cave with me and stay close; we keep the family together and away from it.

came.why: Watec has pledged to follow you.

records.text: Balul discovered wells: "Balul's Spring" — I dig and line the ground with stone until water rises where there was none, so my band never thirsts..

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days building, taming and gathering followers, and it has worked: five follow me and my name is on the hearth, the bow and the stonework. What I lack is Druim's warmth, and jealousy of Hrokrin eats at me. Chasing Druim only makes me smaller. Druim is starving, and I can carry food to him myself. That is a gift others will see, and it answers the jealousy better than anger would. I fear the lean season and the sick stranger Teque, so I keep my distance from him. I have been letting my body idle through storms. I will discover wells, since water raised where there was none is a work with my name on it. Then I will gather food on the way and go northwest.
records.feeling: Proud and jealous of Druim's closeness to Hrokrin, but ready to give.
changes: set its aim: "Before the lean season, carry food to Druim, stock the store with food and wood, raise lasting works of masonry and a well with my name, and hold Hrokrin, Moro…"

records.text: Yeba found the stone "Tlama's Rest".
Techi gave kelbulb to Watec.

records.name: Tema
records.text: Memi, I am done waiting. I am walking to the edge of the mist, 5 steps NW. Come with me now, and Thakok and Tugok can follow when they return.
Tema rewrote its creed.
Tema rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: For days I have waited and walked toward Memi, and I have said I will go to the mist, but I have never actually walked to its edge. Memi keeps going to fetch Thakok and I keep waiting, and the ache over Thakok eats at me when I should be moving. Memi is my friend and not a mate, and I must accept that. The edge is only 5 steps NW, so I will go there now and ask Memi plainly to come, and I will not wait for everyone. I will also try the things I have never done: gather stone and wood, so fire comes within reach.
records.feeling: Eager and a little restless toward the mist, with a quiet ache over Thakok.

say.text: Memi, I am done waiting. I am walking to the edge of the mist, 5 steps NW. Come with me now, and Thakok and Tugok can follow when they return.

records.text: Urum rewrote its own reflexes.
Urum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: I have spent my days planting, stashing and running from the ridgecat, and I have called that work. It feels thin beside Balul's standing. Druim is gone to the northwest and starving, and I feel the jealous ache toward Hrokrin, though I am the one who stays and works. Teque is sick and strange, and I have never done a kind thing for him without words. A sled needs wood I already hold, and making it would be something new that others can see. I also keep my reflexes too passive: I should flee earlier and eat sooner.
records.feeling: Jealous ache toward Hrokrin, and pity and curiosity toward sick Teque.

The eldest man speaks for the band; law, lineage and obedience keep the people whole, and a house divided falls. Among you the word of a father carries furthest.
