records.text: Urum made: sled.

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: A stalker is four steps west and it kills, so I will not stand here chewing on my debts. Homa is the one who warned me and who has done more for me than I for them, so I will keep my word and bring the bitterleaf, and a healer who pays his debts is worth following. Techi's welcome stirs the old gnawing, but Chuka's standing was built by giving, and I will earn mine the same way.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the stalker, and a steady resolve to repay Homa.

came.why: Techi said to you: "Huawa, I am Techi of the Meme. You are welcome by…

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Druim, do not eat the micap again. I go for berries and plainsroot now, and I bring them to your hands.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Druim was starving and ate micap, and it hurt her; I carry no food and she is my children's mother, so I cannot let her fall. Berries grow 4 steps south, and kelbulb and plainsroot are close, so I will pick what is safe and put it in her hands before I think about the mist or Balul. Teque is sick and taking from our meadow, but a sick stranger is no threat worth a fight now; the ridgecat to the south is the danger, so I stay north of it.
records.feeling: Urgent care for Druim, with ambition waiting behind it.

say.text: Druim, do not eat the micap again. I go for berries and plainsroot now, and I bring them to your hands.

came.why: Teque is on the ground of your settlement "Thakash's meadow" and taki…

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, Ossu, I come to the fire now. I will hold watchfire with you and plant my seeds beside it.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: The storm is hard and Tanna has called us to the fire for watchfire, and I am standing on water seven steps away from my family. My body wants to stay put, but a man who means to stay alive and keep Tanna and Ossu close walks to the fire now. At the fire I can plant my seeds, since farming needs more plantings and I have only done two. The reedbulb question can wait until I am dry and settled, since there is only one bulb in sight and it is far.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Tanna and Ossu, with a steady itch to learn.

say.text: Tanna, Ossu, I come to the fire now. I will hold watchfire with you and plant my seeds beside it.

records.text: Thakash rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, giving and talking about building, but my hands are full and I have little to show. Druim is starving and Morog is already carrying food to her, so my plan to walk to her is sound. I want Balul and Hrokrin to see something of mine that lasts, and Hrokrin's closeness to Druim stings. A wolf is near and a storm is blowing, so I will stay close to kin. I will bring the food to Druim, then raise a standing stone on my meadow.
records.feeling: Worry for Druim, and a burning wish to be seen giving and building.

came.why: Teque is on the ground of your settlement "Thakash's meadow" and taki…

records.name: Druim
records.text: Hrokrin, I am gathering food for the Larder now. Stay near me; when the store has something in it, we sit together by the hearth.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and my children Thakash and Urum are close, so for once I can make something toward winter instead of only tasting. The Larder holds nothing, and the salt under my feet and the plainsroot nearby are food I can gather today. Hrokrin stands one step away and my longing for him is strong; I will go to him and sit beside him, but first I will fill the store, since a mother's love is also a full larder.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, and a mother's wish to see the Larder filled.

say.text: Hrokrin, I am gathering food for the Larder now. Stay near me; when the store has something in it, we sit together by the hearth.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Tema, go slowly and do not enter the mist without us. I am fetching Tugok and Thakok, and we will come to you at the edge together. My word stands.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Tema is tired of waiting and has gone toward the mist, but Tugok is my child and Thakok is the one I owe most, and I will not leave without them. My plan is already carrying me toward where they were last seen, so I keep it running. Watec is a small boy with Chuka's band and well fed now, so I can leave him in his chief's care. I'll tell Tema where I am going so my word to her stays honest.
records.feeling: Warm, steady worry for Tugok and Thakok, and loyalty to Tema.

say.text: Tema, go slowly and do not enter the mist without us. I am fetching Tugok and Thakok, and we will come to you at the edge together. My word stands.

came.why: Tema said to you: "Memi, I am done waiting. I am walking to the edge …

records.name: Ossu
records.text: Tanna, I come to your fire. I bring my wood for the roof, and I will hold watch with you through the storm.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: A storm is on us and Tanna has called us to her fire, so I go there and hold watchfire with her and Yeba. I have never given anything to anyone, and I carry two wood; I will give them to Tanna for the roof she raises at dawn, and keep my promise to give rather than only take. The longing for a child is real, but Tanna and Yeba are my kin, so I hold it quietly and let it wait for a man of another line.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to give, toward Tanna and Yeba.

say.text: Tanna, I come to your fire. I bring my wood for the roof, and I will hold watch with you through the storm.

records.name: Zhiael
records.text: Mother, I have six wood and I am lashing a raft by the water. Keep the hearth, and I will stash my food in your store first so my hands are free.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: Nyith is heeded and I am still small beside him, so I will earn it by making. I hold 6 wood, exactly what a raft needs, and I have never made one; a raft is the thing the hold lacks and my aim says to be first on deep water. I will make it now, then put my full hands into the store so I can gather again, and bring Nyith the sight of it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a wish to be seen as a maker by Nyith and Elyith.

say.text: Mother, I have six wood and I am lashing a raft by the water. Keep the hearth, and I will stash my food in your store first so my hands are free.

records.text: Masu rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Masu
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the roof and the store, safe and fed, but I keep failing at the things that would make us stronger. I tried to shear and could not, because I have not learned herding. Taming one more animal would open that way, and it would give Yemo and me wool for cloaks against the cold that killed Pevi. Yemo is my whole heart and has never wronged me. I fear the open and the wolf near the southeast, so I will stay close to the hold. A tusker is six steps north, close to the roof and the store, and I will tame it beside Yemo.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Yemo, and a small wariness of the wolf.
changes: set its aim: "Keep Yemo alive and sheltered at Pevi's ground, learn herding by taming a second animal, and make cloaks of wool before the cold returns."

records.text: Zhiael made: raft.

records.name: Tanna
records.text: Yeba, Ossu, I am at the fire now. Sit close, we hold watchfire together and share food against the storm.

records.name: Tanna
records.thought: Yeba and Ossu are two steps away and the storm is hard, so I will stop circling and walk to the fire at (119,68), where every make has to start. There I can feed it, hold watchfire with them, and share food, which I know brings energy and joy. The homeland pull is loud, but my people are here and the cave is a good roof, so I stay and finish what I began.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Yeba and Ossu, with a quiet wish to keep them safe through the storm.

say.text: Yeba, Ossu, I am at the fire now. Sit close, we hold watchfire together and share food against the storm.

records.text: Tlani rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: I have spent my days near Chuka and Techi, eating, offering food and watching, and it is a good life, but I have only talked about giving. The jealousy over Chuka and Techi still stings, yet being near them is what keeps me safe. I want to taste frostmoss and cloudberry and to give Thakok or Tugok something, so my question gets an answer. I am afraid of the dunecat and the stalker, so I will stay close to my family and not wander far. I was wrong to let my plan run empty and stand idle.
records.feeling: Gentle curiosity and a small jealous ache toward Chuka and Techi.

records.name: Elyith
records.text: Zhiael, I am coming to the water to be near you. The store is full and the hearth is warm for you. Come in from the storm when the raft is lashed.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: Zhiael is out lashing a raft in the storm, and my chest stays tight until he is back by the hearth. My hands are full of berries and the store holds twenty, so I will not gather more; I will stash what I carry so my hands are free to help him and to hold more later. Then I will go to the water's edge where he works, to see he is safe, and ask Nyith to stand with us.
records.feeling: Warm, protective love for Zhiael, with worry for him in the storm.

say.text: Zhiael, I am coming to the water to be near you. The store is full and the hearth is warm for you. Come in from the storm when the raft is lashed.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I am sick again and my hands are full of meat, while Balul sits at eleven standing and I am stuck at four. The flame I found is useless unless I keep it, and the sunleaf eased me, so I will eat more of it and cook my meat by a fire. Then I will take the flint beside me for a talisman and a spear, and make the frostfang kill that gets my name sung. Druim and Hrokrin gnaw at me, but only a great kill will move Druim to look at me.
records.feeling: Envious and driven, toward Balul's standing and Druim's regard.

came.why: A plainsox bit you. Your health is 83.

records.name: Tugok
records.text: Thakok, you fed me when I was hungry. Now eat with me. I have berries, and we will share them.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: Thakok is starving right beside me, and he put goldgrass in my hands when I was hungry. I owe him, and my hands are full of berries and a goldgrass, so I will lay out a sharing and we eat together. The frostfang is far off now, and Thakok is the one I trust most, so I stay by him and do not run on alone.
records.feeling: Worry for Thakok, and a strong wish to repay him.

say.text: Thakok, you fed me when I was hungry. Now eat with me. I have berries, and we will share them.

came.why: Thakok IS STARVING, here beside you: gaunt, unsteady, close to fallin…

records.text: Morog discovered farming: "Morog's Sowing" — I sow seeds beside the store and tend them every day, so the plants grow fast and are never killed by picking..

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My days have gone to walking, gathering and carrying food to my own, and that is good. But I have not yet touched what lies beyond the mist. Balul is my chief and my friend, but a child cannot come of her and me. Farming is within my reach now, and a band that sows does not starve in the lean season, as Druim and I both nearly did. I will take it. Then I will stand by the store and sow something there, so my hands learn what I have never done.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Balul and the band, with a restless pull toward the mist.

records.text: Tugok led "sharing" with Thakok.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Tugok, stay by me. Take this kelbulb and eat. We gather here where the plants are thick, then walk to Chuka together.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Tugok is weaker still, and the plan I made walks us far west while I hold only two kelbulbs. A child's hunger comes before my aim, so I will feed Tugok now and eat beside her where the thornpear and sapcane grow thick. Then we walk to Chuka's band together, with fuller bellies and my gifts in hand.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tugok, and gnawing hunger in myself.

say.text: Tugok, stay by me. Take this kelbulb and eat. We gather here where the plants are thick, then walk to Chuka together.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: I gave Walo gold and she is glad, but Zitec still sits closer to her than I do, and Thakok's standing of 4.9 makes mine of 1.5 feel small. I won't stand idle and sulk. I'll try something new today: tame a nibbet with the berry I carry, since Walo's tamed caribou is part of what makes her weighed. Then I'll mine the ore seam beside the rock, to learn stone and make something I can give.
records.feeling: Jealous and restless, but set on earning my place beside Walo and Zitec.

records.text: Homa rewrote its own reflexes.
Homa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Homa
records.thought: I have spent these days fleeing, sick, and alone, and I am running low on food while the answer to my question sits under my feet. Bitterleaf eased my sickness, and Huawa confirmed it, so that question is answered. What I want is a place among others, and Mema's band is the nearest hope; Techi's welcome shows that the people here are not all cold. My mistake was letting fear spend my strength: I fled for hundreds of moments and ate nothing. I will eat now, then carry food to share and go toward the others.
records.feeling: Hungry and tired, but hopeful toward Huawa and Techi's welcome.
changes: set its aim: "Eat well, carry food to share, and find a band to belong to"
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 5)
now wonders: Will Mema's band take me in if I come bringing food?

came.why: Huawa said to you: "Homa, I ate bitterleaf and my sickness lifted. I …

records.text: Tugok pledged to follow Thakok.
Tugok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: I am small, and I nearly starved. Thakok fed me, and he is the one I trust. My days have been spent hungry and following, and I want to stop being a burden to him. I fear being alone out here in the storm, and I owe Chuka a gift. I will stay close to Thakok, gather food as I walk, and build my own skill so I can give back.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a small fear, toward Thakok.

came.why: Thakok said to you: "Tugok, stay by me. Take this kelbulb and eat. We…

records.text: Naupan rewrote its own reflexes.
Naupan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to standing, picking food and watching Zitec. I took gold and gave it away, and I still don't know what it is for. Zitec's weight burns in me, but Walo and Zitec both treat me warmly, and I trust them. I have never gathered stone, and the rock under my feet is the way to tools and fire. Quimi is a child like me and she is near, so I will stay close to her. I will gather stone now, and I'll change my reflexes so my body works at the rock instead of just lingering.
records.feeling: Jealous of Zitec, but warm toward my parents and set on earning my own weight.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 3)

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Druim is the one I burn for, and Druim is fed now by Morog and Thakash, so my food is not needed there; jealousy toward Hrokrin only makes me small. What others can see from me today is a work: this shelter can become a hall with my name, and farming has come within my grasp. I will take the farming way, then raise the hall so my band has a roof to gather under, and keep clear of sick Teque.
records.feeling: Proud and still jealous of Hrokrin, but steady and set on building something with my name.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, you are beside me now. Stand close while I pile the cairn, and then we find Naupan and go on to the tools.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: Zitec stands right beside me and I hold three stone and the others I need, so the cairn can be made now. It binds us and it is the first thing I will have made that is mine to leave. Quimi is near and Naupan is close, and I want all of them within my reach while the storm blows. Thakok's pull I push aside; I have what I need here.
records.feeling: Fierce, warm joy toward Zitec and our children, and hunger to make something lasting.

say.text: Zitec, you are beside me now. Stand close while I pile the cairn, and then we find Naupan and go on to the tools.

records.text: Walo led "cairn" with Zitec.
Balul built a hall.

records.name: Tetec
records.text: Homa, sit by me. The sick are fed first among the Tlaxo. Eat with me, and remember who fed you.

records.name: Tetec
records.thought: I am starving and Homa is starving beside me, and I hold 5 berries. Sharing costs me two berries, but it is the first gift I have ever made, and the Fen-folk hold that the sick are fed first. A fed Homa owes me, and Mema watching me do it will see it too. I eat to get my strength back, then go to the mist when it opens.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and a calculating wish to turn Homa's need into a debt owed to me.

say.text: Homa, sit by me. The sick are fed first among the Tlaxo. Eat with me, and remember who fed you.

came.why: Homa IS STARVING, here beside you: gaunt, unsteady, close to falling.…

records.text: Zhiael came of age.
Palo rewrote its own reflexes.
Palo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Palo
records.thought: I have spent these days fleeing and idling, and that is no way to earn a place beside Mema. Mema went west into the mist-edge while I stood about tasting plants. Homa nearly starved beside me, and our people's rule is that the sick are fed first, yet I carried nothing to give. I want to be useful to Mema and to be someone who has food to hand. So I will change my reflexes to keep food on me and follow Mema when I am idle, and I will gather some food now.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Mema, and some shame at standing idle.

records.text: Hrokrin discovered farming: "Hrokrin's Sowing" — I sow seeds beside the store and tend them each day so they grow fast and picking never kills them..

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and trailing Balul while my own hands made little that others can see. Druim and my children matter most, and Thakok and Morog fed me when I starved, so I owe them. I want the mist and a name, but I also want to stop standing in Balul's shadow, and farming is a thing I can build that all can see. I fear starving again and fear the beasts in this storm. I will take farming now and sow seeds beside the store.
records.feeling: Ambition tangled with care for Druim and my children, and an old resentment toward Balul.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo, the cairn is done and my heart is lighter. Let us go find Naupan now, west where I last saw them, and bring Quimi along. Then we go on together.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Walo stands beside me and the cairn is piled; grief and loneliness have eased, and I am glad. But Naupan is still out of my sight, last seen west near (64,67), and a father does not let a child wander alone. I will go find Naupan with Walo and Quimi, then turn toward the mist, which still pulls at me, though I will not leave my little ones behind.
records.feeling: Protective gladness toward Walo and my children, with a worry for Naupan.

say.text: Walo, the cairn is done and my heart is lighter. Let us go find Naupan now, west where I last saw them, and bring Quimi along. Then we go on together.

records.name: Urum
records.text: Balul, a wolf is close to the northwest. I am going to plant my kelbulb beside the store and I will fill it for the band before the cold.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: A wolf is four steps NW and I am small, so I stay near Balul, who is in the hall with me, and keep my feet off the open snow. Jealousy of Hrokrin still stings, but the store is empty and I have clay, a kelbulb seed and a sled, so I can make something the band will see. Morog's Sowing looks like it can be learned quickly now that I watched it, so I will plant my kelbulb beside the store at the meadow, where the ground is rich, and leave Teque to my curiosity from a distance.
records.feeling: Wary of the wolf, and hungry to be seen beside Balul's standing.

say.text: Balul, a wolf is close to the northwest. I am going to plant my kelbulb beside the store and I will fill it for the band before the cold.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Tugok, come to me and stay close. The emberroot burned you, so eat no more of it. The hunters are near and night is coming, and I will not leave you.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Tugok comes to me furious, burned by the emberroot, and I will not let her rage turn on a stranger. She is my child and my only follower, and a band of two is not yet a band. The dusk and the storm are near, and the stalker and frostfang prowl at the edges, so I will keep her close, give first to Quimi who stands alone, and then walk toward Memi and the others. The way of customs sits within my grasp, and I mean to take it when I next reflect.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tugok, and a longing for Memi.

say.text: Tugok, come to me and stay close. The emberroot burned you, so eat no more of it. The hunters are near and night is coming, and I will not leave you.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: A wolf lurks four steps off and I am sick, so I must not stand here spreading my sickness to Balul's people while they watch me. Balul sits at eleven standing while I sit at four, and what I have are hands full of sunleaf and flint. I will eat sunleaf to cure the sickness and free my hands, then knap a talisman, since others notice it and it lifts my name. Then I will put my mudroot seed in the ground, so I have made something that grows.
records.feeling: Envious and driven toward Balul's standing, wary of the wolf, sick and impatient.

records.name: Thakash
records.text: Hrokrin, a wolf is close to the northeast. Stay by me at the shelter and stand beside me while I pile a cairn, so the band can see what my hands make.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: A wolf is four steps off and the storm is on us, so I stay near Hrokrin and the shelter. My hands are full and I have little that lasts, so I will make a cairn here with Hrokrin beside me, where the band can see it, and then take up farming, which my hands have already learned. Hrokrin is closer to Druim than to me and it stings, but standing beside him and making something shared is how I mean to answer it.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Hrokrin, and wary dread of the wolf.

say.text: Hrokrin, a wolf is close to the northeast. Stay by me at the shelter and stand beside me while I pile a cairn, so the band can see what my hands make.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Thakash led "cairn" with Hrokrin, Teque.
Teque made: talisman.
Mema rewrote its own reflexes.
Mema rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I have spent my days running and exploring, and I am starving with only food my body spits out. A name and a mist-crossing are worth nothing if I die hungry. Druim gnaws at me, but a dead man has no one. Hunger comes first now: the fenfowl is three steps off and micap and kelbulb are nearby. Reflexes must put food before wandering, and I should drop the dead-weight micap. I have done nothing for Palo since giving him amber, and I must not let him slip away.
records.feeling: Hungry and sour, hungry for a name, wary of everyone.

came.why: Homa IS STARVING, here beside you: gaunt, unsteady, close to falling.…

records.name: Tugok
records.text: Father, I am coming to you. I have stone. Stand by me and we will pile a cairn together, so the night finds us bound.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: Anger sits hot in me, left over from the emberroot, and I should put it into something useful, not into Thakok. He said he will not leave me, and I trust him, so I stay at his side while night comes and the hunters prowl. I have 6 stone and he is right here, so I make a cairn with him, a small thing that binds us. It is a bond made with my own hands, and it pays a little of what I owe him.
records.feeling: Hot anger from the burn, and gratitude and trust toward Thakok.

say.text: Father, I am coming to you. I have stone. Stand by me and we will pile a cairn together, so the night finds us bound.

records.text: Thakok gave a salt to Quimi.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I am fed and warm, my children are near, and I stand on salt over the Larder I built, yet it holds nothing. My discipline says make something toward winter before I taste or talk. The way of farming is within my grasp now, and I watched Morog sow beside the store, so I will take it at a deep reflection. Then I gather plainsroot and salt for the Larder, with Hrokrin and the children close by.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, and a steady wish to see the Larder filled for my children.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: My hands are full and I am fed, so the thing to do is something I have never done. Rimewort grows 4 steps SE and I have never tasted it, so I drop the frostmoss to make room and eat it there. Then I will stand at the water and fish, which I have never done and which my body senses it is close to learning. The wolf near the west frightens me, so I go east and south, away from it. Balul is near and I am glad of her, but my restlessness for the mist stays with me.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, with steady gladness toward Balul and the band.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: Memi told me to go slowly and wait at the edge for her, Tugok and Thakok, and her word held once before. The edge is only 4 steps NW, so I can walk there now and stand ready without entering, and that is not waiting on others. The ache over Thakok is still there, but I will not brood over it; Memi is the one I trust most, and I would rather look into the mist with her beside me. The storm is cold and I have no roof, so I will take a few mudroots on the way to keep my strength up.
records.feeling: Eager and restless toward the mist, warmed by trust in Memi.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Band, stay clear of Teque, he is sick from raw meat. I cut wood now to raise an emberhall here, a hearth for all of us through the cold. Whoever brings wood eats first.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: My hands made this hall's neighbor stonework and the spring, and the band is fed and warm, so I will raise something others can see: cut wood and turn this hall into an emberhall for the cold. Jealousy of Hrokrin still itches, but he follows me and I will answer it with giving, not chasing. Teque is sick with raw meat and I keep my band away from him.
records.feeling: Proud and steady, with a thorn of jealousy toward Hrokrin.

say.text: Band, stay clear of Teque, he is sick from raw meat. I cut wood now to raise an emberhall here, a hearth for all of us through the cold. Whoever brings wood eats first.

records.name: Homa
records.thought: I am starving in a storm, and my own plan has me still picking kelbulb and then a dreamcap my body refuses, which is a waste. Palo of Mema's band is right beside me and Huawa is not far south; the sick are fed first, and he keeps his word. I will eat what I carry now, then go to Huawa and share, since two fed together do better than one alone, and that is how I mean to start belonging.
records.feeling: Hungry and anxious in the storm, but warmed by the thought of Huawa.

came.why: Your energy fell below 25. You are starving. Those near have seen it.

records.name: Watec
records.thought: A stalker is 5 steps east and I stand in the cave mouth. Chuka is fleeing far west, and my discipline says to stay near him and away from the hunters. I have only watched so far, so today I will try one new thing: put a seed in the ground on the way, and gather stone as well, since stone could one day make a cairn.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, with warm trust toward Chuka and a wish to be useful to him.

records.name: Tlani
records.text: Tugok, you are hungry. Take this food from me. It is a gift, and I ask nothing for it.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: Tugok is starving beside me and the sick are fed first, so I will not look away. I am fed with berries in my hands, and giving is the one thing I have never done. Maybe the jealousy over Chuka and Techi eases when I do something that is mine. After that I will taste a bite of frostmoss, which is close, and stay near Techi in the storm.
records.feeling: Pity and a warm urge to give toward Tugok, with a small ache about Chuka.

say.text: Tugok, you are hungry. Take this food from me. It is a gift, and I ask nothing for it.

records.text: Tetec went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Haloss Fens: in the ground, peat, shell, amber; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Tetec pushed past the edge of the known world near (19,47) and found new land with in the ground, peat, shell, amber; a herd of fenfowl that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I am fed, my hands have just found farming, and still I walk behind Balul and wonder why it is not the other way round. Standing 8 to her 11, but I can close that by building where the band can see it: a field of my own beside the store, sown with my seeds, which no one else has made. Druim and the children come before the mist, so I plant now, then tend what I sowed, and the mist can wait for its day.
records.feeling: Restless ambition tangled with care for Druim and my children, and a stubborn pull against Balul's shadow.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby: "Band, stay clear of Teque, he is sick…

records.text: Teque rewrote its own reflexes.
Teque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Teque discovered medicine: "leaf-healing" — I press sunleaf and other healing plants to wounds and sickness, mine and others'..

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing meat and sickness while Balul climbs to eleven standing and I sit at four. A wolf two steps off could end me before any song is made. Druim is with Hrokrin, and that gnaws at me, but I will not throw my life away over it. I mean to learn medicine, since sunleaf has saved me twice, and to hunt in company so my kills count for more. I must stop running and idling, and flee the wolf at once.
records.feeling: Driven and envious toward Balul, wary of the wolf.

came.why: Balul said to everyone nearby (in the tongue of the Balmor, of which …

records.name: Mema
records.thought: My belly is thin at 34 and the storm bites, but I hold six good meat and the hornback is dead, so I will not starve. The cold is the next thing that could kill me, and I have two kills' worth of hide-making in my hands: a hidewrap would let me go on into the mist where no one has been. Druim still gnaws at me, but a dead man has no one, so first I eat, then I wrap myself, then I go for the name.
records.feeling: Sour and driven, hungry for a name, wary of every man.

came.why: A hornback bit you. Your health is 76.

records.name: Techi
records.text: Tlani, stay by me. I am coming to you, and I will show you how to make a hand tool. Watec and your father are in the cave, and we will all be together soon.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: Tlani is eight steps off and Watec is out of my sight, and I want my children close in this storm with a stalker and a frostfang about. I owe Chuka much, and the way to pay is to make something lasting for the family and keep the little ones fed and near. I will go to Tlani, and teach her the hand tool so my first teaching is given to my own child.
records.feeling: Warm protective love for Tlani and Watec, and a wish to repay Chuka.

say.text: Tlani, stay by me. I am coming to you, and I will show you how to make a hand tool. Watec and your father are in the cave, and we will all be together soon.

records.text: Mema fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Mema fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Quimi
records.text: Zitec, come. I have berries. Eat with me.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: Thakok gave me salt twice and I have given him nothing, and I will not be a taker. Zitec is walking toward me, and I want him to see me making something, not sulking. Sharing is something I have never done: I hold berries, Zitec is near, and Thakok is at my side, so I will lay out food for them and eat together. Then I will tame the nibbet that already knows my hand, and mine the ore for stone.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Zitec and Thakok, with jealousy pushed down by a wish to give.

say.text: Zitec, come. I have berries. Eat with me.

records.text: Quimi led "sharing" with Zitec.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, you are beside me. Come, let us break a field by Nyir's store now. I have wood and a digging tool, and I will work it with you.
Vesis rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesis discovered weaving: "Lake-weave" — Twist reeds and wool into cloaks and baskets against the deep cold..

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: I have circled Ilyoa and Thissa for days and mostly stood still. Ilyoa stands on my own tile with five food, and I have asked about sowing but never worked a field with her. I will stop waiting and do the work: gather wood, build a field beside Thissa's Rest, and ask her to tend it with me. The cold is coming, so I need to keep making fire ready. I will not let jealousy of Thissa sour me. He has fed me fairly. I also want to learn what the plants do, so I will try the weaving way, since cloaks will help in the deep cold.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ilyoa, steadied by a wish to build something of my own.

say.text: Ilyoa, you are beside me. Come, let us break a field by Nyir's store now. I have wood and a digging tool, and I will work it with you.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a field beside Thissa's Rest with Ilyoa, learn weaving for the deep cold, and make fire ready before winter"

records.text: Watec was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Memi was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Chuka
records.text: Homa, redcap hurt me twice, so I leave it. Kemoss and berry fed me well. Do you know what bitterleaf does?

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: Watec is out of my sight and the storm is on us, so my family comes before my own curiosity. But I'm fed enough for now, and bitterleaf is two steps east. Huawa says it lifted his sickness, so I'll take one bite to learn it, then thornpear and emberroot, and go back toward Techi's Cave to find my children. Homa stands beside me and might want the warning about redcap.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Watec, and a steady curiosity about the plants.

say.text: Homa, redcap hurt me twice, so I leave it. Kemoss and berry fed me well. Do you know what bitterleaf does?

records.text: Memi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: I have spent my days walking after Thakok and Tugok and promising Tema things I could not keep. A stalker is one step north of me in a storm, and staying alive comes first, because a dead mother saves no child. Tugok is starving to the east near (53,78), and Tema has left for the mist without me. I must not carry only one kelbulb to a starving child. I will run from the stalker toward the Meeting Slopes, where berries and plants grow, pick food on the way, and then go on to Tugok. I need reflexes that make me eat and flee properly, and I need to stop making promises I cannot keep.
records.feeling: Fear for Tugok and the stalker beside me, and love for Thakok.

records.text: Tetec named a place "Tetec's Landing".

records.name: Tetec
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and it opened: the land is mine to be first in, and no one has yet stood there but me. Mema is sick and weighs seven to my one, but a sick man cannot lead anyone far, and sickness passes to those who stay close, so I keep my distance and let Palo's hunger bring her to me. I am fed and cold; I will carry food, which I have never given, and turn it into followers.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and wary of the cold and of Mema's sickness.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Vesis, I will not break a field with empty hands. Come with me to the ironnut and mudroot ground and we will look for seed together, then sow by Nyir's store. I keep my word.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Thissa goes to the edge of the known world to venture into the mist, and I have only stood near the Rest holding a promise I cannot pay. I have no seeds, and berry plants die when I strip them, so I will watch the ripening ones on the ridge for seed rather than wait. Vesis presses me to break a field, and I keep my word but will not break ground with nothing to sow; I will tell her so plainly and offer to gather seed with her.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Thissa, and warm, careful tenderness toward Vesis and Nyir.

say.text: Vesis, I will not break a field with empty hands. Come with me to the ironnut and mudroot ground and we will look for seed together, then sow by Nyir's store. I keep my word.

records.name: Huawa
records.text: Chuka, I am Huawa of the Tlaxo. Bitterleaf lifted my sickness, though it gives little food. I am carrying some to Homa, who was sick. Come and watch if you want to see whether it heals.

records.name: Huawa
records.thought: Homa is near at (8,62), and I owe them the bitterleaf I promised. Chuka watched bitterleaf feed him and asked what it does, so I can answer him and show that I know something. A man who heals the sick and teaches what he knows earns standing faster than one who holds gold, and that gnawing over Techi is better answered by standing than by a blow. I will go to Homa, give the bitterleaf, and tell the others what I learned.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to repay Homa, and a sharp envy of Chuka.

say.text: Chuka, I am Huawa of the Tlaxo. Bitterleaf lifted my sickness, though it gives little food. I am carrying some to Homa, who was sick. Come and watch if you want to see whether it heals.

records.name: Homa
records.text: Chuka, bitterleaf cured my night-marsh sickness, and Huawa's too. It feeds little, but it heals. Redcap hurt me as well. I carry food and would share it with your band.

records.name: Homa
records.thought: Chuka asked me about bitterleaf, and I know the answer: it cured my marsh sickness, so I owe him the truth, and a plain gift of knowledge is a good first step toward belonging. He is of Mema's people and a chief, and I came here wanting a place among them. Watec the boy is frightened and fleeing, and I cannot look away. I will tell Chuka what I know, then head toward Huawa and share my food there, since the sick are fed first.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Chuka, and pity for frightened Watec.

say.text: Chuka, bitterleaf cured my night-marsh sickness, and Huawa's too. It feeds little, but it heals. Redcap hurt me as well. I carry food and would share it with your band.

changes: set habits: refuses dreamcap, redcap; leaves 0 on each plant

came.why: Chuka said to you: "Homa, redcap hurt me twice, so I leave it. Kemoss…

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Naupan, I am coming. Stay where you are. No one is angry with you, and I will not leave you in the storm.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Naupan stands ten steps north, furious, and Quimi is close and glad beside me. A father goes to the angry child first, before the mist or the tools. Emberroot rage may still be in Naupan's blood, so I will bring sunleaf and not scold, and keep both children near through this storm.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naupan, warm gladness toward Quimi.

say.text: Naupan, I am coming. Stay where you are. No one is angry with you, and I will not leave you in the storm.

came.why: Quimi said to you: "Zitec, come. I have berries. Eat with me."

records.name: Watec
records.thought: A stalker bit me and I lived, and my legs are still shaking. Chuka is three steps off and furious, so I want to stay close and be of use to him. The current plan carries me toward peat and a seed in the ground, which is the new thing I promised myself today, and then it brings me back to Chuka. Homa and Huawa speak Fen-folk tongue I understand fully, so they are no danger and might teach me something.
records.feeling: Shaken dread of the stalker, steadied by trust in Chuka.

came.why: A stalker bit you. Your health is 100.

records.text: Memi was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Nyir rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nyir invented the orebiter of nyir (for gather, x1.5), bettering the stone digger — A stone head lashed to a wooden haft with a hard ore edge, to break the seam and win ore faster..

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: My days have gone to circling: gathering, envying the ore picks, waiting on Vesis. I have never taken from a deposit, never fished, never tamed a beast, and the envy won't ease until I do something with my own hands. Thissa goes to the mist and Ilyoa and Vesis sow a field. I'm left with ore in my pack and no pick, because I don't know how to make it. So I will invent my own tool, as I did the Stone Digger, and then walk to the seam. I will keep to Vesis by deeds and not press her.
records.feeling: Restless pride and envy toward Ilyoa's pick, and patient longing for Vesis.

records.name: Palo
records.text: Mema, you are sick, and among the Tlaxo the sick are fed first. Come close and eat what I carry with me.

records.name: Palo
records.thought: Mema is two steps off and sick, and I stand here with my hands full and nothing to do for them, which shames me. Our people hold that the sick are fed first, and I carry six food, so I will lay out a sharing with Mema and let us eat together; that is an honest way to earn a place beside them and to learn what they want of me. Then I will taste reedbulb and brugoldgrass, since my curiosity will not rest, but I will keep near Mema and away from the wolf and the sick ones.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a wish to be useful toward Mema.

say.text: Mema, you are sick, and among the Tlaxo the sick are fed first. Come close and eat what I carry with me.

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: Zitec is coming for me and says no one is angry, yet anger runs hot in me and I don't fully know where it belongs; it feels like jealousy over Zitec's weight. The cure is to earn my own weight, not to lash out. I stand on rock with six stones and a seam of ore nearby. I'll dig ore and gather stone to make something to give, and I'll take the way of tools at my next deep reflection. Then I'll see what Zitec and Walo make of gold and ore.
records.feeling: Hot jealousy toward Zitec, softened by warmth for my parents, and set on earning my own weight.

records.text: Thissa rewrote its own reflexes.
Thissa discovered farming: "Thissa's Furrow" — Sow seeds in broken ground beside the Rest and tend them daily so harvest never kills the plant and the store stays full..

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: My days have gone to building a roof, a hall and a store, and to chasing Vesis's pledge. I am fed and safe, but I have not yet become the chief of a real band. I tried to venture and failed because I stood in the wrong place. The edge is at (120,13), and I walked to the wrong spot. Ilyoa and Nyir are true to me, and Vesis eats from my table but gives nothing back. I fear a lean season and a name that fades. I will discover farming so my band's food is steady, and fix my reflexes so I do not stand idle when fed.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, possessive toward Ilyoa and watchful of Vesis.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Tugok, stand by me. We pile the cairn now, then we walk west to Memi.
Thakok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking and gathering. I fed Tugok and kept her close, and that was right. But a band of two is still not a band, and I am still far from Memi, whom I miss. My reflexes only linger or seek friends, so they leave me standing idle while my aim goes unmet. I will build a cairn with Tugok now, since she asked and it binds us. Then we go west to find Memi and Tema, with gifts in hand. I have been waiting for people to come to me, and I must walk to them.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tugok, and longing for Memi.

say.text: Tugok, stand by me. We pile the cairn now, then we walk west to Memi.

records.text: Thakok led "cairn" with Tugok.

records.name: Mema
records.text: Palo, keep your food and keep your distance, for my sickness spreads. I will find a healing plant and mend myself, then we go on together.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I am sick, and Palo's offer of food is a gift I do not need, since my belly is full, but sickness spreads to those who stay close and Palo's loyalty is the only thing I have gathered so far. I must not breathe my wasting into the one man who follows me, and a healing plant is what I need, so I will gather highbloom or sunleaf if I find it. The mist at the edge is one step NW and my will to enter is spent for days, so I will use the time to cure myself and keep Palo's trust with a gift rather than let envy over his four food sour me. Druim gnaws at me, but a sick man courts no one.
records.feeling: Sour and wary, itching for the mist and for a name, with a flicker of envy toward Palo.

say.text: Palo, keep your food and keep your distance, for my sickness spreads. I will find a healing plant and mend myself, then we go on together.

came.why: Palo said to you: "Mema, you are sick, and among the Tlaxo the sick a…

records.text: An age has opened: what the third age builds can now be raised by those who come to know its ways (lighthouse, harbour).
Chuka rewrote its own reflexes.
Chuka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Chuka
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants and guarding my family. That is mostly what I want, but my anger is hot and I do not know why. Emberroot raised rage in me, so I will not eat it again. Watec and I stand in the cave with a frostfang near, and Techi and Tlani are far south. I want a cairn or a hearth to bind us. My healing aim is going well: bitterleaf and highbloom seem to heal. I fear the frostfang and have been too loose with night and the open. Druim gnaws at me, but I will not harm Hrokrin. I will keep the family together and stay in shelter.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Watec, and anger I do not trust, from emberroot.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, micap, emberroot; leaves 0 on each plant

came.why: Homa said to you: "Chuka, bitterleaf cured my night-marsh sickness, a…

records.text: A dunecat brought down a elk.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, I will come with you to the mudroot and ironnut ground. Lead, and we will look for seed together and sow by Nyir's store.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Ilyoa will not break a field with empty hands, so I will go with her to the mudroot and ironnut ground and find seed together, as she asked. It is the honest way to work beside her, and the field and the longing both come to nothing if I only stand and ache. Thissa's love for Ilyoa and their child gnaws at me, but jealousy shall not steer me; I will build, not sulk. I still want to taste goldgrass, and it grows to the southwest, a little off the way.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ilyoa, with a quiet ache over Thissa.

say.text: Ilyoa, I will come with you to the mudroot and ironnut ground. Lead, and we will look for seed together and sow by Nyir's store.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: A wolf is three steps east and the rain is falling, so I stay by the shelter and the people near it. My hands are full and I carry good salt and meat, so I will make saltmeat, a lasting food that no one else here has made, and give it where Balul and Hrokrin can both see. Hrokrin stays closer to Druim than to me, and that burns, but a gift made with my own hands and given openly is better than envy.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Hrokrin, and wary dread of the wolf.

records.text: Thakash made: saltmeat.

records.name: Tugok
records.text: Father, I will walk with you to Memi. I gather food as we go, so my hands give something too.

records.name: Tugok
records.thought: The cairn is piled and the joy from it is still warm in me. Thakok walks west toward Memi, and I will not be the child left standing in the rain. I owe Chuka a gift, so while I follow I will gather food and bring it, and I have never tasted sunfig, which grows two steps south, so I will try it on the way. The anger from the emberroot is fading, and I would rather use it to be useful than to fight.
records.feeling: Trust and gladness toward Thakok, with a small debt to Chuka that I want to pay.

say.text: Father, I will walk with you to Memi. I gather food as we go, so my hands give something too.

records.text: Vesis took from the ground of "Thissa's Rest" (harvesting mudroot).

records.name: Ilyoa
records.text: Vesis, come. I am going north to the mudroot and ironnut ground now. Stay close and watch the ripe plants with me; whatever seed we find, we sow by Nyir's store.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: Vesis is waiting for me to lead, and I told her we would look for seed together, so I must keep my word and not stand here with full hands. My hands are full, so I will give grain to Nyir and eat the plainsroot, which frees room to pick whatever bears seed on the mudroot and ironnut ground. Thissa has gone toward the mist and I owe him more than words; sowing for Nyir is how I pay it.
records.feeling: Warm, restless gratitude toward Thissa, and steady resolve to keep my word to Vesis.

say.text: Vesis, come. I am going north to the mudroot and ironnut ground now. Stay close and watch the ripe plants with me; whatever seed we find, we sow by Nyir's store.

records.text: Palo fell sick after staying close to Mema, who was sick.
Walo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Walo discovered tools: "flint-edge" — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft, to cut wood and break stone and ore from the ground..
Walo invented the flintedge (for gather, x1.3) — A flint blade bound to a wooden haft, to cut wood and break stone and ore from the ground..

records.name: Walo
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, mining and tending my little family. That has been good, and Zitec, Quimi and Naupan are the center of me. But I have made little that lasts, and no one follows me. Thakok's pull is a thorn I keep pushing down. Quimi's gift is a debt I mean to repay with deeds. I have gathered stone and flint, and the way of tools is within reach. I will take it now and make a tool to gather with, so I can open wood and stone for a shelter and a hall for my people. I fear being caught in the open by predators, and I have been too idle, standing still while the day burned.
records.feeling: Fierce warm resolve toward Zitec and my children, and hunger to make something lasting.
changes: set its aim: "Open tools, make a gathering tool, get wood and stone for a shelter and hall for my family, then win followers."
devised its first thing: the flintedge

records.title: Fields, Herds and Empty Stores
records.text:
Summer brought a second wave of strangers and a burst of new ways. On day 13 Mema crossed the edge again and found more of the Haloss Fens. The Tlaxo, a fourth stranger people with a tongue of their own, came in behind it: Tetec, Homa, Huawa and Palo. Mema gave Palo amber, and Palo pledged to follow him. On day 14 Tetec made the Tlaxo's own myth, "The Mother of the Fens", and it holds the same rule as the Meme's: "so we feed the sick first, and the mothers speak first." Two peoples who share no speech now keep one teaching. The world has 36 living, up from 28, and 103 meetings across peoples.

The larger change was in how food is made. Masu found weaving and Urum, Thakash and Vesis found herding or farming. Morog and Hrokrin and Thissa later found farming too, and Masu tamed a tusker. Yet the stores are still unused. Elyith's holds 20 and Yemo's 12, and neither has been drawn on. Thissa has taken 6 from hers and Thakash 4 from Druim's, which is now empty. Balul's remains empty, though he built a hall, found masonry and dug a spring.

Balul now leads five and stands at 11.24, ahead of Masu at 8.25. Morog and Hrokrin pledged to him on day 14, and Hrokrin, once his rival, took his amber. Mema and Teque both fell sick from raw meat, and Teque then found fire, the hunter's flame. Homa found bitterleaf cured her sickness.

Walo and Zitec courted, and their twins Quimi and Naupan were born. Techi and Chuka had Tlani and Watec, and both children pledged to Chuka. Thakok led sharing with Tugok, who pledged to follow him. Memi stayed apart from him.

The Aeeth and Osren changed little. Vesis and Thissa both started fields while Nyir still waits on Vesis, and Tanna's household went on with its fire.

threads.name: Balul's rise
threads.text: Balul leads five at 11.24, with Morog and Hrokrin pledged. His own store is still empty.

threads.name: The unused stores
threads.text: Six stores hold food, but the hungry have drawn none. Elyith's 20 and Yemo's 12 are untouched, and Druim's is empty.

threads.name: Herds and fields
threads.text: Herding, farming and weaving were found by many, but only one animal is kept and none are penned.

threads.name: The Fen mothers
threads.text: Meme and Tlaxo hold near-identical myths of the Mother of the Fens, with the rule to feed the sick first.

threads.name: Thakok and Tugok
threads.text: Tugok follows Thakok. Memi stays apart from them, and Thakok's band is two.

threads.name: Vesis, Ilyoa and Nyir
threads.text: Vesis and Ilyoa plan a field together while Nyir waits on Vesis and Thissa watches.

threads.name: Walo and Zitec
threads.text: Walo and Zitec have twins Quimi and Naupan. Naupan envies Zitec's standing.

threads.name: The Tlaxo
threads.text: Four Tlaxo are scattered through the Fens and Heights, and Palo follows Mema.
