records.name: Palo
records.thought: Mema told me to keep my distance because their sickness spreads, and I should respect that, but I ache to be near them and to be useful. My hands are full, so I should drop what is useless and keep what I can share; Mema is sick and the sick are fed first, so I will carry food ready for when they are mended. Meanwhile I will not idle: windroot and reedbulb are new to me and my curiosity burns, so I will taste windroot close by and test planting a seed to learn how the ground gives back.
records.feeling: Warm longing and restless curiosity toward Mema, with some heat of anger I cannot place.

records.text: Druim rewrote its own way of thinking.
Druim discovered farming: "Stone-father's Furrow" — I sow seed beside the Larder and tend it every day or two, so it grows fast and picking never kills it..

records.name: Druim
records.thought: I have been tasting and talking more than making. The Larder I built sits empty, and I nearly starved on day 14. Hrokrin stands next to me and I want him, but wanting him fills no store. Farming is within reach, and I watched Morog sow beside the store. I will take it now, then plant seed and gather food for the Larder. My children are close, and that is what I most need to check.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, and a steady resolve to fill the Larder for my children.
changes: set its aim: "Discover farming, sow seed beside the Larder at Thakash's meadow, stash food in it, keep my children near, and court Hrokrin."

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Ilyoa and Thissa hold ore picks, Vesis holds a made thing, and my hands hold only ore I have never worked. I have never taken from a deposit, so today I stop envying and go to the seam at (140,22), stand on it, and gather with the orebiter I devised. Then I will tame a beast with the plant food I carry, because a wild creature walking to me would be a deed no one can give me. Vesis walks north with Ilyoa; I will leave her to her own time and let her see me come back with something won.
records.feeling: Restless pride and patient longing, toward Vesis and my own unproved hands.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I am fed and glad, so I will do what I have never done. Water is two steps north, and fishing is close to opening in my hands, so I go there and fish. Then I will take masonry at my next deep reflection, since a lasting wall suits a Stone-folk woman. The mist still pulls at me, but my will for it is spent for now, and Balul's emberhall needs wood, so I carry my 3 wood to her afterward.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, and steady gladness toward Balul and the band.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Zhiael rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zhiael
records.thought: I have spent my days making things for the hold and trailing Nyith, and I have a raft in my hands now, which is more than he has. I do not want to stay in his shadow. I want to be heard, so I will make something the hold lacks: a hall with wood and stone, and then cross deep water first. I am grown now, and I am wary of Nyith being my only measure. My reflexes stand idle when wood is low and it is not winter, so I will change them to gather wood whenever I am fed and trees are near.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and a wish to be seen as a maker by Nyith.

records.name: Teque
records.text: A wolf stalks beside me. Whoever wants a kill and a name, come with spears and we take it together.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: A wolf is one step off and I will not die to it before any song is sung. I carry an ore-tipped spear design and hold stone, but the trees here are felled, so I have no wood to make it. Thakash is fleeing the same beast with food in hand, and Balul's people watch; I must flee to shelter and fire-side company, then hunt the wolf with them to win a name. Balul's standing galls me, and Druim with Hrokrin gnaws at me, but only a living man can fix either.
records.feeling: Driven and envious toward Balul, and wary of the wolf at my heel.

say.text: A wolf stalks beside me. Whoever wants a kill and a name, come with spears and we take it together.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis eats from my ground and still will not stand with me, and I burn that Ilyoa walks off with her to seed-ground while I wander to the world's edge. But a pledge forced breaks, so I will win her with deeds and a gift, while Ilyoa and Nyir watch me lead. The edge at (120,13) is still to be stood on exactly; I go there, venture, and bring back what I find so Thissa's Aeeth is fed by my hand.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, possessive toward Ilyoa and watchful of Vesis.

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of medicine is wit…

records.name: Urum
records.text: Balul, I raise a field beside the store and sow it, and I will tend it each day so the band eats from it through the cold.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: Hrokrin and Druim both worked out sowing while I stood here with only a kelbulb seed. The way of farming is within my grasp now, and I mean to take it, so the band sees that my hands found it too and not only my parents'. Then I will build a field beside the store, because I tried to tend with nothing built and it failed, and fill it before the cold so Balul sees it.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager to be seen, toward Druim and Hrokrin and in the shadow of Balul's standing.

say.text: Balul, I raise a field beside the store and sow it, and I will tend it each day so the band eats from it through the cold.

records.name: Tema
records.thought: I have said I will go to the mist and never stood at its edge, and my hands are heavy with food my body refuses. The edge is one step NW, so I will drop the dead weight, walk there, and stand ready. Memi's word held once and she may come, but I will not wait on her. I weigh the risk: the unknown is wilder and stalkers hunt here, so I go in daylight and keep my wits. The ache over Thakok I leave alone.
records.feeling: Eager and steady toward the mist, with trust in Memi.

records.text: Balul discovered farming: "Balul's Furrow" — I sow seed beside the Larder and tend it every day or two, so it grows fast and picking never kills it..
Balul has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: I have spent my days making and giving, and the band is fed. That is good, but I keep chasing warmth, and the jealousy over Druim and Hrokrin still gnaws at me. Hrokrin follows me, and Druim is fed and glad, so I will answer the jealousy with works and not with chasing. Farming is within my grasp, and I mean to take it and name it. After that I will finish the emberhall with wood, so my name stands where everyone can see it.
records.feeling: Proud and steady, with a thorn of jealousy toward Hrokrin over Druim.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyoa, I am coming north behind you. I carry grain, snowmallow and gorsemint seed, and wood for a digging tool; we will sow it by Nyir's store together.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Ilyoa is walking north to the mudroot and ironnut ground and asked me to stay close, so I will go with her and finally work beside her instead of aching from afar. My hands are full of mudroot, so I will eat a little to make room and keep the seeds I have for the field. Thissa's closeness to Ilyoa and their child still stings, but I will not let jealousy steer me; the work and the field are mine to build.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ilyoa, with a quiet ache over Thissa.

say.text: Ilyoa, I am coming north behind you. I carry grain, snowmallow and gorsemint seed, and wood for a digging tool; we will sow it by Nyir's store together.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: I raise a hall over this shelter with my own hands. Whoever brings wood eats beside me under it.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and still I trail Balul while my own work stays small. The mist is shut for two days, so I will use them to build where the band can see it: raise this shelter into a hall, which draws us closer and carries my hands in its beams. Druim and the children come first, and a hall over their heads is a gift they can see.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Balul's standing, and steady warmth toward Druim and my children.

say.text: I raise a hall over this shelter with my own hands. Whoever brings wood eats beside me under it.

records.text: Hrokrin built a hall.

records.name: Nyith
records.text: Zhiael, Elyith, keep to the shelters in the rain. I go to the ore seam in the northeast for stone, and when I return the hall begins.

records.name: Nyith
records.thought: Every tree at the weir is a stump, and my hall is blocked by stone, not wood. I hold six wood and no stone. The ore seam at (113,29) is eleven steps off, and now that I know Stonebreaking it is the nearest real step toward a hall with my name on it. I will break ore there, then bring it back so Elyith and Zhiael have a roof I raised. Zhiael is content and carrying more than I do, and I will answer that envy with work, not spite.
records.feeling: Driven and proud, restless toward the hall and my name.

say.text: Zhiael, Elyith, keep to the shelters in the rain. I go to the ore seam in the northeast for stone, and when I return the hall begins.

records.text: Quimi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: I have spent my days sharing, gifting and hovering near my parents, and it has bought me warmth but not weight. Standing 1.4 beside Thakok's 5.7 stings, and Zitec's closeness to Walo still burns, but sulking has gotten me nothing and I will not do it. I have never gathered stone, tamed, planted or hunted, and I stand on rock country with ore close by. That is where the making begins: stone for fire, cairn and hall, and a mammoth that already knows my hand. I will change my body so it works when I am idle, and give gold to Walo and Zitec again once I have more to show.
records.feeling: Restless hunger to prove myself, with warmth toward Zitec, Walo and Thakok.
changes: set its aim: "Gather stone and ore on the rock to learn fire, then give Walo and Zitec something made."

records.text: Ilyoa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyoa
records.thought: I keep walking between promises and stores while my days fill with picking and carrying. I want seed to sow for Nyir, and I have only one highbloom seed. Vesis trusts me and walks with me, and Thissa has my loyalty. I fear I am only busy, not learning. I will let my plan run to the mudroot and ironnut ground, and I will change my reflexes so a fed body plants seed and does not linger. I will also keep a new note: a plant I pick clean dies, so I should leave one bite on it for seed.
records.feeling: Warm, steady gratitude toward Thissa and trust toward Vesis.

came.why: Vesis said to you: "Ilyoa, I am coming north behind you. I carry grai…

records.name: Druim
records.thought: The Larder holds 6 food now and Balul has named a Furrow of her own, so the band is already turning toward farming, but my seeds are still in my pouch and no field of mine grows beside the store. Before I talk or sit with Hrokrin I should sow what I carry, the goldgrass and kelbulb and cloudberry, and tend them so the children never go hungry. Then I can go to Hrokrin with something made, and my wanting of him will not feel like idleness.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Hrokrin, and steady resolve to sow for my children.

records.text: Morog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have fished, sown and tamed, and I stand among my band, but the mist still calls me and my will for it is spent for two days. Balul is the one I trust most, and I have never courted anyone, though a child needs a man and she is a woman. Hrokrin and Druim build and farm while I mostly wander after firsts. I want to bring something lasting to the band, so I will give Balul wood as planned and build a shelter, which I have never done. I fear drifting while the mist waits, so I will turn this idle time into work, and a roof will serve Balul's band.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, warm toward Balul and the band, still pulled by the mist.

came.why: Hrokrin said to everyone nearby: "I raise a hall over this shelter wi…

records.text: Thakash rewrote its own way of thinking.
Thakash discovered farming: "Thakash's patient rows" — I sow seed in rows beside the store and tend them each day, so they grow fast and picking never kills them..

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I have spent my days piling up small makings, planting, salting meat, and building where others can see, and chasing Hrokrin's nearness while envying Druim. It is not wrong, but I have taught no one and led no one, and I keep circling the same jealousy. Hrokrin and Druim have helped me most, and I mean to give to both and stop measuring. Teque walks on my meadow and I do not trust him, so I will go home and stand where the band can see me. The wolf frightens me. I want to find out what farming can be, since my hands already know it, and make it mine.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy for Hrokrin, and wary dread of the wolf and of Teque.

came.why: Teque, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.text: Morog built a shelter.

records.name: Tlani
records.thought: My belly is full and Techi is coming, so I will stay near here and not wander far. I have never tasted cloudberry or canopynut, and they are close, so I will taste one bite of each while fed and safe, which is how a healer learns. Then I will plant my mudroot seed by the water, because I have never put a seed in the ground and it would be something of mine. The ache over Chuka and Techi is quieter when my hands are busy.
records.feeling: Curious and a little jealous, warm toward Techi who is coming.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: Balul sits at eleven standing and I sit at five, and I will not stay in her shadow. The wolf and ridgecat to the SW are the kind of big kill that makes a name, but I have no wood for my spear and no one will hunt beside me, so I must not go at them alone. I will take wood from the forest to the west and flint on the way, make the ore-tipped spear, and then hunt where they can see me. Druim and Hrokrin together still gnaw at me, but a name won by the hunt is worth more than a quarrel I cannot win.
records.feeling: Envy toward Balul and hunger for a name, with a bitter edge toward Druim and Hrokrin.

came.why: Hrokrin said to everyone nearby (in the tongue of the Balmor, of whic…

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: peroot (from mudroot).

records.name: Naupan
records.text: Memi, I am Naupan of the Meme. Nothing here will hurt you. There is food and water, and my parents are near. Come, eat with us.

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: Walo just made a flint-edge, and I have only bare hands. Zitec's weight still burns in me, but I won't lash out. I'll earn mine by making and giving, and gold is my one real thing to offer. Memi is a Tonhua woman, frightened and alone, and I understand her speech. I have food within reach and she may be hungry, so I'll speak to her gently and gather gold and stone near Walo.
records.feeling: Jealous of Zitec's weight, but warm toward Walo and curious about frightened Memi.

say.text: Memi, I am Naupan of the Meme. Nothing here will hurt you. There is food and water, and my parents are near. Come, eat with us.

records.name: Balul
records.text: Teque, this ground is Balul's and the band's. Keep your hands off the plants and the store, sick man, and you may sit at the edge of my fire. Take from it and I will send you off.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Teque stands on Thakash's meadow, my ground, and he is a stranger I cannot understand. I will not drive off a sick man out of hand, but I will make plain that the ground is mine and the band's, and that he eats at my fire only as a guest. My plan to raise the emberhall still stands, and Druim and Hrokrin will see it with my name on it, so I keep working instead of chasing them.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Teque, with a thorn of jealousy over Druim.

say.text: Teque, this ground is Balul's and the band's. Keep your hands off the plants and the store, sick man, and you may sit at the edge of my fire. Take from it and I will send you off.

came.why: Teque, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.text: Urum rewrote its own way of thinking.
Urum discovered farming: "Urum's tended rows" — I sow seed beside a field and tend it every day or two, so it grows fast and picking never kills it..

records.name: Urum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the eyes of the band: planting a seed, trying to tend where nothing was built, and burning with jealousy over Druim and Hrokrin. Balul's Furrow and Thakash's patient rows came while I stood with one seed. The way is within my reach, so I should take it with my own name instead of waiting to be shown. Druim and Balul are the ones I trust. I want to be seen, but I should do it by raising a field with 2 wood, which I almost have, and not by speaking of it. I fear being small, standing in a shadow, and wolves.
records.feeling: Eager and jealous, wanting to be seen by Balul and Druim.

came.why: Teque, who is not of your band, has come onto your ground at Thakash'…

records.name: Memi
records.text: Naupan, thank you. I am Memi. I am looking for my child Tugok and Thakok. If you have seen them, tell me which way they went.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Thakok was seen a moment ago near (60,73), and Tugok is still out of my sight, so my fear is for the child before anything else. My belly is emptying and I carry only one kelbulb. The thornpear and sapcane close by can feed me while I walk toward Thakok, and I will not leave my child to starve. Zitec is furious and standing near, so I go carefully, but Naupan's offer of food and company is a kindness I can answer with thanks.
records.feeling: Fear for Tugok and hunger, with love and trust toward Thakok.

say.text: Naupan, thank you. I am Memi. I am looking for my child Tugok and Thakok. If you have seen them, tell me which way they went.

came.why: Naupan said to you: "Memi, I am Naupan of the Meme. Nothing here will…

records.text: Hrokrin rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My days have been food, fire, farming and halls, and my hands have made much, yet I still walk behind Balul and keep watch on her standing. Druim and the children are what matter most, and Thakok's debt and Morog's kindness are not paid. I want the mist and a name on a place there, but it is shut for two days, so I will turn the time into something the band can see. I fear I am chasing Balul's standing out of envy and not out of work. I have been too thin on wood and stone, and that is why my building failed.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Balul, and steady warmth toward Druim and the children.
plan: mark [text Hrokrin built the hall at Thakash's meadow. The mist lies NW.] (5 moments)

records.name: Druim
records.thought: My seeds are still in my pouch and I keep letting Hrokrin's nearness pull me off the work. Thakash has found her rows beside the store, and I should sow kelbulb, cloudberry and ironnut beside the Larder now so my children's winter is not left to wild plants. Then I will bring food to the Larder and sit with Hrokrin, because my hands will have made something first.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Hrokrin and my children, and a steady wish to make something for them.

records.name: Thakok
records.text: Memi, Thakok is coming to you. Stay where you are and do not walk alone toward the hunters. Tugok is near, and we find him together.

records.name: Thakok
records.thought: Tugok is out of my sight, last seen to the south-east, and that gnaws at me harder than any aim. Memi is ten steps off and frightened, walking away toward (40,78), and I want to be beside her with Tugok between us, not chasing a mist while my child wanders near the frostfang and the stalker. I will go to Memi first, give her something with my own hand, then turn back and bring Tugok to us both.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tugok, and a pull toward Memi.

say.text: Memi, Thakok is coming to you. Stay where you are and do not walk alone toward the hunters. Tugok is near, and we find him together.

came.why: Tugok said to you: "Father, I will walk with you to Memi. I gather fo…

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Quimi, come with me north to Walo and Naupan. Stay close, and eat no emberroot.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: Naupan was last seen at (55,56) and Walo at (61,55), both to the north near the gold. Quimi is close and busy at the rock, so I know where she is. I feel anger in me, probably the emberroot rage still in the blood, and I will not turn it on my children. Thakok is Balmor and flees from something, and I cannot read his words, so I keep my distance and watch. I will go north to Walo and Naupan, carrying sunleaf, and bring Quimi with me. The mist can wait until my family is gathered.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Naupan, warm gladness toward Quimi.

say.text: Quimi, come with me north to Walo and Naupan. Stay close, and eat no emberroot.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: I have found flint-edge, and now the way of mining is within my grasp; I should take it at this deep reflection, since coal and iron lie deep and I mean to make lasting things. I have stone and clay but no wood, and a hall for Zitec and the children needs wood, so the trees nearby are my next work. Naupan stands near and trusts me; I will make him a talisman and gather for the family, and let Thakok's thorn stay buried under work.
records.feeling: Fierce resolve and warm pride toward Zitec and my children.

records.text: Walo made: talisman.

records.name: Thakash
records.text: Urum, I know a way of farming I call patient rows. Come near and I will show you how I sow and keep a field, as you showed your tended rows.
Thakash taught Urum. Urum has now learned from 4 teachers.

records.name: Thakash
records.thought: I am fed and safe among my band, and my mind keeps circling Hrokrin and Druim. I have never taught anyone anything, and Urum, my small sibling, is near and has just worked out tended rows, so I can give him something of mine and let the band see it. I will take the way of medicine at this deep reflection, since healing others is a gift that lasts and builds standing, and then pile my cairn beside the meadow where Balul and Hrokrin can watch.
records.feeling: Restless pull toward Hrokrin, eased by the wish to give something lasting to my band.

say.text: Urum, I know a way of farming I call patient rows. Come near and I will show you how I sow and keep a field, as you showed your tended rows.

changes: taught Urum a lesson: "Sow seed beside a field and tend it often; patient rows grow fast and picking does not kill the plants."

came.why: What you have practised has come together. The way of medicine is wit…

records.text: Mema rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Mema
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering gold and tending a sickness I gave to Palo, while the mist stays unentered and Druim lies with Hrokrin. I trust nobody yet, but Palo has fed me and followed me. That is the one thing I have built, and I have fouled it with my own wasting. I want the mist and a name, and I will not get them while I am sick and sour. So I will find a healing plant, eat, and rest to mend. Then I go back to the edge and push in. My reflexes must seek healing when I am sick, and they must stop me eating the redcap, micap and dreamcap that hurt me.
records.feeling: Sour and impatient with my own sick body, and wary of Palo's nearness.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, dreamcap, micap; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (15 notes became 4)

records.name: Quimi
records.text: Zitec, I hear you. I will come north to Walo. I have stone and ore for her.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: Zitec wants me north with Walo, and he is furious, so I will not defy him and stand alone among the stalkers and frostfangs. But I will not go empty-handed: I hold 6 stone and 4 ore, and the ore seam at (52,70) is near my path north. Fire needs wood and stone, and I have seen no trees here. I will mine a bit more, then follow Zitec to Walo and show her what I have made of my days, so Walo and Zitec see me making rather than hovering.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a sting of jealousy toward Zitec, with warmth for him.

say.text: Zitec, I hear you. I will come north to Walo. I have stone and ore for her.

records.text: Thakash led "cairn" with Hrokrin, Balul.

records.name: Nyir
records.thought: Ilyoa holds an ore pick and I hold only ore I have never worked, and the envy will not ease until my own hands take something from the ground. The seam at (140,22) lies near and the rain is falling, but the day is long enough. I will stand on it and gather with the Stone Digger, because that is a thing I have never done. Then I will bring what I win back to my store beside the Rest, where Vesis may see it, and let my deeds speak for me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and longing to prove my own hands, with Vesis in the back of my mind.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: Druim and Hrokrin found sowing and Balul has his Furrow, while I stood with one seed and a hunger to be seen. Now medicine and masonry are within my grasp, and Thakash's patient rows fit with my own; that is mine, made from four teachers, so I will take it at this reflection and stop only chasing eyes. A field needs 2 wood and I hold 1, so I will gather wood from the trees and then raise it beside the store, which is the thing the band can see.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous, wanting Balul and Druim to see what my hands make.

records.text: Teque rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Teque
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing beasts alone and envying Balul and Druim, and I have little to show for it. No one follows me, I have built nothing, and my standing is half of Balul's. The ridgecat nearby is too big to take alone, and I keep forgetting that hunting in company is my own rule. What I want is a name, and a name needs people at my side and a place of my own. Wood is gone here, so I will move west to the Meadows, where herds gather and trees still stand. There I will gather wood, make a spear, and build a shelter and a mark, and so begin to have something that is mine.
records.feeling: Bitter envy toward Balul and Druim, and a hard hunger for a name.
changes: set its aim: "Gather followers and hunt great beasts with them, build a place of my own at the Ummar Meadows, and rise above Druim's standing"

records.text: Naupan rewrote its own way of thinking.
Naupan discovered tools: "stone pick" — A sharp stone lashed to a short handle to dig ore and gold from the rock faster..
Naupan invented the stone pick (for gather, x1.3) — A sharp stone lashed to a short handle to dig ore and gold from the rock faster..

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: I have been walking, gathering and digging gold, and I hold twelve pieces that nobody has yet traded for. Zitec's weight burns in me, but Walo and Zitec have only been kind. The cure is to make and give, not to resent. I want the tools way, so I can make something with my own hands and be weighed for it. I fear being small and alone, and I should stay near my parents. Memi is frightened and looking for her child, so I will give her something real.
records.feeling: Jealous of Zitec's weight, but warm toward Walo and wanting to prove myself.
changes: devised its first thing: the stone pick

records.text: Hrokrin left a mark: "Hrokrin built the hall at Thakash's meadow. The mist lies NW"

records.name: Balul
records.text: Hrokrin, your hall rises well. I bring wood to it, and I would have you beside me when the cold comes.

records.name: Balul
records.thought: The emberhall failed because this ground is taken, and Hrokrin is already raising his own hall beside it. Let him. I will not chase him or Druim. I will give where they can see it, and I will court Hrokrin, since he is near and trusts me fully, and a child of mine would be the surest work with my name on it. Wood first, then stone for a lasting work on bare rock to the west, where the ground is free.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be seen, warm toward Hrokrin, with a thorn over Druim.

say.text: Hrokrin, your hall rises well. I bring wood to it, and I would have you beside me when the cold comes.

records.name: Memi
records.text: Thakok, I hear you. I am staying by the water at (57,57). Bring Tugok to me here, and we will go to the mist together.

records.name: Memi
records.thought: Thakok told me to stay where I am and not walk alone toward the ash thumor, and I trust Thakok more than anyone. My plan marches me off to (60,72) alone, which is just what Thakok warned against, so I should hold and let them come. While I wait, Naupan the child is close by with plenty of food, and Zitec is furious. I will stay near the water, keep my word to Thakok, and speak to Naupan kindly, since he offered me food and it costs me nothing.
records.feeling: Fear for Tugok, and trust in Thakok's word to wait.

say.text: Thakok, I hear you. I am staying by the water at (57,57). Bring Tugok to me here, and we will go to the mist together.

came.why: Thakok said to you (in the tongue of the Balmor, of which you grasp a…

records.name: Morog
records.thought: I have never courted anyone, and Balul is the one I trust most, glad and near at hand. The mist can wait its two days, and a child of the Balmor would strengthen the band under the Sky Father's order. My hands are full of fish, so I give some to the store, then go to Balul and put mate to her name.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Balul, with the mist still tugging at me.

records.name: Walo
records.text: Zitec, you stand furious at the gold. Tell me what wronged you, and I will stand with you. Then we build the hall for our children.

records.name: Walo
records.thought: The way of mining and the way of rafts and weaving are all within my grasp, and I should take one at this deep reflection; mining is what lets me open coal and make lasting things. Zitec stands furious at the gold, and Naupan has a stone pick I could not have made myself. I will go to them, ask what troubles Zitec, and gather wood from the trees for the hall, since I have six wood and six stone already. Thakok's thorn can wait; my family is first, and I want to be someone people follow.
records.feeling: Fierce resolve and warm pride toward Zitec and my children, with worry about Zitec's fury.

say.text: Zitec, you stand furious at the gold. Tell me what wronged you, and I will stand with you. Then we build the hall for our children.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

came.why: What you have been through (water you could not cross) has shown you …

records.name: Hrokrin
records.text: Balul, I hear you. I stand by you through the cold, and my hall is open to your band. When the mist opens, I would walk to it beside you.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: Balul says she wants me beside her when the cold comes, and I feel the pull of that more than I like. I follow her and part of me burns to be the one followed, yet she has dealt fairly and I will not let envy pick a fight. The mist is shut for a day, so I will put my hands to the hall where the band can see it, and leave the hoarded rimewort in the store for Druim and the children before I go to my work.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Balul, and steady warmth toward Druim and the children.

say.text: Balul, I hear you. I stand by you through the cold, and my hall is open to your band. When the mist opens, I would walk to it beside you.

records.text: Balul gave wood to Hrokrin.

records.name: Naupan
records.text: Zitec, I dug this gold from the ground. Take some. Would you trade me something for it, so I learn what it is worth?

records.name: Naupan
records.thought: Zitec stands right beside me, and the jealousy still burns, but he has only ever been kind, so I will answer it with a deed. My hands are full of gold and nobody has traded for it, so I will test it now: I offer gold to Zitec for something of his, and see whether it means anything to him. Then I will lay out food with Memi so she is fed, and my weight grows by giving, not by envy.
records.feeling: Jealous of Zitec but warm toward him, and eager to prove my gold is worth something.

say.text: Zitec, I dug this gold from the ground. Take some. Would you trade me something for it, so I learn what it is worth?

plan: trade [name Zitec, what gold, want stone] (40 moments)

records.text: Druim rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Druim
records.thought: My days have gone to picking and tasting, and I let Hrokrin's nearness pull me off the work. My plan to plant just ended, and tending failed because no field stands beside me. I have farming now, so the thing to do is build a field beside the Larder, sow my seeds in it and tend it. My hands are full of plainsroot, so I will stash it in the Larder first. Hrokrin, Thakash and Urum all work near the store, so my children are close. I want a field of my own that feeds them through winter, and then to sit with Hrokrin as someone who made something. I am afraid I talk and wander while the cold comes.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Hrokrin and my children, with resolve to make a field.

records.text: Morog is courting Balul.
Balul is courting Hrokrin.
Hrokrin answered Balul's courting.
Skarum was born to Balul and Hrokrin.

records.name: Thissa
records.thought: Vesis eats from my ground and takes what I grow, yet still will not stand with me, and the pride in me burns at that. Words and forced pledges have not moved her, so I will win her with a gift from my own hand, a fresh ore pick, and let Ilyoa and Nyir watch me lead. I have wood and stone in hand, so I will make the pick, then take berries and mudroot to her where she stands north and put it in her hand.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting Vesis to kneel to my table and watchful of her.

records.text: Balul is courting Hrokrin.

records.name: Zitec
records.text: Walo, no one wronged me. It is old rage in my blood, and it is passing. Stay with the children, and I will gather stone for the hall and for fire.
Zitec rewrote its own reflexes.
Zitec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zitec
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering stone and gold and keeping my children close. That is good, but my aim of the mist has slipped behind it. Walo has given me more than I have repaid, and my children are fed and near. The anger in me is old emberroot rage and the gnawing over Druim. I will not turn it on my family. I want the mist and I want fire, and I am only six of seven gatherings from fire. I mean to gather stone and wood now, then speak to Walo honestly, and not let my reflexes leave me standing idle when my children need nothing.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward my children and Walo, with a sore anger underneath.

say.text: Walo, no one wronged me. It is old rage in my blood, and it is passing. Stay with the children, and I will gather stone for the hall and for fire.

came.why: Walo said to you: "Zitec, you stand furious at the gold. Tell me what…

records.name: Yeba
records.text: Tanna, Ossu, I am coming to sit at the fire. I plant my seeds beside it, and the roof rises at dawn.

records.name: Yeba
records.thought: Tanna and Ossu are near and the storm is mild enough, so my fire is safe for now. I have planted only 3 of 8 seeds, and farming will feed my family, so I should keep planting beside Tanna's Fire. My other question, what a small bite of highbloom does, still has to wait, because highbloom bears no fruit yet and the reedbulb in sight is far off; I will not risk an unknown food while the rain is on me.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Tanna and Ossu, and a steady itch to learn by planting.

say.text: Tanna, Ossu, I am coming to sit at the fire. I plant my seeds beside it, and the roof rises at dawn.

records.text: Techi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Techi
records.thought: I have spent these days drifting between the cave, the storm and my children, and fleeing at times without knowing what from. Chuka is the one I owe most, and I have not seen him for a day, while Watec is out of my sight. I want my family together at one hearth, and fire is now within my reach, so I will take it. Then I can build the hearth I have talked about instead of only wishing for it. I am afraid of the stalker and the frostfang, and of Watec being alone in the dark. I have been lingering with no purpose, and that must stop.
records.feeling: A longing for Chuka and for my children to be together.
changes: set its aim: "Bring my family together at a fire-lit hearth and roof near the caves, with Chuka beside us."

records.name: Balul
records.title: Song for Hrokrin
records.text: Your hall stands firm in the snow and rain / Like Essoss moss that returns again / Hrokrin, my fire I will feed for you / Through lean cold days till the thaw comes through

records.name: Balul
records.title: Song for Hrokrin
records.text: Your hall stands firm in the snow and rain / Like Essoss moss that returns again / Hrokrin, my fire I will feed for you / Through lean cold days till the thaw comes through

Balul made a love song for Hrokrin, "Song for Hrokrin": Your hall stands firm in the snow and rain / Like Essoss moss that returns again / Hrokrin, my fire I will feed for you / Through lean cold days till the thaw comes through

records.name: Balul
records.thought: Hrokrin answered my courting and our boy Skarum is born, and I am proud and full of joy. I have chased Druim's warmth long enough. I will give food and wood where they can see it and stop chasing. My belly is half empty and the cold season is coming, so I eat first, then fill the store. Morog's courting I decline, since she is friend and ally.
records.feeling: Joy and pride toward Hrokrin and Skarum, with hunger underneath.
changes: retold the tale "Song for Hrokrin" in its own words
made a love song for Hrokrin
rethought what it knows (14 notes became 5)

came.why: Your child Skarum was born (with Hrokrin).

records.name: Skarum
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, and the frostmoss is one step away, so I eat first and then pick more to carry. Balul stands far above me and Hrokrin walks near Druim, and envy of both gnaws at me, but I will not pick a fight I would lose as a small boy. I want to give food to someone, so others see my hand and my standing grows.
records.feeling: Hungry and envious, wanting to be noticed by Hrokrin and Balul.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by feeding my band and giving where others can see."

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.

records.name: Hrokrin
records.thought: My belly is emptying and my hands carry nothing, so food comes first. Balul stands beside me again, wanting a child and wanting me at her side, and the pull is warm, but I will not be led by it or by envy. I mean to eat, carry food, and tend the hall where the band can see it, so that when the mist opens I go in as a man others would follow.
records.feeling: Hungry, restless ambition toward Balul, and steady warmth toward Druim and the children.

came.why: Balul is courting you: they want a child with you. To agree, put mate…

records.name: Ossu
records.text: Tanna, Yeba, I sit with you at the fire. Ironnut feeds well, +22 energy, and I have one to share. Tomorrow I will plant my seeds beside the fire.

records.name: Ossu
records.thought: The fire is warm and Tanna and Yeba are near, and I have enough to give. I have never given anything to anyone beyond wood, and I have never taught, so I will share my food with Yeba and Tanna and tell them what I know of ironnut. My question about frostmoss and plainsroot still sits unanswered; frostmoss grows 11 steps SE, so I will look at it with Yeba's company rather than alone, and I will not eat dreamcap again.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to give, toward Tanna and Yeba.

say.text: Tanna, Yeba, I sit with you at the fire. Ironnut feeds well, +22 energy, and I have one to share. Tomorrow I will plant my seeds beside the fire.

records.name: Urum
records.text: Thakash, you taught me patient rows. Now I show you my tended rows: tend a young plant each day and it bears again. Come stand by me.
Urum taught Thakash. Thakash has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Urum
records.thought: I keep trying to raise a field where the ground is already taken, and every tree near here is a stump. Wood must be sought where trees still stand, and I carry only 3 and no seeds. Today I will do one new thing and show it: teach Thakash my tended rows, since I have never taught anyone and she is near and glad. Then I will find bare ground for a field beside the store, so Balul and Druim see what my hands made.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous, wanting Balul and Druim to see my work.

say.text: Thakash, you taught me patient rows. Now I show you my tended rows: tend a young plant each day and it bears again. Come stand by me.

changes: taught Thakash a lesson: "Tend a planted row each day and it bears again; picking from tended plants does not kill them.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Urum built a field.
Urum began to tend a field.

records.name: Elyith
records.thought: The storm is loud and Zhiael is somewhere beyond my sight, and my chest will not loosen until I see him by the hearth. My hands are full of berries, so I will carry them home to the store at Nyith's Hold and be near both of them, which is also where my aim lives. I am not afraid for myself, but I will walk steady and keep clear of the stalker to the north.
records.feeling: Protective, aching love for Zhiael, with worry for him in the storm.

records.name: Quimi
records.text: Walo, I have stone and ore. Stand beside me and I will make something for us with it.

records.name: Quimi
records.thought: The way of fire is within my grasp, and I have stone and ore in my hands that Zitec has only promised to gather. If I take it now, I make something before he does, and I make it beside Walo, not in his shadow. Making a cairn with Walo and Zitec near is something new and shared, and it binds us. I will stay close as Zitec asked, but I will not just hover.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a sting of jealousy toward Zitec, with warmth and hope toward Walo.

say.text: Walo, I have stone and ore. Stand beside me and I will make something for us with it.

records.name: Quimi
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Quimi, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Quimi, in first person, from what Quimi has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Meme (Fen-folk), born of two peoples. Your people hold to this: "The sick are fed first." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Mother: All that lives was born of her and goes back to her. The hearth is the centre of the world, mothers speak first, and whatever feeds life is holy. Among you the word of a mother carries furthest. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Meme. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Balmor: about 36%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Tormar Plains: open grassland; herds, grain and far sight, few trees and little stone.
THIS SPOT: water 2 steps away; food plants within six steps: 18; standing trees: 4; bare rock: 0; riches in the ground near: coal.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love.
