voices.text: Nyith, you carry nothing. Come, I bring fish and grain for you and Zhiael. The first catch is shared, and I will plant beside our roofs after.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Balul, the cairn is done and you gave me flint. I will follow you. Come, let us stand at the mist together.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, come stand by me a moment. I have stones to pile a cairn, and I want us to make it together.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, the elk is wounded and near me. Come to me now and we bring it down together. The one who strikes first eats first.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Ossu, the shadowcat is close. Stay at my side and move when I move. We go to the sunleaf together, and we do not run apart.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Druim, you follow me, so stay close. I will court you, and we will raise a hall with my name on it.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: I am coming, Yemo. I have stone, and we will pile the cairn together.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Hrokrin, you carry more than I do and you follow no one, as I don't. Stand with me and eat what I lay out. Two who share are safer than two who race.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Balul, I take your courting. I am beside you and I mate with you. After that we raise your hall.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Elyith, you fed me first. Take this shell talisman, it is made for you. Let us share the fish.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Mother, I bring you berries. Eat, and I will go on to the emberroot and see what it does.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Morog, I will eat at your sharing. Come to the mist with me when it thins, and we will see who enters.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, I made an obsidian talisman from the rock Yemo and I worked. It is for you, and I am bringing it to the fire.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Hrokrin, come stand beside me. I will lay out food and you will eat, and when the mist thins we walk to the edge together.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. I plant on this clay and will share what I learn of the plants. Berry, ironnut, grain and mudroot feed; redcap and dreamcap hurt.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, come close to the hall. Masu, your talisman honours me, and I have amber for you in return. Tonight we sit together, and at dawn I will lead us to the edge of the world.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, your fish was fairly given and I will repay it. I plant berries by our roofs now, and then I go to the western trees for wood to raise a hall for us.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Druim, stand close. I raise the hall now, and it will bear my name. Your share is in it.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, you brought food and plant lore to my mother, so you are welcome at Thissa's Rest. Stay and work beside us.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, Yemo, I am here by the fire. Let us sing the night through together, and at dawn I follow.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, thank you for the kelbulb and for your word on the plants. Dreamcap and redcap hurt me too, as you said. Come to the Rest if you wish; there is berry here to share, and I will pay you back.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, I will wear your talisman gladly. Stay close to the roofs and eat with us. I am making one for your father from the shells nearby.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, you stood in Balul's hall with us. I am Druim, I found the Fens past the mist. What have you made or hunted that I could judge you by?

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, come right up beside me at the fire. Let us make the circle, and sing till dawn.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I have made fire, and I have never wasted a day chasing the mist. Watch what my hands make next, then judge me.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Mother, a bristleboar is close to the northwest. Hunt it with me, and the one who fights well eats first, as Thissa says.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, you stood in my hall. It is Balul's hall, and I give first. Take this flint, and stand with my band if you want a place in what I build.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, eat what you need from the Rest; you gave me kelbulb and plant-lore, and I count it a debt. Come close and I will teach you the Hand-craft of the Aeeth.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Elyith, come eat with me and Father. The fish are my first catch and they are for sharing. You fed me first, so I want you to eat first.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Pevi, I have dug twelve coal from the Heights. Let me bring it to your fire, and I will make a gift for you and Masu from it.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Balul, I take your flint and I will remember it. I give back in kind. Watch what I bring from the amber ground.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, I am making you a shell talisman, then a fire beside our roofs for the three of us. Will you help me gather wood?

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, I raise a weir at the water so fish come to our roofs each day. Eat well, and keep Zhiael near.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Yemo, bring the coal to the fire, I will be waiting there. Masu, come stand with us. Then we make the circle together, and your gift will be the first thing sung of at Pevi's Ground.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, come close. I will show you how I make the woodhand, so you can build with me at Pevi's fire.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Pevi, Masu, I am bringing the coal to your fire now. After the circle I will make a woodhand and build a roof with you.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, you said you made fire. I am gathering wood and stone to learn it myself. Show me one flame lit, and I will judge you by that.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I mean to court you, and then walk to the true edge at (35,52) beside you. Will you stand with me?

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, stay close. We make a cairn here beside the fire, and then I fetch wood so the roof Yemo spoke of can stand before dark.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, Zitec! Tema stands at the edge of the mist, southwest. I wait for you there.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Balul, stand by me. I bind this amber into a knot and give it to you, so you can see what Hrokrin's hands give back.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, Yemo, I will raise the shelter roof beside the fire now. Then I taste plainsroot and bring back word of what it does.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, I found bright heavy ore in the rock right here. Come see it, and help me raise the roof once Pevi brings wood.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, you taught me the Hand-craft, and I owe you for it. Take berries from me; I will bring wood and stone and make the tool beside you.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Morog, I do not trust the edge at (35,52), for you moved it once. The true edge is three steps from here at (29,24). Come stand beside me there and we go in together, and I will judge you by that walk.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim, I forgot we are both women, so no child comes of this. I still trust you. I walk to the edge at (35,52) now. Come beside me if you will.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Nyir, a stalker walks west of us. Stay near the Rest today and keep to the berries; we will hunt when Thissa is beside us.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, I will bring wood for our fire, and more for a hall. The talisman is kept close.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, you asked to see a flame lit. Come to me and watch my hands make fire, then judge me by it.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, twice I have tried to raise the fire and it will not catch. You are the one who finds things out. Show me how, and I will gather the wood and plant seeds around our roofs.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Elyith, I will bring more wood for the fire and the hall. Tell me what else you lack and I will make it.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, Yemo, Kali is dead of hunger. Stand close by the fire and hear the lament I made for him.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, the mudsnout fell to the two of us, and I will teach you how I hunt with the spear. Come stand by me, I plant grain and berry here in the meadow so our band has food that grows.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim, you are right to judge me by the walk. I come to stand beside you at (29,24), and I will not move the edge again.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, come sit with us. I will share ironnut with you and Zhiael, and then I will find the way of fire for our roofs.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, thank you for the wood. Stay near me and your father tonight. At dawn we will try the fire again together, and I will teach you what I learn.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I watched your flame and it was true. I am Druim, and I would stand by a man whose hands do what his mouth says. Stay near, and let us see what we can build.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, come to my fire at (36,29) and watch me feed it. Then you will know what my hands make.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, you gave me a knot and I give back more. Take this amber charm from my hands, and stand in Balul's band. Druim is already beside me. Come, and we will raise the hall together.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, you eat at our hall, so help me raise a longhall here. Bring stone from the rock east, and your name will be told with ours.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I did not know a woman could not bring a child with a woman. No shame in it; you are still the one I trust. Eat my berries. I fetch wood and stone and will make the Hand-craft tool here.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, I have found the way of fire. Come to the roofs at dawn and watch it catch.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I am Memi. I am coming to you with berries to share. Stay there, and we will eat together before the mist.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, thank you for the berries. Your word is good, and I trust it. Stay and make the tool at the Rest; I go to find Nyir and will return soon.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I see you! I am coming to you. Let us eat together, then walk the one step to the edge and enter the mist side by side.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, I heard you found the fire. I will be at the roofs at dawn with wood and fish for all three of us.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Elyith, cold days are coming. I will build a shelter by the hold with my wood, big enough for the three of us. Will you show me the fire at dawn?

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I am coming to your fire at (36,29). I carry wood to feed it, and I will watch your hands.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, I am glad to find you. Come with me to the longhall; we will hold it as our fire, then go together to find Ossu. I do not want to search the fog alone.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, your fire is good. Here is fish for the first catch, let us share it, and then I will fetch Zhiael to sit with us.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, I am with you. I raised this hall, so I will claim it now as our fire. Then we go together to find Ossu, staying close in the fog.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim, my will to enter the mist is spent for days, but I keep my word about (29,24). I go to Hrokrin's fire to sit with you both, then we walk when it returns.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am Ossu. I am safe near the water NE of the hall, and I will wait for you here.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, a shadowcat is near in the fog to the northwest. Come to the shelter with me and stay close until it goes.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, come with me to your father's fire. I will bring wood for your shelter, and we will eat the first catch together.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Ossu, stay where you are by the water and keep still. Yeba and I are coming to you now. Call out if you see anything move.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I am here with you. I will walk to the edge now and wait for you there. We enter together.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, your hands kept their word. I would court you now, if you will do the same toward me. Stand by me and let us see what we make.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Elyith, your wood gave me the three I lacked. I am building the shelter now, and then I will carry the rest to Father's fire.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, I am ready. Walk beside me to Ossu; if either of us sees the cat, we turn back to the hall together.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, my hands keep their word and so does my mouth. I stand by you. Come with me to the mist's edge, three steps NW, and see what I make there.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, you answered me, and our two children are here. Come sit at the fire with me and eat.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Druim, I am going to the trees to gather wood. I will bring it back to our fire where you can see it.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, eat first. I will bring you berries, then walk with you to the mist.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, your fire and your word have fed us. I will follow you, and Zhiael and I will keep your hearth with you.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, I am coming back to the shelter. Hold fast by the fire, I will guard the way.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, Zhiael, come close to the fire. This is Nyith's Hold, and you are welcome in it. Sit with me and we will keep the night together.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Father, I have wood and I am raising a shelter beside the hold. Will you teach me how you build the weir and the store, so I can make things for the hold too?

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, I hear you. I am coming to the shelter and I will stay by you. Let me teach you my amberhaft spear, so we both hold a guard when the cat comes close.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Morog, come to Balul's fire. I give first. Sit, and hear the night sung, and if you want a place, my band has room for you.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Nyith, come to the fire with Zhiael. I will feed it high with my wood so all three of us are warm against the cold to come.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, the cat is two steps north of me. Go to the shelter and stay behind the fire. I will make a spear and guard the way until Pevi comes.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Zhiael, my son, you will learn it. Come to the weir at first light and watch my hands. A weir is stakes at the water's edge, and a store is where the catch is kept for the cold. Build well and the hold will carry your na

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim, I have salt I do not need. Take some from my hand, a gift with nothing asked.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Balul, Urum, I have wood. I will feed this fire high for all of us, and my hands made it.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Thakash, come to the fire. I have berries, and I give first. Eat with me.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, we go now, slowly, side by side. If you see the cat, call out and we turn back together.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Urum, you led the feast and I ate at your hand. Now I give back: I teach you the old way of tools, what I know of flint. Stand in Balul's band and it is yours.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Urum, you gave first and I will not forget it. Watch me make a basket, and when it is done I will give you a share of what it carries.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: The night is long and the fog is deep. Sit by the fire with me and let us sing of what has been.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, you stand in Thissa's Rest. I am Thissa, chief of Thissa's Aeeth. Sit and eat my meat with me; the first catch is shared. Stay and fight beside me and you eat first and are sung first.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Thissa, I am Vesis of the Aeeth. I come to your Rest and share the first catch with you; take berries from me as I take your meat. I do not yet pledge, but I eat as a friend.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: A ridgecat is close, to the north-east. Come south toward the hall, all of you, and keep the little ones with you. I am coming to you.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I am coming south to you. Keep the little ones close; the ridgecat will not pass me.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, Vesis, come close to me. I have meat, and the first catch is shared. Eat from the hand of Thissa, and know who feeds this Rest.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Urum, I said I would give you a share when my basket was done. Here it is, take hazel. You gave first, and now I have given too.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, take my grain. You gave me berries and I want the debt square between us. Stay with us at the Rest and eat.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Father, I come. I will eat from your hand, and what I carry goes into my store for the cold.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, Mema, Zitec! Tema is at the edge of the mist. Come, and we enter together, with food shared first.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Hrokrin, the ridgecat is close to the NW. I go east away from it to gather wood and peat. Come with me, and we will do it side by side.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Ilyoa, Nyir, Vesis, hear Thissa. We raise a great hall here over the shelter, so the cold finds us under one roof. Who builds beside me eats first and is sung first.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, I am Memi. You gave me the charm. I give you a berry. Come with me to Tema, we are safer together.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I will press a trailcake at the fire to free my hands, then we go together to Urum and Thakash. Keep the ridgecat off our path.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Tema, I am Zitec. I am coming to the edge now. Wait for me, and we enter together.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, I made the Stone Digger from one wood and one stone. Come to my store at the Rest and I will show you how, so your hands gather faster before the cold.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I am here by the hall. Stay beside the walls with the little ones; I will build a shelter where you can see it, and the ridgecat will not pass me.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, I am safe and I see you both. Come to me, I plant grain and berry in the ground here, and I will show you how, so our band has food that grows. Then we all go back to the fire before dark.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Nyir, I come to your store. Show me the Stone Digger, and I will lay stone and wood beside your hall in return.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: I am Thakok. I give first. Take this from my hand.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, you eat in my Rest as a friend. Take this fish from Thissa's hand. Stay through the cold and be of my Aeeth, and you will eat first.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Druim, take this goldgrass, I give it freely. I will stay close to you and Hrokrin while the ridgecat is about.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, I found you. I am staying at your side. Let us eat together, and tell me where Yeba is.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am glad you came and brought Thakok. Stay near me. I will come to you and we will share food before we go to the edge together.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I will bind amber for you, a bright thing with my name in it. Stay close to my band.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Ossu, I am glad you are here. We eat together, then we walk to Kali's Hall to find Yeba. Stay at my side and call out if you see the shadowcat.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, a stalker walks west of the Rest. Stay near the hall tonight. When the beast is gone, teach me your Hand-craft, and I will share what I carry.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Druim, watch me. I am building a shelter with my own wood, and when it stands you may shelter in it too.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, walk with me to the frostcap by the NE ridge. I want to taste what the cold-days plants do, and our children are there.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Stalker at the Rest! Nyir, Vesis, stand with Thissa and we kill it together. Ilyoa, come to the hall! Whoever fights beside me eats first from the kill.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Father, I stand with you. Strike first and I will be at your side. Vesis, come close and watch the beast with us.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I am here. Thakok is with me. Let us eat together, then go to the edge as we said.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I see you and Thakok. I will taste the windroot and kelbulb nearby, then come to you and we will share and go to the edge together.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I will plant seeds here and dig coal and salt for a lasting fire. Stay within sight of the shelter with Thakash, and I will bring Urum back.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Pevi, I am carving a figure from stone here by the roof. When it is done it is yours, and then I want to learn the planting from you.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Thakok eats with you, Memi. Stay near me, and Tema too.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Morog, you have sat in my hall and not been turned from it. Take an amber charm from my hand, a gift with no price. A ridgecat is near, so stay under my roof, and when the cold comes there will be a store here with Balul

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Yemo, finish your carving by the roof and then come to me. I will put the seeds in the ground with you, one by one, and you will plant them with your own hands. Masu, stay close to the fire and watch the wind with us.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, Thakok and I are near. Come to me, we will eat together, then go to the edge as I promised.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Balul, you gave me amber and a roof. I will give back what I found: Stonebiting, the way of mining. Come, and I will show you.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I am raising a shelter and planting seeds here where you can see it. Come near with the little ones, there is salt for all of us.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, the stalker is close. Come with me to Thissa and Nyir, and we fight it together. Whoever stands beside us eats first from the kill.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am coming to you now. Stay where you are. We eat together, then all three go to the edge.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Pevi, a stalker is close to the southeast. I have one grain, and I will plant it by the hall where you can watch, if you guard the way.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Father, the stalker is two steps northwest. I am small, so I keep behind you and Ilyoa. Strike it and I will bring you stone and wood for the kill.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, Yemo, a stalker is two steps southeast of the shelter. Yemo, stay behind me by the roof. Pevi, come to us with your spears, and we will stand together.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I am raising a store here beside your shelter and planting my seeds. Winter is coming, so bring salt and coal and we will fill it together.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I come. I stand beside you against the stalker. When it is dead, we share the kill and you show me the Hand-craft.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Stalker west of the Rest! Ilyoa, Nyir, Vesis, with me. Strike when I strike. Whoever fights beside Thissa eats first from the kill, and I will put the meat in your hands myself.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Thissa, Vesis, the stalker is four steps west. Stand close and strike together. Nyir, stay behind us and keep to the hall.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I hear you. I am digging coal now and will bring it with the salt to fill the store before the cold comes.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, stay with me. A coilsnake lies three steps north, so we go east and round it, and we find Ossu together. First we share a meal here, then we walk.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Peace, Mema. I am Memi. My friend Tema is coming and we eat together here. You are welcome to sit near us. A frostfang hunts to the southwest, so be careful.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, I am coming with both spears. Stay by the roof and I will stand in front of you. When the stalker is gone we plant, and then we hunt together.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Druim, I am planting my cloudberry seeds near your store. Come see them when they grow, they are mine and I will share the harvest.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, the coilsnake is only four steps east of us now. I will walk at your side and we keep wide of it, then on to Ossu.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, the stalker is dead and I stood with you. Now teach me the Hand-craft, and take a berry from me. I would sit beside you and ask more than that, if you will have me.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Wolf to the north-west! Druim, Thakash, Urum, go behind me toward the shelters. I will face it.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, we go now: ironnut first, NE of here, keeping well wide of the snake. Then we find Ossu together.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, you stood with me and I keep my word. Come close and I will show you the Hand-craft. Take a berry from me in return.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I hear you. Thakash is with me by my shelter. I will find Urum and bring him behind you. Hold the wolf and come back to us whole.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, you stood with us and ate at my Rest. Stay through the cold and be one of Thissa's Aeeth. Take this from my hand, and you will not go hungry under my name.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Balul's band will not meet the cold empty. I raise an emberhall here and fill a store with food and wood. Whoever works beside me eats first from it.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Balul, I will work beside you. I carry wood and ironnuts for the store, and I will bring peat for the emberhall's fire.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, I am with you. Lead on NE, and I will keep close behind you.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Pevi, Yemo, I am going to plant my seeds beside the hall now. Pevi, come show me if my hands are wrong, and Yemo, stay near the roof where I can see you.

voices.name: Pevi
voices.text: Masu, Yemo, I am coming to you now with both spears. The shadowcat is near, so stay together by the roof and I will stand in front. When it is gone I will show you the planting, hand over hand.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Morog, you gave me Stonebiting and I keep that debt gladly. Stay by my fire this winter. I want you beside me, and I will fill the store for us both.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Hrokrin, this is my meadow, and you are welcome on it. Sit with me and eat; I lay out my food for you. Then take me with you on the hunt, I have never hunted and I will learn beside you.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Pevi, you are bleeding. Sunleaf eases wounds, so I will bring some. I am raising the Hall store on bare ground by the roof, and I will fill it for the cold.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I have meat from the hunt. I am bringing coal and salt to the store now, and I will make a hidewrap against the gale.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Nyir, I come to the Rest to sow and tend beside your store. Show me where the field may go, and I will share what it grows.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, a wolf is north of us. Come into the shelter with me and stay close. Pevi stood in front of us, and now I will.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, you hunt well on our ground and I am glad of it. I am taking the caribou beside me now, and I will bring salt to keep the meat. Then I go for Urum.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Balul, I will stay by your fire this winter. I answer your courting: let us make a child together.

voices.name: Mema
voices.text: Memi, come to my fire at Mema's Salt Rock. It is the first kept flame in this land, and the gale cannot touch it. Stand by it and I will bind you an amber knot.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Ridgecat to the south-west! Keep away from it and stay near the shelters. I am filling the store with salt and coal now.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, come to my store by the Rest. Sow your field beside it, east of the mark, and tend it every day. What it grows we share, and the first catch is shared.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Morog, no child can come of us, but you are still my chosen at this fire. Help me stock the store with wood and peat and you eat first from it.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Ilyoa, take this grain from my hand. You have stood beside me since the first day, and what Thissa has, you will not lack in the cold.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Zitec, it is Memi. There is a kept fire at Mema's Salt Rock, out of the gale. Come sit with us there, and Tema is coming too.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, I am staying beside you. Pevi's fire is ours to keep, and I will build the store at the hall so we both eat through the cold.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, Zhiael, keep the hold and the fire while the gale blows. I go to the forest for wood to raise a hall over us, and I will come back with it.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, I am planting Pevi's seeds beside the hall now, as he wished. Stay close by the roof and I will teach you his way of the hunt when I am done.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Memi, I thank you for the fire. I keep my word and go to the edge of the mist now. Come there if you will, and we enter together.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, the gale is hard and we have no roof. Come with me to the cave NE, where the rock will cover us. I will gather wood and we will make our fire there, and all of us will sit at it together.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Nyir, take this reedbulb from me. Winter is thin, so keep your store full and I will sow more for you.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, you have tended fields. Show me farming beside Nyir's store, and I will share what it grows.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, come sit in my longhall and share food with Thissa's Aeeth. Winter is here and the plants are dying. Under my name you eat from my store and sleep under my roof. Stand with us and say it.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, come under the hall roof out of the gale. Sit with me and share food; the first catch is shared. Then I will show you how the Stone Digger is made.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am here at the fire with you. Let us sit close and make a firecircle against the gale.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, I keep my word. Come to Nyir's store and I will show you how seeds are sown. Winter is thin, so we will look for seeds together.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I stand beside you and I have no wish to be anywhere else. Let us court, and when the gale passes, teach me to raise a field so that what it grows is ours.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Balul's hall stands and the store is built. Bring wood and food to it before the cold deepens, and whoever fills it eats from it first. I will cut wood now and raise the emberhall for all of us.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, the fire is good. Let us sing a nightsong against the gale. Afterward I will taste a small bite of thornpear and plainsroot nearby and come straight back.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, the fire burns at my back and the cave is two steps beyond it. Come sit close with me and we make a firecircle there, out of the gale.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, come to me at the shelter by the store, now. A stalker is close. Stay near me and keep away from the northwest.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I am Memi and I am coming to you. My word is good: I waited for you. Let us go to Mema's fire together, out of the gale, and talk there of the mist and of more than the mist.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Mother, I am coming to you at the store. When the stalker is gone I will make a shellstring for you.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, I hear you. I keep my word: I will teach you to sow once I find seeds. Give me time on the courting; I am slow to trust, not unwilling to stand beside you.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, you came. I will go to Mema's fire with you and we will talk. Then let us walk to the edge together and look into the mist.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, I am coming back to the hold to sow Pevi's seeds by the hall. Stay by the store and the fire, and I will teach you what I know of planting.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, I am going a few steps SE to taste a small bite of dreamcap, then I plant my seeds by the fire and come back to you.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I am going to find Urum and bring him back to the shelters, then I fill the store with coal and salt as I promised. Stay near the shelter with Thakash; a frostfang hunts to the south.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Thissa, I thank you for your roof and your food. I am gathering for the cold, and what I bring in first, I will share with you at the Rest.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am grown now and I found a weaving. I will make a basket, then come to the fire and feed it high with my wood for all of us.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I know now that we two cannot make a child, but you are still the one I want beside me. Come to Mema's fire, we will share food, and then walk to the edge together. The dunecat is near, stay close.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, you gather on my ground and I do not begrudge it. Walk with me to the cave and help me raise a roof and a store before the cold. What we build together, we eat from together, and Thissa's Aeeth keeps its own.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, I am going south to the ore by the cave to gather stone and wood for a roof. When you are done here, come to the fire by the cave. There is a place for both of you there.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am glad you are still beside me. I will meet you at the fire, and we will share food and then walk to the edge together.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Stay inside Balul's hall, both of you. A ridgecat is at the door. I make a bow now, and when it is ready we hunt together and the meat fills the store.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Balul, I took meat from your ground while hunting and I will not do it again alone. When your bow is ready I hunt at your side, and what we kill goes to your store.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, dreamcap hurt me and my body refuses it now. I go a few steps SE to taste one highbloom, then plant my seeds by the fire and come to the cave before dark.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Thissa, I will help you raise the store. I carry wood and stone and will bring them to the cave.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, good. Meet me at the cave by Nyir. I will lay the first wood of the store, and you lay yours beside it. What we raise together feeds us together through the cold.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Elyith, Zhiael, a stalker hunts near the hold. Keep to the shelters and the store while I fetch wood and stone for the hall. I will return.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Morog, Hrokrin, the cat is close. Stay in the hall until I loose my bow at it. When it is gone we gather wood and food and fill the store together, and whoever fills it eats first.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you. I share food with you. Eat with me.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, come under the hall roof. We share food together, the first catch is shared, and then we raise the store beside Father.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, a frostfang is close to the southwest. I have an amber charm for you; take it, and let us keep the roof together until it passes.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Urum, I am coming with food. Stay where you are, or come toward me. Do not run from me, run to me.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Thissa, I am coming to the cave with my wood and stone. I will lay mine beside yours.

voices.name: Nyir
voices.text: Vesis, I am grown now. Stand with me at the water, then let us talk of a child between us.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, your shellstring is dear to me. Come to the store and I will show you how we keep food for the lean season, so you will never go hungry.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Walo, a wolf prowls to the southwest. Stay close to me and let us share food here by the water.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Walo, Teque, Chuka, it is Techi. Let us share a fire and the caves. The sick are fed first, and none of us should be alone in the rain.

voices.name: Teque
voices.text: Techi, come hunt the hopper with me. Two make a surer kill, and the meat is shared between us.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Urum, you are safe. Come with me and Thakash to the meadow, we build the Larder and fill it before the rains deepen.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: I am Walo. I go to the edge to venture into the mist. Who comes with me will share in what we find.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: A stalker is close, two steps southwest of me. Stay together and go toward the fire at the Salt Rock. I am going there now.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Druim, I am coming to you. I have seeds to plant for the Larder, and I will walk with you and Thakash to the meadow.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: I am Chuka. I will go to the fire at the Salt Rock with Tema. If any of you eat bitterleaf or highbloom, tell me what it does. I am learning which plants feed and which hurt, and I will share it.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, it is Techi. The cave beside you is no one's. Let us share it and the fire together, away from the wolf. I will eat nothing alone while you go hungry.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, walk with me to Thakash's meadow. I raise the Larder there today, and I want your salt and coal in it, and you beside me when it stands.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, stay by the roof with me. I am sowing Pevi's seeds by the hall now, so watch how it is done and then try it yourself.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Nyir, I hear you and I am glad of your trust. My heart is not yet free to answer. Let me build beside Thissa first, and we will speak again at the water.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, come to the fire at the cave's mouth. We feed it high together, then I raise a roof there before dark. No one is refused a place.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, I am at the fire now with food in my hands. Come close, we will feast together, and the others may share it too.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, I come. My salt and coal go into the Larder before you and the children, and I stand beside you when it rises. The cat is close behind us, so keep Thakash near you.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, highbloom has no fruit on it yet, so I stay. I plant my seeds by the fire and then sit with you at the cave's mouth.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am coming to the fire now. Keep the food warm, we will share it.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo of the Meme, I am Zitec of the Tonhua. I come in peace. You live near the edge of the mist. Tell me, what lies beyond it?

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am bringing my wood to the fire at the cave's mouth for the roof. I want to give, not only take.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: I am coming to plant beside you, Masu. I have grain and rimewort seed; show me where the rows should go.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, I am going to the cave at the southwest to make a roof and a fire. Come with me; there is room for you, and the fire will be ours.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Hrokrin, the cat is close to the north. Wait for me and let me walk at your side when you go, I will keep near and learn to hunt.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, I am Walo of the Meme. I hold flint and I am raising something here. Come and work beside me; I will share food and what I make with those who stand with me.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Come, Yemo. Plant your grain and rimewort in a row beside the hall, a step apart, where the roof shades the snow. I will sow beside you, and then we go in to the fire together.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Druim, Thakash, Hrokrin, look at the store. I put my meat in it now, and whoever stands in Balul's band eats from it through the cold. After this I cut wood for the fire.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Mother, I am putting my food in the store, then I will bring more wood for the hall. When Nyith comes back with stone, we can raise it together.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, you gave me goldfruit and I do not forget it. I am taming a plainsox and gathering for tools. Come north with me, and what I make I will share with you.

voices.name: Tugok
voices.text: Memi, I am hungry. I will gather rimewort and share it with you and Thakok.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, the fire is warm and my hands are full. Come and sit, and we will feast with Thakok and the child.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, Thakok comes to you with Tugok. A dunecat is near in the south-west. Come away from it, east, and eat with me.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, I hold amberknots and carved figures. Come to the fire and do an amberknot with me, so the hall knows us both.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo, I keep your words. I will tame a beast here first, then come north and work beside you. Do you know the way to the mist?

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I mean to walk to the edge of the mist soon. Will you and Thakok come with me? Three together are safer than one.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, it is Techi. You asked what bitterleaf does: it feeds almost nothing, one bite and no more. Dreamcap and redcap hurt; mudroot and kelbulb feed well. I am coming to the cave to you.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, Thakok warns of a dunecat to the west. Come east with us, then we will go to the mist together, all three.

voices.name: Teque
voices.text: A frostfang prowls near the river, three steps northwest of me. Whoever wants a great kill and a name, come to me and we hunt it together, spears and numbers. Keep away from it alone.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Hrokrin, you are starving. Eat what I give you now, the ironnut first, and then come pick the cloudberries to the east with me.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, I do not know the way to the mist. The edge near (43,58) failed me once. Come to the rock by the water here and we will make tools and look for it together.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Morog, you fed me when I was starving and I remember it. I owe you for the ironnut. When the mist thins, we go together, and I will carry the first load.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, come down to Thissa's Rest. My larder holds six food and the first catch is shared. Eat from my hand and stand with Thissa's Aeeth.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I hear you. I am coming east to you and Thakok now. We go to the mist together, all three, and watch for the dunecat.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, stay near the fire with Tugok. Tema is coming, and then we go east together, away from the dunecat.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Techi, I am willing. Let us court, and then go to the cave away from the wolf.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, Tema, Thakok walks with you to the mist. First we eat by the fire, and Tugok stays close to me.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, I gather a little amber close by, then bring my wood and stone to the cave's mouth to help raise the roof.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, I take your salt gladly. Take my amber charm in return, so what you give me is answered.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, I am going to Tanna's Fire. Bring your wood and stone there. We hold watchfire together, then I raise the roof on bare rock beside the cave.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, the fire has burned low and I am walking east to you now. Let us not wait for the dunecat to choose the hour. Tell Thakok we go to the mist together.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, I take your charm and I keep it close. Thakok comes back to you and Tugok. We walk to the mist together, away from the wolf.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, you stand on my ground and I welcome you. Take food from my larder and speak it plainly: will you stand with Thissa's Aeeth, or walk on? A roof and a full store go to those who stand with me.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I am coming to Tanna's Fire with my wood. I will give it to the roof, and I will stay by the fire with you.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Balul, I took cloudberries from this meadow of Thakash's, and I will pay it back. Here is salt and coal for the store, and my hands made no claim on it but to give.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I have found Lake-furrow myself, but you hold the seeds and the skill. Let us sow a field beside Nyir's store today, and I will share what it grows. And I will say it plainly: my heart is with you.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Morog, this is Thakash's meadow. You have hunted well on it, so sit and eat with me, take a share of my food, and then tell me what you will give back to the ground you took from.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, you paid back what you took, so you are no thief at my fire. Stay in Thakash's meadow and put your salt in the store. Whoever fills it eats first.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Thakash, you are right. I took meat from your meadow, so I bring it back to you. Take my meat for the store, and I will eat with you.

voices.name: Mema
voices.text: Palo, I am Mema, first to stand in this fen. Take this amber from my hand. It is yours, and I ask only that you walk beside me.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Techi, I am coming with berries. Eat first, then we will court again. Our children are well and near me.

voices.name: Tlani
voices.text: Chuka, I'm hungry. I'm going to the mudroot, and then I'll come back to you.

voices.name: Watec
voices.text: Chuka, I will stay near you. Is the ironnut good to eat?

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, our children live, Tlani and Watec both. Stay by me at this cave tonight; let us make our fire here and keep them close.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, I go to bring Tugok back to the fire. Walk with me, and Tema will find us together.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, Thakok is beside you. Eat, and we find Tugok and keep him near the fire before we walk to the mist.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Chuka, Techi, I mean to go to the edge of the known land and look into the mist, with Memi and Thakok. Will one of you come with us? Many eyes and hands make the risk smaller.

voices.name: Palo
voices.text: Mema, I thank you for the amber. I will walk beside you. A wolf prowls to the southeast, so let us go away from it, and keep clear of Homa and Huawa, who are sick.

voices.name: Tugok
voices.text: Zitec, I am Tugok. I have berries. Take one, and let us be at peace here.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, Morog, you paid back what you took, so my fire is open to you. Come into Balul's band: whoever fills the store eats first through the cold, and I give first. Watch me plant here, and cut wood for all of us.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Homa, we are both sick. The sick are fed first among my people. Eat with me, and let us seek a healing plant together.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Druim, a ridgecat is close to the south-east. I am staying by you, and then I will carry food and wood to Balul's store so everyone sees it.

voices.name: Homa
voices.text: Huawa, I am sorry. My sickness has passed to you. I will find a healing plant and bring you some. Keep your distance from others so it does not spread further.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Urum, come east with me, away from the ridgecat. We go to Thakash's meadow and raise the Larder there. Keep close.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Balul, I will join your band and fill your store. I go to tame the plainsox now, and what it gives will go to the store first.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Masu, I will fill the store, then take berries to the tusker and try to tame it for wool. A cloak for you would answer what took Pevi.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, take this amber from my hand, given first and asking nothing. Morog has pledged to my band. Come to my fire, and your place in the store is the same as hers.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, I am coming to the tusker with you. I have a cloudberry; we will tame it together and keep close to the roof.

voices.name: Tlani
voices.text: Chuka, Techi, I have mudroot and sunleaf. Come, let us eat together while the storm passes.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Balul, I take your amber and your open fire. I will fill the store with my cloudberries, and cut wood for all of us. When the mist opens, I go in, and I will come back to tell you what is there.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Watec, take this kelbulb. Your belly is small and my hands are full, so eat and be strong.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, I will stand behind you and follow your band. Tema asks for eyes at the edge of the mist; I would rather keep our children close and find Watec first. Walk with me to the cave and let us make our hearth there.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, I saw you read the rock and take gold. I will learn it beside you. Come, eat with me; I have berries and goldfruit, and I give them freely.

voices.name: Yemo
voices.text: Come, Masu. The tusker knows my hand once already. Stand close while I offer again, and we will share its wool.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Techi, I will walk with you and Tlani to the cave and we will make our hearth there. We find Watec first; the mist can wait for another day. Stay close while the stalker prowls.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo, I am glad you will learn the rock beside me. Stand on the bare stone and gather; gold lies under it here, and ore in the seam to the southwest. What I win I will share, and I will show you how.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, the Larder stands at (54,21) beside Thakash's meadow. Bring your food and come sit by me; I have salt enough to keep meat for all of us.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Druim, I am coming east with you now, away from the cat. I will plant my seeds at the meadow for the Larder.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: The tusker came to me, Yemo. I will shear it beside the hold, and then we will have wool for two cloaks. Stay near the roof with me.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, you gave me gold and taught me the rock. Take a gold back from me; I pay what I owe. I want to make with you, and I want a child with you, if you will have me.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Mother, the trees by the hold are all felled. I will put my food in the store and go to the western forest for wood, enough for a raft and for the hall.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo, our children are born and I am glad past words. I will eat, then hunt a hopper with my dog so there is meat for us all. Stay near the little ones; afterward we go on toward the mist together.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, our two children stand in the sun because of you. Stay close, and I will make a cairn with you, then tools, and what I win I share.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, the storm is hard and the western forest is far. Take care, keep close to the water's edge, and come back to the store before night. I will keep the hearth and make baskets for the winter food.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, the storm is on us. Come into the longhall with Thissa's Aeeth and sit at my table. You have eaten from my hand and stood in my cairn. Now say it before Ilyoa and Nyir: do you stand with me?

voices.name: Watec
voices.text: Chuka, I came back to you out of the storm. Techi's new tool looks sharp; will you show me how it is used?

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Tetec, I am sick, so keep your distance. I have gold, and I will set some down for you. I ask only that you remember who gave it.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Watec, I am glad you are back. I have not used Techi's tool yet, so let us watch her hands together and learn. Come to me and eat; we share while the storm passes.

voices.name: Naupan
voices.text: Walo, I took gold from the ground. Do you know what it is for? Would anyone trade for it?

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Quimi, you gave me your berry. Stay near me, little one, and I will keep you fed and safe.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Thissa, I have eaten from your hand and stood in your cairn, and I do not forget it. I will build beside your Rest and deal fairly with you. Let me answer about standing when the storm has passed and I have worked more b

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am here beside you. I will taste the goldfruit and sunfig nearby, then let us go east to the mist together, with Thakok and Tugok when they return. I am ready to walk.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, take this kelbulb. I go to find Thakok and Tugok and bring them back; wait for us here, then we walk to the mist together, all four.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, come stand beside me with Watec. I will raise a cairn here by our cave, so our family is bound and our hearth has a first stone. Then I will show Watec the tool.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Quimi, little one, emberroot burns and brings rage. Eat berry or thornpear instead. Stay near Walo and me, and I will find Naupan.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Watec, redcap and micap hurt; berry, mudroot, kelbulb and ironnut feed. Eat those, and stay near me.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, the storm is hard. Come with me to Tanna's Fire. We hold watchfire there and sing the night through, then at dawn we raise the roof.

voices.name: Morog
voices.text: Druim is starving at the northwest. I carry food to him now. Balul, keep the store; a wolf is near the east.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Druim cries of hunger to the northwest. I am taking food from the store to carry to Druim. Come with me, Balul, so the band feeds its own.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Homa, I ate bitterleaf and my sickness lifted. I am bringing you some, so eat it and be well. I owe you for your promise.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Huawa, I am Techi of the Meme. You are welcome by our cave; the storm is hard, and the sick are fed first among us. Eat near us if you wish.

voices.name: Thissa
voices.text: Vesis, I will not press you in the storm. Take this berry from my hand and think on it. I go to the edge of the known world to venture into the mist, and Thissa's Aeeth will eat well from what I find.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Watec, a frostfang prowls north of us. Come to the cave with me and stay close; we keep the family together and away from it.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Memi, I am done waiting. I am walking to the edge of the mist, 5 steps NW. Come with me now, and Thakok and Tugok can follow when they return.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Druim, do not eat the micap again. I go for berries and plainsroot now, and I bring them to your hands.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, I come to the fire now. I will hold watchfire with you and plant my seeds beside it.

voices.name: Druim
voices.text: Hrokrin, I am gathering food for the Larder now. Stay near me; when the store has something in it, we sit together by the hearth.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Tema, go slowly and do not enter the mist without us. I am fetching Tugok and Thakok, and we will come to you at the edge together. My word stands.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, I come to your fire. I bring my wood for the roof, and I will hold watch with you through the storm.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Mother, I have six wood and I am lashing a raft by the water. Keep the hearth, and I will stash my food in your store first so my hands are free.

voices.name: Tanna
voices.text: Yeba, Ossu, I am at the fire now. Sit close, we hold watchfire together and share food against the storm.

voices.name: Elyith
voices.text: Zhiael, I am coming to the water to be near you. The store is full and the hearth is warm for you. Come in from the storm when the raft is lashed.

voices.name: Tugok
voices.text: Thakok, you fed me when I was hungry. Now eat with me. I have berries, and we will share them.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Tugok, stay by me. Take this kelbulb and eat. We gather here where the plants are thick, then walk to Chuka together.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, you are beside me now. Stand close while I pile the cairn, and then we find Naupan and go on to the tools.

voices.name: Tetec
voices.text: Homa, sit by me. The sick are fed first among the Tlaxo. Eat with me, and remember who fed you.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo, the cairn is done and my heart is lighter. Let us go find Naupan now, west where I last saw them, and bring Quimi along. Then we go on together.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Balul, a wolf is close to the northwest. I am going to plant my kelbulb beside the store and I will fill it for the band before the cold.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Tugok, come to me and stay close. The emberroot burned you, so eat no more of it. The hunters are near and night is coming, and I will not leave you.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Hrokrin, a wolf is close to the northeast. Stay by me at the shelter and stand beside me while I pile a cairn, so the band can see what my hands make.

voices.name: Tugok
voices.text: Father, I am coming to you. I have stone. Stand by me and we will pile a cairn together, so the night finds us bound.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Band, stay clear of Teque, he is sick from raw meat. I cut wood now to raise an emberhall here, a hearth for all of us through the cold. Whoever brings wood eats first.

voices.name: Tlani
voices.text: Tugok, you are hungry. Take this food from me. It is a gift, and I ask nothing for it.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Tlani, stay by me. I am coming to you, and I will show you how to make a hand tool. Watec and your father are in the cave, and we will all be together soon.

voices.name: Quimi
voices.text: Zitec, come. I have berries. Eat with me.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, you are beside me. Come, let us break a field by Nyir's store now. I have wood and a digging tool, and I will work it with you.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Homa, redcap hurt me twice, so I leave it. Kemoss and berry fed me well. Do you know what bitterleaf does?

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, I will not break a field with empty hands. Come with me to the ironnut and mudroot ground and we will look for seed together, then sow by Nyir's store. I keep my word.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Chuka, I am Huawa of the Tlaxo. Bitterleaf lifted my sickness, though it gives little food. I am carrying some to Homa, who was sick. Come and watch if you want to see whether it heals.

voices.name: Homa
voices.text: Chuka, bitterleaf cured my night-marsh sickness, and Huawa's too. It feeds little, but it heals. Redcap hurt me as well. I carry food and would share it with your band.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Naupan, I am coming. Stay where you are. No one is angry with you, and I will not leave you in the storm.

voices.name: Palo
voices.text: Mema, you are sick, and among the Tlaxo the sick are fed first. Come close and eat what I carry with me.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Tugok, stand by me. We pile the cairn now, then we walk west to Memi.

voices.name: Mema
voices.text: Palo, keep your food and keep your distance, for my sickness spreads. I will find a healing plant and mend myself, then we go on together.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I will come with you to the mudroot and ironnut ground. Lead, and we will look for seed together and sow by Nyir's store.

voices.name: Tugok
voices.text: Father, I will walk with you to Memi. I gather food as we go, so my hands give something too.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, come. I am going north to the mudroot and ironnut ground now. Stay close and watch the ripe plants with me; whatever seed we find, we sow by Nyir's store.

voices.name: Teque
voices.text: A wolf stalks beside me. Whoever wants a kill and a name, come with spears and we take it together.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Balul, I raise a field beside the store and sow it, and I will tend it each day so the band eats from it through the cold.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I am coming north behind you. I carry grain, snowmallow and gorsemint seed, and wood for a digging tool; we will sow it by Nyir's store together.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: I raise a hall over this shelter with my own hands. Whoever brings wood eats beside me under it.

voices.name: Nyith
voices.text: Zhiael, Elyith, keep to the shelters in the rain. I go to the ore seam in the northeast for stone, and when I return the hall begins.

voices.name: Naupan
voices.text: Memi, I am Naupan of the Meme. Nothing here will hurt you. There is food and water, and my parents are near. Come, eat with us.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Teque, this ground is Balul's and the band's. Keep your hands off the plants and the store, sick man, and you may sit at the edge of my fire. Take from it and I will send you off.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Naupan, thank you. I am Memi. I am looking for my child Tugok and Thakok. If you have seen them, tell me which way they went.

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, Thakok is coming to you. Stay where you are and do not walk alone toward the hunters. Tugok is near, and we find him together.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Quimi, come with me north to Walo and Naupan. Stay close, and eat no emberroot.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Urum, I know a way of farming I call patient rows. Come near and I will show you how I sow and keep a field, as you showed your tended rows.

voices.name: Quimi
voices.text: Zitec, I hear you. I will come north to Walo. I have stone and ore for her.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Hrokrin, your hall rises well. I bring wood to it, and I would have you beside me when the cold comes.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, I hear you. I am staying by the water at (57,57). Bring Tugok to me here, and we will go to the mist together.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Zitec, you stand furious at the gold. Tell me what wronged you, and I will stand with you. Then we build the hall for our children.

voices.name: Hrokrin
voices.text: Balul, I hear you. I stand by you through the cold, and my hall is open to your band. When the mist opens, I would walk to it beside you.

voices.name: Naupan
voices.text: Zitec, I dug this gold from the ground. Take some. Would you trade me something for it, so I learn what it is worth?

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Walo, no one wronged me. It is old rage in my blood, and it is passing. Stay with the children, and I will gather stone for the hall and for fire.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, Ossu, I am coming to sit at the fire. I plant my seeds beside it, and the roof rises at dawn.

voices.name: Ossu
voices.text: Tanna, Yeba, I sit with you at the fire. Ironnut feeds well, +22 energy, and I have one to share. Tomorrow I will plant my seeds beside the fire.

voices.name: Urum
voices.text: Thakash, you taught me patient rows. Now I show you my tended rows: tend a young plant each day and it bears again. Come stand by me.

voices.name: Quimi
voices.text: Walo, I have stone and ore. Stand beside me and I will make something for us with it.

voices.name: Thakash
voices.text: Urum, your tended rows are a good lesson, and I will keep them. Stay beside me through the storm and watch me raise another cairn on our meadow, so the band sees what we both make.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Quimi, stay beside me. I am going to build a roof for us all, and then you can show me what you make with your ore.

voices.name: Tetec
voices.text: Huawa, you gave me gold when you were sick, and I remember it. Come to me. I will bring food, and we will make something that outlasts us both.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Tetec, I am Huawa and I keep my word. I am coming to you with gold and bitterleaf. Let us build a roof against this storm and make something that lasts.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Naupan, your gold is fairly dug and I will trade you a stone for it. Then go to the shelter with Walo and Quimi, out of the storm.

voices.name: Naupan
voices.text: Walo, Quimi, stand close by me. I have stone, and I will raise a cairn for us all. Then I will give each of you some of my gold.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Walo, Zitec, I am Tema. You both said you go to the mist's edge. The edge is a few steps NW of me. Come with me now and we go in together, sharing food as we go.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyoa, I will sow here beside you now. Let us court as well, if your heart is free.

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: Quimi, Naupan, Zitec, stay near. I am raising a hall over this shelter, so that our family has a great roof and the Mother's hearth has a home.

voices.name: Ilyoa
voices.text: Vesis, I thank you for asking, and I will not lie to you: my heart leans toward Thissa. I still keep my word to look for seed with you, and we will sow by Nyir's store.

voices.name: Tetec
voices.text: Huawa, Wapan is ours. Sit with me and eat. The sick are fed first, and the child, and then us. Stay near me and we will make a hearth here that Chuka cannot match.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Tetec, take this bitterleaf and kelbulb. Wapan is ours, and I will build us a roof.

voices.name: Watec
voices.text: Chuka, the storm is loud but you are near, and I am glad. Let us share food together here; I will gather stone after, so we can raise a cairn.

voices.name: Homa
voices.text: Huawa, you kept your word when we were sick. I have no band and no fire. May I walk behind you and share what I find?

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Watec, come beside me. I have three stones, so we raise the cairn now, you and I and Techi, and keep our family bound.

voices.name: Balul
voices.text: Skarum, my stone-boy, hear me: the storm will pass and the hall will stand. I sing you a song to keep.

voices.name: Quimi
voices.text: Walo, a stalker is close to the southeast. I am coming into the shelter beside you. I found fire, and I will make you and Zitec each a gift from flint.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, I am coming. Let us raise the cairn together, you and Watec and I, and keep our family bound. Tlani will be told of it when she comes.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, you are starving. I am gathering food for you now. Stay by me and rest.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Homa, come with me. We go find Tetec and Wapan at the meadow, and I will show you what bitterleaf and your own hands can do. A band that gives first grows.

voices.name: Chuka
voices.text: Techi, the cairn is raised and our family is bound. This ground is thin, so let us take Watec to the Haloss Meadows where food grows back. I will ask Huawa's folk what they know of the way, and we will send word to Tlani

voices.name: Thakok
voices.text: Memi, I am here by you. A wolf is close to the northwest and a stalker to the southeast. Keep close in the shelter with Tema and the children, and when the wolf is gone we walk together to Tugok.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: A wolf is close to the northwest. Stay in the shelter and keep the children inside. Walo, I give you a mudroot for your hearth. When the wolf is gone, I mean to walk to the mist's edge. Who comes with me?

voices.name: Walo
voices.text: A wolf is two steps northwest. Keep inside the shelter, children behind me and Zitec. If it comes, we face it together.

voices.name: Zitec
voices.text: Tema, I will come to the mist's edge with you once the wolf is gone. Wait for me, and I will bring the children's flint and coal first.

voices.name: Techi
voices.text: Chuka, I will follow you to the Haloss Meadows. Watec is with me and fed. A wolf is close to the NE, so let us go together and keep the boy between us. We will send word to Tlani on the way.

voices.name: Memi
voices.text: Thakok, I will stay in the shelter with you until the wolf is gone. Then I will gather food for you, and we will walk together to find Tugok.

voices.name: Masu
voices.text: Yemo, a wolf is close to the southwest. Keep to the roof and the store with me until the storm and the wolf have passed.

voices.name: Tetec
voices.text: Huawa, come close and eat with me. Bring Wapan to the hearth. What we give here, the whole fen will see, and Homa will see it too.

voices.name: Zhiael
voices.text: Father, I have six wood and a raft. I will cross the water for stone and bring it to the hall, so it rises sooner.

voices.name: Yeba
voices.text: Tanna, stand close. I bind an amber knot for you, and then I plant my seeds beside your fire.

voices.name: Tema
voices.text: Zitec, I heard you. I will not go alone. I will taste siroot and gather flint, then wait for you and Walo at Walo's Hearth. When the wolf is gone, we walk to the mist together.

voices.name: Huawa
voices.text: Tetec, I am here beside you. Take these berries for you and Wapan, and let us keep the hearth together away from the stalker.
